/*RZ990206*/
/*RZ990520- Add check pordIsFixed*/
/*RZ990818- Add sum of tax,discount,price before tax*/
/*NKR14020727- Add Validity Fields*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ApispInsertPreOrderItems]
/*
	exec ApispInsertPreOrderItems 								
*/
(
/*PreOrder*/
@PreOrderId INT = NULL,
@PordNumber BIGINT = NULL,
/*PreOrder Item*/
@PordIPrdId INT = NULL,
@PordIPrdCode NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@PordIQuantity FLOAT,
@PordIPrice Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordITotalPrice Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIDescription NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL,
@PordIQuantityDesc NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL,
@PordIDiscount Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIDiscountI Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIDiscountPercent Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIDiscountIPercent Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIPrdUnitId INT = NULL,
@PordICurrencyUnitId INT = NULL,
@PordIOrderView INT = NULL,
@PordIFCR FLOAT = NULL,
@PordITax Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordITaxIndex Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordICalculateTax BIT = NULL,
@PordINotVisible BIT = NULL,
@PordIFCRI FLOAT = NULL,
@PordINotInSum BIT = NULL,
@PordIWHId INT = NULL,
@PordIRound Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIRoundPlus Numeric(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordIPrdPriceGroupId INT = NULL,
/*RZ990818- Add sum of tax,discount,price before tax*/
@PordITracing NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
/*RZ990818- End*/
/**/
@UserId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType VARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT = NULL, 
/**/
@InsertedPreOrderItemId INT OUTPUT,
@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT,
/*NKR14020727- Start*/
@PordIValidityExpireDate DATETIME = NULL,
@PordIValidityExpireDatePersian NVARCHAR(8) = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryTermId INT = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryDate DATETIME = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryDatePersian NVARCHAR(8) = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryTime NVARCHAR(10) = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryDay NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryEndDate DATETIME = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryEndDatePersian NVARCHAR(8) = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryEndTime NVARCHAR(10) = NULL,
@PordIDeliveryEndDay NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
/*NKR14020727- End*/
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/********************************************************************************/
/****************************** TRANSACTION *************************************/
/********************************************************************************/
BEGIN TRANSACTION Main
/**/
/********************************************************************************/
/**********************************Default LanguageID ***************************/
DECLARE @DefaultLanguageID INT 
SET @DefaultLanguageID = (SELECT TOP 1 [DefaultLanguageID] FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting])

/********************************************************************************/
/************************************ Year1 => FPId *****************************/
DECLARE @FPId INT
SET @FPId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ID] FROM [dbo].[WSFinancialPeriod] ORDER BY [ID] DESC)
/********************************************************************************/
/****************************** Error & Variables *******************************/
DECLARE @ErrorFrom VARCHAR(50), @ErrorNumber INT
/********************************************************************************/
/********************************* Check fields *********************************/
/********************************************************************************/
/*PreOrder*/
IF(ISNULL(@PreOrderId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	SET @PreOrderId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] WHERE [PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId)
END
ELSE IF (ISNULL(@PordNumber,0) <> 0)
BEGIN
	SET @PreOrderId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] WHERE [pordNumber] = @PordNumber)
END
IF(ISNULL(@PreOrderId,0) <= 0)
	SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordId|'
/*Product*/
IF(@PordIPrdId IS NOT NULL AND @PordIPrdId > 0)
BEGIN
	SET @PordIPrdId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ProductID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] WHERE [ProductID] = @PordIPrdId)
END
ELSE IF (ISNULL(@PordIPrdCode,'') <> '')
BEGIN
	SET @PordIPrdId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ProductID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] WHERE [PrdCode] = @PordIPrdCode)
END
IF(ISNULL(@PordIPrdId,0) <= 0)
	SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PrdId|'
/*PordIPrdUnitId*/
IF(ISNULL(@PordIPrdUnitId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	IF((SELECT TOP 1 [ProductUnitID] FROM [dbo].[WSProductUnits] WHERE [ProductUnitID] = @PordIPrdUnitId) IS NULL)
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordIPrdUnitId|'
END
/*PordICurrencyUnitId*/
IF(ISNULL(@PordICurrencyUnitId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	IF((SELECT TOP 1 [CurrencyUnitID] FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = @PordICurrencyUnitId) IS NULL)
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordICurrencyUnitId|'
END
/*PordIWHId*/
IF(ISNULL(@PordIWHId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	IF((SELECT TOP 1 [WareHouseID] FROM [dbo].[WsWareHouse] WHERE [WareHouseID] = @PordIWHId) IS NULL)
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordIWHId|'
END
ELSE 
	SET @PordIWHId = (SELECT TOP 1 [WareHouseID] FROM [dbo].[WsWareHouse] WHERE ISNULL([WrhsDeActive],0) = 1)
/*PordIPrdPriceGroupId*/
IF(ISNULL(@PordIPrdPriceGroupId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	IF((SELECT TOP 1 [ProductPriceGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProductPriceGroup] WHERE [ProductPriceGroupID] = @PordIPrdPriceGroupId) IS NULL)
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordIPrdPriceGroupId|'
END
ELSE 
BEGIN
/**/
	SET @PordIPrdPriceGroupId = (SELECT TOP 1 ProductPriceGroupId 
												FROM dbo.WSProductPrice PP
												WHERE PP.PrdId = @PordIPrdId AND PP.Price = @PordIPrice)
	IF(ISNULL(@PordIPrdPriceGroupId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @PordIPrdPriceGroupId = (SELECT TOP 1 ProductPriceGroupId 
									FROM dbo.WSProductPriceGroup PP
									ORDER BY PP.OrderView)													
	/**/
	END
/**/
END

/*RZ990520- Add check pordIsFixed*/
DECLARE @IsFixed BIT
SET @IsFixed = (SELECT TOP 1 pordIsFixed FROM dbo.WSPreOrder WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId)
IF(ISNULL(@IsFixed,0) = 1)
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'IsFixed|'
END
/*RZ990520- End*/
/********************************************************************************/
/******************** Insert PreOrder Items *************************************/
/********************************************************************************/
BEGIN TRY  
    IF(@ErrorMessage IS NULL OR @ErrorMessage = '')/*No Error*/
	BEGIN		
		/*======================== Order Item ==========================*/		
		BEGIN TRAN
			/*=============== Discount =================*/
			IF(ISNULL(@PordIDiscount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@PordIDiscountPercent,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@PordIPrice,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @PordIDiscount = (ISNULL(@PordIPrice,0) * ISNULL(@PordIDiscountPercent,0)) / 100
			END	
			IF(ISNULL(@PordIDiscount,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@PordIDiscountPercent,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@PordIPrice,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @PordIDiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@PordIDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@PordIPrice,0)
			END						
			/*=============== Calculate ================*/
			DECLARE @TmpI NUMERIC(18,2) = 0, @TmpII NUMERIC(18,2) = 0, 
			@TotalPrice NUMERIC(18,2) = 0
			/*Tmp = Quantity * FCR * FCRI*/
			SET @TmpI = @PordIQuantity * ISNULL(@PordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@PordIFCRI,1)
			/*TempII = price - discount - round + roundPlus*/
			SET @TmpII = ISNULL(@PordIPrice,0) - ISNULL(@PordIDiscount,0) - ISNULL(@PordIRound,0) + ISNULL(@PordIRoundPlus,0)/*- 0 - 0 + 0 */

			/*=============== Tax =================*/
			/*RZ990818*/
			IF(ISNULL(@PordITax,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@PordITaxIndex,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@TmpII,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @PordITax = (ISNULL(@TmpII,0) * ISNULL(@PordITaxIndex,0)) / 100
			END	
			IF(ISNULL(@PordITax,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@PordITaxIndex,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TmpII,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @PordITaxIndex = (ISNULL(@PordITax,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TmpII,0)
			END			
			/*RZ990818-End*/
			/*===================================*/
			/*TotalPrice = (@TmpI * @TmpII) + (@TmpI * tax)*/
			SET @TotalPrice = (@TmpI * @TmpII) + (@TmpI * ISNULL(@PordITax,0))/*RZ990818*/
			IF(@pordITotalPrice IS NULL )
				SET @pordITotalPrice = @TotalPrice
			/**********************************************************/				
			/*Set OrderView*/
			IF(@PordIOrderView IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @ItemCount INT
				SET @ItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] OI WHERE OI.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)
				SET @PordIOrderView = (@ItemCount + 1) + (@ItemCount * 4 ) - 1		
			END
			/**********************************************************/
			/*RZ990818- Add sum of tax,discount,price before tax*/
			DECLARE @PordIPriceSum Numeric(18, 2) = 0,
			@PordIDiscountSum Numeric(18, 2) = 0,			
			@PordITaxSum Numeric(18, 2) = 0

			SET @PordIPriceSum = (@TmpI * @TmpII)
			SET @PordIDiscountSum = ISNULL(@PordIDiscount,0) * @TmpI
			SET @PordITaxSum = ISNULL(@PordITax,0) * @TmpI
			/*RZ990818- End*/			
			/**********************************************************/
			/*Main table*/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems]
				([PreOrderId]
				,[pordIPrdId]
				,[pordIQuantity]
				,[pordIPrice]
				,[pordITotalPrice]
				,[pordIDescription]
				,[UserId]
				,[FPId]
				,[Month1]
				,[RegisterDate]
				,[RegisterDatePersian]
				,[pordIQuantityDesc]
				,[pordIDiscount]
				,[pordIDiscountI]
				,[pordIDiscountPercent]
				,[pordIDiscountIPercent]
				,[pordIPrdUnitId]
				,[pordICurrencyUnitId]
				,[pordIOrderView]
				,[pordIFCR]
				,[pordITax]
				,[pordITaxIndex]
				,[pordICalculateTax]
				,[pordINotVisible]
				,[pordIFCRI]
				,[pordINotInSum]
				,[pordIWHId]
				,[pordIRound]
				,[AppType]
				,[LanguageID]
				,[FirstRegisterUserId]
				,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
				,[FirstRegisterDate]
				,[pordIRoundPlus]
				,[pordIPrdPriceGroupID]
				/*RZ990818- Add sum of tax,discount,price before tax*/
				,[pordITracing]
				,[pordIPriceSum]
				,[pordIDiscountSum]				
				,[pordITaxSum]
				/*RZ990818- End*/
				/*NKR14020727- Start*/
				,[pordIValidityExpireDate]
				,[pordIValidityExpireDatePersian]
				,[pordIDeliveryTermId]
				,[pordIDeliveryDate]
				,[pordIDeliveryDatePersian]
				,[pordIDeliveryTime]
				,[pordIDeliveryDay]
				,[pordIDeliveryEndDate]
				,[pordIDeliveryEndDatePersian]
				,[pordIDeliveryEndTime]
				,[pordIDeliveryEndDay]
				/*NKR14020727- End*/)
			VALUES
				(@PreOrderId
				,@PordIPrdId
				,@PordIQuantity
				,@PordIPrice
				,@PordITotalPrice
				,@PordIDescription
				,@UserId
				,@FPId
				,@Month1
				,@RegisterDate
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@PordIQuantityDesc
				,@PordIDiscount
				,@PordIDiscountI
				,@PordIDiscountPercent
				,@PordIDiscountIPercent
				,@PordIPrdUnitId
				,@PordICurrencyUnitId
				,@PordIOrderView
				,@PordIFCR
				,@PordITax
				,@PordITaxIndex
				,@PordICalculateTax
				,@PordINotVisible
				,@PordIFCRI
				,@PordINotInSum
				,@PordIWHId
				,@PordIRound
				,@AppType
				,@DefaultLanguageID
				,@UserId
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@RegisterDate
				,@PordIRoundPlus
				,@PordIPrdPriceGroupID
				/*RZ990818- Add sum of tax,discount,price before tax*/
				,@PordITracing
				,@pordIPriceSum
				,@pordIDiscountSum				
				,@pordITaxSum
				/*RZ990818- End*/
				/*NKR14020727- Start*/
				,@PordIValidityExpireDate
				,@PordIValidityExpireDatePersian
				,@PordIDeliveryTermId
				,@PordIDeliveryDate
				,@PordIDeliveryDatePersian
				,@PordIDeliveryTime
				,@PordIDeliveryDay
				,@PordIDeliveryEndDate
				,@PordIDeliveryEndDatePersian
				,@PordIDeliveryEndTime
				,@PordIDeliveryEndDay
				/*NKR14020727- End*/)
			/**/
			SET @InsertedPreOrderItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()			
			/*********** Insert to lang table ***********/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems_Lang]
				([PreOrderItemID]
				,[LanguageID]
				,[pordIDescription]
				,[pordIQuantityDesc])
			SELECT
				 @InsertedPreOrderItemId
				,LN.LanguageID
				,@PordIDescription
				,@PordIQuantityDesc
			FROM dbo.Languages LN 
			WHERE LN.LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID	
			AND ISNULL(LN.IsActive,0) = 1

		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN SET @ErrorFrom='Error In Insert PreOrderItem' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 				
		/*==================== PreOrderItemSpecification ===============*/
		EXEC [dbo].[ApispInsertPreOrderItemSpecificationAll]
		@PrdId = @PordIPrdId,
		@PreOrderItemId = @InsertedPreOrderItemId,
		@UserId = @UserId,
		@Month1 = @Month1,
		@FPId = @FPId,
		@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
		@AppType = @AppType,
		@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID						
		/*=========================== Calculate PreOrder ====================*/		
		EXEC [dbo].[ApispCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmounts] 	@PreOrderId, @Month1, @LanguageID, @DefaultLanguageID				
		/**/
	END
	/**/	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
	SELECT 1

END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	 /*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/
	 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
     SET @InsertedPreOrderItemId = 0	 
	 SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error|'
	 IF(ISNULL(@ErrorFrom,'') <> '')
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + @ErrorFrom
 	 SELECT 0	 
END CATCH  	
/********************************************************************************/
/**/
END

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[ApispInsertPreOrderItemSpecification]
/*
	exec ApispInsertPreOrderItemSpecification 								
*/
(
@PreOrderItemId INT,
@Specification NVARCHAR(300),
@SpecificationI NVARCHAR(300) = NULL,
@SpecificationII NVARCHAR(300) = NULL,	
/**/
@UserId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType VARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT = NULL, 
/**/
@InsertedPreOrderItemSpcflId INT OUTPUT,
@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/********************************************************************************/
/****************************** TRANSACTION *************************************/

BEGIN TRANSACTION Main
/**/
/********************************************************************************/
/**********************************Default LanguageID ***************************/

/********************************************************************************/

SET @FPId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ID] FROM [dbo].[WSFinancialPeriod] ORDER BY [ID] DESC)

DECLARE @ErrorFrom VARCHAR(50), @ErrorNumber INT

	SET @PreOrderItemId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderItemID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] WHERE [PreOrderItemID] = @PreOrderItemId)

IF(ISNULL(@PreOrderItemId,0) <= 0)
	SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordItemId|'

/*RZ990520- Add check pordIsFixed*/

						(SELECT TOP 1 PreOrderId FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems WHERE PreOrderItemID = @PreOrderItemID))

				,@SpecificationII
				,@AppType
				,@DefaultLanguageID
				,@UserId
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@RegisterDate)
			/**/
			SET @InsertedPreOrderItemSpcflId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()			
			/*********** Insert to lang table ***********/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderItemSpecification_Lang]
				([PreOrderItemSpcflID]

				,[SpecificationI]
				,[SpecificationII])

				,@SpecificationI
				,@SpecificationII

		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN SET @ErrorFrom='Error In Insert PreOrderItem' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 									
		/**/
	END
	/**/	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
	SELECT 1

END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	 /*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/

     SET @InsertedPreOrderItemSpcflId = 0

		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + @ErrorFrom
 	 SELECT 0

/*RZ990206*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[ApispInsertPreOrderPayments]
/*
	exec ApispInsertPreOrderPayments 								
*/
(
/*PreOrder*/
@PreOrderId INT = NULL,
@PordNumber BIGINT = NULL,
/*PreOrder Payment*/
@PordpayTypeId INT = NULL,
@PordpayDocId INT = NULL,
@PordpayDocTypeId INT = NULL,
@PordpayAmount NUMERIC(18, 2),
@PordpayDocNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@PordpayDocDate NVARCHAR(8) = NULL,
@PordpayDocDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@PordpayDocAmount NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@PordpayDescription NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL,
/**/
@UserId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType VARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT = NULL, 
/**/
@InsertedPreOrderPaymentId INT OUTPUT,
@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/********************************************************************************/
/****************************** TRANSACTION *************************************/
/********************************************************************************/
BEGIN TRANSACTION Main
/**/
/********************************************************************************/
/**********************************Default LanguageID ***************************/
DECLARE @DefaultLanguageID INT 
SET @DefaultLanguageID = (SELECT TOP 1 [DefaultLanguageID] FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting])

/********************************************************************************/
/************************************ Year1 => FPId *****************************/
DECLARE @FPId INT
SET @FPId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ID] FROM [dbo].[WSFinancialPeriod] ORDER BY [ID] DESC)
/********************************************************************************/
/****************************** Error & Variables *******************************/
DECLARE @ErrorFrom VARCHAR(50), @ErrorNumber INT
/********************************************************************************/
/********************************* Check fields *********************************/
/********************************************************************************/
/*PreOrder*/
IF(ISNULL(@PreOrderId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	SET @PreOrderId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] WHERE [PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId)
END
ELSE IF (ISNULL(@PordNumber,0) <> 0)
BEGIN
	SET @PreOrderId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] WHERE [pordNumber] = @PordNumber)
END
IF(ISNULL(@PreOrderId,0) <= 0)
	SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordId|'
/*PordpayTypeId*/
IF(ISNULL(@PordpayTypeId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
	IF((SELECT TOP 1 [OrderPaymentTypeId] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderPaymentTypes] WHERE [OrderPaymentTypeId] = @PordpayTypeId) IS NULL)
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PordpayTypeId|'
END
ELSE
	SET @PordpayTypeId = (SELECT TOP 1 [OrderPaymentTypeId] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderPaymentTypes] ORDER BY OrderView)
/*PordpayDocDate*/
IF(@PordpayDocDateTime IS NULL)
BEGIN
	SET @PordpayDocDateTime = @RegisterDate
	SET @PordpayDocDate = @RegisterDatePersian
END	
/**/
IF(ISNULL(@PordpayDocAmount,0) = 0)
BEGIN
	SET @PordpayDocAmount = @PordpayAmount
END
/********************************************************************************/
/******************** Insert PreOrder Payments *************************************/
/********************************************************************************/
BEGIN TRY  
    IF(@ErrorMessage IS NULL OR @ErrorMessage = '')/*No Error*/
	BEGIN		
		/*======================== PreOrder Paymant ==========================*/		
		BEGIN TRAN			
			/*Main table*/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderPayments]
				([ImportDate]
				,[pordpayTypeId]
				,[pordpayPreOrderId]
				,[pordpayDocId]
				,[pordpayDocTypeId]
				,[pordpayAmount]
				,[pordpayDocNumber]
				,[pordpayDocDate]
				,[pordpayDocAmount]
				,[pordpayDescription]

			VALUES

				,@PordpayDocTypeId
				,@PordpayAmount

				,@PordpayDocDate
				,@PordpayDocAmount

				,@Month1
				,@RegisterDate
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@RegisterDate
				,@PordpayDocDateTime				
				,@AppType
				,@DefaultLanguageID
				,@UserId
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@RegisterDate)
			/**/
			SET @InsertedPreOrderPaymentId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()			
			/*********** Insert to lang table ***********/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderPayments_Lang]
				([PreOrderPaymentId]
				,[LanguageID]
				,[pordpayDescription])
			SELECT
				 @InsertedPreOrderPaymentId
				,LN.LanguageID
				,@PordpayDescription
			FROM dbo.Languages LN 
			WHERE LN.LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID	
			AND ISNULL(LN.IsActive,0) = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN SET @ErrorFrom='Error In Insert PreOrderPayment' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 							
		/*=========================== Calculate PreOrder ====================*/		
		EXEC [dbo].[ApispCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmounts] 	@PreOrderId, @Month1, @LanguageID, @DefaultLanguageID		
		/**/
	END
	/**/	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
	SELECT 1

END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	 /*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/
	 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
     SET @InsertedPreOrderPaymentId = 0	 
	 SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error|'
	 IF(ISNULL(@ErrorFrom,'')  <> '')
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + @ErrorFrom
 	 SELECT 0	 
END CATCH

END

		/*======================= End Insert Doc Item ========================*/
		/**/
	END /* END = IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') = '') */
	/*==============================*/
	IF((ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'' ) <> ''))
	BEGIN
	/**/
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
 		SELECT 1
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF((ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'' ) = ''))
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SELECT 1
	/**/
	END
	
	/*===========================*/
	IF (@ErrorNumber > 0 OR (ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'' ) <> ''))
	BEGIN 
		RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
 		SELECT 0
	END 
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SELECT 1
	END	
	/**/
END

				SELECT @DocItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				/*RZ960225 for multi language*/
				/*Begin insert records in lang table*/
				INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItems_Lang (
					[DocItemID]
				   ,[LanguageID]
				   ,[Description]	
				   ,[PrdNickname]  /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
				) 
				SELECT
					@DocItemId,
					OILN.LanguageID,
					OILN.ordIDescription,
					OILN.ordIPrdNickname  /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
				FROM dbo.WSOrderItems_Lang OILN 
				WHERE  OILN.OrderItemID = @OrderItemID
				/*RZ960225 for multi language*/
				/*End insert records in lang table*/
				/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
				/*------------------------- WSDocItemSerials --------------------------*/
				/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
				/*------------------- tran3 ---------------------*/
				BEGIN TRAN
				/*------------------- tran3 ---------------------*/
					/*RZ960225 for multi language */
					/*----------------- Begin user cursor for insert serial in doc -------------------*/
					/*-------------------------- Begin define variables ------------------------------*/
					DECLARE @SerialId INT = NULL
					/*RZ960829- add length nvarchar to max*/
					DECLARE @ordItemSerialDescription NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
					DECLARE @OrderItemSerialID INT = NULL
					DECLARE @docItemSerialId INT = NULL
					/*-------------------------- End define variables --------------------------------*/
					DECLARE Crsr_Add_Serial CURSOR LOCAL For
						/*RZ14000628- Insert docItemSerials to number  (@ordIQuantity)*/
						SELECT  TOP (CAST(@ordIQuantity AS INT))/*RZ14000628- Add manual quantity for every product in multi draft*/
							SerialId,
							[Description],
							OrderItemSerialID	
						FROM dbo.WSOrderItemSerials OSI
						WHERE OrderItemID = @OrderItemID
						/*RZ14000628- Add manual quantity for every product in multi draft*/
						AND SerialId NOT IN(SELECT   DIS.SerialId
											FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
											WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemID]    
																FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]
																WHERE PrdId = @ordIPrdId
																AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																				FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																				WHERE D.OrderId = @OrderId
																				AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType IN(2,3)))
										
						
															 )											
											)
						AND  (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((SELECT DISI.Serial FROM dbo.WSDocItemSerials DISI WHERE DISI.DocItemSerialID = OSI.SerialId),'') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
											NOT IN(SELECT (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(DIS.Serial AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
													FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
													WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemID]    
																		FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]
																		WHERE PrdId = @ordIPrdId
																		AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																						FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																						WHERE D.OrderId = @OrderId
																						AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType = 1))																
																		)																
								)
						
						/*RZ14000628- End*/
					OPEN Crsr_Add_Serial
					FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO @SerialId, @ordItemSerialDescription, @OrderItemSerialID
					WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
					BEGIN
					/*---------------------------------------*/
						/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
						DECLARE @Serial NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,@RootId INT = NULL,@OprType INT = NULL
						/*Find doc type via orderOpr*/
						SET @OprType = (SELECT TOP 1[OprType]
											FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr]  DO
											WHERE DO.[DocOprID]  = ((SELECT  
																		(SELECT TOP 1 Opr.DocOprId 
																			FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr WHERE Opr.OrderOprID = O.OrderOprID) 			 
																		FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																		WHERE OrderId = @OrderId))						
										)
						/*check doc type*/
						IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 1)/*Doc*/
						BEGIN
						/**/
							SELECT TOP 1 
								 @Serial = [Serial]	
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
							WHERE [DocItemSerialID] = @SerialId
							SET @RootId = 0
							SET @SerialId = NULL
						/**/
						END
						ELSE IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 2 OR  ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 3)/*Draft Or Movement*/
						BEGIN
						/**/
							/*----------------*/
							SELECT TOP 1 
								 @Serial = [Serial]							
								,@RootId = [RootId]
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
							WHERE [DocItemSerialID] = @SerialId
							SET @RootId = ISNULL(@RootId,0)
							IF(@RootId = 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @RootId = @SerialId
							END
							/*ELSE IF(@RootId <> 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @RootId = @RootId
							END*/
							/*----------------*/
						/**/
						END						 			
						
						/*RZ14000325- End*/
						
						INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItemSerials (
							ItemId,
							SerialId,
							[Description],
							WHId,
							UserId,	
							Month1,	
							FPId, 
							RegisterDate, 
							RegisterDatePersian, 
							AppType,
							/*ADBF951130*/
							LanguageID,
							FirstRegisterDatePersian,
							FirstRegisterUserId,
							FirstRegisterDate,
							/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
							[Serial],
							[RootId]
							/*RZ14000325*/)	
						VALUES( 
							@DocItemId,
							@SerialId,
							@ordItemSerialDescription,
							/*@WhID,*/
							ISNULL(@WareHouseId,@WhID),/*RZ14000226- Add the possibility of issuing multiple docs for different warehouses*/
							@UserId, 
							@Month1, 
							@FPId, 
							GETDATE(), 
							@RegisterDatePersian, 
							@AppType,
							/*ADBF951130*/
							@LanguageID,
							@RegisterDatePersian,
							@UserId,
							GETDATE(),
							/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
							@Serial,
							@RootId
							/*RZ14000325*/)
		
						SET @docItemSerialId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
						/*Insert records in lang table*/			
						INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials_Lang]
						(
							[DocItemSerialID]
						   ,[LanguageID]
						   ,[Description]
						)
						SELECT
							@docItemSerialId,
							OISLN.LanguageID,
							OISLN.[Description]
						FROM dbo.WSOrderItemSerials_Lang OISLN 
						WHERE  OISLN.OrderItemSerialID = @OrderItemSerialID
		
						FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO  @SerialId, @ordItemSerialDescription, @OrderItemSerialID
					/*---------------------------------------*/
					END
					CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
					DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
					/*----------------- End user cursor for insert serial in doc --------------------------------*/				
					/*------------------- tran3 -----------------------*/
					IF (@@ERROR > 0)
					BEGIN 
						SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItemSerial' 
						SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
						/*RZ960225 for multi language*/
						CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
						DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
					ROLLBACK TRAN 
					END		
					ELSE 
					COMMIT TRAN 
					/*------------------- tran3 -----------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM crsr INTO @OrderItemID, @ordIPrdId, @ordIQuantity, 
										  @ordIDescription,@ordIFCR, @ordIFCRI, /*RZ980729- Add FCR,FCRI to docItem */
										  @ordITracing/*RZ990318- Add Tracing*/
										  ,@ordIPrdUnitId /*RZ14010425- Add PrdUnitId*/
										  ,@ordIQuantityTotal /*RZ14010524- Add QuantityTotal*/
										  ,@ordIPrdUnitIdI,@ordIPrdUnitIRateResult/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
										  ,@ordIPrdNickname  /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			END
			/*--*/
			CLOSE crsr
			DEALLOCATE crsr
			/*--*/
			/*------------------- tran2 ----------------------*/
			IF (@@ERROR > 0)
			BEGIN 
				SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItems' 
				SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
			ROLLBACK TRAN 
			END		
			ELSE 
			COMMIT TRAN 
			/*------------------- tran2 ----------------------*/			
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Wrhs INTO @WareHouseId
	END
	CLOSE Crsr_Wrhs
	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Wrhs
		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14000226- End*/

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
begin
	RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
	Set @DraftId = 0
	Return @DraftId
end
ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main
	Return @DraftId
END	
/*--*/
END








GO

	ELSE IF((@CompanyId IS NOT NULL AND @CompanyId > 0))
	BEGIN

		IF(@PrsId IS NULL)
			SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No PrsId|'

	/**/

ELSE IF(ISNULL(@CompanyPersonId,0) = 0)/*RZ980812- Add person when pass null*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SET @CompanyPersonId = (SELECT TOP 1 [CompanyPersonID] FROM dbo.CrmCompanyPersons WHERE prsCompanyId = @CompanyId ORDER BY ISNULL(prsOrderView, CompanyPersonID))
	IF(ISNULL(@CompanyPersonId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/

			,@RegisterDatePersian

		SET @CompanyPersonId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	/**/

/*PROJECTID*/		
IF(@ProjectId IS NOT NULL AND @ProjectId > 0)

/*PORODUCT*/
IF(@ProductJson IS NULL OR @ProductJson = '')
	SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No Prd|'



/*RZ14010919- Add PrdLinked and PrjPrdHis and ordCurrencyUnitId*/

IF(@ordCurrencyUnitId IS NOT NULL AND @ordCurrencyUnitId > 0)
BEGIN
	DECLARE @OrdCUId INT
	SET @OrdCUId = (SELECT TOP 1 [CurrencyUnitID] FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = @ordCurrencyUnitId)
	IF(@OrdCUId IS NULL)
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'No ordCurrencyUnitId|'
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @ordCurrencyUnitId = (SELECT TOP 1 [CurrencyUnitID]            
								  FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits]
								  WHERE (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST([CurrencyUnit] AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,
										NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
										= (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(N'—Ì«·' AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,
										NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
								  )
END
/*RZ14010919- End*/

/********************************************************************************/
/********************************* OrdNumber ************************************/
/********************************************************************************/
IF(@ErrorMessage IS NULL OR @ErrorMessage = '')
BEGIN

		DECLARE @DupOrdNumber BIGINT
		SET @DupOrdNumber = (SELECT TOP 1 [ordNumber] from [dbo].[ApifnCheckDuplicateOrderNumber](@OrdNumber, 0, @FPId,@OrderOprId))

			SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + 'DupOrdNumber= ' + CAST(ISNULL(@DupOrdNumber,0) AS NVARCHAR(200)) + '|'				
	END
END

						END

						END

						IF @PrdFieldName = 'OrdIPrdPriceGroupID'

				IF(ISNULL(@OrdIPrdPriceGroupID,0) > 0)

				/*=============== Discount =================*/
				/*RZ990206*/
				IF(ISNULL(@OrdIDiscount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@OrdIDiscountPercent,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@OrdIPrice,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @OrdIDiscount = (ISNULL(@OrdIPrice,0) * ISNULL(@OrdIDiscountPercent,0)) / 100
				END	
				IF(ISNULL(@OrdIDiscount,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@OrdIDiscountPercent,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@OrdIPrice,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @OrdIDiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@OrdIDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@OrdIPrice,0)

				DECLARE @TmpI NUMERIC(18,2) = 0, @TmpII NUMERIC(18,2) = 0, 
				@TotalPrice NUMERIC(18,2) = 0
				/*Tmp = Quantity * FCR * FCRI*//*FCRI =1 */
				SET @TmpI = @OrdIQuantity * ISNULL(@OrdIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@OrdIFCRI,1) /** 1 */
				/*TempII = price - discount - round + roundPlus*/				
				SET @TmpII = ISNULL(@OrdIPrice,0) - ISNULL(@OrdIDiscount,0) - ISNULL(@OrdIRound,0) + ISNULL(@OrdIRoundPlus,0)/*- 0 - 0 + 0 */
				/*=============== Tax =================*/
				/*RZ990818*/
				IF(ISNULL(@OrdITax,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@OrdITaxIndex,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@TmpII,0) > 0)

				IF(ISNULL(@OrdITax,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@OrdITaxIndex,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TmpII,0) > 0)

				/*TotalPrice = (@TmpI * @TmpII) + (@TmpI * tax)*/
				SET @TotalPrice = (@TmpI * @TmpII)/* + (@TmpI * 0)*/

				SET @OrdIDiscountSum = ISNULL(@OrdIDiscount,0) * @TmpI

						SET @OrdIValidityExpireDate = DATEADD(HOUR, ISNULL(@OrdIValidityExpireHour,0), @OrdIValidityExpireDate)
						SET @OrdIValidityExpireDate = DATEADD(MINUTE, ISNULL(@OrdIValidityExpireMinute,0), @OrdIValidityExpireDate)
					/**/
					END

				END

					SET @OrdIValidityExpireDatePersian = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithOutSlash](CAST(@OrdIValidityExpireDate AS DATE)))

				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSOrderItems]

		/**/
		FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrItem INTO  @OrdItem
		END
		CLOSE CrsrItem

		/**/
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN SET @ErrorFrom='Error In Insert Order Items' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 		
		/*============================ Order Payments ====================*/	
		IF(@PaymentJson	IS NOT NULL AND @PaymentJson <>'')
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @OrdPayTypeId INT,
					@OrdPayDocId INT,
					@OrdPayDocTypeId INT,
					@OrdPayAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
					@OrdPayDocNumber NVARCHAR(50),
					@OrdPayDocDate NVARCHAR(15),

					@OrdpayBankDocNumber NVARCHAR(50)/*RZ990206- Add ordIPrdPriceGroupID and ordpayBankDocNumber*/
			/**/
			BEGIN TRAN
			DECLARE CrsrPay CURSOR FOR 		
				SELECT 
				(STUFF((SELECT '|' + CAST(PJIN.[Name] AS NVARCHAR(max)) + '=' + CAST(PJIN.[StringValue] AS NVARCHAR(max))							
									FROM [dbo].[fnParseJSON](@PaymentJson) PJIN
									WHERE PJIN.[Parent_ID] =PJ.[SequenceNO]
									FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value(N'(./text())[1]', N'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '')) 
				FROM [dbo].[fnParseJSON](@PaymentJson) PJ
				WHERE PJ.[ValueType] = 'object'
			OPEN CrsrPay
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPay INTO @OrdPay
			/**/
			WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
			BEGIN		
			/**/
				DECLARE @InsertedOrdPayId INT
				/**/
				SET @OrdPayTypeId = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDocId = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDocTypeId = NULL
				SET @OrdPayAmount = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDocNumber = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDocDate = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDescription = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDocDateTime = NULL
				SET @OrdPayDocAmount  = NULL
				SET @PreOrderPaymentId  = NULL
				SET @OrdpayBankDocNumber = NULL/*RZ990206- Add ordIPrdPriceGroupID and ordpayBankDocNumber*/
				/**/
				IF(@OrdPay IS NOT NULL AND @OrdPay <> '')
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @OrdPay = @OrdPay + '|'/*for last field*/
					DECLARE @PayField NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
					WHILE LEN(@OrdPay) > 0
					BEGIN
						IF(PATINDEX('%|%',@OrdPay) > 0)
						BEGIN
							SET @PayField = SUBSTRING(@OrdPay, 0, PATINDEX('%|%', @OrdPay))						
							/**/
							DECLARE @PayFieldValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
							DECLARE @PayFieldName NVARCHAR(200)
							SET @PayFieldName = SUBSTRING(@PayField, 1, CHARINDEX('=',@PayField)-1)                                    
							SET @PayFieldValue = SUBSTRING(@PayField, CHARINDEX('=', @PayField)+1, Len(@PayField))
							/**/
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayTypeId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayTypeId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayDocId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayDocId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayDocTypeId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayDocTypeId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayAmount'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayAmount = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS NUMERIC(18,2)) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayDocNumber'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayDocNumber = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE @PayFieldValue END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayDocDateTime'
							BEGIN						
								SELECT @OrdPayDocDateTime = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS DATETIME) END
								/**/
								IF(@OrdPayDocDateTime IS NULL)
									SET @OrdPayDocDateTime = @RegisterDate							
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayDescription'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayDescription = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE @PayFieldValue END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdPayDocAmount'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdPayDocAmount = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS NUMERIC(18,2)) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PreOrderPaymentId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PreOrderPaymentId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/		
							/*RZ990206- Add ordIPrdPriceGroupID and ordpayBankDocNumber*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'OrdpayBankDocNumber'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @OrdpayBankDocNumber = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE @PayFieldValue END
							END
							/*RZ990206- END*/
							/*--------------------------*/						
							/*--------------------------*/
							SET @OrdPay = SUBSTRING(@OrdPay,
									  LEN(@PayField + '|') + 1,
									  LEN(@OrdPay))
							/*--------------------------*/								
							/*--------------------------*/
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @PayField = @OrdPay
							SET @OrdPay = NULL						
						END
					END
					/**/	
					/**********************************************************/
					IF(@OrdPayTypeId IS NULL)
						SET @OrdPayTypeId = (SELECT TOP 1 [OrderPaymentTypeId] FROM dbo.WSOrderPaymentTypes PT ORDER BY OrderView)
					/**/
					IF(@OrdPayDocDateTime IS NULL)
						SET @OrdPayDocDateTime = @RegisterDate
					/**/
					IF(@OrdPayDocDateTime IS NOT NULL)
					BEGIN
						SET @OrdPayDocDate = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDate](CAST(@OrdPayDocDateTime AS DATE)))
						IF(@OrdPayDocDate IS NOT NULL AND @OrdPayDocDate <> '')
							SET @OrdPayDocDate = REPLACE(@OrdPayDocDate,'/','')
					END
					/*OrdpayDocAmount*/
					IF(ISNULL(@OrdpayDocAmount,0) = 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @OrdpayDocAmount = @OrdpayAmount
					END

					/**/
					/*Main table*/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSOrderPayments]
						   ([ImportDate]
						   ,[ordpayTypeId]
						   ,[ordpayOrderId]
						   ,[ordpayDocId]
						   ,[ordpayDocTypeId]
						   ,[ordpayAmount]
						   ,[ordpayDocNumber]
						   ,[ordpayDocDate]
						   ,[ordpayDescription]
						   ,[ordpayFirstRegisterUserId]
						   ,[ordpayFirstRegisteDatePersian]
						   ,[ordpayFirstRegisteDate]
						   ,[UserId]
						   ,[FPId]
						   ,[Month1]
						   ,[RegisterDate]
						   ,[RegisterDatePersian]
						   ,[ImportDateTime]
						   ,[ordpayDocDateTime]
						   ,[ordpayDocAmount]
						   ,[PreOrderPaymentId]
						   ,[AppType]
						   ,[LanguageID]
						   ,[FirstRegisterUserId]
						   ,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
						   ,[FirstRegisterDate]
						   ,[ordpayBankDocNumber]/*RZ990206- Add ordIPrdPriceGroupID and ordpayBankDocNumber*/)
					 VALUES
						   (@RegisterDatePersian
						   ,@OrdPayTypeId
						   ,@InsertedOrderId
						   ,@OrdPayDocId
						   ,@OrdPayDocTypeId
						   ,@OrdPayAmount
						   ,@OrdPayDocNumber
						   ,@OrdPayDocDate
						   ,@OrdPayDescription
						   ,@UserId
						   ,@RegisterDatePersian
						   ,@RegisterDate
						   ,@UserId
						   ,@FPId
						   ,@Month1
						   ,@RegisterDate
						   ,@RegisterDatePersian
						   ,@RegisterDate
						   ,@OrdPayDocDateTime
						   ,@OrdPayDocAmount
						   ,@PreOrderPaymentId
						   ,@AppType
						   ,@DefaultLanguageID
						   ,@UserId
						   ,@RegisterDatePersian
						   ,@RegisterDate
						   ,@OrdpayBankDocNumber/*RZ990206- Add ordIPrdPriceGroupID and ordpayBankDocNumber*/)
					/**/
					SET @InsertedOrdPayId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
					/*********** Insert to lang table ***********/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSOrderPayments_Lang]
						   ([OrderPaymentId]
						   ,[ordpayDescription]
						   ,[LanguageID])
					SELECT
							@InsertedOrdPayId
						   ,@OrdPayDescription				
						   ,LN.LanguageID
					FROM dbo.Languages LN 
					WHERE LN.LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID	
					AND ISNULL(LN.IsActive,0) = 1				
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPay INTO @OrdPay
			END
			/**/
			CLOSE CrsrPay
			DEALLOCATE CrsrPay
			/**/
			IF (@@ERROR > 0)
			BEGIN SET @ErrorFrom='Error In Insert Order Payments' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
			ELSE 
			COMMIT TRAN 
		END

		/**********************************************************/
		/*RZ14010919- Add PrdLinked and PrjPrdHis and ordCurrencyUnitId*/
		IF(ISNULL(@AppPrjPrdHis,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(@InsertedOrderId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			EXEC [dbo].[ApispInsertProjectProductHistoryByOrderId]
			@OrderId = @InsertedOrderId, 
			@UserId = @UserId,
			@Month1 = @Month1,
			@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
			@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
			@AppType = @AppType	
		/**/	
		END
		/*RZ14010919- End*/
		/**********************************************************/
		/*=========================== Calculate Order ====================*/
		EXEC [dbo].[ApispCalcAndUpdateOrderAmounts] 	@InsertedOrderId, @Month1, @LanguageID, @DefaultLanguageID				
		/**/
	END
	/**/	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
	SELECT 1

END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	 /*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/
	 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
     SET @InsertedOrderId = 0
	 SET @InsertedOrderNumber = 0
	 SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error|'
	 IF(@ErrorFrom IS NOT NULL AND @ErrorFrom <> '')
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + @ErrorFrom
 	 SELECT 0	 
END CATCH  	
/********************************************************************************/
/**/
END

				SET @PordpayDocNumber = NULL
				SET @PordpayDocDate = NULL
				SET @PordpayDocDateTime = NULL
				SET @PordpayDocAmount = NULL
				SET @PordpayDescription = NULL
				/**/
				IF(ISNULL(@OrdPay,'') <> '')
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @OrdPay = @OrdPay + '|'/*for last field*/
					DECLARE @PayField NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
					WHILE LEN(@OrdPay) > 0
					BEGIN
						IF(PATINDEX('%|%',@OrdPay) > 0)
						BEGIN
							SET @PayField = SUBSTRING(@OrdPay, 0, PATINDEX('%|%', @OrdPay))						
							/**/
							DECLARE @PayFieldValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
							DECLARE @PayFieldName NVARCHAR(200)
							SET @PayFieldName = SUBSTRING(@PayField, 1, CHARINDEX('=',@PayField)-1)                                    
							SET @PayFieldValue = SUBSTRING(@PayField, CHARINDEX('=', @PayField)+1, Len(@PayField))
							/**/
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayTypeId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayTypeId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayDocId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayDocId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayDocTypeId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayDocTypeId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayAmount'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayAmount = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS NUMERIC(18,2)) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayDocNumber'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayDocNumber = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE @PayFieldValue END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayDocDateTime'
							BEGIN						
								SELECT @PordpayDocDateTime = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS DATETIME) END
								/**/
								IF(@PordpayDocDateTime IS NULL)
									SET @PordpayDocDateTime = @RegisterDate							
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayDescription'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayDescription = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE @PayFieldValue END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'PordpayDocAmount'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @PordpayDocAmount = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS NUMERIC(18,2)) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/							
							/*--------------------------*/
							SET @OrdPay = SUBSTRING(@OrdPay,
									  LEN(@PayField + '|') + 1,
									  LEN(@OrdPay))
							/*--------------------------*/								
							/*--------------------------*/
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @PayField = @OrdPay
							SET @OrdPay = NULL						
						END
					END
					/**/	
					/**********************************************************/					
					IF(@PordpayDocDateTime IS NULL)
						SET @PordpayDocDateTime = @RegisterDate
					/**/
					IF(@PordpayDocDateTime IS NOT NULL)
					BEGIN
						SET @PordpayDocDate = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithOutSlash](CAST(@PordpayDocDateTime AS DATE)))						
					END
					/*========================================================*/
					EXEC [dbo].[ApispInsertPreOrderPayments] 								
					@PreOrderId = @InsertedPreOrderId,
					@PordNumber = NULL,
					/*PreOrder Payment*/
					@PordpayTypeId = @PordpayTypeId,
					@PordpayDocId = @PordpayDocId,
					@PordpayDocTypeId = @PordpayDocTypeId,
					@PordpayAmount = @PordpayAmount,
					@PordpayDocNumber = @PordpayDocNumber,
					@PordpayDocDate = @PordpayDocDate,
					@PordpayDocDateTime = @PordpayDocDateTime,
					@PordpayDocAmount = @PordpayDocAmount,
					@PordpayDescription = @PordpayDescription,
					/**/
					@UserId = @UserId,
					@Month1 = @Month1,
					@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
					@AppType = @AppType,
					@LanguageID = @LanguageID, 
					/**/
					@InsertedPreOrderPaymentId = @InsertedPordPayId OUTPUT,
					@ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT		
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPay INTO @OrdPay
			END
			/**/
			CLOSE CrsrPay
			DEALLOCATE CrsrPay
			/**/
			IF (@@ERROR > 0)
			BEGIN SET @ErrorFrom='Error In Insert Order Payments' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
			ELSE 
			COMMIT TRAN 
		END

		/*=========================== Calculate PreOrder ====================*/	
		IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') = '')		
			EXEC [dbo].[ApispCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmounts] 	@InsertedPreOrderId, @Month1, @LanguageID, @DefaultLanguageID	
		/**/
	END
	/*=========================================================================*/		
	IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') = '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SELECT 1					
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
		SET @InsertedPreOrderId = 0
		SET @InsertedPreOrderNumber = 0
		SELECT 0			
	/**/
	END	
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	 /*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/
	 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
     SET @InsertedPreOrderId = 0
	 SET @InsertedPreOrderNumber = 0
	 SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error|'
	 IF(ISNULL(@ErrorFrom,'') <> '')
		SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + @ErrorFrom
 	 SELECT 0	 
END CATCH  	
/********************************************************************************/
/**/
END







GO

-- [dbo].[ApispTransferUsersToAnotherPosition]








/*RZ14010714*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[ApispTransferUsersToAnotherPosition]
/*
	exec ApispTransferUsersToAnotherPosition 2,3,'60,54,58,',3,'2020-09-27','13990706',7,'dasti'	
*/
(
@OldPositionId INT,
@PositionId INT,
@CrmUserIds NVARCHAR(2000),
/**/
@UserId INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@Month INT,
@AppType NVARCHAR(20)
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*================= Create tmpTable for get child a position =================*/
DECLARE @PositionTmpTable TABLE (
	[PositionId] INT
)
/*============================================================================*/
	/*===================== Delete LinkedUsers ================*/		
	DELETE FROM [dbo].[CrmLinkedUsers]
	WHERE  [CrmUserId] IN(SELECT CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,'0') AS INT) FROM dbo.fnSplitString(@CrmUserIds,','))
	AND [LinkerPart] = 2/*RZ990716- Add LinkerPart = 2*/	
	/*============ Delete LinkedUsers on OdlLink From parent =============*/	
	/*======================= Get Parent =================================*/
	DELETE FROM @PositionTmpTable			
	;WITH Rollups AS (
		SELECT [PositionId], ParentId
		FROM [UserPositions] Child WHERE [PositionId] in (@OldPositionId)
		UNION ALL
		SELECT cl.[PositionId], cl.ParentId
		FROM [UserPositions] cl 
		INNER JOIN Rollups Children ON Children.ParentID = cl.[PositionId]
	)
			
	INSERT INTO @PositionTmpTable 
		([PositionId])
	SELECT DISTINCT
		Rollups.[PositionId]
	FROM Rollups;	
	IF((SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @PositionTmpTable) IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[CrmLinkedUsers]				
		WHERE  LinkedUserId IN(SELECT CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,'0') AS INT) FROM dbo.fnSplitString(@CrmUserIds,','))
		AND [CrmUserId] IN (SELECT
								U.UserId					
							FROM dbo.[Users] U 
							WHERE U.[PositionId]  IN (SELECT LP.[LinkedPositionId] 
													FROM [dbo].[CrmLinkedUserPositions] LP 
													WHERE LP.[LinkedPositionId] IN(SELECT [PositionId] FROM @PositionTmpTable)))
		AND [LinkerPart] = 2		
		/*-------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END
	/*====================================================================*/

	UPDATE [dbo].[Users]
	SET 
		 [UserId1] = @UserId
		,[Month1] = @Month
		,[RegisterDate] = @RegisterDate
		,[RegisterDatePersian] = @RegisterDatePersian        
		,[AppType] = @AppType
		,[PositionId] = @PositionId
	WHERE [PositionId] = @OldPositionId
	AND UserId IN(SELECT CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,'0') AS INT) FROM dbo.fnSplitString(@CrmUserIds,','))	
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[ApispVerificationRequestVerify]






/*NKR14020803*/
/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[ApispVerificationRequestVerify]
(		
/* 
	EXEC [ApispVerificationRequestVerify]
*/
@VerificationWorkFlowId INT,
@ObjectId INT,
@VerificationRequestId INT,
@VerificationWorkFlowStepId INT,
@VerifyText NVARCHAR(MAX),
@VerifyTextLang NVARCHAR(MAX),
@MsgSubject NVARCHAR(200),
@VerifiedMsgSubject NVARCHAR(200),
@RollId INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@UserId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@AppType VARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL,
@MaxDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2) OUTPUT,
@Result NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT 
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
DECLARE @FPId INT, @Year1 SMALLINT
SET @FPId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ID] FROM [dbo].[WSFinancialPeriod] ORDER BY [ID] DESC)
SET @Year1 = @FPId
/*===================================== Define variables ==================================*/
DECLARE @ObjectType INT, @SequenceObservation BIT,
@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive BIT,@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),
@LimitOrderDiscountActive BIT,@LimitOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),
@DiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),@SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
@SumDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),
@MsgTypeId INT,@VerifyUserId INT, @RegisterTime NVARCHAR(8),@InternalMessageId INT
/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2)
/*RZ14001018- End*/
SET @RegisterTime = CAST(@RegisterDate AS TIME)
/*============================= SET Object and @SequenceObservation =======================*/	
SELECT @ObjectType = [ObjectType], @SequenceObservation = [SequenceObservation]
FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlows]
WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId
/*================================= Check Discount Percent ================================*/
SELECT @LimitPreOrderDiscountActive = LimitPreOrderDiscountActive, 
@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent = LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent,
@LimitOrderDiscountActive = LimitOrderDiscountActive,
@LimitOrderDiscountPercent = LimitOrderDiscountPercent
FROM dbo.CrmsysRolls
WHERE ID = @RollId

IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 10)/*PreOrder*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @MaxDiscountPercent = ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent,0)
	END
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @pordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2)
		SET @pordDiscount = (SELECT pordDiscount FROM dbo.WSPreOrder WHERE PreOrderID = @ObjectId)
		SELECT 
			@SumPriceAmount = SumPriceAmount,
			@SumDiscount = SumDiscount, 
			/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount ,
			@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
			/*RZ14001018- End*/
		FROM [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)				

		/**/						
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		/*IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0)		
			SET @Result = '-1' /-*DivisionByZero*-/
		ELSE*/	
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 )	
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)

			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/					
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')	/*RZ14000202- Modify for DivisionByZero*//*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@SumDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)*//*calculate product discount*/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/

			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)/*calculate preorder discount*/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
				SET @Result = '-3' /*The pre-order discount is too high*/	
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		ELSE IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) <> 0)	
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-1' /*DivisionByZero*/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/

	END
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 20)/*Order*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @MaxDiscountPercent = ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountPercent,0)
	END
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2)
		SET @ordDiscount = (SELECT ordDiscount FROM dbo.WSOrder WHERE OrderID = @ObjectId)
		SELECT 
			@SumPriceAmount = SumPriceAmount,
			@SumDiscount = SumDiscount,
			/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount ,
			@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
			/*RZ14001018- End*/
		FROM [dbo].[WSfnReturnOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)
		/**/				
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		/*IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0)		
			SET @Result = '-1' /-*DivisionByZero*-/
		ELSE*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 )	
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)
			/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')	/*RZ14000202- Modify for DivisionByZero*//*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
		BEGIN
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@SumDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)*//*calculate product discount*/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)/*calculate order discount*/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
				SET @Result = '-3' /*The order discount is too high*/	
		END
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		ELSE IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0) <> 0)	
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-1' /*DivisionByZero*/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
	END
/**/
END
/*RZ14001128- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to dyform*/
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 80)/*DyForm*/
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @DyWorkflowId INT = 0;
	SET @DyWorkflowId = (SELECT TOP (1) [WorkflowId]
						FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
						WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @ObjectId)

	IF(ISNULL(@DyWorkflowId,0) <> 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/	
		IF(EXISTS (SELECT [FormId] 
					FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails] VMD 
					WHERE VMD.[MasterValueId] = @ObjectId
					AND  ISNULL(VMD.[IsChecked],0) = 0
					AND VMD.FormId <> (SELECT MV.FormId FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues] MV WHERE MV.FormFieldMasterValueId = @ObjectId)))
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @Result = '-6' /*the mastervalue hav masterValueDetails in workflow not checked*/	
		/**/	
		END
	/**/
	END
/**/
END
/*RZ14001128- End*/



/*================================== Check steps before current step ======================*/
IF(ISNULL(@SequenceObservation,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @StepBfCurrId INT
	SET @StepBfCurrId = (SELECT TOP 1 [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]       	   
							FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
							WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId
							AND ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId]) < (SELECT ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])  
																						FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWSI 
																						WHERE VWSI.[VerificationWorkFlowStepId] = @VerificationWorkFlowStepId)
							AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] NOT IN (SELECT  [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]      
																	 FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails] VRD 
																	 WHERE VRD.[VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId)	
							ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId]))
	IF(ISNULL(@StepBfCurrId,0) > 0 )
	BEGIN
		IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)

			SET @Result = '-4|' + ISNULL((SELECT [VerificationWorkFlowStepTitle]  	   
											FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
											WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] = @StepBfCurrId),'')
		END
		ELSE IF(@LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-4|' + ISNULL((SELECT [VerificationWorkFlowStepTitle] 	   
											FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps_Lang] VWS
											WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] = @StepBfCurrId AND VWS.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')	
		END

	END
/**/
END

/**/	
	/*======================== Create Tmp table for language ==========================*/
	/*Sample= @VerifyTextLang = N'[LangId=1033|,|Txt=TextI|,|Subj=subjectI|,|VerifiedSubj=vSubjI|,|]@[LangId=1025|,|Txt=TextII|,|Subj=subjectII|,|VerifiedSubj=vSubjII|,|]@',*/
	DECLARE @TmpTable TABLE (
		[LangId] INT,
		[Txt] NVARCHAR(MAX),
		[Subj] NVARCHAR(200),
		[VerifiedSubj] NVARCHAR(200)
	)
	DECLARE @LangId INT,@Txt NVARCHAR(MAX), @Subj NVARCHAR(200),@Text NVARCHAR(MAX),@VerifiedSubj NVARCHAR(200)
	IF(ISNULL(@VerifyTextLang,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
		/**/	
		DECLARE Crsr Cursor For
		/**/	
			SELECT SplitData  
			FROM fnSplitString(@VerifyTextLang, '@')
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @Text
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*================================================================================*/
			DECLARE @Field NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
			SET @LangId = NULL
			SET @Txt = NULL
			SET @Subj = NULL
			SET @VerifiedSubj = NULL
			/**/
			/*****************************************************************/
			IF(ISNULL(@Text,'') <> '') 
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @Text = SUBSTRING(@Text, 2, LEN(@Text)-2)			
				/*===================== Get Fields ==========================*/
				WHILE LEN(@Text) > 0
				BEGIN
					IF PATINDEX('%|,|%', @Text) > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @Field = SUBSTRING(@Text, 0, PATINDEX('%|,|%', @Text))
						/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						/*Get parameter name and split value form parameter*/
						/*For example => LangId=1065 => LangId= => LangId => Compare => value*/
						DECLARE @FieldValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
						DECLARE @FieldName NVARCHAR(200)
						SET @FieldName = SUBSTRING(@Field, 1, CHARINDEX('=',@Field)-1)                                    
						SET @FieldValue = SUBSTRING(@Field, CHARINDEX('=', @Field)+1, Len(@Field))
						/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						/*---------------------------- BEGIN Fill variabele ------------------------------*/
						/*BEGIN*/
						IF @FieldName = 'LangId'
						BEGIN
							SET @LangId = CASE WHEN CAST(ISNULL(@FieldValue,'0') AS INT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(@FieldValue AS INT) END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'Txt'
						BEGIN
							SET @Txt = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'Subj'
						BEGIN
							SET @Subj = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'VerifiedSubj'
						BEGIN
							SET @VerifiedSubj = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/				
						/*END */
						/*---------------------------- END Fill variabele --------------------------------*/
						/*---------------------------- Remove current parameter from listparam ------------*/
						SET @Text = SUBSTRING(@Text,LEN(@Field + '|,|') + 1,LEN(@Text))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @Field = @Text
						SET @Text = NULL       
					END
				END
				/*===========================================================*/
				INSERT INTO @TmpTable ([LangId],Txt,Subj,VerifiedSubj)
				VALUES(@LangId,@Txt,@Subj,@VerifiedSubj)
			/**/
			END
			/*================================================================================*/					    				 					
		/**/	
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @Text
		END
		CLOSE Crsr
		DEALLOCATE Crsr
	/**/
	END		
	/*============================= Insert into WSVerificationRequestDetails ===================*/

				@msgdAttachRecDesc = NULL,
				@msgdGroupId  = NULL,
				@UserId = @UserId,
				@Year1 = @Year1,
				@Month1 = @Month1,
				@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
				@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
				@AppType = @AppType, 
				@InsertedID = @InternalMessageId OUTPUT, /*AI14011223 - instead of @InternalMessageID*/
				@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID,
				@msgdAttachRecIdI = NULL,
				@msgdAttachRecDescI = NULL
			/*Insert Lang table*/
			IF(ISNULL(@InternalMessageId,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmInternalMessage_Lang]
					([InternalMessageID]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[msgSubject]
					,[msgBody])
				SELECT
					@InternalMessageId
					,[LangId]
					,[VerifiedSubj]
					,[Txt]
				FROM @TmpTable 
				WHERE [LangId] <> 0 
			END			
			/*=========================================================================*/
		/**/
		END		
	/**/
	END
	ELSE
		SET @Result = '-5'/*error in insert into WSVerificationRequestDetails*/
/**/
END
/*======================================================================*/
IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
	SET @Result = '1' /*OK*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[CRMfnReturnValueInMultiLanguage]


/*RZ960218- use for multi laguage*/
Create Function [dbo].[CRMfnReturnValueInMultiLanguage]
(			
/*
	Select dbo.CRMfnReturnValueInMultiLanguage(1031, '@LangID=1033,%,test1033|@LangID=1031,%,test1031|')
 */
@LanguageID INT,
@Value NVARCHAR(MAX) 
)
Returns NVARCHAR(MAX) 		
As
BEGIN
/**/
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*
input string => '@LangID=1033,%,test1033|@LangID=@LanguageID,%,test@LanguageID|'
change input string to list and
split langId and value
then langId check with @LanguageID
if condition is true 
return value 
*/
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------- BEGIN fill variable from parameters ------------------------------------*/	
	DECLARE @individual NVARCHAR(MAX) = null
	DECLARE @ReturnValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = null
	WHILE LEN(@Value) > 0
	BEGIN
		IF PATINDEX('%|%', @Value) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @individual = SUBSTRING(@Value,
										0,
										PATINDEX('%|%', @Value))
			
			/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			DECLARE @paramValue NVARCHAR(4000)
			DECLARE @LangId VARCHAR(20)
			SET @LangId = SUBSTRING(@individual, CHARINDEX('@LangID=', @individual)+8, CHARINDEX(',%,',@individual) - (CHARINDEX('@LangID=', @individual)+8))                                   
			SET @paramValue = SUBSTRING(@individual, CHARINDEX(',%,', @individual)+3, Len(@individual))
			/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------- BEGIN Fill variabele ------------------------------*/
			/**/
			IF(@LangId = CAST(@LanguageID AS VARCHAR(20))) 
      			SET @ReturnValue = @paramValue
		   /*---------------------------- END Fill variabele --------------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------- Remove current parameter from listparam ------------*/
			SET @Value = SUBSTRING(@Value,
									  LEN(@individual + '|') + 1,
									  LEN(@Value))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @individual = @Value
			SET @Value = NULL
		END
	END

	RETURN(@ReturnValue)
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[CRMspCheckActionForUser]






/*RZ14020604*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[CRMspCheckActionForUser]
/*
	DECLARE @HasAction BIT
	EXEC CRMspCheckActionForUser N'frmPreOrderDataEntry', N'actAutoCalcNumRef', 3, @HasAction OUTPUT
	SELECT @HasAction
*/
(
@FormName NVARCHAR(50),
@ActionName NVARCHAR(50),
@UserId INT,
@HasAction BIT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT * FROM dbo.CrmsysRollPermission
		WHERE FormId = (SELECT ID FROM dbo.CrmsysForms WHERE FormName = @FormName )
		AND FormActionId = (SELECT Id FROM dbo.CrmsysFormActions WHERE ActionName = @ActionName
							AND FormId = (SELECT ID FROM dbo.CrmsysForms WHERE FormName = @FormName ))
		AND RollId = (SELECT TOP 1 RollId FROM dbo.UsersPermission WHERE UserId = @UserId AND PrjId = 11/*CRM*/))
	BEGIN
		SET @HasAction = 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @HasAction = 0
	END
END

-- [dbo].[CRMspCreateCompanyUsernameAndPassword]






/*RZ14000420*/
/*RZ14000505- Chcke set password and username*/
/*RZ14001120-Change first person to cmpMainPerson*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[CRMspCreateCompanyUsernameAndPassword]
(
/* 
	exec CRMspCreateCompanyUsernameAndPassword 	6983,3,'2021-07-11','14000420','dasti'
*/
@CompanyId INT,
/**/
@UserId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@Year1 SMALLINT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType VARCHAR(20)
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*==========================================================================*/
/*Set type from foSetting*/
DECLARE @CmpDefUsernameType INT,@CmpDefPasswordType INT
SELECT TOP 1
     @CmpDefUsernameType = [CmpDefUsernameType]
    ,@CmpDefPasswordType = [CmpDefPasswordType]
FROM [dbo].[CrmFoSetting]
/*Type = 0 => cmpNumber, Type = 1 => cmpMobile, Type = 2 => cmpEmail, Type=3 => prsNationalCode*/
/*==========================================================================*/
BEGIN TRANSACTION Main
BEGIN TRY	
	/*======================================================================*/
	DECLARE @CmpUserName NVARCHAR(50) = '',@CmpPassword NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	@NewUserName NVARCHAR(50) = '',@NewPassword NVARCHAR(50) = ''
	/*====================== Set UserName,Password ===============================*/		
	/*============== Set username ================*/
	IF(@CmpDefUsernameType = 0)/*cmpNumber*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewUserName = CAST(ISNULL(cmpNumber,0) AS NVARCHAR(50))	FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefUsernameType = 1)/*cmpMobile*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewUserName = cmpMobile	FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefUsernameType = 2)/*cmpEmail*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewUserName = cmpEmail	FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefUsernameType = 3)/*prsNationalCode*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewUserName = (SELECT TOP 1 LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(prsNationalCode, '')))
								FROM dbo.CrmCompanyPersons CP 
								/*WHERE CP.prsCompanyId = CC.CompanyId AND ISNULL(CP.[prsWorkingOut], 0)  = 0
								ORDER BY ISNULL(prsOrderView, CompanyPersonID)*/
								/*RZ14001120-Change first person to cmpMainPerson*/
								WHERE CP.CompanyPersonID = CC.cmpMainPersonId
								/*RZ14001120-End*/
								)	
		FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END			
	/**/
	IF((@CmpDefUsernameType IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT cmpUserName FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId AND ISNULL(cmpUserName,'') <> ''))/*When the company already has a username*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewUserName = cmpUserName FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	/*============== Set password ================*/
	IF(@CmpDefPasswordType = 0)/*cmpNumber*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewPassword = CAST(ISNULL(cmpNumber,0) AS NVARCHAR(50))	FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefPasswordType = 1)/*cmpMobile*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewPassword = cmpMobile	FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefPasswordType = 2)/*cmpEmail*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewPassword = cmpEmail	FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefPasswordType = 3)/*prsNationalCode*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewPassword = (SELECT TOP 1 LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(prsNationalCode, '')))
								FROM dbo.CrmCompanyPersons CP 
								/*WHERE CP.prsCompanyId = CC.CompanyId AND ISNULL(CP.[prsWorkingOut], 0)  = 0
								ORDER BY ISNULL(prsOrderView, CompanyPersonID)*/
								/*RZ14001120-Change first person to cmpMainPerson*/
								WHERE CP.CompanyPersonID = CC.cmpMainPersonId
								/*RZ14001120-End*/
								)	
		FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END	
	ELSE IF(@CmpDefPasswordType = 4)/*random*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT @NewPassword = COALESCE(@NewPassword, '') + n /*Create a string random with 5 character*/
		FROM (SELECT TOP 5 CHAR(number) n FROM
		MASTER..spt_values
		WHERE TYPE = 'P' AND 
		(number BETWEEN ASCII(0) AND Ascii(9)
		OR number BETWEEN ASCII('A') AND ASCII('Z')
		OR number BETWEEN ASCII('a') AND ASCII('z'))
		ORDER BY NEWID()) a
		/**/
		
	/**/
	END
	/**/
	DECLARE @PasswordParII NVARCHAR(4) = '',@Second NVARCHAR(2) = '',@MilliSecond NVARCHAR(3) = ''
	SET @Second = DATEPART(SECOND,GETDATE())
	SET @MilliSecond = DATEPART(ms,GETDATE())
	IF(LEN(@Second) = 1) SET @Second = '0' + @Second
	IF(LEN(@MilliSecond) = 1) SET @MilliSecond = '00' + @MilliSecond
	IF(LEN(@MilliSecond) = 2) SET @MilliSecond = '0' + @MilliSecond
	SET @PasswordParII = CAST((LEFT(SUBSTRING(RTRIM(RAND()) + SUBSTRING(RTRIM(RAND()),3,11), 3,11),4)) AS NVARCHAR(4))		
	/*SET @NewPassword = @MilliSecond + @Second + @NewPassword + @PasswordParII*/					
	IF(ISNULL(@NewPassword,'') <> '' )
	BEGIN 
		SET @NewPassword = @MilliSecond + @Second + @NewPassword + @PasswordParII
	END
	/**/
	IF((@CmpDefPasswordType IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT cmpPassword FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId AND ISNULL(cmpPassword,'') <> ''))/*When the company already has a password*/
	BEGIN
		SELECT @NewPassword = cmpPassword FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
	END
	/*============ Update Company ===============*/
	/*UPDATE [dbo].[CrmCompany] 
		SET cmpUserName = @NewUserName, 
			cmpPassword = @NewPassword,
			UserId = @UserId,
			Month1 = @Month1,
			Year1 = @Year1,
			RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
			RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
			AppType =@AppType  
	WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId*/
	/*RZ14000505- Chcke set password and username*/
	IF(ISNULL(@NewUserName,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@NewPassword,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmCompany] 
			SET cmpUserName = @NewUserName, 
				cmpPassword = @NewPassword,
				UserId = @UserId,
				Month1 = @Month1,
				Year1 = @Year1,
				RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
				RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
				AppType =@AppType  
		WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId	
		/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SELECT 1 AS Result
	/**/
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SELECT -1 AS Result
	/**/
	END		
	/*RZ14000505- End*/
	/**/
	/*COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
	SELECT 1 AS Result*/
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main

-- [dbo].[CRMspDyFormCheck]







/*RZ970824*/
/*RZ980329- Add FormId and Update masterValueDetail*/
/*RZ970404- Add Mode And remove FormId*/
/*RZ14010331- Check update CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails in for form has a workflow*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[CRMspDyFormCheck]				
(
/* 
	exec CRMspDyFormCheck 357, 3,'13970824' ,2
*/
@MasterValueId INT,
@CheckerUserId INT,
@CheckedDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
/*@FormId INT*//*RZ980329- Add FormId*/
/*RZ970404- Add Mode And remove FormId*/
@Mode INT /*mode=1 ===> form is normal, mode=2 ===> form is a workflow*/
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(@Mode = 1)/*for normal form*/
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 1
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
			  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
		WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
		/**/
		/*RZ980329- Update masterValueDetail*/
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 1
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
			  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
		WHERE [MasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
		/*RZ980329- END*/
	END
	ELSE /*for form has a workflow*/
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 1
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
			  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
			  /*RZ970404- Remove FormId*/
			  /*,[WorkflowStepId] = (SELECT TOP 1 WD.[FormWorkflowStepId] FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormWorkflowSteps] WD WHERE WD.[SubFormId] = @FormId)*/
		WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId	
		/*RZ14010331- Check update CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails in for form has a workflow*/
		DECLARE @FormId INT
		SET  @FormId = (SELECT TOP 1 [FormId] FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues] WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId) 
		IF(ISNULL(@FormId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails]
			   SET [IsChecked] = 1
				  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
				  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
				  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
			WHERE [MasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
			AND [FormId] = @FormId
		/**/
		END		
		/*RZ14010331- End*/
	END			
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[CRMspInsertCompanyChangeHistory]







/*RZ14011124*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[CRMspInsertCompanyChangeHistory]
/*
	declare @InsertedId int = 0
	exec CRMspInsertCompanyChangeHistory 
	@CompanyId = 68697,
	@FieldName = N'cmpReferUserId',
	@OldValue = N'56',
	@NewValue = N'3',
	@Desc = N'', 
	@CmpChangeHistory_Lang = NULL, 	
	@UserId = 3,
	@RegisterDate = '2023-02-13',
	@RegisterDatePersian = '14011124',
	@AppType = 'dasti',
	@DefaultLanguageID = 1065,		
	@InsertedId = @InsertedId OUTPUT
	select @InsertedId 
*/
(
@CompanyId INT,
@FieldName NVARCHAR(300),
@OldValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@NewValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@Desc NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, 
@CmpChangeHistory_Lang NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, 
/**/
@UserId INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(20),
@DefaultLanguageID INT,
/**/
@InsertedId INT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	/*============================================================================*/
	/*================================ Insert ====================================*/
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmCompanyChangeHistory]
        ([CompanyID]
        ,[FieldName]
        ,[OldValue]
        ,[NewValue]
        ,[Desc]
        ,[UserId]
        ,[RegisterDate]
        ,[RegisterDatePersian]        
        ,[AppType]
        ,[LanguageID])
    VALUES
        (@CompanyID
        ,@FieldName
        ,@OldValue
        ,@NewValue
        ,@Desc
        ,@UserId
        ,@RegisterDate
        ,@RegisterDatePersian
        ,@AppType
        ,@DefaultLanguageID)
	SET @InsertedId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()	
	IF(ISNULL(@InsertedId,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@CmpChangeHistory_Lang,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmCompanyChangeHistory_Lang]
			([CompanyChangeHistoryId]
			,[LanguageID]
			,[OldValue]
			,[NewValue]
			,[Desc])
		SELECT 
			@InsertedId,
			JS.[LanguageID],
			JS.[OldValue],
			JS.[NewValue],
			JS.[Desc]
		FROM OPENJSON(ISNULL(@CmpChangeHistory_Lang,'[]'))
		WITH (
			[LanguageID] INT '$.LanguageID',
			[OldValue] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.OldValue',
			[NewValue] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.NewValue',
			[Desc] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.Desc'
		) AS JS
		WHERE JS.[LanguageID] <> @DefaultLanguageID
		AND JS.[LanguageID] IN(SELECT L.[LanguageID]
							   FROM [dbo].[Languages] L
							   WHERE ISNULL(L.IsActive,0) = 1)
	/**/
	END		
	/*===========================================================================*/
/**/
END

ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main
	/*--Return @OrderId*/
	SET @InsertedID = @MessageID  /*ESP951102*/
END	
/*--****/	 
END

BEGIN
DECLARE @Term VARCHAR(4000)
