/*--Province*/
IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenProvince
WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
SET @Term = @Term +
' AND C.cmpProvinceId Not IN (
SELECT ForbiddenProvinceId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenProvince
WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessProvince
WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
SET @Term = @Term +
' AND C.cmpProvinceId IN (
SELECT JustAccessProvinceId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessProvince
WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
/*--City*/
IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCity
WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0

' AND C.cmpCityId Not IN (
SELECT ForbiddenCityId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCity

IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCity

/*--GroupIV*/

/*--Group*/
IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroup

IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenSubGroup

-- [dbo].[fnGregorianToPersianDate]







/*RZ960502*/
/*Convert Gregorian to Persian */
/*RZ990128- Convert DateTiem to date*/
Create Function [dbo].[fnGregorianToPersianDate] (@date DATETIME)
/*
	Select dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDate]('2017-07-24') as [Persian Date]
*/
RETURNS NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	SET @date = CAST(@date AS DATE)/*RZ990128- Convert DateTiem to date*/
    DECLARE @depoch AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @cycle  AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @cyear  AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @ycycle AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @aux1 AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @aux2 AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @yday AS BIGINT
    DECLARE @Jofst  AS NUMERIC(18,2)
    DECLARE @jdn BIGINT
    DECLARE @iYear   AS INTEGER
    DECLARE @iMonth  AS INTEGER
    DECLARE @iDay    AS INTEGER

    SET @Jofst=2415020.5
    SET @jdn=Round(CAST(@date AS INT)+ @Jofst,0)

    SET @depoch = @jdn - [dbo].[fnPersianToJulianDate](475, 1, 1) 
    SET @cycle = CAST(@depoch / 1029983 AS INT) 
    SET @cyear = @depoch%1029983 

    IF @cyear = 1029982
       BEGIN
         SET @ycycle = 2820 
       END
    ELSE
       BEGIN
        SET @aux1 = CAST(@cyear / 366 AS INT) 
        SET @aux2 = @cyear%366 
        SET @ycycle = CAST(((2134 * @aux1) + (2816 * @aux2) + 2815) / 1028522 AS INT) + @aux1 + 1 
      END

    SET @iYear = @ycycle + (2820 * @cycle) + 474 

    IF @iYear <= 0
      BEGIN 
        SET @iYear = @iYear - 1 
      END
    Set @yday = (@jdn - dbo.fnPersianToJulianDate(@iYear, 1, 1)) + 1 
    IF @yday <= 186 
       BEGIN
         SET @iMonth = CEILING(CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,4),@yday) / 31) 
       END
    ELSE
       BEGIN
          SET @iMonth = CEILING((CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,4),@yday) - 6) / 30)  
       END
       SET @iDay = (@jdn - dbo.fnPersianToJulianDate(@iYear, @iMonth, 1)) + 1 

	DECLARE @DayStr NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @MonthStr NVARCHAR(50)
	IF(@iDay<10)
		SET @DayStr = '0' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@iDay)
	ELSE
		SET @DayStr = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@iDay)
		
	IF(@iMonth<10)
		SET @MonthStr = '0' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@iMonth)
	ELSE
		SET @MonthStr = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@iMonth)
	
	
      RETURN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@iYear) + '/' + @MonthStr + '/' + @DayStr 
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords]



/*RZ980225*/
Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords] ( 
    @Number Numeric (38, 0) /* Input number with as many as 18 digits*/
/*
	Select dbo.[fnNumberToArWords] (947)
	Select dbo.fnNumberToArWords (7446744073709551616)	
*/ 
) RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX) 
AS 
BEGIN
/**/
DECLARE @inputNumber NVARCHAR(38)
DECLARE @NumbersTable TABLE (number INT, word NVARCHAR(20))
DECLARE @outputString NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @length INT
DECLARE @counter INT
DECLARE @loops INT
DECLARE @position INT
DECLARE @chunk NCHAR(3)
DECLARE @tensones NCHAR(2)
DECLARE @hundreds NCHAR(1)
DECLARE @tens NCHAR(1)
DECLARE @ones NCHAR(1)
DECLARE @And NVARCHAR(3)
DECLARE @Neg NVARCHAR(10)
 
    IF @Number = 0 return N'’›—'
     
    IF  Left(@Number ,1) <> '-'
        SET  @Neg = N' '
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET  @Neg = N'”·»Ì '
        SET  @Number = @Number * -1
    END
 
SELECT @inputNumber = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(38), @Number)
     , @outputString = ''
     , @counter = 1
SELECT @length   = LEN(@inputNumber)
     , @position = LEN(@inputNumber) - 2
     , @loops    = LEN(@inputNumber)/3
 
 
IF LEN(@inputNumber) % 3 <> 0 SET @loops = @loops + 1
 
 
INSERT INTO @NumbersTable   SELECT 0, N''
    UNION ALL SELECT 1, N' Ê«Õœ '      UNION ALL SELECT 2, N' «À‰«‰ '
    UNION ALL SELECT 3, N' À·«À… '    UNION ALL SELECT 4, N' √—»⁄… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 5, N' Œ„”… '     UNION ALL SELECT 6, N' ” … '
    UNION ALL SELECT 7, N' ”»⁄… '    UNION ALL SELECT 8, N' À„«‰Ì… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 9, N'  ”⁄… '     UNION ALL SELECT 10, N' ⁄‘—… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 11, N' √Õœ ⁄‘— '   UNION ALL SELECT 12, N' «À‰Ì ⁄‘— '
    UNION ALL SELECT 13, N' À·«À… ⁄‘— ' UNION ALL SELECT 14, N' √—»⁄… ⁄‘—… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 15, N' Œ„”… ⁄‘— '  UNION ALL SELECT 16, N' «·”«œ” ⁄‘— '
    UNION ALL SELECT 17, N' ”»⁄… ⁄‘— ' UNION ALL SELECT 18, N' «·À«„‰… ⁄‘— '
    UNION ALL SELECT 19, N'  ”⁄… ⁄‘— ' UNION ALL SELECT 20, N' ⁄‘—Ê‰ '
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, N' À·«ÀÊ‰ '   UNION ALL SELECT 40, N' √—»⁄Ì‰ '
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, N' Œ„”Ê‰ '    UNION ALL SELECT 60, N' ” Ê‰ '
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, N' ”»⁄Ê‰ '  UNION ALL SELECT 80, N' À„«‰Ê‰ '
    UNION ALL SELECT 90, N'  ”⁄Ê‰ '   UNION ALL SELECT 100, N' „«∆… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 200, N' „«∆ Ì‰ '   UNION ALL SELECT 300, N' À·«À „∆… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 400, N' √—»⁄… „∆… '   UNION ALL SELECT 500, N' Œ„”„«∆… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 600, N' ” „«∆… '   UNION ALL SELECT 700, N' ”»⁄„«∆… '
    UNION ALL SELECT 800, N' À„«‰ „«∆… '   UNION ALL SELECT 900, N'  ”⁄„«∆… '
 
 
WHILE @counter <= @loops BEGIN
 
    SET @chunk = RIGHT('000' + SUBSTRING(@inputNumber, @position, 3), 3)
     
 
    IF @chunk <> '000' BEGIN
        SELECT @tensones = SUBSTRING(@chunk, 2, 2)
             , @hundreds = SUBSTRING(@chunk, 1, 1)
             , @tens = SUBSTRING(@chunk, 2, 1)
             , @ones = SUBSTRING(@chunk, 3, 1)
 
        IF CONVERT(INT, @tensones) <= 20 OR @Ones='0' BEGIN
                if len(@outputString)>0
                    begin
                    set @And=N'Ê '
                    end
                else
                    begin
                    set @And=N''
                    end
                     
                SET @outputString = (SELECT word
                                    FROM @NumbersTable
                                    WHERE @hundreds+'00'  = number)
                            + case @hundreds when '0' then '' else 
                                case @tensones when '00' then N'' else N'Ê' end  end+
                            (
                                    SELECT word
                                      FROM @NumbersTable
                                      WHERE @tensones = number)
                   + CASE @counter WHEN 1 THEN N'' /* No name*/
                       WHEN 2 THEN N' √·› ' WHEN 3 THEN N' „·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 4 THEN N' „·Ì«— '  WHEN 5 THEN N' »·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 6 THEN N' »·Ì«—œÊ ' WHEN 7 THEN N' ﬂÊÌ‰ Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 8 THEN N' ”ò” Ì·ÌÊ‰ '  WHEN 9 THEN N' ”» Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 10 THEN N' «ò Ì·ÌÊ‰ '  WHEN 11 THEN N' ‰Ê‰Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 12 THEN N' œ”Ì·ÌÊ‰ '  WHEN 13 THEN N' «‰œ”Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       ELSE N'' END
                               + @And + @outputString
            END
 
         ELSE BEGIN
 
                    if len(@outputString)>0
                    begin
                    set @And=N'Ê '
                    end
                else
                    begin
                    set @And=N''
                    end
                     
                 
 
                SET @outputString = N' '
                            + (SELECT word
                                    FROM @NumbersTable
                                    WHERE @hundreds+'00'  = number)
                             + case @hundreds when '0' then N'' else  N'Ê' end
                            + (SELECT word
                                    FROM @NumbersTable
                                    WHERE   @tens+'0'  = number)
                             + N'Ê'
                             + (SELECT word
                                    FROM @NumbersTable
                                    WHERE  @ones = number)
                   + CASE @counter WHEN 1 THEN N'' /* No name*/
                       WHEN 2 THEN N' √·› ' WHEN 3 THEN N' „·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 4 THEN N' „·Ì«— '  WHEN 5 THEN N' »·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 6 THEN N' »·Ì«—œÊ ' WHEN 7 THEN N' ﬂÊÌ‰ Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 8 THEN N' ”ò” Ì·ÌÊ‰ '  WHEN 9 THEN N' ”» Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 10 THEN N' «ò Ì·ÌÊ‰ '  WHEN 11 THEN N' ‰Ê‰Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       WHEN 12 THEN N' œ”Ì·ÌÊ‰ '  WHEN 13 THEN N' «‰œ”Ì·ÌÊ‰ '
                       ELSE N'' END
                            + @And + @outputString
        END
         
 
    END
 
    SELECT @counter = @counter + 1
         , @position = @position - 3
 
END
 
SET @outputString = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(@outputString, N'  ', N' ')))
SET @outputstring = UPPER(LEFT(@outputstring, 1)) + SUBSTRING(@outputstring, 2, 8000)
SET @outputstring = @Neg + @outputstring
 
RETURN @outputString

/**/
END

/*RZ980225*/
Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](@Number AS BIGINT)
/*
	Select dbo.[fnNumberToEnWords] (947)
	Select dbo.fnNumberToEnWords (7446744073709551616)		
*/
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
      DECLARE @Below20 TABLE (ID INT  IDENTITY(0,1), Word VARCHAR(32))

      DECLARE @Below100 TABLE (ID INT IDENTITY(2,1), Word VARCHAR(32))

      INSERT @Below20 (Word) VALUES

                        ( 'zero'), ('one'),( 'two' ), ( 'three'),

                        ( 'four' ), ( 'five' ), ( 'six' ), ( 'seven' ),

                        ( 'eight'), ( 'nine'), ( 'ten'), ( 'eleven' ),

                        ( 'twelve' ), ( 'thirteen' ), ( 'fourteen'),

                        ( 'fifteen' ), ('sixteen' ), ( 'seventeen'),

                        ('eighteen' ), ( 'nineteen' )

       INSERT @Below100 VALUES ('twenty'), ('thirty'),('forty'), ('fifty'),

                               ('sixty'), ('seventy'), ('eighty'), ('ninety')

DECLARE @English  NVARCHAR(MAX) =

(

  SELECT Case

    WHEN @Number = 0 THEN  ''

    WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1 AND 19

      THEN (SELECT Word FROM @Below20 WHERE ID=@Number)

   WHEN @Number BETWEEN 20 AND 99  

     THEN  (SELECT Word FROM @Below100 WHERE ID=@Number/10)+ '-' +

           dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 10)

   WHEN @Number BETWEEN 100 AND 999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 100))+' hundred '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 100)

   WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000 AND 999999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 1000))+' thousand '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 1000) 

   WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000 AND 999999999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 1000000))+' million '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 1000000)

   WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 999999999999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 1000000000))+' billion '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 1000000000)

   WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000000000 AND 999999999999999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 1000000000000))+' trillion '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 1000000000000)

  WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000000000000 AND 999999999999999999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 1000000000000000))+' quadrillion '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 1000000000000000)

  WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000000000000000 AND 999999999999999999999  

     THEN  (dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number / 1000000000000000000))+' quintillion '+

         dbo.fnNumberToEnWords( @Number % 1000000000000000000)

        ELSE ' INVALID INPUT' END

)

SELECT @English = RTRIM(@English)

SELECT @English = RTRIM(LEFT(@English,LEN(@English)-1))

                 WHERE RIGHT(@English,1)='-'

RETURN (@English)
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[fnParseJSON]






/*RZ980416*/
/*RZ991111-Modify for negetive number*/
Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnParseJSON]( @JSON NVARCHAR(MAX))
/*
	 Select * from fnParseJSON('{}')
*/
	RETURNS @hierarchy TABLE
	  (
	   Element_ID INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, /* internal surrogate primary key gives the order of parsing and the list order */
	   SequenceNo [int] NULL, /* the place in the sequence for the element */
	   Parent_ID INT null, /* if the element has a parent then it is in this column. The document is the ultimate parent, so you can get the structure from recursing from the document */
	   Object_ID INT null, /* each list or object has an object id. This ties all elements to a parent. Lists are treated as objects here */
	   Name NVARCHAR(2000) NULL, /* the Name of the object */
	   StringValue NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,/*the string representation of the value of the element. */
	   ValueType VARCHAR(10) NOT null /* the declared type of the value represented as a string in StringValue*/
	  )
	  /*
 
	   */
	AS
	BEGIN
	  DECLARE
	    @FirstObject INT, /*the index of the first open bracket found in the JSON string*/
	    @OpenDelimiter INT,/*the index of the next open bracket found in the JSON string*/
	    @NextOpenDelimiter INT,/*the index of subsequent open bracket found in the JSON string*/
	    @NextCloseDelimiter INT,/*the index of subsequent close bracket found in the JSON string*/
	    @Type NVARCHAR(10),/*whether it denotes an object or an array*/
	    @NextCloseDelimiterChar CHAR(1),/*either a '}' or a ']'*/
	    @Contents NVARCHAR(MAX), /*the unparsed contents of the bracketed expression*/
	    @Start INT, /*index of the start of the token that you are parsing*/
	    @end INT,/*index of the end of the token that you are parsing*/
	    @param INT,/*the parameter at the end of the next Object/Array token*/
	    @EndOfName INT,/*the index of the start of the parameter at end of Object/Array token*/
	    @token NVARCHAR(200),/*either a string or object*/
	    @value NVARCHAR(MAX), /* the value as a string*/
	    @SequenceNo int, /* the sequence number within a list*/
	    @Name NVARCHAR(200), /*the Name as a string*/
	    @Parent_ID INT,/*the next parent ID to allocate*/
	    @lenJSON INT,/*the current length of the JSON String*/
	    @characters NCHAR(36),/*used to convert hex to decimal*/
	    @result BIGINT,/*the value of the hex symbol being parsed*/
	    @index SMALLINT,/*used for parsing the hex value*/
	    @Escape INT /*the index of the next escape character*/
	    
	  DECLARE @Strings TABLE /* in this temporary table we keep all strings, even the Names of the elements, since they are 'escaped' in a different way, and may contain, unescaped, brackets denoting objects or lists. These are replaced in the JSON string by tokens representing the string */
	    (
	     String_ID INT IDENTITY(1, 1),
	     StringValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
	    )
	  SELECT/*initialise the characters to convert hex to ascii*/
	    @characters='0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
	    @SequenceNo=0, /*set the sequence no. to something sensible.*/
	  /* firstly we process all strings. This is done because [{} and ] aren't escaped in strings, which complicates an iterative parse. */
	    @Parent_ID=0;
	  WHILE 1=1 /*forever until there is nothing more to do*/
	    BEGIN
	      SELECT
	        @start=PATINDEX('%[^a-zA-Z]["]%', @json collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin);/*next delimited string*/
	      IF @start=0 BREAK /*no more so drop through the WHILE loop*/
	      IF SUBSTRING(@json, @start+1, 1)='"' 
	        BEGIN /*Delimited Name*/
	          SET @start=@Start+1;
	          SET @end=PATINDEX('%[^\]["]%', RIGHT(@json, LEN(@json+'|')-@start) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin);
	        END
	      IF @end=0 /*either the end or no end delimiter to last string*/
	        BEGIN/* check if ending with a double slash...*/
             SET @end=PATINDEX('%[\][\]["]%', RIGHT(@json, LEN(@json+'|')-@start) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin);
 		     IF @end=0 /*we really have reached the end*/ 
				BEGIN
				BREAK /*assume all tokens found*/
				END
			END 
	      SELECT @token=SUBSTRING(@json, @start+1, @end-1)
	      /*now put in the escaped control characters*/
	      SELECT @token=REPLACE(@token, FromString, ToString)
	      FROM
	        (SELECT           '\b', CHAR(08)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\f', CHAR(12)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\n', CHAR(10)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\r', CHAR(13)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\t', CHAR(09)
			 UNION ALL SELECT '\"', '"'
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\/', '/'
	        ) substitutions(FromString, ToString)
		SELECT @token=Replace(@token, '\\', '\')
	      SELECT @result=0, @escape=1
	  /*Begin to take out any hex escape codes*/
	      WHILE @escape>0
	        BEGIN
	          SELECT @index=0,
	          /*find the next hex escape sequence*/
	          @escape=PATINDEX('%\x[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]%', @token collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)
	          IF @escape>0 /*if there is one*/
	            BEGIN
	              WHILE @index<4 /*there are always four digits to a \x sequence   */
	                BEGIN
	                  SELECT /*determine its value*/
	                    @result=@result+POWER(16, @index)
	                    *(CHARINDEX(SUBSTRING(@token, @escape+2+3-@index, 1),
	                                @characters)-1), @index=@index+1 ;
	         
	                END
	                /* and replace the hex sequence by its unicode value*/
	              SELECT @token=STUFF(@token, @escape, 6, NCHAR(@result))
	            END
	        END
	      /*now store the string away*/ 
	      INSERT INTO @Strings (StringValue) SELECT @token
	      /* and replace the string with a token*/
	      SELECT @JSON=STUFF(@json, @start, @end+1,
	                    '@string'+CONVERT(NCHAR(5), @@identity))
	    END
	  /* all strings are now removed. Now we find the first leaf.  */
	  WHILE 1=1  /*forever until there is nothing more to do*/
	  BEGIN
	 
	  SELECT @Parent_ID=@Parent_ID+1
	  /*find the first object or list by looking for the open bracket*/
	  SELECT @FirstObject=PATINDEX('%[{[[]%', @json collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)/*object or array*/
	  IF @FirstObject = 0 BREAK
	  IF (SUBSTRING(@json, @FirstObject, 1)='{') 
	    SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar='}', @type='object'
	  ELSE 
	    SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar=']', @type='array'
	  SELECT @OpenDelimiter=@firstObject
	  WHILE 1=1 /*find the innermost object or list...*/
	    BEGIN
	      SELECT
	        @lenJSON=LEN(@JSON+'|')-1
	  /*find the matching close-delimiter proceeding after the open-delimiter*/
	      SELECT
	        @NextCloseDelimiter=CHARINDEX(@NextCloseDelimiterChar, @json,
	                                      @OpenDelimiter+1)
	  /*is there an intervening open-delimiter of either type*/
	      SELECT @NextOpenDelimiter=PATINDEX('%[{[[]%',
	             RIGHT(@json, @lenJSON-@OpenDelimiter)collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)/*object*/
	      IF @NextOpenDelimiter=0 
	        BREAK
	      SELECT @NextOpenDelimiter=@NextOpenDelimiter+@OpenDelimiter
	      IF @NextCloseDelimiter<@NextOpenDelimiter 
	        BREAK
	      IF SUBSTRING(@json, @NextOpenDelimiter, 1)='{' 
	        SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar='}', @type='object'
	      ELSE 
	        SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar=']', @type='array'
	      SELECT @OpenDelimiter=@NextOpenDelimiter
	    END
	  /*and parse out the list or Name/value pairs*/
	  SELECT
	    @contents=SUBSTRING(@json, @OpenDelimiter+1,
	                        @NextCloseDelimiter-@OpenDelimiter-1)
	  SELECT
	    @JSON=STUFF(@json, @OpenDelimiter,
	                @NextCloseDelimiter-@OpenDelimiter+1,
	                '@'+@type+CONVERT(NCHAR(5), @Parent_ID))
	  WHILE (PATINDEX('%[A-Za-z0-9@+-.e]%', @contents collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin))<>0/*RZ991111-Modify for negetive number*/ 
	    BEGIN
	      IF @Type='object' /*it will be a 0-n list containing a string followed by a string, number,boolean, or null*/
	        BEGIN
	          SELECT
	            @SequenceNo=0,@end=CHARINDEX(':', ' '+@contents)/*if there is anything, it will be a string-based Name.*/
	          SELECT  @start=PATINDEX('%[^A-Za-z@][@]%', ' '+@contents collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)/*AAAAAAAA*/
              SELECT @token=RTrim(Substring(' '+@contents, @start+1, @End-@Start-1)),
	            @endofName=PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', @token collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin),
	            @param=RIGHT(@token, LEN(@token)-@endofName+1)
	          SELECT
	            @token=LEFT(@token, @endofName-1),
	            @Contents=RIGHT(' '+@contents, LEN(' '+@contents+'|')-@end-1)
	          SELECT  @Name=StringValue FROM @strings
	            WHERE string_id=@param /*fetch the Name*/
	        END
	      ELSE 
	        SELECT @Name=null,@SequenceNo=@SequenceNo+1 
	      SELECT
	        @end=CHARINDEX(',', @contents)/* a string-token, object-token, list-token, number,boolean, or null*/
                IF @end=0
	        /*HR Engineering notation bugfix start*/
	          IF ISNUMERIC(@contents) = 1
		    SELECT @end = LEN(@contents) + 1
	          Else
	        /*HR Engineering notation bugfix end */
		  SELECT  @end=PATINDEX('%[A-Za-z0-9@+-.e][^A-Za-z0-9@+-.e]%', @contents+' ' collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin) + 1/*RZ991111-Modify for negetive number*/
	       SELECT
	        @start=PATINDEX('%[^A-Za-z0-9@+-.e][A-Za-z0-9@+-.e]%', ' '+@contents collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)/*RZ991111-Modify for negetive number*/
	      /*select @start,@end, LEN(@contents+'|'), @contents */ 
	      SELECT
	        @Value=RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@contents, @start, @End-@Start)),
	        @Contents=RIGHT(@contents+' ', LEN(@contents+'|')-@end)
	      IF SUBSTRING(@value, 1, 7)='@object' 
	        INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	          (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, Object_ID, ValueType)
	          SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, SUBSTRING(@value, 8, 5),
	            SUBSTRING(@value, 8, 5), 'object' 
	      ELSE 
	        IF SUBSTRING(@value, 1, 6)='@array' 
	          INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	            (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, Object_ID, ValueType)
	            SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, SUBSTRING(@value, 7, 5),
	              SUBSTRING(@value, 7, 5), 'array' 
	        ELSE 
	          IF SUBSTRING(@value, 1, 7)='@string' 
	            INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	              (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	              SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, StringValue, 'string'
	              FROM @strings
	              WHERE string_id=SUBSTRING(@value, 8, 5)
	          ELSE 
	            IF @value IN ('true', 'false') 
	              INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'boolean'
	            ELSE
	              IF @value='null' 
	                INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                  (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                  SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'null'
	              ELSE
	                IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', @value collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)>0 
	                  INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                    (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                    SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'float'
	                ELSE
	                  INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                    (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                    SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'int'
	      if @Contents=' ' Select @SequenceNo=0
	    END
	  END
	INSERT INTO @hierarchy (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, Object_ID, ValueType)
	  SELECT '-',1, NULL, '', @Parent_ID-1, @type
	/**/
	   RETURN
	END

/*RZ960921*/

Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnPersianToGregorianDate] 
(
@DateWithOutSlash NVARCHAR(8), 
@Time NVARCHAR(8)
)
/*
	Select dbo.fnPersianToGregorianDate( N'13960912', null)			
*/
Returns DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	/*RZ14000126- Set null to string empty*/
	IF(ISNULL(@DateWithOutSlash,'') = '')
		SET @DateWithOutSlash = NULL
	/*RZ14000126- End*/


	DECLARE @iYear INT,@iMonth INT,@iDay INT
	SET @iYear = (SELECT CAST ((SUBSTRING(@DateWithOutSlash, 1, 4)) AS INT))
	SET @iMonth = (SELECT CAST ((SUBSTRING(@DateWithOutSlash, 5, 2)) AS INT))
	SET @iDay = (SELECT CAST ((SUBSTRING(@DateWithOutSlash, 7, 2)) AS INT))
	/*convert jalali*/
	DECLARE @jdn BIGINT
	SET @jdn = dbo.fnPersianToJulianDate(@iYear,@iMonth,@iDay)	
	/**/
    DECLARE @Jofst  AS NUMERIC(18,2)
    SET @Jofst=2415020.5
    RETURN CAST ((Convert(NVARCHAR(11),Convert(DATETIME,(@jdn- @Jofst),113),110)) + ' ' + ISNULL(@Time, '') AS DATETIME)          	            
/**/
END

Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation] (@Num NUMERIC(18,2))
/*
	SELECT dbo.[fnRoundNumberCalculation](null)
	SELECT dbo.[fnRoundNumberCalculation](5.0002)
	SELECT dbo.[fnRoundNumberCalculation](5.49)
	SELECT dbo.[fnRoundNumberCalculation](5.51)
	SELECT dbo.[fnRoundNumberCalculation](0.48)
	SELECT dbo.[fnRoundNumberCalculation](0.5)
*/
RETURNS NUMERIC(18,2)
AS
BEGIN
/**/	
	DECLARE @RoundType INT = 0
	/*RETURN CEILING(@Num)*/
	/*RETURN ROUND(@Num,@RoundType)*/
	/*-----------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14020927- Add PriceRoundType*/
	DECLARE @PriceRoundType INT = 0,@RoundNumberResult NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL 
	SET @PriceRoundType = (SELECT TOP(1) PriceRoundType FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting])
	
	IF(ISNULL(@PriceRoundType,0) = -1)
	BEGIN
		SET @RoundNumberResult =  FLOOR(@Num)
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@PriceRoundType,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @RoundNumberResult =  ROUND(@Num,@RoundType)
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@PriceRoundType,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @RoundNumberResult =  CEILING(@Num)
	END	
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @RoundNumberResult =  ROUND(@Num,@RoundType)
	END
	/**/
	RETURN @RoundNumberResult
	/*RZ14020927- End*/
	/*-----------------------------------*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[fnSplitString]

/*9502*/
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSplitString] 
( 
    @string NVARCHAR(MAX), 
    @delimiter CHAR(1) 
) 
RETURNS @output TABLE(splitdata NVARCHAR(MAX) 
) 
BEGIN 
    DECLARE @start INT, @end INT 
    SELECT @start = 1, @end = CHARINDEX(@delimiter, @string) 
    WHILE @start < LEN(@string) + 1 BEGIN 
        IF @end = 0  
            SET @end = LEN(@string) + 1
       
        INSERT INTO @output (splitdata)  
        VALUES(SUBSTRING(@string, @start, @end - @start)) 
        SET @start = @end + 1 
        SET @end = CHARINDEX(@delimiter, @string, @start)
        
    END 
    RETURN 
END

					VALUES

						,@LangId

				FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			END
		CLOSE Crsr

	END							
	/*==================================================*/
	/*================= Update status ==================*/	
	DECLARE @SumOrdPayAmount NUMERIC(18,2)

	IF(ISNULL(@SumOrdPayAmount,0) <> 0 AND (@ordStatusId <> 4 AND @ordStatusId <> 5))/*AI14000812 - Modify condition in check status*/

	/*==================================================*/
END

)
As
BEGIN
/**/
/*----------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14021030- Re-Calculate items tax*/
DECLARE @CalcItemTaxResult INT = 0
EXEC [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderItemsTax]
@PreOrderId = @PreOrderId,
@Month1 = @Month1,
@Result = @CalcItemTaxResult OUTPUT	
/*RZ14021030- END*/
/*----------------------------------------*/
/*AI14010707- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
DECLARE @cuUnitIsDecimal BIT
SET @cuUnitIsDecimal = (SELECT TOP 1 [IsDecimal]
						FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] 
						WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = (SELECT pordCurrencyUnitId 
												  FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] 
												  WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId))
/*AI14010707- End*/
/*Calculate & Update the order*/	
/**/

/*AI14020325 - Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
DECLARE @SumQuantity FLOAT = NULL,@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@TotalTaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL
/*AI14020325 - End*/

DECLARE @SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2)
SELECT 
	/*@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(/*ROUND(*/
							CAST(SUM(
							 (ISNULL(pordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL(pordIFCR, 1) * ISNULL(pordIFCRI, 1)) 
							 * 
							 (( ISNULL(pordIPrice, 0) - ( ISNULL(pordIDiscount, 0) + ISNULL(pordIDiscountI, 0) + ISNULL(pordIRound, 0))
							 + ISNULL(pordIRoundPlus, 0)
							 ))	  
	 							+ (ISNULL( pordITax, 0) * ISNULL(pordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL(pordIFCR, 1) * ISNULL(pordIFCRI, 1))
							) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
							/*, 0)*/,0)		*/ /*AI991014*/
	@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(CAST(SUM(ISNULL([pordIPriceSum],0) + ISNULL([pordITaxSum],0)) AS NUMERIC(18,2)),0) /*AI991014*/
	/*AI14020325 - Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
	,@SumQuantity = SUM(pordIQuantity)
	,@TotalDiscountSum = SUM(pordIDiscountSum)
	,@TotalTaxSum = SUM(pordITaxSum)
	/*AI14020325 - End*/	
FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems
WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderId
AND ISNULL(pordINotInSum, 0) = 0
/**/
IF(@SumPriceAmount IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
	/**/
	DECLARE @pordItemCount  INT, @pordItemsAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordInstallAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@pordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordSumAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@pordTax NUMERIC(18,2),@pordTaxIndex NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordCalculateTax BIT,@pordTotalAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@pordTransportation NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),@pordRound NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordTotalAmountStr NVARCHAR(1000)	
	/**/			
	SELECT 
       @pordInstallAmount =[pordInstallAmount],
       @pordDiscount = [pordDiscount],
       @pordTaxIndex = [pordTaxIndex],
       @pordCalculateTax = [pordCalculateTax],
       @pordDiscountPercent = [pordDiscountPercent],
       @pordTransportation = [pordTransportation],
       @pordRound = [pordRound]      
	FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO
	WHERE PO.[PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId
	/**/
	SET @pordItemsAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)
	IF(@pordDiscountPercent IS NOT NULL AND @pordDiscountPercent > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @pordDiscount = (ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordDiscountPercent,0)) / 100
	END
	/**/
	SET @pordSumAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) + ISNULL(@pordInstallAmount,0) - ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0)
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@pordCalculateTax,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTax = ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordTaxIndex,0) / 100
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTax = 0
	END
	/**/
	SET @pordTotalAmount = ISNULL(ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0) + ISNULL(@pordTax,0) + ISNULL(@pordTransportation,0) - ISNULL(@pordRound,0),0)
	/**/
	SET @pordItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] POI WHERE POI.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	/*AI14010707- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
	IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
	BEGIN					
		/*AI14020627-Change Ceiling to Round*/
		SET @pordItemsAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordItemsAmount))					
		SET @pordSumAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordSumAmount))		
		SET @pordTax = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTax))		
		SET @pordTotalAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTotalAmount))		
		SET @pordDiscount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordDiscount))	
		
		/*AI14020325- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/	
		SET @TotalDiscountSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)))	
		SET @TotalTaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)))	
		/*AI14020325- End*/
		/*AI14020627- End*/
	END
	/*AI14010707- End*/




	/*************** ToTalAmountStr *******************/
	DECLARE @TotalAmoutI NVARCHAR(MAX),@TotalAmoutII NVARCHAR(MAX)
	IF(@pordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN			
		SET @TotalAmoutI = SUBSTRING(CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), 1, CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))-1)                                    
		SET @TotalAmoutII = SUBSTRING(CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))+1, 2)
		/**/
		IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1065)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			END
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr /*+ N' —Ì«·'*/
		END
		ELSE IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1025)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			END
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
			END
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = REPLACE(@pordTotalAmountStr,'-',' ') 
		END
	END
	/**************************************************/
	/*Update*/
	UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
	SET  [pordItemCount] = ISNULL(@pordItemCount,0)
		,[pordItemsAmount] = ISNULL(@pordItemsAmount,0)
		,[pordSumAmount] = ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0)
		,[pordTax] = ISNULL(@pordTax,0)
		,[pordTotalAmount] = @pordTotalAmount
		,[pordTotalAmountStr] = @pordTotalAmountStr
		,[pordDiscount] = ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0)
		,[Month1] = @Month1
		/*AI14020325 - Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
		,[pordItemsQty] = ISNULL(@SumQuantity,0)
		,[pordItemsDiscount] = ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)
		,[pordItemsTax] = ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)
		/*AI14020325 - End*/
	WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId
	/**/
	IF(@pordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LangId INT
		/**/
		DECLARE Crsr CURSOR FOR
			SELECT LanguageID
			FROM [dbo].[Languages]		
			WHERE LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
			AND ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			While @@Fetch_Status = 0
			BEGIN	 
				DECLARE @pordTotalAmountStrLang NVARCHAR(1000)	
				/*-------------------------------------------*/				
				IF(@LangId = 1065)
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang /*+ N' —Ì«·'*/
				END
				ELSE IF(@LangId = 1025)
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
					END							
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = REPLACE(@pordTotalAmountStrLang,'-',' ')
				END
				/**/
				DECLARE @PreOrdIdLang INT
				SET @PreOrdIdLang = (SELECT [WSPreOrderLangID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang] WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId AND LanguageID = @LangId)
				IF(@PreOrdIdLang IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang]
						SET [pordTotalAmountStr] = @pordTotalAmountStrLang
					WHERE [WSPreOrderLangID] = @PreOrdIdLang						
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang]
						([PreOrderID]
						,[LanguageID]
						,[pordTotalAmountStr])
					VALUES
						(@PreOrderId
						,@LangId
						,@pordTotalAmountStrLang)
				END
				/*-------------------------------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			END
		CLOSE Crsr
		DEALLOCATE Crsr	
	END							
	/*==================================================*/			
END		

/*==================================================*/	
/*RZ14030301- Clac and update Amount in currencyI*/
EXEC [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmountsCurrency]	
@PreOrderId = @PreOrderId,
@LanguageID = @LanguageID,
@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID
/*RZ14030301- End*/
/*==================================================*/
/**/
END








GO
-- [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmountsCurrency]





/*RZ14030301*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmountsCurrency]
/* 	
	exec MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmountsCurrency 4841,1033,1065	
*/
(
@PreOrderId INT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
DECLARE @pordItemsAmount NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@pordInstallAmount NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
@pordDiscount NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordSumAmount NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@pordTax NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordTotalAmount NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,		
@pordTransportation NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordRound NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,	
@pordCurrencyUnitId INT = NULL,	@pordItemsDiscount NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@pordItemsTax NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,	@pordCurrencyUnitIdI INT = NULL,
@pordCurrencyUnitIRate FLOAT = NULL,@pordItemsAmountCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@pordInstallAmountCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordDiscountCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@pordSumAmountCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordTaxCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL,
@pordTransportationCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordRoundCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@pordItemsDiscountCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,@pordItemsTaxCurrencyI NUMERIC(18, 2) = NULL,
@CurrencyUnitIsDecimal BIT = NULL,@IsDivisionCurrencyRate BIT = NULL,@RialCurrencyUnitId INT = NULL
/*-------------------------------------*/
SELECT TOP (1)     
     @pordItemsAmount = [pordItemsAmount]
    ,@pordInstallAmount = [pordInstallAmount]
    ,@pordDiscount = [pordDiscount]
    ,@pordSumAmount = [pordSumAmount]
    ,@pordTax = [pordTax]    
    ,@pordTotalAmount = [pordTotalAmount]        
    ,@pordTransportation = [pordTransportation]
    ,@pordRound = [pordRound]    
    ,@pordCurrencyUnitId = [pordCurrencyUnitId]    
    ,@pordItemsDiscount = [pordItemsDiscount]
    ,@pordItemsTax = [pordItemsTax]    
    ,@pordCurrencyUnitIdI = [pordCurrencyUnitIdI]
    ,@pordCurrencyUnitIRate = [pordCurrencyUnitIRate]    
FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO
WHERE [PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId
/*-----------------------------------*/
SET @CurrencyUnitIsDecimal = (SELECT TOP 1 [IsDecimal]
							  FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] 
							  WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = @pordCurrencyUnitIdI)
SET @RialCurrencyUnitId = (SELECT TOP 1 [CurrencyUnitID]            
						   FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits]
						   WHERE (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST([CurrencyUnit] AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,
								  NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
								= (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(N'—Ì«·' AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,
								   NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
							)

IF(ISNULL(@DefaultLanguageID,0) = 0)
BEGIN
	SET @DefaultLanguageID = (SELECT TOP(1) [DefaultLanguageID] FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting])
END
/*-----------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitId,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIdI,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0) <> 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitId,0) <> ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIdI,0))
	BEGIN
	/**/	
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/
		IF(ISNULL(@RialCurrencyUnitId,0) = ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitId,0))
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*Change rate when main currency unit is rial*/
			SET @pordCurrencyUnitIRate = CAST((1.0/ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,1)) AS FLOAT)
		/**/
		END		
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/			
		IF(ISNULL(@pordItemsAmount,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordItemsAmountCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordItemsAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordInstallAmount,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordInstallAmountCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordInstallAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordDiscountCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordSumAmountCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordTax,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTaxCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordTax,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordTotalAmount,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordTotalAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordTransportation,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTransportationCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordTransportation,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordRound,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordRoundCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordRound,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordItemsDiscount,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordItemsDiscountCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordItemsDiscount,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@pordItemsTax,0) <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordItemsTaxCurrencyI = ISNULL(@pordItemsTax,0) * ISNULL(@pordCurrencyUnitIRate,0)
		END
		/**/
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/
		IF(ISNULL(@CurrencyUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
		BEGIN	
		/**/
			SET @pordItemsAmountCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordItemsAmountCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordInstallAmountCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordInstallAmountCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordDiscountCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordDiscountCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordSumAmountCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordSumAmountCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordTaxCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTaxCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordTransportationCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTransportationCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordRoundCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordRoundCurrencyI))	
			SET @pordItemsDiscountCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordItemsDiscountCurrencyI))					
			SET @pordItemsTaxCurrencyI = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordItemsTaxCurrencyI))								
		/**/
		END
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END
/**/
END
/*-----------------------------------*/
/*************** TotalAmountStr *******************/
DECLARE @TotalAmoutI NVARCHAR(MAX),@TotalAmoutII NVARCHAR(MAX)
IF(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN			
	SET @TotalAmoutI = SUBSTRING(CAST(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), 1, CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))-1)                                    
	SET @TotalAmoutII = SUBSTRING(CAST(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))+1, 2)
	/**/
	IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1065)
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
		IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
		END
		SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr 
	END
	ELSE IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1025)
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
		IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
		END
		SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
		IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
		END
		SET @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr = REPLACE(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr,'-',' ') 
	END
END
/*-----------------------------------*/
UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
SET  [pordItemsAmountCurrencyI] = @pordItemsAmountCurrencyI
    ,[pordInstallAmountCurrencyI] = @pordInstallAmountCurrencyI
    ,[pordDiscountCurrencyI] = @pordDiscountCurrencyI
    ,[pordSumAmountCurrencyI] = @pordSumAmountCurrencyI
    ,[pordTaxCurrencyI] = @pordTaxCurrencyI
    ,[pordTotalAmountCurrencyI] = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyI
    ,[pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr] = @pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr
    ,[pordTransportationCurrencyI] = @pordTransportationCurrencyI
    ,[pordRoundCurrencyI] = @pordRoundCurrencyI
    ,[pordItemsDiscountCurrencyI] = @pordItemsDiscountCurrencyI
    ,[pordItemsTaxCurrencyI] = @pordItemsTaxCurrencyI
WHERE [PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId
/*-----------------------------------*/
/*************** TotalAmountStr in other language *******************/
IF(@pordTotalAmountCurrencyI IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
	DECLARE @LangId INT
	/**/
	DECLARE Crsr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT LanguageID
		FROM [dbo].[Languages]		
		WHERE LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
		AND ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
	/**/
	OPEN Crsr
	FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
		While @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN	 
			DECLARE @pordTotalAmountStrLang NVARCHAR(1000)	
			/*-------------------------------------------*/				
			IF(@LangId = 1065)
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
				IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
				END
				SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang /*+ N' —Ì«·'*/
			END
			ELSE IF(@LangId = 1025)
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
				IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
				END
				SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
				IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
				END							
				SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = REPLACE(@pordTotalAmountStrLang,'-',' ')
			END
			/**/
			DECLARE @PreOrdIdLang INT
			SET @PreOrdIdLang = (SELECT TOP(1) [WSPreOrderLangID] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang] WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId AND LanguageID = @LangId)
			IF(@PreOrdIdLang IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang]
					SET [pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr] = @pordTotalAmountStrLang
				WHERE [WSPreOrderLangID] = @PreOrdIdLang						
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang]
					([PreOrderID]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[pordTotalAmountCurrencyIStr])
				VALUES
					(@PreOrderId
					,@LangId
					,@pordTotalAmountStrLang)
			END
			/*-------------------------------------------*/
			FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
		END
	CLOSE Crsr
	DEALLOCATE Crsr	
END
/*-----------------------------------*/
/*------------ Update Items Amount in Currency -----------*/
EXEC [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderItemAmountsCurrency]
@PreOrderId = @PreOrderId,
@PreOrderItemIds = ''
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END









GO
-- [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderItemsTax]





 



/*RZ14021030*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderItemsTax]
/* 	
	declare @Result INT = 0
	exec MobspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderItemsTax 	
	@PreOrderId = 42842,
	@Month1 = 10,
	@Result = @Result OUTPUT
	select @Result 
*/
(
@PreOrderId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@Result INT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*--------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*------------------------ Define variables --------------------*/
DECLARE @TspPrdSendMethod INT = NULL
,@TspSettingId INT = NULL,@TspIdentify NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,@TspPrivateKey NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
,@cuUnitIsDecimal BIT = NULL
/*------------------------ Set variables ----------------------*/
SET @TspPrdSendMethod = (SELECT TOP(1) [TspPrdSendMethod] FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting])

SELECT TOP (1) 
	 @TspSettingId = [TspSettingId]
	,@TspIdentify = [TspIdentify]
    ,@TspPrivateKey = [TspPrivateKey]      
FROM [dbo].[TspSetting]

SET @cuUnitIsDecimal = (SELECT TOP 1 [IsDecimal]
						FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] 
						WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = (SELECT pordCurrencyUnitId 
												  FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] 
												  WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId))

/*-------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@TspSettingId,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@TspIdentify,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@TspPrivateKey,'') <> '')
BEGIN
/**/
	/*-----------------------------------------------------------*/
	/*----------------------- Declare table temp ----------------*/
	DECLARE @Tmp_PordItemSumTax TABLE(		
		[pordITaxSum] NUMERIC(18,2),
		[TspGroupIndentify] NVARCHAR(100)
	)
	DECLARE @Tmp_PordItems TABLE(		
		 [PreOrderItemID] INT	
		,[pordIPrdId] INT				
		,[pordITaxIndex] NUMERIC(18,2)			   
		,[pordIPriceSum] NUMERIC(18,2)	        
        ,[pordITaxSum] NUMERIC(18,2)	
		,[TspPrdIndentify] NVARCHAR(100)
		,[TspFGIndentify] NVARCHAR(100)
		,[TspSGIndentify] NVARCHAR(100)		
	)
	/*------------------- Fill table temp -----------------------*/
	INSERT INTO @Tmp_PordItems([PreOrderItemID],[pordIPrdId],[pordITaxIndex],[pordIPriceSum],[pordITaxSum],[TspPrdIndentify],[TspFGIndentify],[TspSGIndentify])
	SELECT 
		 [PreOrderItemID]
		,[pordIPrdId]
		,[pordITaxIndex]		
		,[pordIPriceSum]
        ,[pordITaxSum]
		,(SELECT TOP(1) [TspPrdIndentify] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P WHERE P.ProductID = POI.pordIPrdId) [TspPrdIndentify]
		,(SELECT [TspFGIndentify] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] WHERE PrdFirstGroupId = 
			(SELECT FirstGroupId FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] WHERE PrdSecondGroupId = 
				(SELECT PrdGroupId FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] p WHERE ProductID = pordIPrdId))) [TspFGIndentify]
		,(SELECT [TspSGIndentify] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] WHERE PrdSecondGroupId = 
			(SELECT PrdGroupId FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] p WHERE ProductID = pordIPrdId)) [TspSGIndentify]		
	FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems POI
	WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderId
	AND ISNULL(pordINotInSum,0) = 0
	AND ISNULL([pordITaxSum],0) > 0
	ORDER BY pordIOrderView
	/*-----------------------------------------------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL(@TspPrdSendMethod,0) = 1)/*Product first group*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		INSERT INTO @Tmp_PordItemSumTax([pordITaxSum],[TspGroupIndentify])
		SELECT 			 
			 [pordITaxSum]
			,LTRIM(RTRIM([TspFGIndentify])) 
		FROM @Tmp_PordItems
		WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspFGIndentify])),'') <> ''		
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@TspPrdSendMethod,0) = 3)/*Product second group*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		INSERT INTO @Tmp_PordItemSumTax([pordITaxSum],[TspGroupIndentify])
		SELECT 			 
			 [pordITaxSum]
			,LTRIM(RTRIM([TspSGIndentify])) 
		FROM @Tmp_PordItems
		WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspSGIndentify])),'') <> ''	
	/**/
	END
	/*-----------------------------------------------------------*/
	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION /*CalcPordITax*/
	/**/
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		DECLARE @PreOrderItemID INT = NULL,@TspGroupIndentify NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,@PrdGroupPordITaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
		@SumPordITaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@DiffPordITaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
		@SumPordIPriceSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@SumPordITaxIndex NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@NewPordITaxIndex NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@PordICountInGroup INT = NULL,
		@CalcTxt BIT = NULL
		
		DECLARE Crsr_CalcPordITax CURSOR LOCAL FOR				
			SELECT DISTINCT
				[TspGroupIndentify]
			FROM @Tmp_PordItemSumTax
		OPEN Crsr_CalcPordITax
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_CalcPordITax INTO @TspGroupIndentify
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
			/*-----------------------------------------------*/
			SET @PreOrderItemID = NULL
			SET @PrdGroupPordITaxSum = NULL
			SET @SumPordITaxSum = NULL
			SET @DiffpordITaxSum = NULL
			SET @SumPordIPriceSum = NULL
			SET @SumPordITaxIndex = NULL
			SET @NewPordITaxIndex = NULL
			SET @PordICountInGroup = NULL
			SET @TspGroupIndentify = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TspGroupIndentify))
			SET @CalcTxt = NULL
			/*-----------------------------------------------*/
			SET @PrdGroupPordITaxSum = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL([pordITaxSum],0)) 
											  FROM @Tmp_PordItemSumTax 
											  WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM([TspGroupIndentify])) = @TspGroupIndentify),0)

			IF(ISNULL(@TspPrdSendMethod,0) = 1)/*Product first group*/
			BEGIN
			/**/				
				SELECT 
					@SumPordIPriceSum = SUM(ISNULL([pordIPriceSum],0)),
					@SumPordITaxIndex = SUM(ISNULL([pordITaxIndex],0))
				FROM @Tmp_PordItems
				WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspFGIndentify])),'') = @TspGroupIndentify

				SET @PordICountInGroup = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*)
											    FROM @Tmp_PordItemSumTax 
											    WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM([TspGroupIndentify])) = @TspGroupIndentify),0)

				IF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT [pordITaxIndex]) FROM   @Tmp_PordItems WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspFGIndentify])),'') = @TspGroupIndentify) = 1)
				BEGIN
					SET @CalcTxt = 1
				END

				IF(ISNULL(@PordICountInGroup,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @NewPordITaxIndex =  ISNULL(@SumPordITaxIndex,0) / @PordICountInGroup					
				END
				
				IF(ISNULL(@SumPordIPriceSum,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@NewPordITaxIndex,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @SumPordITaxSum = (ISNULL(@SumPordIPriceSum,0) * ISNULL(@NewPordITaxIndex,0)) / 100					
				END				
				SET @PreOrderItemID = (SELECT TOP(1) [PreOrderItemID]
									FROM @Tmp_PordItems
									WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspFGIndentify])),'') = @TspGroupIndentify)
			/**/
			END
			ELSE IF(ISNULL(@TspPrdSendMethod,0) = 3)/*Product second group*/
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SELECT 
					@SumPordIPriceSum = SUM(ISNULL([pordIPriceSum],0)),
					@SumPordITaxIndex = SUM(ISNULL([pordITaxIndex],0))
				FROM @Tmp_PordItems
				WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspSGIndentify])),'') = @TspGroupIndentify

				SET @PordICountInGroup = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*)
											    FROM @Tmp_PordItemSumTax 
											    WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM([TspGroupIndentify])) = @TspGroupIndentify),0)
				
				IF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT [pordITaxIndex]) FROM   @Tmp_PordItems WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspSGIndentify])),'') = @TspGroupIndentify) = 1)
				BEGIN
					SET @CalcTxt = 1
				END

				IF(ISNULL(@PordICountInGroup,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @NewPordITaxIndex =  ISNULL(@SumPordITaxIndex,0) / @PordICountInGroup					
				END
				
				IF(ISNULL(@SumPordIPriceSum,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@NewPordITaxIndex,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @SumPordITaxSum = (ISNULL(@SumPordIPriceSum,0) * ISNULL(@NewPordITaxIndex,0)) / 100
					
				END

				SET @PreOrderItemID = (SELECT TOP(1) [PreOrderItemID]
									FROM @Tmp_PordItems
									WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([TspSGIndentify])),'') = @TspGroupIndentify)
			/**/
			END
			/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @SumPordITaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@SumPordITaxSum))									
			END
			/*-----------------------------------------------*/			
			IF(ISNULL(@SumPordITaxSum,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@PrdGroupPordITaxSum,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@PreOrderItemID,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@CalcTxt,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/				
				SET @DiffPordITaxSum = ISNULL(@SumPordITaxSum,0) - ISNULL(@PrdGroupPordITaxSum,0)				
				IF(ISNULL(@DiffPordITaxSum,0) <> 0 )
				BEGIN
				/**/
					/*---------------------------------------------*/
					DECLARE @pordIQuantity FLOAT = NULL,@pordITotalPrice NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
					@pordIFCR FLOAT = NULL, @pordITax NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@pordITaxIndex NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
					@pordIFCRI FLOAT = NULL,@pordIPriceSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@pordITaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
					@pordIQuantityTotal FLOAT = NULL,@PrdQtyNoFCR BIT = NULL,@TmpI NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL
					/*---------------------------------------------*/
					SELECT TOP (1) 
						 @pordIQuantity = [pordIQuantity]						
						,@pordITotalPrice = [pordITotalPrice]												
						,@pordIFCR = [pordIFCR]
						,@pordITax = [pordITax]
						,@pordITaxIndex = [pordITaxIndex]						
						,@pordIFCRI = [pordIFCRI]						
						,@pordIPriceSum = [pordIPriceSum]						
						,@pordITaxSum = [pordITaxSum]
						,@pordIQuantityTotal = [pordIQuantityTotal]
						,@PrdQtyNoFCR = (SELECT TOP(1) [PrdQtyNoFCR] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] WHERE ProductId = pordIPrdId)	
					FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] 
					WHERE [PreOrderItemID] = @PreOrderItemID
					/*---------------------------------------------*/
					SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCRI,1)
					IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1)
					/**/
					END
					IF(ISNULL(@pordIQuantityTotal,0) > 0)
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantityTotal,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCRI,1)
						IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
						BEGIN
						/**/
							SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantityTotal,1)
						/**/
						END
					/**/
					END
					/*------------------------------------*/
					/*----------------- Calculate -----------------*/
					SET @pordITaxSum = ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0) + ISNULL(@DiffPordITaxSum,0)					
					IF(ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@pordIPriceSum,0) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @pordITaxIndex = (ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@pordIPriceSum,0)
						SET @pordITax = (ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0) / ISNULL(@TmpI,0))
					END
					SET @pordITotalPrice = ISNULL(@pordIPriceSum,0) + ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0)
					/*--------- Calculate item by currency unit ------*/
					IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @pordITaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordITaxSum))
						SET @pordITax = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordITax))									
						SET @pordITotalPrice = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordITotalPrice))						
					END
					/*--------------------- Update item --------------*/					
					UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems]
					SET  [pordITotalPrice] = @pordITotalPrice
						,[pordITax] = @pordITax
						,[pordITaxIndex] = @pordITaxIndex
						,[pordITaxSum] = @pordITaxSum			
						,[Month1] = @Month1						
					WHERE PreOrderItemID = @PreOrderItemID	
					/*------------------------------------------------*/
				/**/
				END							   
			/**/
			END			
			/*-----------------------------------------------*/
			FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_CalcPordITax INTO @TspGroupIndentify
		END
		CLOSE Crsr_CalcPordITax
		DEALLOCATE Crsr_CalcPordITax		
		/*-----------------------------------------------------------------*/	
		/*-----------------------------------------------------------------*/		
		COMMIT /*CalcPordITax*/
		SET @Result = 1
		RETURN @Result
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			ROLLBACK /*CalcPordITax*/	
		/**/
		SET @Result = -1
		CLOSE Crsr_CalcPordITax
		DEALLOCATE Crsr_CalcPordITax
		/**/		
	END CATCH	   
	/*-----------------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END
/*--------------------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspCheckActionForUser]





/*AI14020529*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspCheckActionForUser]
/*
	DECLARE @HasAction BIT
	EXEC MobspCheckActionForUser N'frmPreOrderDataEntry', N'actAutoCalcNumRef', 3, @HasAction OUTPUT
	SELECT @HasAction
*/
(
@FormName NVARCHAR(50),
@ActionName NVARCHAR(50),
@UserId INT,
@HasAction BIT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT * FROM dbo.CrmsysRollPermission
		WHERE FormId = (SELECT ID FROM dbo.CrmsysForms WHERE FormName = @FormName )
		AND FormActionId = (SELECT Id FROM dbo.CrmsysFormActions WHERE ActionName = @ActionName
							AND FormId = (SELECT ID FROM dbo.CrmsysForms WHERE FormName = @FormName ))
		AND RollId = (SELECT TOP 1 RollId FROM dbo.UsersPermission WHERE UserId = @UserId AND PrjId = 11/*CRM*/))
	BEGIN
		SET @HasAction = 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @HasAction = 0
	END
END

-- [dbo].[MobspCheckCmpDataPermissionForUser]




/*RZ971221*/
/*AI990313- add user site*/
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[MobspCheckCmpDataPermissionForUser]
(
/*  
	exec MobspCheckCmpDataPermissionForUser 		
*/
@Mode INT,
@Id INT,
@CrmUserId INT,
@IsAccess BIT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @CheckForbidden BIT = 0, @CheckJustAccess BIT = 1
	IF(@CrmUserId= -10) /*AI990313 user is site*/
	BEGIN
		SET @IsAccess = 1
	END
	ELSE
	IF(@Mode = 1)/*Province*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		/*Forbidden*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenProvince
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((SELECT TOP 1 [ForbiddenProvinceId] FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenProvince
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [ForbiddenProvinceId] = @Id) IS NOT NULL)
				SET @CheckForbidden = 1 
			ELSE
				SET @CheckForbidden = 0
		END
		/*JustAccess*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessProvince
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId ) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT TOP 1 [JustAccessProvinceId]     
				FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyJustAccessProvince]
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [JustAccessProvinceId] = @Id) IS NULL)
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 0
			ELSE
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 1
		END
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CheckForbidden = 0 AND @CheckJustAccess = 1)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 2)/*City*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		/*Forbidden*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCity
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((SELECT TOP 1 ForbiddenCityId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCity
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [ForbiddenCityId] = @Id) IS NOT NULL)
				SET @CheckForbidden = 1 
			ELSE
				SET @CheckForbidden = 0
		END
		/*JustAccess*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCity
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId ) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT TOP 1 [JustAccessCityId]     
				FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyJustAccessCity]
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [JustAccessCityId] = @Id) IS NULL)
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 0
			ELSE
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 1
		END
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CheckForbidden = 0 AND @CheckJustAccess = 1)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 3)/*Group*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		/*Forbidden*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroup
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((SELECT TOP 1 ForbiddenGroupId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroup
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND ForbiddenGroupId = @Id) IS NOT NULL)
				SET @CheckForbidden = 1 
			ELSE
				SET @CheckForbidden = 0
		END
		/*JustAccess*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessGroup
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId ) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT TOP 1 [JustAccessGroupId]     
				FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyJustAccessGroup]
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [JustAccessGroupId] = @Id) IS NULL)
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 0
			ELSE
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 1
		END
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CheckForbidden = 0 AND @CheckJustAccess = 1)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 4)/*SubGroup*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		/*Forbidden*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenSubGroup
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((SELECT TOP 1 ForbiddenSubGroupId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenSubGroup
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND ForbiddenSubGroupId = @Id) IS NOT NULL)
				SET @CheckForbidden = 1 
			ELSE
				SET @CheckForbidden = 0
		END
		/*JustAccess*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessSubGroup
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId ) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT TOP 1 [JustAccessSubGroupId]     
				FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyJustAccessSubGroup]
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [JustAccessSubGroupId] = @Id) IS NULL)
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 0
			ELSE
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 1
		END
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CheckForbidden = 0 AND @CheckJustAccess = 1)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 5)/*GroupIV*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		/*Forbidden*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroupIV
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((SELECT TOP 1 ForbiddenGroupIVId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroupIV
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND ForbiddenGroupIVId = @Id) IS NOT NULL)
				SET @CheckForbidden = 1 
			ELSE
				SET @CheckForbidden = 0
		END
		/*JustAccess*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessGroupIV
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId ) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT TOP 1 [JustAccessGroupIVId]     
				FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyJustAccessGroupIV]
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [JustAccessGroupIVId] = @Id) IS NULL)
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 0
			ELSE
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 1
		END
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CheckForbidden = 0 AND @CheckJustAccess = 1)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 6)/*Company*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		/*Forbidden*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCompany
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((SELECT TOP 1 ForbiddenCompanyId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCompany
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND ForbiddenCompanyId = @Id) IS NOT NULL)
				SET @CheckForbidden = 1 
			ELSE
				SET @CheckForbidden = 0
		END
		/*JustAccess*/
		IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCompany
			WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId ) > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT TOP 1 [JustAccessCompanyId]     
				FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyJustAccessCompany]
				WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId
				AND [JustAccessCompanyId] = @Id) IS NULL)
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 0
			ELSE
				SET @CheckJustAccess = 1
		END
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CheckForbidden = 0 AND @CheckJustAccess = 1)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 7)/*cmpReferUser*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(
			(SELECT * FROM
			(SELECT @CrmUserId ReferUserId 
			 UNION 
			 SELECT LinkedUserId FROM dbo.CrmLinkedUsers 
			 WHERE CrmUserId = @CrmUserId 
			 AND LinkedTypeId = 14 ) as tmp
			 WHERE ReferUserId = @Id			 			 
			 ) IS NOT NULL		
		  )
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------*/
	ELSE IF(@Mode = 8)/*Access see company with all permission*/
	BEGIN
		/**/
		DECLARE @Qry NVARCHAR(MAX) = '' , @cmpDataPermision VARCHAR(max) = '', @CmpId INT		
		/*SET DataPermission*/		 
		EXEC dbo.MobspSetcmpDataPermission @CrmUserId
		SELECT @cmpDataPermision = TXT
		FROM dbo.CrmsysDBTempInfo
		WHERE TypeId = 20
		AND UserId = @CrmUserId
		/*SET Query*/
		SET @Qry = 'SELECT @CmpId = [CompanyID] FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany] C 
					WHERE CompanyID = ' + CAST(@Id AS VARCHAR(MAX)) + ' ' + ISNULL(@cmpDataPermision,'')		
		/*RUN Query*/
        EXECUTE sp_executesql @Qry, N' @CmpId INT OUTPUT', @CmpId OUTPUT			
		/*Set Access*/
		IF(@CmpId IS NOT NULL)
			SET @IsAccess = 1		
		/**/
	END
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspCheckDuplicatePrdSerial]






/*AI14020528 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspCheckDuplicatePrdSerial]
/* 
	EXEC MobspCheckDuplicatePrdSerial  1, 2, 1, 7, '100',13, 1033, 1065, 0
*/		
(
@OprId INT, 
@FPId INT,
@WHID INT,
@PrdId INT,
@Serial NVARCHAR(50),
@CurrId INT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL,
@DocItemSerialID INT = NULL
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
BEGIN
	SELECT 
		DIS.DocItemSerialID, 
		DIS.ItemId, 
		DIS.Serial, 
		DIS.SerialId, 
		DIS.StatusId,
		DI.PrdId,
		(SELECT PrdName FROM dbo.WSProducts WHERE ProductID = DI.PrdId) PrdName,
        D.DocNumber 
	FROM dbo.WSDocItemSerials DIS 
	INNER JOIN dbo.WSDocItems DI ON(DIS.ItemId = DI.DocItemID)
	INNER JOIN dbo.WSDoc D ON(DI.DocId = D.DocID)
	WHERE OprId = @OprId
	AND DI.PrdId = @PrdId
	AND DIS.Serial = @Serial
	AND DIS.WHId = @WHId
	AND DIS.DocItemSerialID <> @CurrId
	AND ISNULL(SerialId, 0) = Isnull(@DocItemSerialID, 0)
END
ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
BEGIN
	SELECT 
		DIS.DocItemSerialID, 
		DIS.ItemId, 
		DIS.Serial, 
		DIS.SerialId, 
		DIS.StatusId,
		DI.PrdId,
		(SELECT PrdName FROM dbo.WSProducts_Lang PLN WHERE PLN.ProductID = DI.PrdId AND PLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID) PrdName,
        D.DocNumber 
	FROM dbo.WSDocItemSerials DIS 
	INNER JOIN dbo.WSDocItems DI ON(DIS.ItemId = DI.DocItemID)
	INNER JOIN dbo.WSDoc D ON(DI.DocId = D.DocID)
	WHERE OprId = @OprId
	AND DI.PrdId = @PrdId
	AND DIS.Serial = @Serial
	AND DIS.WHId = @WHId
	AND DIS.DocItemSerialID <> @CurrId
	AND Isnull(SerialId, 0) = Isnull(@DocItemSerialID, 0)
END
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspCheckHaveCmpProjectByOrdIssuePrdId]






/*AI14020715 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspCheckHaveCmpProjectByOrdIssuePrdId]
/* 
	EXEC MobspCheckHaveCmpProjectByOrdIssuePrdId  6156,10571,1033,1065
*/	
(
@CompanyId INT,
@ProductId INT ,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL 
)	
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*----------------------------------------------------*/
DECLARE @ProjectId INT = NULL,
@PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroupId INT = NULL,@PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleId INT = NULL,@PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@PrdOrdIssuePrjUsedType INT = NULL,
/**/
@prjTitle NVARCHAR(100) = NULL, @prjPostFix NVARCHAR(200) = NULL, @prjTitleGroup NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
/*------------- Set variables ------------*/
SELECT TOP (1) 	   
	 @PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroupId = [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroupId]
	,@PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleId = [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleId]
	,@PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix = [PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix]
	,@PrdOrdIssuePrjUsedType = [PrdOrdIssuePrjUsedType]			
FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]
WHERE [ProductID] = @ProductId
/*---------------------------*/
SET @prjTitle = (SELECT TOP(1) [ProjectTitle] FROM dbo.CrmProjectTitles PT WHERE [ProjectTitleID] = @PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleId)
SET @prjTitleGroup = (SELECT TOP(1) [ProjectTitleGroup] FROM dbo.[CrmProjectTitleGroups] PT WHERE [ProjectTitleGroupId] = @PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroupId)
SET @prjPostFix = @PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix
/*----------------------------*/
SET @ProjectId = (SELECT TOP 1 P.ProjectID 
						FROM [dbo].[CrmProjects] P 
						WHERE P.prjCompanyId = @CompanyId 
						AND ISNULL(prjIsFinished,0) = 0
						AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST((ISNULL((REPLACE((ISNULL(prjTitleGroup,'') + ISNULL(prjTitle,'') + ISNULL(prjPostFix,'')),' ' ,'')),'')) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
						= 
						(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST((ISNULL((REPLACE((ISNULL(@prjTitleGroup,'') + ISNULL(@prjTitle,'') + ISNULL(@prjPostFix,'')),' ' ,'')),'')) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
					)
IF(ISNULL(@PrdOrdIssuePrjUsedType,0) = 1)/*(Issue in an existing project)*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@ProjectId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @ProjectId = -1
	/**/
	END
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@PrdOrdIssuePrjUsedType,0) = 2)/*(Issuing in a new project)*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SET @ProjectId = -1
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@PrdOrdIssuePrjUsedType,0) = 3)/*(No issuance in the absence of a project)*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@ProjectId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @ProjectId = -2
	/**/
	END
/**/
END
/*----------------------------*/
IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT 
		 @ProjectId [ProjectId]
		,[ProductID]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [ProjectTitleGroup] FROM [dbo].[CrmProjectTitleGroups] PTG WHERE PTG.[ProjectTitleGroupId] = [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroupId]) [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroup]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [ProjectTitle] FROM [dbo].[CrmProjectTitles] PT WHERE PT.[ProjectTitleID] = [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleId]) [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitle]
		,[PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix]		
	FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P
	WHERE P.ProductID = @ProductId	
/**/
END
ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT 
		 @ProjectId [ProjectId]
		,[ProductID]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [ProjectTitleGroup] FROM [dbo].[CrmProjectTitleGroups_Lang] PTG WHERE PTG.[ProjectTitleGroupId] = [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroupId] AND PTG.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleGroup]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [ProjectTitle] FROM [dbo].[CrmProjectTitles_Lang] PT WHERE PT.[ProjectTitleID] = [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitleId] AND PT.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdOrdIssuePrjTitle]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PLN WHERE PLN.[ProductID] = P.[ProductID] AND PLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix]		
	FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P
	WHERE P.ProductID = @ProductId	
/**/
END
/*----------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspCloseTicket]





/*AI14010317 - Copied from web*/
/*AI14010317 - remove condition*/
/*AI14010415 - Add prjFinishedDuration*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspCloseTicket]
(	
/* 
	EXEC MobspCloseTicket 62,1
*/
@ProjectId INT,
@UserId INT,
@Year1 INT,
@Month1 INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType VARCHAR(20)
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/	
/*----------------------- define variabels ---------------------*/
DECLARE @RegisterTime NVARCHAR(8),@RegisterDay NVARCHAR(10)
SET @RegisterTime = CAST(@RegisterDate AS TIME)
SET @RegisterDay = DATEPART(dw,@RegisterDate)
/*----------------------------------------------*/
	UPDATE [dbo].[CrmProjects]
	SET  [prjIsFinished] = 1
		,[prjFinishedDate] = @RegisterDatePersian
		,[prjFinishedDay] = @RegisterDay
		,[prjFinishedTime] = @RegisterTime
		,[prjFinishedDateTime] = @RegisterDate
		,[prjFinishedUserId] = @UserId
		,[UserId] = @UserId
		,[Year1] = @Year1
		,[Month1] = @Month1
		,[RegisterDate] = @RegisterDate
		,[RegisterDatePersian] = @RegisterDatePersian		
		,[AppType] = @AppType				
		,[prjToDoTimeDone] = @RegisterDate
		,[prjFinishedDuration] = DATEDIFF(SECOND, prjStartDateTime, @RegisterDate)/*AI14010415*/
	WHERE
	/*ISNULL([prjFOCmpCanSee], 0)  = 0 AI14010317*/
	ISNULL([prjIsTicket], 0)  = 1
	AND ProjectID = @ProjectId
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspDeleteCompanyMoneyBagFromPayment]





/*AI14020502 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDeleteCompanyMoneyBagFromPayment]
(		
/*
	EXEC MobspDeleteCompanyMoneyBagFromPayment 1,1,140
*/
@CompanyMoneyBagId INT,
@Mode INT,/*Mode = 1(Pord), Mode = 2(ord)*/
@PaymentId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		/*-------------------------------------*/
		IF(@Mode = 1)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrderPayments]
			SET pordpayCompanyMoneyBagId = NULL
			WHERE PreOrderPaymentId = @PaymentId
		/**/
		END
		ELSE IF(@Mode = 2)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrderPayments]
			SET ordpayCompanyMoneyBagId = NULL
			WHERE OrderPaymentId = @PaymentId
		/**/
		END
		/*-------------------------------------*/		
		DELETE [dbo].[CrmCompanyMoneyBag_Lang]  WHERE [CompanyMoneyBagId] = @CompanyMoneyBagId
        DELETE [dbo].[CrmCompanyMoneyBag]  WHERE [CompanyMoneyBagId] = @CompanyMoneyBagId
		SELECT 1 AS Result							
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
	SELECT 0 AS Result
END CATCH
/**/
END

	SET @CanDelete = 0

		SET @Result = '-1'

/**/

BEGIN
	SET @CanDelete = 0
	IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
		SET @Result = '-2'
	ELSE

/**/
IF(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] WHERE [CompanyId]= @CompanyId AND [ProjectId] = @ProjectId)) /*Doc*/
BEGIN
	SET @CanDelete = 0
	IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
		SET @Result = '-3'
	ELSE 
		SET @Result = ISNULL(@Result,'') + '|-3'

	exec MobspDeleteCrmCompany 6453
*/
@CompanyId INT
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		/*RZ970309- Delete dependency*/
		EXEC dbo.CRMspDeleteCompanyBackDependencies @CompanyId
		/*!RZ970309- Delete dependency*/
		DELETE dbo.CrmCompany_Lang  WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
        DELETE dbo.CrmCompany  WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
        /*Check for delete*/
        DECLARE @FindRecordId INT
        SET @FindRecordId = (SELECT TOP 1 CompanyID FROM dbo.CrmCompany  WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId)
        IF(@FindRecordId IS NULL) /*delete*/
			SELECT 1 as Result 
		ELSE
			SELECT -1 as Result /*not delete*/
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
	SELECT 0 as Result

END
