-- [dbo].[MobspDeleteCrmConversation]






/*RZ961207*/
/*AI14010415 - Set null in prjResponseDate and prjFirstDoingDate in ticket*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDeleteCrmConversation]
(		
/*
	EXEC MobspDeleteCrmConversation 25566
*/
@ConversationId INT
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION 

		/*RZ14010414- Set null in prjResponseDate and prjFirstDoingDate in ticket*/
		DECLARE @cnvsIsTicket BIT,@cnvsProjectId INT,@CnvsCnt INT
		SELECT TOP(1) 
			@cnvsIsTicket = cnvsIsTicket ,
			@cnvsProjectId = cnvsProjectId
		FROM CrmConversation 
		WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
		/**/		
		IF(ISNULL(@cnvsIsTicket,0) = 1) 
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @CnvsCnt = (SELECT COUNT(*)
							FROM CrmConversation
							WHERE cnvsProjectId = @cnvsProjectId)
			IF(ISNULL(@CnvsCnt,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				UPDATE dbo.CrmProjects
				SET [prjFirstDoingDate] = NULL,
					[prjFirstDoingDuration] = NULL,
					[prjFirstDoingUserId] = NULL,
					[prjResponseDate] = NULL,
					[prjResponseDuration] = NULL,
					[prjResponseUserId] = NULL,
					[prjReadDate] = NULL,
					[prjReadUserId] = NULL,
					[prjReadDuration] = NULL
				WHERE ProjectID = @cnvsProjectId
			/**/
			END
			ELSE IF(ISNULL(@CnvsCnt,0) > 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @CnvsCnt = (SELECT COUNT(*)
								FROM CrmConversation
								WHERE cnvsProjectId = @cnvsProjectId
								AND cnvsStatusProcessKindId IN(1,3)
								AND ISNULL(cnvsIsCopy,0) = 0)

				/*-------------------------------*/
				DECLARE @cnvsStatusProcessKindId INT
				SET @cnvsStatusProcessKindId = (SELECT TOP(1) cnvsStatusProcessKindId 
							   FROM CrmConversation
							   WHERE  ConversationID = @ConversationID
							   AND ISNULL(cnvsIsCopy,0) = 0)

				/*-------------------------------*/
				IF(ISNULL(@CnvsCnt,0) = 1)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL(@cnvsStatusProcessKindId,0) = 1 OR ISNULL(@cnvsStatusProcessKindId,0) = 3) /*Doing Or Done*/
					BEGIN
					/**/
						UPDATE dbo.CrmProjects
						SET [prjFirstDoingDate] = NULL,
							[prjFirstDoingDuration] = NULL,
							[prjFirstDoingUserId] = NULL
						WHERE ProjectID = @cnvsProjectId
					/**/
					END										
				/**/
				END	
				/*-------------------------------*/
				SET @CnvsCnt = NULL
				SET @CnvsCnt = (SELECT COUNT(*)
								FROM CrmConversation
								WHERE cnvsProjectId = @cnvsProjectId
								AND FirstRegisterUserId > 0
								AND ISNULL(cnvsIsCopy,0) = 0)
				/*-------------------------------*/
				DECLARE @cnvsId INT
				SET @cnvsId = (SELECT TOP(1) ConversationID 
							   FROM CrmConversation
							   WHERE cnvsProjectId = @cnvsProjectId
							   AND FirstRegisterUserId > 0
							   AND ISNULL(cnvsIsCopy,0) = 0)

				IF(ISNULL(@CnvsCnt,0) = 1)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL(@cnvsId,0) = @ConversationID)
					BEGIN
					/**/
						UPDATE dbo.CrmProjects
						SET [prjResponseDate] = NULL,
							[prjResponseDuration] = NULL,
							[prjResponseUserId] = NULL
						WHERE ProjectID = @cnvsProjectId
					/**/
					END
				/**/
				END				
				/*-------------------------------*/
			/**/
			END
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14010414- End*/

		DELETE dbo.CrmConversation_Lang  WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationId
        DELETE dbo.CrmConversation  WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationId
        /*Check for delete*/
        DECLARE @FindRecordId INT
        SET @FindRecordId = (SELECT TOP 1 ConversationID FROM dbo.CrmConversation  WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationId)
        IF(@FindRecordId IS NULL) /*delete*/
			SELECT 1 as Result 
		ELSE
			SELECT -1 as Result /*not delete*/                
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
    SELECT 0 as Result 
END CATCH
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspDeleteCrmProject]



/*RZ961207*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[MobspDeleteCrmProject]
(		
/*
	exec MobspDeleteCrmProject 7060, 6298, 5
*/
@ProjectId INT,
@CompanyId INT, 
@prjcnvsStatusGroupId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		/*Check allow delete*/
		DECLARE @CrmProjectMultiGroup INT, @CrmProjectMultiIGroup INT, @CountConversation INT = 0 
		SET @CrmProjectMultiGroup = (SELECT TOP 1 [ProjectID] FROM [dbo].[CrmProjectMultiGroups] WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId)
		/**/
		SET @CrmProjectMultiIGroup = (SELECT TOP 1 [ProjectID] FROM [dbo].[CrmProjectMultiIGroups] WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId)
		/**/
		EXEC MobspCheckUsedPrjCNVSStatusGroup  
		@CompanyId = @CompanyId,
		@ProjectId = @ProjectId,
		@prjcnvsStatusGroupId = @prjcnvsStatusGroupId,
		@CountConversation = @CountConversation OUTPUT
		IF(@CrmProjectMultiGroup IS NULL AND @CrmProjectMultiIGroup IS NULL AND @CountConversation = 0) /*delete*/
		BEGIN
			/*project*/
			DELETE dbo.CrmProjects_Lang  WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId
			DELETE dbo.CrmProjects  WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId
			/*Check for delete*/
			DECLARE @FindRecordId INT
			SET @FindRecordId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ProjectID] FROM dbo.CrmProjects  WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId)
			IF(@FindRecordId IS NULL) /*delete*/
				SELECT 1 as Result 
			ELSE
				SELECT -1 as Result /*not delete*/
			END
		ELSE
		BEGIN /*Redundancy*/
			SELECT 0 as Result /*Redundancy*/
		END    		
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
    SELECT 0 as Result
END CATCH
/**/
END

(		
/*

		DELETE [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials_Lang] 
		WHERE DocItemSerialID IN (SELECT 
										DocItemSerialID 
									FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
									WHERE ItemId IN(SELECT DocItemID
													FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]  
													WHERE DocID = @DocId))

		DELETE [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] WHERE ItemId IN(SELECT DocItemID
														FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]  
														WHERE DocID = @DocId)

		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems_Lang]  
		WHERE DocItemID IN(SELECT DocItemID
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]  
							WHERE DocID = @DocId)

		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]  WHERE DocID = @DocId

		/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
		SELECT 1 AS Result
    COMMIT

        ROLLBACK

-- [dbo].[MobspDeleteDocItemWithLinkedPrd]






/*AI14020601 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDeleteDocItemWithLinkedPrd]
(		
/*
	EXEC MobspDeleteDocItemWithLinkedPrd 559,2200
*/
@DocId INT,
@DocItemId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
		/*------------------------ Delete items by linked -----------------*/
		DECLARE @ProductId INT
		SET @ProductId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PrdId] FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] WHERE [DocItemID] = @DocItemId) 
				
		DELETE [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials_Lang] 
		WHERE DocItemSerialID IN (SELECT 
											DocItemSerialID 
									   FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
									   WHERE ItemId IN (SELECT 
																	I.DocItemID 
																 FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] I 
																 WHERE DocId = @DocId
																 AND [PrdId] IN(SELECT 
																						(CASE WHEN PrdId = @ProductId 
																							THEN LinkedPrdId
																							ELSE PrdId									
																						END) [LinkedPrdId]			 
																					 FROM [dbo].[WSLinkedProducts]	
																					 WHERE ([PrdId] = @ProductId	
																					 OR [LinkedPrdId] = @ProductId)			
																					 )))

		DELETE [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] 
		WHERE ItemId IN (SELECT 
									I.DocItemID 
								  FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] I 
								  WHERE DocId = @DocId
								  AND [PrdId] IN(SELECT 
														(CASE WHEN PrdId = @ProductId 
															THEN LinkedPrdId
															ELSE PrdId									
														END) [LinkedPrdId]			 
													 FROM [dbo].[WSLinkedProducts]	
													 WHERE ([PrdId] = @ProductId	
													 OR [LinkedPrdId] = @ProductId)			
													 ))

		/*-----------------------*/

		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems_Lang]  
		WHERE DocItemID IN (SELECT I.DocItemID FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] I 
								WHERE DocId = @DocId
								AND [PrdId] IN(SELECT 
															(CASE WHEN PrdId = @ProductId 
																THEN LinkedPrdId
																ELSE PrdId									
															END) [LinkedPrdId]			 
													FROM [dbo].[WSLinkedProducts]	
													WHERE ([PrdId] = @ProductId	
													OR 	[LinkedPrdId] = @ProductId)			
													))

		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] 
		WHERE DocId = @DocId
		AND [PrdId] IN (SELECT 
								 (CASE WHEN PrdId = @ProductId 
									   THEN LinkedPrdId
									   ELSE PrdId									
								 END) [LinkedPrdId]			 
							FROM [dbo].[WSLinkedProducts]	
							WHERE ([PrdId] = @ProductId	
							OR 	[LinkedPrdId] = @ProductId)			
							)
		
		/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
		/*---------------------- Delete main item -----------------------*/
		
		DELETE [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials_Lang] 
		WHERE DocItemSerialID IN (SELECT 
										DocItemSerialID 
									FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
									WHERE ItemId = @DocItemId)
		DELETE [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] WHERE ItemId = @DocItemId		
		
		/*-----------------------*/

		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems_Lang]  WHERE DocItemID = @DocItemId
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]  WHERE DocItemID = @DocItemId

		/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
		SELECT 1 AS Result
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
	SELECT 0 AS Result
END CATCH
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspDeleteWSOrderItems]






/*AI14000804*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDeleteWSOrderItems]
(		
/*
	EXEC MobspDeleteWSOrderItems 6453
*/
@OrderItemId INT
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
		/*Check if item exists*/
		DECLARE @FindRecordId INT
        SET @FindRecordId = (SELECT TOP 1 [OrderItemID] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems] WHERE [OrderItemID] = @OrderItemId)
		IF(@FindRecordId IS NULL)
			SELECT -2 AS Result /*Not exist*/
		ELSE IF(@FindRecordId > 0)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @OrdId INT, @Month1 INT, @DefLanguageId INT
			SET @OrdId = (SELECT TOP 1 [OrderId] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems]  WHERE [OrderItemID] = @OrderItemId)
			SET @Month1 = CAST(SUBSTRING(((SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithOutSlash](CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)))),5,2) AS INT)
			SET @DefLanguageId = (SELECT TOP 1 DefaultLanguageID FROM dbo.CrmsysSetting)
			/**/
			DELETE [dbo].[WSOrderItems_Lang] WHERE [OrderItemID] = @OrderItemId
			DELETE [dbo].[WSOrderItems]  WHERE [OrderItemID] = @OrderItemId

			/*Update order amount*/
			EXEC [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdateOrderAmounts] @OrdId, @Month1, @DefLanguageId, @DefLanguageId

			/*Check if is deleted*/
			SET @FindRecordId = (SELECT TOP 1 [OrderItemID] FROM WSOrderItems  WHERE [OrderItemID] = @OrderItemId)
			IF(@FindRecordId IS NULL)
				SELECT 1 AS Result  /*deleted*/
			ELSE
				SELECT -1 AS Result /*not deleted*/
		END
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
	SELECT 0 AS Result
END CATCH
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspDyFormCheck]







/*AI14010512 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDyFormCheck]
(
/* 
	EXEC MobspDyFormCheck 357, 3,'13970824' ,2
*/
@MasterValueId INT,
@CheckerUserId INT,
@CheckedDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@Mode INT /*mode=1 ===> form is normal, mode=2 ===> form is a workflow*/
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(@Mode = 1)/*for normal form*/
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 1
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
			  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
		WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
		/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 1
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
			  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
		WHERE [MasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
	END
	ELSE /*for form has a workflow*/
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 1
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
			  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
		WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId	
		DECLARE @FormId INT
		SET  @FormId = (SELECT TOP 1 [FormId] FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues] WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId) 
		IF(ISNULL(@FormId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails]
			   SET [IsChecked] = 1
				  ,[CheckerUserId] = @CheckerUserId
				  ,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
				  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian
			WHERE [MasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
			AND [FormId] = @FormId
		/**/
		END		
	END			
/**/
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDyFormCheckExit]
(

	EXEC MobspDyFormCheckExit 361, '13970824',2
*/	
@MasterValueId INT,
@CheckedDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@Mode INT /*mode=1 ===> form is normal, mode=2 ===> form is a workflow*/
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(@Mode = 1)/*for normal form*/
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 0
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003*/
			  /*,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian*/
			  ,[CheckedDate] = NULL
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003-End*/
		WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
		/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 0
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003*/
			  /*,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian*/
			  ,[CheckedDate] = NULL
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003-End*/
		WHERE [MasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
	END
	ELSE /*for form has a workflow*/
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsChecked] = 0
			  ,[CheckerUserId] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003*/
			  /*,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian*/
			  ,[CheckedDate] = NULL
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003-End*/
		WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId		
		DECLARE @FormId INT
		SET  @FormId = (SELECT TOP 1 [FormId] FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues] WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @MasterValueId) 
		IF(ISNULL(@FormId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/

			  ,[CheckerUserId] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003*/
			  /*,[CheckedDate] = GETDATE()
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = @CheckedDatePersian*/
			  ,[CheckedDate] = NULL
			  ,[CheckedDatePersian] = NULL
			  /*AI14011003-End*/
			WHERE [MasterValueId] = @MasterValueId
			AND [FormId] = @FormId
		/**/

END

-- [dbo].[MobspDyUpdateToDeleteFormFieldMasterValue]





/*AI14011003*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspDyUpdateToDeleteFormFieldMasterValue]
(		
/*
	EXEC MobspDyUpdateToDeleteFormFieldMasterValue 30
*/
@MasterValueId INT
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldValues]
		   SET [IsDeleted] = 1
		WHERE MasterValueId = @MasterValueId
		/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails]
		   SET [IsDeleted] = 1
		WHERE MasterValueId = @MasterValueId
		/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
		   SET [IsDeleted] = 1
		WHERE FormFieldMasterValueId = @MasterValueId
				
		SELECT 1 AS Result
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK	
	SELECT 0 AS Result
END CATCH
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspInsertCompanyChangeHistory]






/*AI14020705 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspInsertCompanyChangeHistory]
/*
	declare @InsertedId int = 0
	exec MobspInsertCompanyChangeHistory 
	@CompanyId = 68697,
	@FieldName = N'cmpReferUserId',
	@OldValue = N'56',
	@NewValue = N'3',
	@Desc = N'', 
	@CmpChangeHistory_Lang = NULL, 	
	@UserId = 3,
	@RegisterDate = '2023-02-13',
	@RegisterDatePersian = '14011124',
	@AppType = 'dasti',
	@DefaultLanguageID = 1065,		
	@InsertedId = @InsertedId OUTPUT
	select @InsertedId 
*/
(
@CompanyId INT,
@FieldName NVARCHAR(300),
@OldValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@NewValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@Desc NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, 
@CmpChangeHistory_Lang NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, 
/**/
@UserId INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(20),
@DefaultLanguageID INT,
/**/
@InsertedId INT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	/*============================================================================*/
	/*================================ Insert ====================================*/
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmCompanyChangeHistory]
        ([CompanyID]
        ,[FieldName]
        ,[OldValue]
        ,[NewValue]
        ,[Desc]
        ,[UserId]
        ,[RegisterDate]
        ,[RegisterDatePersian]        
        ,[AppType]
        ,[LanguageID])
    VALUES
        (@CompanyID
        ,@FieldName
        ,@OldValue
        ,@NewValue
        ,@Desc
        ,@UserId
        ,@RegisterDate
        ,@RegisterDatePersian
        ,@AppType
        ,@DefaultLanguageID)
	SET @InsertedId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()	
	IF(ISNULL(@InsertedId,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@CmpChangeHistory_Lang,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmCompanyChangeHistory_Lang]
			([CompanyChangeHistoryId]
			,[LanguageID]
			,[OldValue]
			,[NewValue]
			,[Desc])
		SELECT 
			@InsertedId,
			JS.[LanguageID],
			JS.[OldValue],
			JS.[NewValue],
			JS.[Desc]
		FROM OPENJSON(ISNULL(@CmpChangeHistory_Lang,'[]'))
		WITH (
			[LanguageID] INT '$.LanguageID',
			[OldValue] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.OldValue',
			[NewValue] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.NewValue',
			[Desc] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.Desc'
		) AS JS
		WHERE JS.[LanguageID] <> @DefaultLanguageID
		AND JS.[LanguageID] IN(SELECT L.[LanguageID]
							   FROM [dbo].[Languages] L
							   WHERE ISNULL(L.IsActive,0) = 1)
	/**/
	END		
	/*===========================================================================*/
/**/
END

Create Procedure [dbo].[MobspInsertProjectInformationsDefualtField]
(		
/*
	exec MobspInsertProjectInformationsDefualtField 
	@ProjectID = 6968,
	@UserId = 3,
	@Year1 = 2,
	@Month1 = 9,
	@RegisterDate = '2017-12-19',
	@RegisterDatePersian = '13960928',
	@AppType = 'dasti',
	@LanguageID = 1065,
	@FirstRegisterUserId  = 3,
	@FirstRegisterDatePersian = '13960928',
	@FirstRegisterDate = '2017-12-19' 
*/
@ProjectID INT,
@UserId INT,
@Year1 INT,
@Month1 INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(50),
@LanguageID INT,
@FirstRegisterUserId INT,
@FirstRegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(10),
@FirstRegisterDate DATETIME 
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	INSERT INTO dbo.CrmProjectInformations (
		ProjectId,
		FieldTitleId,
		UserId,
		Year1,
		Month1,
		RegisterDate,
		RegisterDatePersian,
		AppType, 
		LanguageID,
		FirstRegisterUserId,
		FirstRegisterDatePersian,
		FirstRegisterDate
	) 
	SELECT 
		@ProjectID,
		ProjectFieldTitleId,
		@UserId,
		@Year1,
		@Month1,
		GETDATE(),
		@RegisterDatePersian,
		@AppType, 
		@LanguageID,
		@FirstRegisterUserId,
		@FirstRegisterDatePersian,
		@FirstRegisterDate 
	FROM dbo.CrmProjectFieldTitle
	WHERE IsDefualtField = 1
	AND ProjectFieldTitleId NOT IN ( SELECT ProjectFieldTitleId 
					FROM CrmProjectFieldTitle
					WHERE ProjectId = @ProjectID)
/**/
END

		@SendDate,
		@SendTime, 
		@SendDateTime,
		@AppType,
		@SendPriority,
		@DefaultLanguageID,
		@UserId,
		@RegisterDatePersian,
		GETDATE(), 
		@SendNeedCheck,
		@CompanyProjectId, 
		@ObjectId,
		@ObjectIdType,
		@OTP
	FROM SmsTempMobileNumbers 
	WHERE UserId = @UserId 
	And Selector = 1	
	AND MobileLength = 11
	AND MobilePreNum = '09'	
	/*--

	IF (@SendType = 1 OR @SendType = 2)

	/*--*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspIntMsgGetCmpVerifyMessageCnt]
(	
/* 
	EXEC MobspIntMsgGetCmpVerifyMessageCnt 3 
*/
@ToUserId INT,
@CompanyId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
/*--*/
	SELECT COUNT(*) Cnt 
	FROM dbo.CrmInternalMessageDetails MD 
	WHERE (CASE
		WHEN MD.msgdTypeId = 5 THEN(SELECT pordCompanyId FROM dbo.WSPreOrder WHERE PreOrderID = MD.msgdAttachRecId) 
		WHEN MD.msgdTypeId = 8 THEN(SELECT ordCompanyId FROM dbo.WSOrder WHERE OrderID = MD.msgdAttachRecId) 
		END) = @CompanyId
		AND msgdToUserId = @ToUserId
		AND (msgdIsRead = 0 OR msgdIsRead is NULL)
END

	@OrdItemList = N'3113,5|3114,3|3115,2|3116,0|3117,4|3118,4|3120,0'
	select @InsertedDraftID,@InsertedDraftNumber

	[OrderItemId] INT,
	[Quantity] FLOAT
)
IF(ISNULL(@OrdItemList,'') <> '')

	/**/
	DECLARE CrsrI CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	/**/	
		SELECT SplitData  
		FROM fnSplitString(@OrdItemList, '|')
	/**/
	OPEN CrsrI
	FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrI INTO @Text
	WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*================================================================================*/
		DECLARE @Field NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
		SET @CrsrOrderItemId = NULL
		SET @CrsrQuantity = NULL			
		/**/
		/*****************************************************************/
		IF(ISNULL(@Text,'') <> '') 
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*===========================================================*/	
			SET @CrsrOrderItemId = CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Text, 1, CHARINDEX(',',@Text)-1),'0') AS INT)                                    
			SET @CrsrQuantity = CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Text, CHARINDEX(',', @Text)+1, Len(@Text)),'0') AS FLOAT)

			INSERT INTO @TmpTable ([OrderItemId],[Quantity])
			VALUES(@CrsrOrderItemId,@CrsrQuantity)
								
			/*===========================================================*/				
		/**/
		END
		/*================================================================================*/					    				 					
	/**/	
	FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrI INTO @Text
	END
	CLOSE CrsrI
	DEALLOCATE CrsrI
/**/
END

/*---------------------------------------------------*/
DECLARE @InsertedOldDraftID INT
/*»—«Ì «Ì‰òÂ »—«Ì Ìò ›«ò Ê— »Ì‘ — «“  ⁄œ«œ „Ã«“ »—êÂ «‰»«— ’«œ— ‰‘Êœ  çò »—«”«” „Ã„Ê⁄Â  ⁄œ«œ «ﬁ·«„  «‰Ã«„ „Ì ‘Êœ.
 “Ì—« „Ì  Ê«‰ »—êÂ «‰»«— »«  ⁄œ«œ œ·ŒÊ«Â ò«·« «“ ›«ò Ê— ’«œ— ò—œ.*/
IF(ISNULL((
	ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(ordIQuantity,0))
			FROM dbo.WSOrderItems
			WHERE OrderId = @OrderID
			/*AI14020912- Not Add Product by prdKind 2*/
			AND ordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
								FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
								WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )

			),0)
	-
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(Quantity,0)) FROM dbo.WSDocItems DI WHERE DI.DocId IN(SELECT D.DocId FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D WHERE D.OrderId = @OrderID)),0)
	),0) = 0
)
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

						AND FormId = (SELECT ID FROM dbo.CrmsysForms WHERE FormName = N'frmIssueDraftFromOrder' ))

	SET @HavePermissionMoveOrdDescIIToDoc = 1

	SET @HavePermissionMoveOrdDescIIToDoc = 0

Declare @DraftId INT

				END

				SET @PrdUnitIRate = NULL

				FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]

				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@ordIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@ordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@ordIFCRI,1)

					SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@ordIQuantity,1) 					
				/**/
				END

				IF(/*ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto,0) = 1 AND*/ ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@ordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0) /*AI14020912- Calculate RateResult in fiexd PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto*/
				BEGIN

					/*SET @ordIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@TmpI,1)*/
					SET @ordIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@ordIQuantity,1)

					IF(ISNULL(@ordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @ordIPrdUnitIRateResult = CAST((FORMAT(@ordIPrdUnitIRateResult, '000.000')) AS FLOAT) 
					/**/
					END
				/**/
				END

				INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItems (

							SerialId,

						FROM dbo.WSOrderItemSerials OSI

																FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]

																				AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType IN(2,3)))
										
						
															 )											
											)
						AND  (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((SELECT DISI.Serial FROM dbo.WSDocItemSerials DISI WHERE DISI.DocItemSerialID = OSI.SerialId),'') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
											NOT IN(SELECT (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(DIS.Serial AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
													FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
													WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemID]    
																		FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]
																		WHERE PrdId = @ordIPrdId
																		AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																						FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																						WHERE D.OrderId = @OrderId
																						AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType = 1))																
																		)																
								)
						
					OPEN Crsr_Add_Serial
					FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO @SerialId, @ordItemSerialDescription, @OrderItemSerialID
					WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
					BEGIN

						DECLARE @Serial NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,@RootId INT = NULL,@OprType INT = NULL
						/*Find doc type via orderOpr*/
						SET @OprType = (SELECT TOP 1[OprType]
											FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr]  DO
											WHERE DO.[DocOprID]  = ((SELECT  
																		(SELECT TOP 1 Opr.DocOprId 
																			FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr WHERE Opr.OrderOprID = O.OrderOprID) 			 
																		FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																		WHERE OrderId = @OrderId))						
										)

						IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 1)/*Doc*/

							SELECT TOP 1 
								 @Serial = [Serial]	
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
							WHERE [DocItemSerialID] = @SerialId
							SET @RootId = 0
							SET @SerialId = NULL
						/**/
						END
						ELSE IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 2 OR  ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 3)/*Draft Or Movement*/
						BEGIN
						/**/
							/*----------------*/
							SELECT TOP 1 
								 @Serial = [Serial]							
								,@RootId = [RootId]
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
							WHERE [DocItemSerialID] = @SerialId
							SET @RootId = ISNULL(@RootId,0)
							IF(@RootId = 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @RootId = @SerialId
							END
							/*----------------*/
						/**/
						END						 			
												
						INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItemSerials (

							@AppType,
							@LanguageID,
							@RegisterDatePersian,
							@UserId,
							GETDATE(),
							@Serial,
							@RootId)
		
						SET @docItemSerialId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
						/*Insert records in lang table*/			
						INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials_Lang]
						(
							[DocItemSerialID]
						   ,[LanguageID]
						   ,[Description]
						)

							@docItemSerialId,
							OISLN.LanguageID,
							OISLN.[Description]
						FROM dbo.WSOrderItemSerials_Lang OISLN

						FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO  @SerialId, @ordItemSerialDescription, @OrderItemSerialID
					/*---------------------------------------*/
					END
					CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
					DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
					/*----------------- End user cursor for insert serial in doc --------------------------------*/				
					/*------------------- tran3 -----------------------*/
					IF (@@ERROR > 0)
					BEGIN 
						SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItemSerial' 
						SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
						CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
						DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
					ROLLBACK TRAN 
					END		
					ELSE 
					COMMIT TRAN 
					/*------------------- tran3 -----------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM crsr INTO @OrderItemID, @ordIPrdId, @ordIQuantity, 
										  @ordIDescription,@ordIFCR, @ordIFCRI,
										  @ordITracing
										  ,@ordIPrdUnitId
										  ,@ordIQuantityTotal
										  ,@ordIPrdUnitIdI,@ordIPrdUnitIRateResult
										  ,@ordIPrdNickname
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			END
			/*--*/
			CLOSE crsr
			DEALLOCATE crsr
			/*--*/
			/*------------------- tran2 ----------------------*/
			IF (@@ERROR > 0)
			BEGIN 
				SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItems' 
				SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
			ROLLBACK TRAN 
			END		
			ELSE 
			COMMIT TRAN 
			/*------------------- tran2 ----------------------*/			
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Wrhs INTO @WareHouseId
	END
	CLOSE Crsr_Wrhs
	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Wrhs
		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
begin
	RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
	Set @DraftId = 0
	Return @DraftId
end
ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main
	Return @DraftId
END	
/*--*/
END







GO

		SET @InsertedPordNumberRevision = 0
		 
		SELECT 0			
	/**/
	END	
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	/*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/

    SET @InsertedPreOrderId = 0
	SET @InsertedPordNumber = 0
	SET @InsertedPordNumberRevision = 0

BEGIN

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspIssueOrderFromPreOrder]
(		
/* 
	EXEC MobspIssueOrderFromPreOrder  18, '13890714',1, 1, 3, 7, 1, '13890714'
*/
@PreOrderID INT,
@OrderDate VARCHAR(8),
@OrderOprId INT,
@OrderPrintFormatID INT,
@OrderReferUserId INT,
@UserId INT,
@Month1 INT,
@FPId INT,
@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(50), 
/*950403*/
@ordNote NVARCHAR(4000)= NULL, 
@ordSettlementTypeId INT= NULL,
@OrderDefaultSettingId INT= NULL,  
/**/
@InsertedOrderID INT OUTPUT ,
@InsertedOrderNumber BIGINT OUTPUT,/*RZ990811- Change type from int to bigint*/
/*ADBF951130*/
@LanguageID INT,
/*RZ960218 for multi language And add length variable*/
@ordNoteLang NVARCHAR(MAX)= NULL,
/*RZ14010531- Add project and add manual quantity for every product in multi order*/
@OrdProjectId INT = NULL,
@PordItemList NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@IsTransferFreePay BIT = NULL,
@IsTransferFreeComm BIT = NULL,
/*RZ14010531- End*/
@ordCompanyPersonId INT = NULL,/*RZ14020531- Add person and issue orderindex*/
/*RZ14020604- Add parameters*/
@ordIssueSettingByPrdId INT = NULL,
@ordIssueIndexedByPrdId INT = NULL
/*RZ14020604- End*/
)
AS
BEGIN
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14010531- Add project and add manual quantity for every product in multi order*/
IF(ISNULL(@OrdProjectId,0) = 0 )
BEGIN
/**/
	SET @OrdProjectId = (SELECT pordProjectId FROM dbo.WSPreOrder PO WHERE PO.PreOrderId = @PreOrderID)
/**/
END
/**/
IF(ISNULL(@PordItemList,'') = '')
BEGIN
/**/	
	/*---------------------------------------*/
	/*---------- Issue one order ------------*/
	SET @IsTransferFreePay = 1
	SET @IsTransferFreeComm = 1
	/*---------------------------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) OrderId FROM WSOrder WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID ),0) = 0) /*PreOrder not have any order*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @PordItemList = (SELECT 
								PreOrderItemID [Id],			
								pordIQuantity [Value],
								/*RZ14020604- Add parameters and expireDate in items*/
								pordIValidityExpireDate [ValidityExpireDate],
								pordIValidityExpireDatePersian [ValidityExpireDatePersian],
								pordIPrdAutoCalcRate [PrdAutoCalcRate]
								/*RZ14020604- End*/
							FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems
							WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID		
							ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)	
							FOR JSON PATH)
	/**/
	END
	ELSE /*IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) OrderId FROM WSOrder WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID ),0) > 0)*/ /*PreOrder have order*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @PordItemList = (SELECT 
								PreOrderItemID [Id],			
								(ISNULL(pordIQuantity,0) - 
								ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ordIQuantity) 
										FROM dbo.WSOrderItems OI
										WHERE OrderId IN(SELECT O.OrderId 
														 FROM dbo.WSOrder O 
														 WHERE O.PreOrderId = POI.PreOrderId
														 )
										/*AND ordIWHId = pordIWHId
										AND ordIPrdId = pordIPrdId
										AND ordIPrice = pordIPrice*/
										/*RZ14021202- Add PreOrderItemId to WSOrderItems*/
										AND OI.PreOrderItemId = POI.PreOrderItemID
										/*RZ14021202- End*/
														 ),0)
	
								) [Value],
								/*RZ14020604- Add parameters and expireDate in items*/
								pordIValidityExpireDate [ValidityExpireDate],
								pordIValidityExpireDatePersian [ValidityExpireDatePersian],
								pordIPrdAutoCalcRate [PrdAutoCalcRate]
								/*RZ14020604- End*/
							FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems POI

					FROM [dbo].[WSOrder]

							,@IndexedOrdIValidityExpireDatePersian

								 @IndexedOrderItemId

							FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang]
							WHERE ProductID = @IndexedOrdIPrdId

						ENd
						/*------------------------------------*/
						IF(ISNULL(@InsertedOrderID,0) > 0)
						BEGIN

							EXEC [dbo].[MobspCalcAndUpdateOrderAmounts] /*AI14020705*/
							@OrderId = @IndexedOrdId,

						/**/
						END
						/*------------------------------------*/	
					/**/
					END
					/*------------------------------------*/		
				/*------------------- tran6 --------------------*/
				IF (@@ERROR > 0)
				BEGIN 
					SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSOrder For PrdIndexed' 
					SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 				
				ROLLBACK TRAN 
				END		
				ELSE 
				COMMIT TRAN 		
				/*----------------------------------------*/
				/*----------------------------------------------*/
			/**/
			END
			/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/**/
		END				
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*---------------- OrdIndex END ----------------*/
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*-------- Update prjRemindDate START ----------*/
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		SET @ProductId = NULL
		SET @PrdValidityUpdatePrjRemindDateAfterIssueOrd = NULL
		SET @prjRemindDate = NULL
		SET @prjRemindDateTime = NULL
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*------- Find product validty for update prjRemindDate ---------*/
		SELECT TOP(1) 
			 @ProductId = ProductID
			,@PrdValidityUpdatePrjRemindDateAfterIssueOrd = [PrdValidityUpdatePrjRemindDateAfterIssueOrd]			
		FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P
		WHERE ProductID IN(SELECT TOP(1) pordIPrdId			
							FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems
							WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID
							AND PreOrderItemID IN(SELECT [Id]
												FROM OPENJSON(@PordItemList)
												WITH (
													[Id] INT '$.Id',
													[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
												) AS JS)				  			
							ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID))
		AND ISNULL([PrdValidityUpdatePrjRemindDateAfterIssueOrd],0) = 1
		AND ISNULL([PrdValidity],0) = 1
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		IF(ISNULL(@ProductId,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@PrdValidityUpdatePrjRemindDateAfterIssueOrd,0) =1)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SELECT TOP(1)
				 @prjRemindDateTime = ordIValidityExpireDate
				,@prjRemindDate = ordIValidityExpireDatePersian
			FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems]
			WHERE OrderId = @InsertedOrderID
			AND ordIPrdId = @ProductId
			AND ordIValidityExpireDate IS NOT NULL
			/**/
			IF(@prjRemindDateTime IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				UPDATE [dbo].[CrmProjects]
				SET prjRemindDateTime = @prjRemindDateTime
					,prjRemindDate = @prjRemindDate
				WHERE ProjectID = @OrdProjectId
			/**/
			END
		/**/
		END			   
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*-------- Update prjRemindDate END ------------*/
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
		/*----------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14020531- End*/
	/*----------------------------------------------*/
	/*----------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

ELSE IF(ISNULL(@OrdProjectId,0) = 0)/*RZ14020531- Add person and issue orderindex*/
BEGIN
/**/
	RETURN -2
/**/
END
/*---------------------------------------------------*/

	RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)

-- [dbo].[MobspOrderVerifyWithPreChecks]






/*RZ971011*/
/*RZ971114- Change price to decimals*/
/*AI14001030 - Modify Calculate discount in item*/
/*AI14010522 - Changed sp name from MobspOrderVerify because it contains pre checks*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspOrderVerifyWithPreChecks]
/* 
	DECLARE	@Result INT, @Limit NUMERIC(18,2)
	EXEC MobspOrderVerifyWithPreChecks 17362, 1, 3, '14000811', '2021-11-02 12:48:17', @LimitOrderDiscountPercent = @Limit OUTPUT, @Result = @Result OUTPUT
	SELECT @Result as Result, @Limit as Limit
*/		
(
@OrderId INT,
@RollId INT,
@VerifierUserId INT,
@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(20),
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@LimitOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2) OUTPUT,
@Result INT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/**************** Find MaxDiscountPercent For Roll ********************/
	DECLARE @LimitOrderDiscountActive BIT

	SELECT 
		@LimitOrderDiscountActive = LimitOrderDiscountActive, 
		@LimitOrderDiscountPercent = LimitOrderDiscountPercent
	FROM dbo.CrmsysRolls
	WHERE ID = @RollId

	IF(@LimitOrderDiscountPercent > 0 AND @LimitOrderDiscountPercent IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0, /*RZ971114- Change price to decimals*/
				@SumDiscount NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0 , 
				@ordDiscount NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0 ,
				@DiscountPercent NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0 
				/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
				,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount NUMERIC(18,2) = 0
				,@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2) = 0
				/*AI14001030- End*/	
		SELECT @ordDiscount = [ordDiscount] FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O WHERE O.[OrderID] = @OrderId		
		SELECT 
			 @SumPriceAmount = [SumPriceAmount] 
			,@SumDiscount = [SumDiscount] 
			/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount 
			,@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
			/*AI14001030- End*/ 
		FROM [dbo].[MobfnReturnOrderSumFooter](@OrderId) 
	
		IF(@SumPriceAmount IS NOT NULL AND @SumPriceAmount > 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0)/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
		BEGIN 
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (@SumDiscount * 100) / @SumPriceAmount*/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/

			IF(@DiscountPercent > @LimitOrderDiscountPercent)
			BEGIN			
				SET @Result = -2 /*MaxDiscountPercentInItems*/								
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @DiscountPercent = 0
				SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0) * 100) / @SumPriceAmount				
				IF(@DiscountPercent > @LimitOrderDiscountPercent)
				BEGIN
					SET @Result = -3 /*MaxDiscountPercentInOrder*/					
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @Result = 1
				END				
			END			
		END
		ELSE
			SET @Result = -1 /*DivisionByZero*/		
	END
	ELSE
		SET @Result = 1 				                                               
	/**************** Order Verify *************************************/
	IF(@Result = 1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.WSOrder
		SET 
		ordIsVerified = 1,
		ordVerifierId = @VerifierUserId,
		ordIsFixed = 1,
		ordVerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,

-- [dbo].[MobspPreOrderVerifyWithPreChecks]







/*RZ970312*/
/*RZ971114- Change price to decimals*/
/*AI14001030 - Modify Calculate discount in item*/
/*AI14010522 - Changed sp name from MobspPreOrderVerify because it contains pre checks*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspPreOrderVerifyWithPreChecks]
/* 
	EXEC MobspPreOrderVerifyWithPreChecks  		
*/		
(
@PreOrderId INT,
@RollId INT,
@VerifierUserId INT,
@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(20),
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2) OUTPUT,
@Result INT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/**************** Find MaxDiscountPercent For Roll ********************/
	DECLARE @LimitPreOrderDiscountActive BIT

	SELECT 
		@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive = LimitPreOrderDiscountActive, 
		@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent = LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent
	FROM dbo.CrmsysRolls
	WHERE ID = @RollId

	IF(@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent > 0 AND @LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0, /*RZ971114- Change price to decimals*/
				@SumDiscount NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0 , 
				@PordDiscount NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0 ,
				@DiscountPercent NUMERIC(18, 2) = 0
				/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
				,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount NUMERIC(18,2) = 0
				,@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2) = 0
				/*AI14001030- End*/ 	
		SELECT @PordDiscount = [pordDiscount] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO WHERE PO.[PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId		
		SELECT 
			 @SumPriceAmount = [SumPriceAmount] 
			,@SumDiscount = [SumDiscount]
			/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount 
			,@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
			/*AI14001030- End*/ 
		FROM [dbo].[MobfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter](@PreOrderId) 
	
		IF(@SumPriceAmount IS NOT NULL AND @SumPriceAmount > 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0)/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
		BEGIN 
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (@SumDiscount * 100) / @SumPriceAmount*/
			
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)/*AI14001030- Modify Calculate discount in item*/


			IF(@DiscountPercent > @LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent)
			BEGIN			
				SET @Result = -2 /*MaxDiscountPercentInItems*/								
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @DiscountPercent = 0
				SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@PordDiscount,0) * 100) / @SumPriceAmount				
				IF(@DiscountPercent > @LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent)
				BEGIN
					SET @Result = -3 /*MaxDiscountPercentInPreOrder*/					
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @Result = 1
				END				
			END			
		END
		ELSE
			SET @Result = -1 /*DivisionByZero*/		
	END
	ELSE
		SET @Result = 1                                                    
	/**************** PreOrder Verify *************************************/
	IF(@Result = 1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.WSPreOrder
		SET 
		pordIsVerified = 1,
		pordVerifierId = @VerifierUserId,
		pordIsFixed = 1,
		pordVerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
		pordVerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
		WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId		
	END	

/**/
END

	/*AI14020412- Change cmpName based on cmpKind*/
	IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT

									   THEN ((ISNULL((SELECT CompanyTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyTitle] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTitleID] = C.[cmpTitleId]),'') + ' ' + 
											  ISNULL(C.[cmpName],'')))
									   ELSE	(SELECT ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle] PT WHERE PT.PersonTitleID = CCP.prsTitleId),'')  + ' ' +
													ISNULL(prsFName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(prsLName,'')

											)

		FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany] C
		WHERE CompanyID = @PrjCompanyId
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			@ValueForCmpName = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(C.[cmpKind],0) = 0
									THEN ((ISNULL((SELECT CompanyTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyTitle_Lang] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTitleID] = C.[cmpTitleId] AND CT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'') + ' ' + 
											ISNULL((SELECT CLN.[cmpName] FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany_Lang] CLN WHERE CLN.CompanyID = C.CompanyID AND CLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')))
									ELSE	(SELECT ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle_Lang] PT WHERE PT.PersonTitleID = CCP.prsTitleId AND PT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')  + ' ' +
												ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(CCPLN.prsFName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(CCPLN.prsLName,'') FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons_Lang] CCPLN WHERE CCPLN.CompanyPersonID = CCP.CompanyPersonID AND CCPLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')
										FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
										WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = C.[cmpMainPersonId]		
										)				
								END), 
			@ValueForCmpNameEng = cmpNameEng,
			@ValueForCmpNumber = CAST(cmpNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)),
			@ValueForCmpCode = cmpCode			
		FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany] C
		WHERE CompanyID = @PrjCompanyId
	/**/
	END	
	/*AI14020412- End*/

	SET @ValueForSysNum = @PrjInquiryNum
	SET @ValueForSysNumR =  CAST(@PrjNumR AS NVARCHAR(50))

	SET @ValueForPrjInquiryNum = @PrjInquiryNum
	SET @ValueForPrjNumR =  CAST(@PrjNumR AS NVARCHAR(50))

	/*SELECT 
		@ValueForUserFName = [FName],
		@ValueForUserLName = [LName],
		@ValueForUserFullName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([FName],'') + ' ' +  ISNULL([LName],''))),
		@ValueForUserPersCode = [PersCode]    
	FROM [dbo].[Users] U
	WHERE U.[UserId] = @PrjStarterUserId AI14020412*/

	/*AI14020412- Add multiLang*/

END

SET @selectedNumRef= @prjNumRef

-- [dbo].[MobspSelectClosedCalendarEvents]






/*AI14020126 - Copied from hrm*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspSelectClosedCalendarEvents]
(
	/*
		EXEC MobspSelectClosedCalendarEvents '2022-03-21 00:00:00', '2023-03-20 00:00:00', 1065, 1065
	*/
	@FromDate DATETIME,
	@ToDate DATETIME,
	@LanguageID INT = NULL,
	@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL 
)
AS
BEGIN

	/**/
	DECLARE @MonthDays TABLE(
		MyDays DATE,
		MyDays_EN VARCHAR(20),
		MyDays_FA VARCHAR(20),
		MyDays_FA_Year INT,
		MyDays_FA_Month INT,
		MyDays_FA_Day INT,
		MyDays_AR VARCHAR(20),
		MyDays_AR_Year INT,
		MyDays_AR_Month INT,
		MyDays_AR_Day INT
	)
	/*=================================*/
	DECLARE @FDate_tmp DATE = CAST(@FromDate AS DATE), @TDate_tmp DATE = CAST(@ToDate AS DATE)
	/*=================================*/
	WHILE(@FDate_tmp <= @TDate_tmp)
	BEGIN
		/**/
		INSERT INTO @MonthDays(
			MyDays,
			MyDays_EN,
			MyDays_FA,
			MyDays_FA_Year, 
			MyDays_FA_Month,
			MyDays_FA_Day,
			MyDays_AR,
			MyDays_AR_Year, 
			MyDays_AR_Month, 
			MyDays_AR_Day
		)
		VALUES(
			@FDate_tmp, 
			FORMAT(@FDate_tmp, 'yyyy-MM-dd', 'en-US'),
			FORMAT(@FDate_tmp, 'yyyy/MM/dd', 'fa-IR'),
			SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), FORMAT(@FDate_tmp, 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss', 'fa-IR'), 120), 0, 5),/*Year*/
			SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), FORMAT(@FDate_tmp, 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss', 'fa-IR'), 120), 6, 2),/*Month*/
			SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), FORMAT(@FDate_tmp, 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss', 'fa-IR'), 120), 9, 2),/*Day*/
			/**/
			FORMAT(DATEADD(DAY, -1, @FDate_tmp), 'yyyy/MM/dd', 'ar-SA'),
			SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), FORMAT(DATEADD(DAY, -1, @FDate_tmp), 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss', 'ar-SA'), 120), 0, 5),/*Year*/
			SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), FORMAT(DATEADD(DAY, -1, @FDate_tmp), 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss', 'ar-SA'), 120), 6, 2),/*Month*/
			SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), FORMAT(DATEADD(DAY, -1, @FDate_tmp), 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss', 'ar-SA'), 120), 9, 2)/*Day*/
			)
		/**/
		SET @FDate_tmp = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @FDate_tmp)
		/**/
	END
	/*=================================*/
	/*=================================*/
	IF (@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
		/**/
		SELECT
			MD.MyDays AS [SingleDate]
			,MyDays_EN AS [SingleDateEN]
			,MD.MyDays_FA AS [SingleDateFA]
			,MD.MyDays_AR AS [SingleDateAR]
			,(
				CASE WHEN @LanguageID = 1065 THEN
						(SELECT WD.PersianDay FROM CrmsysWeekDays WD WHERE WD.WeekDayID = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, MD.MyDays))
					WHEN @LanguageID = 1033 THEN
						(SELECT WD.[Day] FROM CrmsysWeekDays WD WHERE WD.WeekDayID = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, MD.MyDays))
					WHEN @LanguageID = 1025 THEN
						(SELECT WD.ArabicDay FROM CrmsysWeekDays WD WHERE WD.WeekDayID = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, MD.MyDays))
					ELSE 
						NULL
				END
			) AS [DayName]
			/**/
			,(CASE WHEN 
				(
					SELECT
						COUNT(*)
					FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
					WHERE 
						IsClosed = 1
						AND 
						(
							(/*FA*/
									MonthNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Month
								AND DayNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Day
								AND LanguageID = 1065
							) OR 
							(/*EN*/
									MonthNum = MONTH(MD.MyDays)
								AND DayNum = DAY(MD.MyDays)
								AND LanguageID = 1033
							) OR 
							(/*AR*/
									MonthNum = MD.MyDays_AR_Month
								AND DayNum =MD.MyDays_AR_Day
								AND LanguageID = 1025
							)
						)
				) >= 1
					THEN
						CAST(1 AS BIT)
					ELSE 
						0
				END
			) AS [IsClosed]
			/**/
			,(
				(
					ISNULL(
					(
						SELECT 
							ISNULL(CE.[Description] + ' - ', NULL)
						FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
						WHERE MonthNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Month
							AND DayNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Day
							AND LanguageID = 1065
					)
					, '')
				)
				+
				(
					ISNULL(
					(
						SELECT 
							ISNULL(CE.[Description] + ' - ', NULL)
						FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
						WHERE MonthNum = MD.MyDays_AR_Month
						  AND DayNum = MD.MyDays_AR_Day
						  AND LanguageID = 1025
					)
					, '')
				)
				+
				(
					ISNULL(
					(
						SELECT 
							CE.[Description]
						FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
						WHERE MonthNum = MONTH(MD.MyDays)
							AND DayNum = DAY(MD.MyDays)
							AND LanguageID = 1033
					)
					, '')
				)
			) AS [IsClosedDesc]
		FROM @MonthDays MD
		WHERE (CASE WHEN 
			(
				SELECT
					COUNT(*)
				FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
				WHERE 
					IsClosed = 1
					AND 
					(
						(/*FA*/
								MonthNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Month
							AND DayNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Day
							AND LanguageID = 1065
						) OR 
						(/*EN*/
								MonthNum = MONTH(MD.MyDays)
							AND DayNum = DAY(MD.MyDays)
							AND LanguageID = 1033
						) OR 
						(/*AR*/
								MonthNum = MD.MyDays_AR_Month
							AND DayNum =MD.MyDays_AR_Day
							AND LanguageID = 1025
						)
					)
			) >= 1
				THEN
					CAST(1 AS BIT)
				ELSE 
					0
			END
			) = 1
		/**/
	END
	ELSE IF (@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
		/**/
		SELECT
			MD.MyDays AS [SingleDate]
			,MyDays_EN AS [SingleDateEN]
			,MD.MyDays_FA AS [SingleDateFA]
			,MD.MyDays_AR AS [SingleDateAR]
			,(
				CASE WHEN @LanguageID = 1065 THEN
						(SELECT WD.PersianDay FROM CrmsysWeekDays WD WHERE WD.WeekDayID = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, MD.MyDays))
					WHEN @LanguageID = 1033 THEN
						(SELECT WD.[Day] FROM CrmsysWeekDays WD WHERE WD.WeekDayID = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, MD.MyDays))
					WHEN @LanguageID = 1025 THEN
						(SELECT WD.ArabicDay FROM CrmsysWeekDays WD WHERE WD.WeekDayID = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, MD.MyDays))
					ELSE 
						NULL
				END
			) AS [DayName]
			/**/
			,(CASE WHEN 
				(
					SELECT
						COUNT(*)
					FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
					WHERE 
						IsClosed = 1
						AND 
						(
							(/*FA*/
									MonthNum = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'MM', 'fa-IR') AS INT)
								AND DayNum = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'dd', 'fa-IR') AS INT)
								AND LanguageID = 1065
							) OR 
							(/*EN*/
									MonthNum = MONTH(MD.MyDays)
								AND DayNum = DAY(MD.MyDays)
								AND LanguageID = 1033
							) OR 
							(/*AR*/
									MonthNum = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'MM', 'ar-SA') AS INT)
								AND DayNum+1 = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'dd', 'ar-SA') AS INT)
								AND LanguageID = 1025
							)
						)
				) >= 1
					THEN
						CAST(1 AS BIT)
					ELSE 
						NULL
				END
			) AS [IsClosed]
			/**/
			,(
				(
					ISNULL(
					(
						SELECT 
							ISNULL(CE.[Description] + ' - ', NULL)
						FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
						WHERE MonthNum = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'MM', 'fa-IR') AS INT)
							AND DayNum = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'dd', 'fa-IR') AS INT)
							AND LanguageID = 1065
					)
					, '')
				)
				+
				(
					ISNULL(
					(
						SELECT 
							ISNULL(CE.[Description] + ' - ', NULL)
						FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
						WHERE MonthNum = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'MM', 'ar-SA') AS INT)
							AND DayNum+1 = TRY_CAST(FORMAT(MD.MyDays, 'dd', 'ar-SA') AS INT)
							AND LanguageID = 1025
					)
					, '')
				)
				+
				(
					ISNULL(
					(
						SELECT 
							CE.[Description]
						FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
						WHERE MonthNum = MONTH(MD.MyDays)
							AND DayNum = DAY(MD.MyDays)
							AND LanguageID = 1033
					)
					, '')
				)
			) AS [IsClosedDesc]
			FROM @MonthDays MD
			WHERE (CASE WHEN 
				(
					SELECT
						COUNT(*)
					FROM CrmsysCalendarEvents CE
					WHERE 
						IsClosed = 1
						AND 
						(
							(/*FA*/
									MonthNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Month
								AND DayNum = MD.MyDays_FA_Day
								AND LanguageID = 1065
							) OR 
							(/*EN*/
									MonthNum = MONTH(MD.MyDays)
								AND DayNum = DAY(MD.MyDays)
								AND LanguageID = 1033
							) OR 
							(/*AR*/
									MonthNum = MD.MyDays_AR_Month
								AND DayNum =MD.MyDays_AR_Day
								AND LanguageID = 1025
							)
						)
				) >= 1
					THEN
						CAST(1 AS BIT)
					ELSE 
						0
				END
				) = 1
		/**/
	END
	
	/**/
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspSelectDocItemTracing]
( 
/* 
	EXEC MobspSelectDocItemTracing N'BB-10-20',0
*/
@Tracing NVARCHAR(200),
@PrdId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
IF(ISNULL(@PrdId,0) > 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT DISTINCT /*TOP (20) */
		[Tracing]      
	FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]	
	WHERE [PrdId] = @PrdId
	AND ISNULL([Tracing],'') <> ''
	AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE([Tracing] , NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
		 = 
		(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tracing , NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))				
/**/
END
ELSE /*IF(ISNULL(@PrdId,0) > 0)*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT DISTINCT /*TOP (20) */
		[Tracing]      
	FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]		
	WHERE ISNULL([Tracing],'') <> ''
	AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE([Tracing] , NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
		 = 
		(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tracing , NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))		
/**/
END
/**/
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspSelectProductIssueOrdFromIndexedByPordId]
/* 
	EXEC MobspSelectProductIssueOrdFromIndexedByPordId 4358, 1033,1065
*/	
(
@PreOrderId INT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL
)
AS 
BEGIN
/**/
IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT 
		 [ProductID]
		,[PrdGroupID]
		,[PrdCode]
		,[PrdName]
		,(SELECT [SGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID]) [PrdSGroupName]
		,(SELECT [SGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID]) [PrdSGroupCode]
	    ,(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID]) [PrdFGroupId]  
	    ,(SELECT [FGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID])) [PrdFGroupName]  
		,(SELECT [FGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID])) [PrdFGroupCode] 
		
		,[PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexed]
		,[PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexedOprId]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [Name] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] OPR WHERE OPR.[OrderOprID] = [PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexedOprId]) [PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexedOpr]
	    ,[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId]
		,(SELECT PP.[PrdName] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdName]
		,(SELECT PP.[PrdCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdCode]
		,(SELECT [SGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
			(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdSGName]
		,(SELECT [SGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
			(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdSGCode]
		,(SELECT [FGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
				(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId]))) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdFGName] 
		,(SELECT [FGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
				(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId]))) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdFGCode]  

	FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P
	WHERE ISNULL([PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexed],0) = 1
	AND P.ProductID IN(SELECT pordIPrdId
					   FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] POI 
					   WHERE POI.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)
	ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[ProductId]) 
/**/
END
ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT 
		 [ProductID]
		,[PrdGroupID]
		,[PrdCode]
		,(SELECT [PrdName] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PLN WHERE PLN.ProductID = P.ProductID AND PLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdName]
		,(SELECT [SGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup_Lang] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID] AND SG.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdSGroupName]
		,(SELECT [SGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID]) [PrdSGroupCode]
	    ,(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID]) [PrdFGroupId]  
	    ,(SELECT [FGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup_Lang] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID]) AND FG.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdFGroupName]  
		,(SELECT [FGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = P.[PrdGroupID])) [PrdFGroupCode]  
		,[PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexed]
		,[PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexedOprId]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [Name] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr_Lang] OPR WHERE OPR.[OrderOprID] = [PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexedOprId] AND OPR.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexedOpr]
	    ,[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId]
		,(SELECT PP.[PrdName] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId] AND PP.LanguageID = @LanguageID)[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdName]
		,(SELECT PP.[PrdCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdCode]
		,(SELECT [SGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup_Lang] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
			(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId]) AND SG.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdSGName]
		,(SELECT [SGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
			(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdSGCode]
		,(SELECT [FGName] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup_Lang] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
				(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId])) AND FG.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdFGName] 
		,(SELECT [FGCode] FROM [dbo].[WSProductFirstGroup] FG WHERE FG.[PrdFirstGroupID] =
			(SELECT [FirstGroupId] FROM [dbo].[WSProductSecondGroup] SG WHERE SG.[PrdSecondGroupID] = 
				(SELECT PP.[PrdGroupID] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE PP.[ProductID] = P.[PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdId]))) [PrdAutoCalcIndexedPrdFGCode]  

	FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P
	WHERE ISNULL([PrdAutoCalcIssueOrdFromIndexed],0) = 1
	AND P.ProductID IN(SELECT pordIPrdId
					   FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] POI 
					   WHERE POI.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)
	ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[ProductId]) 
/**/
END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspSendSmsOrdFOLinkAfterVerify]
(
	/*
		EXEC [MobspSendSmsOrdFOLinkAfterVerify]
	*/
	@OrderId INT,
	@FoLink NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@FoLinkWithLogin NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@FoLinkWithoutLogin NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@UserId INT,
	@Year1 INT,
	@Month1 INT,
	@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
	@AppType NVARCHAR(20),
	@LanguageID INT = NULL,
	@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL,
	@Result INT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/**/
	DECLARE @CompanyId INT = NULL, @ProjectId INT = NULL, @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult NVARCHAR(MAX)

	/**/
	DECLARE @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerify BIT,
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyType INT,
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyGSM BIT,
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyGSMSetId INT,
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyWeb BIT,
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyWebProviderId INT,
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyNumber NVARCHAR(50),
			@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyBodyPatternFormula NVARCHAR(1000)
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerify = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerify,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyType = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyType,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyGSM = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyGSM,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyGSMSetId = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyGSMSetId,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyWeb = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyWeb,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyWebProviderId = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyWebProviderId,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyNumber = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyNumber,
		   @SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyBodyPatternFormula = SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyBodyPatternFormula
	  FROM CrmsysSetting
	
	IF (ISNULL(@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerify, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(@SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyBodyPatternFormula, '') <> '')
	BEGIN
		/**/

		/********************* Define variables *****************/
		DECLARE @CmpTitel NVARCHAR(200) = '',@CmpName NVARCHAR(300) = '',@cmpMobile NVARCHAR(100) = '',@CmpId INT = NULL,
				@PrsTitel NVARCHAR(200) = '',@PrsFName NVARCHAR(100) = '',@PrsLName NVARCHAR(100) = '',
				@prsMobile NVARCHAR(100) = '',
				@PrsId INT = NULL,@prjTitle NVARCHAR(100) = '',@prjPostFix NVARCHAR(200) = '',
				@prjRemindDate NVARCHAR(10) = '',@prjRemindDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
				@PrjId INT = NULL,
				@ordNumber BIGINT = NULL,@ordDate NVARCHAR(10) = '',@ordDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
				@OrderOprID INT = NULL, @OrderOpr NVARCHAR(500) = '',
				@MobileNumber NVARCHAR(100) = '', @ordNumberStr NVARCHAR(200) ='',
				@cmpPreTel NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,@cmpTel  NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,@SmsBodyPatternFormula NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL
		

		/******************** Get formula ******************************/
		SELECT TOP 1 @SmsBodyPatternFormula = [SendSMSOrdFOLinkAfterVerifyBodyPatternFormula] FROM dbo.CrmsysSetting


		/***************************************************************/
		IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
		BEGIN
			/**/
			SELECT @ordNumber = [ordNumber]
				,@ordDate = [ordDate]
				,@CmpId = [ordCompanyId]
				,@PrsId = [ordCompanyPersonId]
				,@PrjId = [ordProjectId]					
				,@ordDateTime = [ordDateTime]					
				,@OrderOprID = [OrderOprID]
				,@OrderOpr = (SELECT TOP(1) [Name] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] OP WHERE OP.OrderOprID = O.OrderOprID)	
				,@CompanyId = O.ordCompanyId
				,@ProjectId = O.ordProjectId
			FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O
			WHERE [OrderID] = @OrderId
			/**/
			SELECT TOP(1) 
				@CmpTitel = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CC.[cmpKind],0) = 0
								THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(((ISNULL((SELECT CompanyTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyTitle] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTitleID] = CC.[cmpTitleId]),'')))))
								ELSE	(SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle] PT WHERE PT.PersonTitleID = CCP.prsTitleId),'')))
										FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
										WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = CC.[cmpMainPersonId]		
									)				
							END),
				@CmpName =  (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CC.[cmpKind],0) = 0
							THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CC.[cmpName],'')))
							ELSE	(SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(prsFName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(prsLName,'')))
									FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
									WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = CC.[cmpMainPersonId]		
								)				
						END),
				@cmpMobile = LTRIM(RTRIM(cmpMobile)),
				@cmpPreTel = cmpPreTel,
				@cmpTel = cmpTel
			FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC
			WHERE CompanyID = @CmpId	

			SELECT TOP(1)
				@PrsTitel = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM dbo.CrmPersonTitle CPT WHERE CPT.PersonTitleId = CP.prsTitleId),''))),
				@PrsFName = LTRIM(RTRIM(prsFName)),
				@PrsLName = LTRIM(RTRIM(prsLName)),
				@prsMobile = LTRIM(RTRIM(prsMobile))
			FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CP
			WHERE CompanyPersonID = @PrsId

			SELECT TOP(1) 
				@prjTitle = LTRIM(RTRIM(prjTitle)),
				@prjPostFix = LTRIM(RTRIM(prjPostFix)),
				@prjRemindDate = prjRemindDate,
				@prjRemindDateTime = prjRemindDateTime
			FROM [dbo].[CrmProjects] P
			WHERE ProjectID = @PrjId
		/**/
		END
		ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
		BEGIN
			/**/
			SELECT @ordNumber = [ordNumber]
				,@ordDate = [ordDate]
				,@CmpId = [ordCompanyId]
				,@PrsId = [ordCompanyPersonId]
				,@PrjId = [ordProjectId]					
				,@ordDateTime = [ordDateTime]					
				,@OrderOprID = [OrderOprID]
				,@OrderOpr = (SELECT TOP(1) [Name] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr_Lang] OP WHERE OP.OrderOprID = O.OrderOprID AND OP.LanguageID = @LanguageID)
				,@CompanyId = O.ordCompanyId
				,@ProjectId = O.ordProjectId
			FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O
			WHERE [OrderID] = @OrderId
			/**/
			SELECT TOP(1) 
				@CmpTitel = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CC.[cmpKind],0) = 0
								THEN LTRIM(RTRIM((ISNULL((SELECT CompanyTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyTitle_Lang] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTitleID] = CC.[cmpTitleId] AND CT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),''))))
								ELSE	(SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle_Lang] PT WHERE PT.PersonTitleID = CCP.prsTitleId AND PT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'') ))
									FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
									WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = CC.[cmpMainPersonId]		
									)				
							END),
				@CmpName =  (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CC.[cmpKind],0) = 0
								THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT CLN.[cmpName] FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany_Lang] CLN WHERE CLN.CompanyID = CC.CompanyID AND CLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')))
								ELSE	(SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(CCPLN.prsFName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(CCPLN.prsLName,'') FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons_Lang] CCPLN WHERE CCPLN.CompanyPersonID = CCP.CompanyPersonID AND CCPLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')))
									FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
									WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = CC.[cmpMainPersonId]		
									)				
							END),
				@cmpMobile = LTRIM(RTRIM(cmpMobile)),
				@cmpPreTel = cmpPreTel,
				@cmpTel = cmpTel
			FROM dbo.CrmCompany CC
			WHERE CompanyID = @CmpId	

			SELECT TOP(1)
				@PrsTitel = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle_Lang] CPT WHERE CPT.PersonTitleId = CP.prsTitleId AND CPT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),''))),
				@PrsFName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) prsFName FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons_Lang] CPLN WHERE CPLN.CompanyPersonID = CP.CompanyPersonID AND CPLN.[LanguageID] = @LanguageID), ''))),
				@PrsLName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) prsLName FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons_Lang] CPLN WHERE CPLN.CompanyPersonID = CP.CompanyPersonID AND CPLN.[LanguageID] = @LanguageID), ''))),
				@cmpMobile = LTRIM(RTRIM(prsMobile))
			FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CP
			WHERE CompanyPersonID = @PrsId

			SELECT TOP(1) 
				@prjTitle = LTRIM(RTRIM((SELECT TOP(1) prjTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmProjects_Lang] PLN WHERE PLN.ProjectID = P.ProjectId AND PLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID ))),
				@prjPostFix = LTRIM(RTRIM((SELECT TOP(1) prjPostFix FROM [dbo].[CrmProjects_Lang] PLN WHERE PLN.ProjectID = P.ProjectId AND PLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID ))),
				@prjRemindDate = prjRemindDate,
				@prjRemindDateTime = prjRemindDateTime
			FROM [dbo].[CrmProjects] P
			WHERE ProjectID = @PrjId
		/**/
		END		
		

		/***************************************************************/
		IF(ISNULL(@ordNumber,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @ordNumberStr = CAST(@ordNumber AS NVARCHAR(200))
		END


		/*------------ Date ----------*/
		IF(@LanguageID = 1065)/*Persian*/
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @prjRemindDate = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithSlash](@prjRemindDateTime))
			SET @ordDate = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithSlash](@ordDateTime))	
		/**/
		END
		ELSE IF(@LanguageID <> 1065)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @prjRemindDate = CAST(CAST(@prjRemindDateTime AS DATE) AS NVARCHAR(10))
			SET @ordDate = CAST(CAST(@ordDateTime AS DATE) AS NVARCHAR(10))
		/**/
		END


		/********************** Set pattern for body *******************/
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = @SmsBodyPatternFormula
		/****/
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#⁄‰Ê«‰ „‘ —Ì#]', ISNULL(@CmpTitel, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#‰«„ „‘ —Ì#]', ISNULL(@CmpName, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#⁄‰Ê«‰ Å—”‰·#]', ISNULL(@PrsTitel, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#‰«„ òÊçò Å—”‰·#]', ISNULL(@PrsFName, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#‰«„ Œ«‰Ê«œêÌ Å—”‰·#]', ISNULL(@PrsLName, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#⁄‰Ê«‰ Å—ÊéÂ#]', ISNULL(@prjTitle, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#Å”Ê‰œ Å—ÊéÂ#]', ISNULL(@prjPostFix, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[# «—ÌŒ Ì«œ¬Ê—Ì Å—ÊéÂ#]', ISNULL(@prjRemindDate, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#‘„«—Â ›«ò Ê—#]', ISNULL(@ordNumberStr, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[# «—ÌŒ ’œÊ— ›«ò Ê—#]', ISNULL(@ordDate, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#‰Ê⁄ ›«ò Ê—#]', ISNULL(@OrderOpr, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#·Ì‰ò ›«ò Ê— œ— »«‘ê«Â#]', ISNULL(@FoLink, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#·Ì‰ò ›«ò Ê— »« Ê—Êœ (·«êÌ‰) »Â »«‘ê«Â#]', ISNULL(@FoLinkWithLogin, ''))
		SET @SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult = REPLACE(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, N'[#·Ì‰ò ›«ò Ê— »œÊ‰ Ê—Êœ (·«êÌ‰) »Â »«‘ê«Â#]', ISNULL(@FoLinkWithoutLogin, ''))
		/**/
	END


	IF (ISNULL(@SmsBodyPatternFormulaResult, '') <> '')
	BEGIN
		/**/
		DECLARE @PersonMobileNumber VARCHAR(50),
				@SendType INT,
				@SendTopic NVARCHAR(50),
				@SID INT,
				@smsBody NVARCHAR(2000),
				@SmsBodyLen INT,
				@SmsBodyLangType VARCHAR(50),
				@SmsBodyPageCnt VARCHAR(50),
				@FromNumber VARCHAR(50),
				@SmsEnCost NUMERIC,
				@SmsFaCost NUMERIC,
				@SmsBodyCost NUMERIC,
				@NumberCount INT,
				@Numbers VARCHAR(MAX),
				@RefNumbers VARCHAR(MAX),
				@AllSmsCount INT,
				@UserCost NUMERIC,
				@SendUserId INT,
				@SendDay NVARCHAR(50),
				@SendDate VARCHAR(8),
				@SendTime NVARCHAR(50),
				@CompaniesId VARCHAR(MAX),
				@CompanyPersonsId VARCHAR(MAX),
				@SingleNumber VARCHAR(20) = NULL,
				@SingleCompanyId INT = NULL,
				@SingleCompanyPersonId INT = NULL,
				@SingleRefNumber BIGINT = NULL ,
				@StatusId INT,
				@CMessage INT,
				@SchedulDate DATETIME  = NULL,
				@SendPriority INT = NULL,
				@SendDateTime DATETIME

		DECLARE @SMSSendDate DATETIME = GETDATE()
		DECLARE @ValueForSMSSendDate NVARCHAR(1000) = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDate](CAST(@SMSSendDate AS DATE)))
		DECLARE @calcSendDay NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT DATEPART(dw, @SMSSendDate)) 
		DECLARE @calcSendDate VARCHAR(8) = (SELECT SUBSTRING(@ValueForSMSSendDate, 1, 4) + SUBSTRING(@ValueForSMSSendDate, 6, 2) + SUBSTRING(@ValueForSMSSendDate, 9, 2) )
		DECLARE @calcSendTime NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(8), @SMSSendDate, 108))
		DECLARE @calcSendDateTime DATETIME = @SMSSendDate

		/**/
		SET @PersonMobileNumber = ISNULL(@cmpMobile, @prsMobile) 
		SET @SendTopic = NULL
		SET @SID = (Select dbo.SmsfnReturnSID())
		SET @smsBody = @SMSBodyPatternFormulaResult
		SELECT 
			@SmsBodyLen = BodyLen, 
			@SmsBodyLangType = BodyLang, 
			@SmsBodyPageCnt = BodyPageCount
		FROM SmsReturnBodyTextLang(@smsBody)
		/**/
		SELECT TOP 1

-- [dbo].[MobspSetcmpDataPermission]







/*RZ961205*/
/*AI14000621 - Skip the operation for userId < 0*/
/*AI14000710 - Remove skip the operation for userId < 0 because of adding a record for user -20 at dbo.UserPermission*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspSetcmpDataPermission]
(		
/* 
	EXEC MobspSetcmpDataPermission 3 
*/
@UserId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Term VARCHAR(4000)
	SET @Term = '';
	/*IF(@UserId > 0) /*AI14000621 - IF added*/
	BEGIN AI14000710*/
	/*--Province*/
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenProvince
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND C.cmpProvinceId Not IN (
	SELECT ForbiddenProvinceId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenProvince
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessProvince
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND C.cmpProvinceId IN (
	SELECT JustAccessProvinceId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessProvince
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	/*--City*/
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCity
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND C.cmpCityId Not IN (
	SELECT ForbiddenCityId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCity
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCity
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND C.cmpCityId IN (
	SELECT JustAccessCityId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCity
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	/*--GroupIV*/
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroupIV
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND IsNull(C.cmpGroupIdIV, 0) Not IN (
	SELECT ForbiddenGroupIVId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroupIV
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessGroupIV
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND IsNull(C.cmpGroupIdIV, 0) IN (
	SELECT JustAccessGroupIVId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessGroupIV
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	/*--Company*/
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCompany
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND C.CompanyId Not IN (
	SELECT ForbiddenCompanyId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenCompany
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCompany
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND C.CompanyId IN (
	SELECT JustAccessCompanyId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessCompany
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	/*--Group*/
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND IsNull(C.cmpGroupId, 0) Not IN (
	SELECT ForbiddenGroupId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND IsNull(C.cmpGroupId, 0) IN (
	SELECT JustAccessGroupId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	/*--SubGroup*/
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenSubGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND IsNull(C.cmpSubGroupId, 0) Not IN (
	SELECT ForbiddenSubGroupId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyForbiddenSubGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	IF  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessSubGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = @UserId ) > 0
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' AND IsNull(C.cmpSubGroupId, 0) IN (
	SELECT JustAccessSubGroupId FROM dbo.CrmCompanyJustAccessSubGroup
	WHERE CrmUserId = '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10))+')'
	/*--*/
	/*--cmpReferUser*/
	SET @Term = @Term +
	' And C.cmpReferUserId IN( 
	(SELECT '+CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' UNION 
	SELECT LinkedUserId FROM dbo.CrmLinkedUsers WHERE CrmUserId = '+ 
	CAST(@UserId AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' AND LinkedTypeId = 14 ) ) '

	/*END AI14000710-End*/
	/*
	--
	--
	--
	--
	*/
	DELETE dbo.CrmsysDBTempInfo
	WHERE TypeId = 20
	AND UserId = @UserId
	/*--*/
	INSERT INTO dbo.CrmsysDBTempInfo (
		UserId,	TXT, TypeId)
	 VALUES ( @UserId, @Term, 20 ) 


END

/*AI14010711 - Copied from web*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspTransferPreOrderFileToOrderOneToOne]
(		
	/*
		EXEC [MobspTransferPreOrderFileToOrderOneToOne] 66,3,2,4,'13960427','dasti'
	*/
	@PreOrderId INT, 
	@OrderId INT,
	@FileDirectoryId INT,
	@FileDirectoryTypeId INT,
	@UserId INT,	
	@FPId INT,
	@Year1 SMALLINT,
	@Month1 SMALLINT,
	@RegisterDate DATETIME,
	@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(8),
	@AppType NVARCHAR(50),
	@LanguageId INT,
	@InsertedId INT OUTPUT
)
As
BEGIN
	/**/
	DECLARE @ordProjectId INT = NULL
	SET @ordProjectId = (SELECT TOP(1) ordProjectId FROM WSOrder WHERE OrderID = @OrderId)
	
	INSERT INTO CrmFilesDirectory(
		FileDirectoryTypeId,
		MasterId,
		DetailId,
		SubDetailId,
		Title,
		FolderName,
		[FileName],
		FilePath,
		CopyFromPath,
		UserId,
		Year1,
		Month1,
		RegisterDate,
		RegisterDatePersian,
		DocDate,
		DocDay,
		DocTime,
		DocDateTime,
		TypeOprObjectId,
		AppType,
		LanguageID,
		FirstRegisterUserId,
		FirstRegisterDate,
		FirstRegisterDatePersian,
		OrderView,
		FileFOCmpCanSee,
		FileDirectoryParentId
	)
	SELECT 
		@FileDirectoryTypeId,
		FD.MasterId,
		FD.DetailId,
		@ordProjectId,
		FD.Title,
		FD.FolderName,
		FD.[FileName],
		FD.FilePath,
		FD.CopyFromPath,
		@UserId,
		@Year1,
		@Month1,
		@RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian,
		FD.DocDate,
		FD.DocDay,
		FD.DocTime,
		FD.DocDateTime,
		@OrderId,
		@AppType,
		@LanguageId,
		@UserId,
		@RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian,
		FD.OrderView,
		FileFOCmpCanSee,
		FD.FileDirectoryID
	FROM CrmFilesDirectory FD
	WHERE  fd.FileDirectoryID = @FileDirectoryId and
			fd.FileDirectoryID not in (
				select d.FileDirectoryParentId from CrmFilesDirectory d 
				where TypeOprObjectId = @OrderId and 
					d.FileDirectoryTypeId IN (
						SELECT FileDirectoryTypeID 
						FROM dbo.CrmFileDirectoryType 
						WHERE FileDirectoryTypeOprId = 20)
			)

	SET @InsertedId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	IF (ISNULL(@InsertedId, 0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		/**/
		INSERT INTO CrmFilesDirectory_Lang(
			FileDirectoryID,
			LanguageID,
			Title
		)
		SELECT 
			@InsertedId,
			FDL.LanguageID,
			FDL.Title
		FROM CrmFilesDirectory_Lang FDL
		WHERE FileDirectoryID = @FileDirectoryId
		/**/
	END
	/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspUpdateOrderLinkAccConflictByPay]






/*AI14020830 - Copied from web*/
/*AI14021005 - The date is not important in the type of Chq*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspUpdateOrderLinkAccConflictByPay]
/* 
	EXEC MobspUpdateOrderLinkAccConflictByPay 41734
*/		
(
@OrderId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*----------------------------------------------*/
DECLARE @ordLinkAccConflict BIT = 0
/*--------------- Check Payment ----------------*/
IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP (1) [OrderPaymentId]      
		  FROM [dbo].[WSOrderPayments]
		  WHERE [ordpayOrderId] = @OrderId
		  AND ISNULL([ordpayDeActive],0) = 0
		  AND (
				(ISNULL([ordpayDocAmount],0) <> 0 AND ISNULL([ordpayBankDocAmount],0) <> 0 AND ISNULL([ordpayDocAmount],0) <> ISNULL([ordpayBankDocAmount],0))
				OR
				([ordpayDocDateTime] IS NOT NULL AND [ordpayBankDocDate] IS NOT NULL AND CAST([ordpayDocDateTime] AS DATE) <> CAST([ordpayBankDocDate] AS DATE)
				 AND [ordpayTypeId] NOT IN(SELECT [OrderPaymentTypeId] FROM [dbo].[WSOrderPaymentTypes] WHERE ISNULL([ordpayTypeIsChq],0) = 1)/*AI14021005 - The date is not important in the type of Chq*/
				)
			  )
   ),0) <> 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	SET @ordLinkAccConflict = 1
/**/
END
/*--------------- Update Order -----------------*/
EXEC [dbo].[MobspUpdateOrderLinkAccConflict]
@OrderId = @OrderId,
@ordLinkAccConflict = @ordLinkAccConflict
/*------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END
