-- [dbo].[MobspUpdateProjectFromIssueOrderFromPreOrder]






/*AI14020703*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspUpdateProjectFromIssueOrderFromPreOrder]
/*
	EXEC MobspUpdateProjectFromIssueOrderFromPreOrder
*/
(
@ProjectParams NVARCHAR(MAX),
@UserId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType VARCHAR(20), 
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL,
/**/
@ResErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE 
		@ProjectId INT,
		@prjTitle NVARCHAR(100),
		@prjPostFix NVARCHAR(200),
		@prjRemindDate VARCHAR(8),
		@prjRemindDateTime DATETIME,
		@prjTitleGroup NVARCHAR(200)


	BEGIN TRY

		IF(ISNULL(@ProjectParams, '') <> '')
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				@ProjectId = PJ.ProjectId,
				@prjTitle = PJ.prjTitle,
				@prjPostFix = PJ.prjPostFix,
				@prjRemindDate = PJ.prjRemindDate,
				@prjTitleGroup = PJ.prjTitleGroup
			FROM OPENJSON(@ProjectParams)
			WITH(
				[ProjectId] INT '$.ProjectId',
				[prjTitle] NVARCHAR(100) '$.prjTitle',
				[prjPostFix] NVARCHAR(200) '$.prjPostFix',
				[prjRemindDate] VARCHAR(8) '$.prjRemindDate',
				[prjTitleGroup] NVARCHAR(200) '$.prjTitleGroup'
			) AS PJ
		END

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @ResErrorMessage = @ResErrorMessage + '#|^|#' + 'ParseData=Error'
		GOTO EndOfScript
	END CATCH

	IF(ISNULL(@prjRemindDate, '') <> '')
	BEGIN
		SET @prjRemindDateTime = dbo.fnPersianToGregorianDate(@prjRemindDate, NULL)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @prjRemindDateTime = NULL
	END

	UPDATE [dbo].[CrmProjects]
		SET [prjTitle] = @prjTitle
		,[prjPostFix] = @prjPostFix
		,[prjRemindDate] = @prjRemindDate
		,[prjRemindDateTime] = @prjRemindDateTime
		,[prjTitleGroup] = @prjTitleGroup
		,[UserId] = @UserId
		,[Month1] = @Month1
		,[RegisterDate] = @RegisterDate
		,[RegisterDatePersian] = @RegisterDatePersian
		,[AppType] = @AppType
	WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId

	/******* Update lang table ********/
	UPDATE [dbo].[CrmProjects_Lang]
		SET [prjTitle] = @prjTitle
		,[prjPostFix] = @prjPostFix
		,[prjTitleGroup] = @prjTitleGroup
	FROM dbo.Languages LN 
	WHERE [ProjectID] = @ProjectId
	AND LN.LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID	
	AND ISNULL(LN.IsActive,0) = 1

	EndOfScript:
		PRINT 'EndOfScript:'
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[MobspVerificationRequestVerify]



/*AI14010512 - Copied from web*/
/*AI14011223 - Send int msg without updating user receiver*/
/*AI14020129 - Add doc - add leave - add responsible user*/
/*AI14020701 - Add cmpReferUserId and cmpSuppUserId to verifyUser*/
/*AI14020918- Add WSStockSupply and buyOrder*/
/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[MobspVerificationRequestVerify]
(		
/* 
	EXEC MobspVerificationRequestVerify 		
*/
@VerificationWorkFlowId INT,
@ObjectId INT,
@VerificationRequestId INT,
@VerificationWorkFlowStepId INT,
@VerifyText NVARCHAR(MAX),
@VerifyTextLang NVARCHAR(MAX),
@MsgSubject NVARCHAR(200),
@VerifiedMsgSubject NVARCHAR(200),
@RollId INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@UserId INT,
@FPId INT,
@Year1 SMALLINT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@AppType VARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL,
@MaxDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2) OUTPUT,
@Result NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT 
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*===================================== Define variables ==================================*/
DECLARE @ObjectType INT, @SequenceObservation BIT,
@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive BIT,@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),
@LimitOrderDiscountActive BIT,@LimitOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),
@DiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),@SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
@SumDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),
@MsgTypeId INT,@VerifyUserId INT, @RegisterTime NVARCHAR(8),@InternalMessageId INT
,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2)
SET @RegisterTime = CAST(@RegisterDate AS TIME)
/*============================= SET Object and @SequenceObservation =======================*/	
SELECT @ObjectType = [ObjectType], @SequenceObservation = [SequenceObservation]
FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlows]
WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId
/*================================= Check Discount Percent ================================*/
SELECT @LimitPreOrderDiscountActive = LimitPreOrderDiscountActive, 
@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent = LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent,
@LimitOrderDiscountActive = LimitOrderDiscountActive,
@LimitOrderDiscountPercent = LimitOrderDiscountPercent
FROM dbo.CrmsysRolls
WHERE ID = @RollId

IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 10)/*PreOrder*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @MaxDiscountPercent = ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent,0)
	END
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @pordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2)
		SET @pordDiscount = (SELECT pordDiscount FROM dbo.WSPreOrder WHERE PreOrderID = @ObjectId)
		SELECT 
			@SumPriceAmount = SumPriceAmount,
			@SumDiscount = SumDiscount, 
			@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount ,
			@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
		FROM [dbo].[MobfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)				

		/**/				
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		/*IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0)		
			SET @Result = '-1' /-*DivisionByZero*-/
		ELSE*/	
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 )	
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)

			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/					
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@SumDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)*//*calculate product discount*/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)

			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)/*calculate preorder discount*/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
				SET @Result = '-3' /*The pre-order discount is too high*/	
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		ELSE IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) <> 0)	
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-1' /*DivisionByZero*/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/

	END
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 20)/*Order*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @MaxDiscountPercent = ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountPercent,0)
	END
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2)
		SET @ordDiscount = (SELECT ordDiscount FROM dbo.WSOrder WHERE OrderID = @ObjectId)
		SELECT 
			@SumPriceAmount = SumPriceAmount,
			@SumDiscount = SumDiscount,
			@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount ,
			@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
		FROM [dbo].[MobfnReturnOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)
		/**/				
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		/*IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0)		
			SET @Result = '-1' /-*DivisionByZero*-/
		ELSE*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0)	
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)
			/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
		BEGIN
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@SumDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)*//*calculate product discount*/

IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
BEGIN
/**/	
	/*======================== Create Tmp table for language ==========================*/
	/*Sample= @VerifyTextLang = N'[LangId=1033|,|Txt=TextI|,|Subj=subjectI|,|VerifiedSubj=vSubjI|,|]@[LangId=1025|,|Txt=TextII|,|Subj=subjectII|,|VerifiedSubj=vSubjII|,|]@',*/
	DECLARE @TmpTable TABLE (
		[LangId] INT,
		[Txt] NVARCHAR(MAX),
		[Subj] NVARCHAR(200),
		[VerifiedSubj] NVARCHAR(200)
	)
	DECLARE @LangId INT,@Txt NVARCHAR(MAX), @Subj NVARCHAR(200),@Text NVARCHAR(MAX),@VerifiedSubj NVARCHAR(200)
	IF(ISNULL(@VerifyTextLang,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
		/**/	
		DECLARE Crsr Cursor For
		/**/	
			SELECT SplitData  
			FROM fnSplitString(@VerifyTextLang, '@')
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @Text
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*================================================================================*/
			DECLARE @Field NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
			SET @LangId = NULL
			SET @Txt = NULL
			SET @Subj = NULL
			SET @VerifiedSubj = NULL
			/**/
			/*****************************************************************/
			IF(ISNULL(@Text,'') <> '') 
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @Text = SUBSTRING(@Text, 2, LEN(@Text)-2)			
				/*===================== Get Fields ==========================*/
				WHILE LEN(@Text) > 0
				BEGIN
					IF PATINDEX('%|,|%', @Text) > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @Field = SUBSTRING(@Text, 0, PATINDEX('%|,|%', @Text))
						/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						/*Get parameter name and split value form parameter*/
						/*For example => LangId=1065 => LangId= => LangId => Compare => value*/
						DECLARE @FieldValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
						DECLARE @FieldName NVARCHAR(200)
						SET @FieldName = SUBSTRING(@Field, 1, CHARINDEX('=',@Field)-1)                                    
						SET @FieldValue = SUBSTRING(@Field, CHARINDEX('=', @Field)+1, Len(@Field))
						/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						/*---------------------------- BEGIN Fill variabele ------------------------------*/
						/*BEGIN*/
						IF @FieldName = 'LangId'
						BEGIN
							SET @LangId = CASE WHEN CAST(ISNULL(@FieldValue,'0') AS INT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(@FieldValue AS INT) END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'Txt'
						BEGIN
							SET @Txt = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'Subj'
						BEGIN
							SET @Subj = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'VerifiedSubj'
						BEGIN
							SET @VerifiedSubj = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/				
						/*END */
						/*---------------------------- END Fill variabele --------------------------------*/
						/*---------------------------- Remove current parameter from listparam ------------*/
						SET @Text = SUBSTRING(@Text,LEN(@Field + '|,|') + 1,LEN(@Text))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @Field = @Text
						SET @Text = NULL       
					END
				END
				/*===========================================================*/
				INSERT INTO @TmpTable ([LangId],Txt,Subj,VerifiedSubj)
				VALUES(@LangId,@Txt,@Subj,@VerifiedSubj)
			/**/
			END
			/*================================================================================*/					    				 					
		/**/	
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @Text
		END
		CLOSE Crsr
		DEALLOCATE Crsr
	/**/
	END		
	/*============================= Insert into WSVerificationRequestDetails ===================*/

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails]

				END
				/*AI14020129 - add leave and doc*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 60)/*Doc*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.MobspDocVerify
					@DocId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@VerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@VerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 90)/*leave*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.MobspLeaveVerify
					@LeaveId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@VerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@VerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 100)/*mission*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.MobspLeaveVerify
					@LeaveId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@VerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@VerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				/*AI14020129-End*/
				/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 110) /*Letter*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC [dbo].[MobspLetterVerify]
					@LetterId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,					
					@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
					@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@AppType = @AppType							
				/**/
				END
				/*RZ14030308- End*/
			END
			/*======================== Expired All Request but current request ========*/
			EXEC MobspUpdateVerificationRequestsExpired 
				@VerificationRequestId = @VerificationRequestId,
				@VerificationWorkFlowId = 0,
				@ObjectId = @ObjectId,
				@ObjectType = @ObjectType,
				@Expired = 1,
				@LanguageID = @LanguageID,
				@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID
			/*================== Send Message for the object is verified ==============*/
			/*EXEC [dbo].[MobspInternalMessageLoadReceiver] @crmUserId = @UserId
			EXEC [dbo].[MobspIntMsgUpdateSelectReceiver]
				@crmUserId = @UserId,@UserId = @VerificationReqUserId,@Selected = 1, @Mode  = 1  */

			/*AI14011223 - instead of [MobspInternalMessageSend]*/
			EXEC [dbo].[MobspInternalMessageSendSingle]
				@msgMasterId = NULL,
				@msgSubject = @VerifiedMsgSubject,
				@msgBody = @VerifyText,
				/*@msgActiveInCycle = NULL, AI14011223*/
				@msgdTypeId = @MsgTypeId,
				@msgdFromUserId = @UserId,
				@msgdToUserId = @VerificationReqUserId,
				@msgdSendDate=@RegisterDatePersian,
				@msgdSendTime = @RegisterTime,
				@msgdSendDateTime = @RegisterDate,
				@msgdPriorityId = NULL,
				@msgdAttachFile = NULL,
				@msgdAttachRecId = @ObjectId,
				@msgdAttachRecDesc = NULL,
				@msgdGroupId  = NULL,
				@UserId = @UserId,
				@Year1 = @Year1,
				@Month1 = @Month1,
				@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
				@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
				@AppType = @AppType, 
				@InsertedID = @InternalMessageId OUTPUT,  /*AI14011223 - instead of @InternalMessageID*/
				@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID,
				/*@FirstRegisterUserId = @UserId,
				@FirstRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
				@FirstRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
				@ApiId = NULL, AI14011223*/
				@msgdAttachRecIdI = NULL,
				@msgdAttachRecDescI = NULL
			/*Insert Lang table*/
			IF(ISNULL(@InternalMessageId,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmInternalMessage_Lang]
					([InternalMessageID]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[msgSubject]
					,[msgBody])
				SELECT
					@InternalMessageId
					,[LangId]
					,[VerifiedSubj]
					,[Txt]
				FROM @TmpTable 
				WHERE [LangId] <> 0 
			END			
			/*=========================================================================*/
		/**/
		END		
	/**/
	END
	ELSE
		SET @Result = '-5'/*error in insert into WSVerificationRequestDetails*/
/**/
END
/*======================================================================*/
IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
	SET @Result = '1' /*OK*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[PayRollspCalculateUserCycleItemValues]







/*RZ980126*/
/*RZ14011214- Update CycleNetSalary*/
/*AI14020328 - Fix formula with unknown tags - Round formula result*/
/*RZ14021130- Add orderView to fix calculate*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[PayRollspCalculateUserCycleItemValues]
(		
/*		
	declare @p8 nvarchar(max)
	set @p8=N''
	exec [dbo].[PayRollspCalculateUserCycleItemValues] @CycleId=1154,@UserId=3,@RegisterDate='2023-06-18 10:04:49',@RegisterDatePersian='14020328',@Year1=30,@Month1=3,@AppType='web',@ErrorMessage=@p8 output,@LanguageID=1065,@DefaultLanguageID=1065
	select @p8
*/
@CycleId	INT,
@UserId		INT,
@RegisterDate	DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian	VARCHAR(8),
@Year1	SMALLINT,
@Month1	SMALLINT,
@AppType	VARCHAR(20), 
@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*==================================================*/
DECLARE @PayRollUserCycleItemValueId INT, @ItemId INT, @Value NUMERIC(18,2),
@UsefulIds NVARCHAR(MAX), @ItemTypeId INT,@ItemFormula NVARCHAR(MAX)
/**/
DECLARE Crsr CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 
		[PayRollUserCycleItemValueId]
		,CIV.[ItemId]
		,CIV.[Value]
		,CIV.[UsefulIds]
		/**/
		,PRI.[ItemTypeId]
		,PRI.[ItemFormula]		   
	FROM [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues] CIV
	INNER JOIN [PayRollItems] PRI 
	ON CIV.ItemId = PRI.PayRollItemId
	WHERE CIV.[CycleId] = @CycleId
	AND PRI.[ItemTypeId] = 2 /*formula*/
	/*AND ISNULL(PRI.[ItemIsActive],0) = 1*/
	ORDER BY PRI.ItemOrderView,CIV.[ItemId]/*RZ14021130- Add orderView to fix calculate*/
/**/
OPEN Crsr
FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @PayRollUserCycleItemValueId, @ItemId, @Value, @UsefulIds,@ItemTypeId,@ItemFormula
	While @@Fetch_Status = 0
	BEGIN	 	
		/*-------------------------------------------*/				
		/*Set Item Name*/
		DECLARE @ItemName NVARCHAR(300)
		IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
			SET @ItemName = (SELECT [ItemName] FROM [dbo].[PayRollItems] PRI WHERE PRI.[PayRollItemId] = @ItemId)
		ELSE
			SET @ItemName = (SELECT [ItemName] FROM [dbo].[PayRollItems_Lang] PRI WHERE PRI.[PayRollItemId] = @ItemId AND PRI.[LanguageID] = @LanguageID)
		
		/*-------------------------------------------------*/
			IF(@ItemFormula IS NOT NULL AND @ItemFormula <> '')
			BEGIN
				/**/
				/*--------------- Replace formula ---------------*/
				SELECT @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula,PRI.[ItemFormulaTag],ISNULL(CAST(CIV.[Value] AS NVARCHAR(300)),PRI.[ItemFormulaTag]))
				FROM [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues] CIV
				INNER JOIN [PayRollItems] PRI ON CIV.ItemId = PRI.PayRollItemId
				WHERE CIV.CycleId = @CycleId
				AND (PRI.[ItemFormulaTag] IS NOT NULL AND PRI.[ItemFormulaTag] <>'')

				/*AI14020328 - Fix formula with unknown tags*/
				IF(PatIndex('%#%', @ItemFormula) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, PRI.[ItemFormulaTag], '|#|') FROM [PayRollItems] PRI WHERE
					(PRI.[ItemFormulaTag] IS NOT NULL AND PRI.[ItemFormulaTag] <>'')

					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, ' ', '')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '+|#|', '+0')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|+', '0+')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '+(|#|)', '+(0)')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)+', '(0)+')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '-|#|', '-0')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|-', '0-')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '-(|#|)', '-(0)')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)-', '(0)-')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '*|#|', '*1')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|*', '1*')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '*(|#|)', '*(1)')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)*', '(1)*')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|/', '0/')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '/|#|', '/1')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)/', '(0)/')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '/(|#|)', '/(1)')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|>', '0>')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '>|#|', '>0')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)>', '(0)>')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '>(|#|)', '>(0)')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|<', '0<')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '<|#|', '<0')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)<', '(0)<')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '<(|#|)', '<(0)')
					/**/
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|=', '0=')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '=|#|', '=0')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '(|#|)=', '(0)=')
					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '=(|#|)', '=(0)')

					SET @ItemFormula = REPLACE(@ItemFormula, '|#|', '0')
				END
				/*AI14020328-End*/

				/*AND ISNULL(PRI.ItemJustForShow,0) = 0*/
				/*------------- Calculate and Update ------------*/
				BEGIN TRY
					/**/
						/*--------- Calculate formula -------------*/
						DECLARE @Result NUMERIC(18,2), @StrCom NVARCHAR(MAX) = N''
						SET @StrCom ='SELECT @Result = ' + @ItemFormula
						EXECUTE sp_executesql @StrCom, N'@Result NUMERIC(18,2) OUTPUT',@Result = @Result OUTPUT
						/*-----------------------------------------*/
						/**/
						UPDATE [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues]
							SET  [Value] = CEILING(@Result) /*AI14020328 - round formula result*/
								,[UsefulIds] = @UsefulIds
								,[ValueNotValid] = 0
								,[UserId] = @UserId
								,[Year1] = @Year1
								,[Month1] = @Month1
								,[RegisterDate] = @RegisterDate
								,[RegisterDatePersian] = @RegisterDatePersian
								,[AppType] = @AppType
						WHERE [PayRollUserCycleItemValueId] = @PayRollUserCycleItemValueId
						/**/										
					/**/
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					/*SET @ErrorMessage += N'Error in formula,Id=' + CAST(@PayRollUserCycleItemValueId AS NVARCHAR(100)) + '|'*/
					SET @ErrorMessage += N'Error in formula,ItemName=' + ISNULL(@ItemName,'') + '@|@'

					/**/
					UPDATE [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues]
						SET  [ValueNotValid] = 1
					WHERE [PayRollUserCycleItemValueId] = @PayRollUserCycleItemValueId
					/**/
				END CATCH
				/*-----------------------------------------------*/									
				/**/
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN						
				/*SET @ErrorMessage += N'Formula is null,Id=' + CAST(@PayRollUserCycleItemValueId AS NVARCHAR(100)) + '|'*/
				SET @ErrorMessage += N'Formula is null,ItemName=' + ISNULL(@ItemName,'') + '@|@'
				/**/
				UPDATE [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues]
					SET  [ValueNotValid] = 1
				WHERE [PayRollUserCycleItemValueId] = @PayRollUserCycleItemValueId
				/**/
			END						
								
		/*-------------------------------------------*/
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @PayRollUserCycleItemValueId, @ItemId, @Value, @UsefulIds,@ItemTypeId,@ItemFormula
	END
CLOSE Crsr
DEALLOCATE Crsr					
/*==================================================*/									
/*RZ14011214- Update CycleNetSalary*/
UPDATE [dbo].[PayRollUserCycle]
SET [CycleNetSalary] = ISNULL((
							ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL([Value],0))
								 FROM [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues] CIV
								 WHERE CIV.[CycleId] = @CycleId
								 AND CIV.[ItemId] IN (
									SELECT [PayRollItemId]FROM [dbo].[PayRollItems] PRI
									WHERE PRI.[ItemKind] = 1
									AND ISNULL(PRI.[ItemJustForShow],0) = 0)),0)								 			
							-
							ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL([Value],0))
								 FROM [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues] CIV
								 WHERE CIV.[CycleId] = @CycleId
								 AND CIV.[ItemId] IN (
									SELECT [PayRollItemId]FROM [dbo].[PayRollItems] PRI
									WHERE PRI.[ItemKind] = 2
									AND ISNULL(PRI.[ItemJustForShow],0) = 0)),0)
						),0)	
WHERE [PayRollUserCycleId] = @CycleId
/*RZ14011214- End*/
/*==================================================*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[SmsReturnBodyTextLang]





--ADBF960911
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[SmsReturnBodyTextLang]
(	-- Select * From SmsReturnBodyTextLang('tyu')
@input VARCHAR(4000)
)
RETURNS @tbl TABLE (BodyLang VARCHAR(5), BodyLen INT, BodyPageCount INT )
AS 
BEGIN
DECLARE 
@Lan VARCHAR(10), @BodyCount INT  
SET @BodyCount = LEN(REPLACE(@input, CHAR(10),''))
/**/
DECLARE @EnglishChar char(36) = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
DECLARE @index int = 1
WHILE @index <= LEN(@input)
BEGIN
IF CHARINDEX(SUBSTRING(@input,@index,1),@EnglishChar)=0
	BEGIN
	SET @Lan = 'FA';
	BREAK;
	END
ELSE
	BEGIN
	SET @Lan = 'EN';
	SET @index = @index+1;
	END	  
END
/**/
DECLARE @x int
IF @Lan = 'En'
BEGIN
	SET @x= @BodyCount
	SET @BodyCount = 0
	WHILE @x > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @BodyCount = @BodyCount + 1
		IF @BodyCount = 1 SET @x = @x - 159
		ELSE
		IF @BodyCount = 2 SET @x = @x - 146 - 1
		ELSE
		IF @BodyCount > 2 SET @x = @x - 152 - 1
	END 
/**/
END
ELSE
IF @Lan = 'Fa'
BEGIN				
	SET @x= @BodyCount
	SET @BodyCount = 0
	WHILE @x > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @BodyCount = @BodyCount + 1
		IF @BodyCount = 1 SET @x = @x - 70
		ELSE
		IF @BodyCount = 2 SET @x = @x - 63 - 1
		ELSE
		IF @BodyCount > 2 SET @x = @x - 66 - 1
	END 
END
/**/
INSERT INTO @tbl
SELECT @Lan ,LEN(REPLACE(@input, CHAR(10),'')), @BodyCount
/**/
RETURN
END

-- [dbo].[WSfnMakeAndReturnPrdCode]



/*ADBF899510*/
CREATE Function [dbo].[WSfnMakeAndReturnPrdCode] ( @FGId INT, @SGId INT)
/*-- Select dbo.WSfnMakeAndReturnPrdCode (1, 1) */
Returns VARCHAR(50)		
As
BEGIN
/**/
DECLARE @FGCode VARCHAR(5), @SGCode VARCHAR(5), @PrdCode VARCHAR(50)
/**/
SELECT  @PrdCode = ISNULL(MAX( RIGHT(PrdCode, 5) ), 0)
FROM dbo.WSProducts
WHERE PrdGroupID = @SGId
SELECT @FGCode = ISNULL(FGCode, 0) FROM dbo.WSProductFirstGroup WHERE PrdFirstGroupID = @FGId
SELECT @SGCode = ISNULL(SGCode, 0) FROM dbo.WSProductSecondGroup WHERE PrdSecondGroupID = @SGId
/*--*/
SET @FGCode = RIGHT('000' + IsNull(@FGCode, 0), 3) 
SET @SGCode = RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(@SGCode, 0), 3)
/*--PRINT @FGCode PRINT @SGCode*/
SET @PrdCode = @PrdCode + 1
SET @PrdCode = RIGHT('0000' + @PrdCode, 4)
/*--PRINT @PrdCode*/
SET @PrdCode = RIGHT( @FGCode + @SGCode + @PrdCode, 20)
/*--PRINT @PrdCode*/
RETURN(@PrdCode)
/**/
END

CREATE Function [dbo].[WSfnReturnOrderSerialNumber]
(			-- Select dbo.WSfnReturnOrderSerialNumber(1, 2)
@FinancialPeriod INT,
@OrderOprId INT 
)
Returns INT		
As
BEGIN

DECLARE @SNumber INT, @CurrentYear INT, @BeginNumber INT 

SELECT @CurrentYear = SUBSTRING(CAST(FDate AS VARCHAR(4)), 3, 2)
FROM dbo.WSFinancialPeriod 
Where Id = @FinancialPeriod

SET @BeginNumber = CAST(CAST(@CurrentYear AS VARCHAR(4))+
		CAST(@OrderOprId AS VARCHAR(5)) + '0000' AS INT) 

SELECT @SNumber = ISNULL(MAX( ordSerial), @BeginNumber)
FROM dbo.WSOrder
WHERE OrderOprID = @OrderOprId 
AND FPId = @FinancialPeriod

SET @SNumber = @SNumber + 1

RETURN(@SNumber)
end

-- [dbo].[WSfnReturnOrderSumFooter]








/*--890621ADBF9105039211930294109411*/
/*RZ971109- Change price to decimals*/
/*RZ990817- Add fields*/
/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
/*RZ14001018- Add TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount*/
Create Function [dbo].[WSfnReturnOrderSumFooter]
(			/* Select * from dbo.WSfnReturnOrderSumFooter(17241) */
@OrderID INT 
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
	SELECT /*Round(*//*RZ971109- Change price to decimals*/
		/*CAST(SUM(
		  (ISNULL(ordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL( ordIFCR, 1)* ISNULL( ordIFCRI, 1)) *
		( ISNULL(ordIPrice, 0) - ( ISNULL(ordIDiscount, 0) + ISNULL(ordIDiscountI, 0) + ISNULL(ordIRound, 0)) 
			/*960703*/
			+ ISNULL(ordIRoundPlus, 0) )		
			+ ISNULL(ordITax, 0) * ISNULL(ordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL( ordIFCR, 1)* ISNULL( ordIFCRI, 1)		
		) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
		/*, 0)*/ SumPriceAmount, */

		/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
		CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ordIPriceSum,0) + ISNULL(ordITaxSum,0)) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) SumPriceAmount, 
		/*RZ991008- End*/
		SUM(ordIPrice) SumPrice,
		SUM(ordIQuantity) SumQuantity,
		SUM(ordIDiscount) SumDiscount, 
		SUM(ordIDiscountI) SumDiscountI, 
		SUM(ordITax) SumTax,
		SUM(ordIFCR) SumFCR,
		SUM(ordIFCRI) SumFCRI,
		SUM(ordIRound) SumRound,
		/*RZ990817- Add fields*/
		SUM(ordIPriceSum) TotalPriceSum,	
		SUM(ordIDiscountSum) TotalDiscountSum,
		SUM(ordIDiscountISum) TotalDiscountISum,
		SUM(ordITaxSum) TotalTaxSum, 
		/*RZ990817- End*/ 
		/*RZ14001018- Add TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount*/
		SUM(
			ISNULL(ordIPriceSum,0) + ISNULL(ordIDiscountSum,0)		
		)TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount
		/*RZ14001018- End*/
	FROM dbo.WSOrderItems
	WHERE OrderId = @OrderID
	AND ISNULL(ordINotInSum, 0) = 0
)

(	/* Select dbo.WSfnReturnPreOrderNumber(30,6)*/
@FinancialPeriod INT,
@pordTypeId INT = NULL /*RZ14000116- Add pordTypeId*/
)
RETURNS BIGINT	/*RZ990811- Change type from int to bigint*/	
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*DECLARE @Number INT, @CurrentYear INT, @BeginNumber INT */
DECLARE @Number BIGINT, @CurrentYear INT, @BeginNumber BIGINT/*RZ990811- Change type from int to bigint*/

SELECT @CurrentYear = SUBSTRING(CAST(FDate AS VARCHAR(4)), 3, 2)
FROM dbo.WSFinancialPeriod 
Where Id = @FinancialPeriod
/**/
/*SET @BeginNumber = CAST(CAST(@CurrentYear AS VARCHAR(4)) + '0000' AS INT) */
SET @BeginNumber = CAST(CAST(@CurrentYear AS VARCHAR(4)) + '0000' AS BIGINT) /*RZ990811- Change type from int to bigint*/
/**/
/*SELECT @Number = ISNULL(MAX( pordNumber), @BeginNumber)
FROM dbo.WSPreOrder
Where FPId =  @FinancialPeriod*/
/*--------------------------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14000116- Add pordTypeId*/
IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 [IsActivePordNumberByType] FROM dbo.CrmsysSetting),0) = 1 AND ISNULL(@pordTypeId,0) <> 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT @Number = ISNULL(MAX( pordNumber), @BeginNumber)
	FROM dbo.WSPreOrder
	Where FPId =  @FinancialPeriod
	AND pordTypeId = @pordTypeId
/**/
END
ELSE 
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT @Number = ISNULL(MAX( pordNumber), @BeginNumber)
	FROM dbo.WSPreOrder
	Where FPId =  @FinancialPeriod
/**/
END
/*RZ14000116- End*/
/*--------------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
SET @Number = @Number + 1
/**/
RETURN(@Number)
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderNumberRevision]




/*RZ990821*/
Create Function [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderNumberRevision]
(	
	/* 
		Select dbo.WSfnReturnPreOrderNumberRevision(2481,30)
	*/
@PorOrderId INT,
@FinancialPeriod INT
)
RETURNS BIGINT	
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @NumberRevision BIGINT
	/**/
	SELECT @NumberRevision = ISNULL(MAX(pordNumberRevision), 0)
	FROM dbo.WSPreOrder PO
	WHERE PO.pordNumber =  (SELECT TOP 1 P.pordNumber FROM WSPreOrder P WHERE P.PreOrderID = @PorOrderId)
	AND PO.FPId =  @FinancialPeriod
	/**/
	SET @NumberRevision = @NumberRevision + 1
	/**/
	RETURN(@NumberRevision)
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter]






/*--890621ADBF9105039211
--ADBF93029507*/
/*RZ971109- Change price to decimals*/
/*RZ990817- Add fields*/
/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
/*RZ14001018- Add TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount*/
Create Function [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter]
(			/* Select * from dbo.WSfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter(3020) */
@PreOrderID INT 
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
SELECT 
   /*ROUND(*//*RZ971109- Change price to decimals*/
	/*	CAST(SUM(
		 (ISNULL(pordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL(pordIFCR, 1) * ISNULL(pordIFCRI, 1)) 
		 * 
		 (( ISNULL(pordIPrice, 0) - ( ISNULL(pordIDiscount, 0) + ISNULL(pordIDiscountI, 0) + ISNULL(pordIRound, 0))
		 /*ADBF960120*/
		 + ISNULL(pordIRoundPlus, 0)
		 ))	  
	 		+ (ISNULL( pordITax, 0) * ISNULL(pordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL(pordIFCR, 1) * ISNULL(pordIFCRI, 1))
		) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
	/*, 0)*/ SumPriceAmount, */

	/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
	CAST(SUM( ISNULL(pordIPriceSum,0) + ISNULL(pordITaxSum,0)) AS NUMERIC(18,2)) SumPriceAmount, 	
	/*RZ991008- End*/

	SUM(pordIPrice) SumPrice,
	SUM(pordIQuantity) SumQuantity,
	SUM( pordIDiscount) SumDiscount, 
	SUM( pordIDiscountI) SumDiscountI, 
	SUM(pordITax) SumTax,
	SUM(pordIFCR) SumFCR,
	SUM(pordIFCRI) SumFCRI,
	SUM(pordIRound) SumRound,
	/*RZ990817- Add fields*/
	SUM(pordIPriceSum) TotalPriceSum,	
	SUM(pordIDiscountSum) TotalDiscountSum,
	SUM(pordIDiscountISum) TotalDiscountISum,
	SUM(pordITaxSum) TotalTaxSum, 
	/*RZ990817- End*/ 
	/*RZ14001018- Add TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount*/
	SUM(
		ISNULL(pordIPriceSum,0) + ISNULL(pordIDiscountSum,0)		
	)TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount
	/*RZ14001018- End*/
FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems
WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID
AND ISNULL(pordINotInSum, 0) = 0
)

					/*SET @pordIDescription = REPLACE(@pordIDescription,N'#FromDate#',ISNULL(((SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithSlash](@pordDateTime))),''))*/
					SET @pordIDescription = REPLACE(@pordIDescription,N'#FromDate#',ISNULL(((SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithSlash](@FromDate))),''))/*RZ14020720- Add field fromDate*/
					SET @pordIDescription = REPLACE(@pordIDescription,N'#ToDate#',ISNULL(((SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithSlash](@pordIValidityExpireDate))),''))
				/**/
				END
				/*RZ14020529- End*/
				/*-------------------------------------------------------*/
				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCRI,1)	
				/*---------------- Calculate item ----------------*/
				SET @TmpII = ISNULL(@pordIPrice,0) - ISNULL(@pordIDiscount,0) - ISNULL(@pordIRound,0) + ISNULL(@pordIRoundPlus,0)
				SET @TmpIII = ((ISNULL(@pordIPrice,0) - ISNULL(@pordIRound,0) + ISNULL(@pordIRoundPlus,0)) * ISNULL(@TmpI,0)) - ISNULL(@pordIDiscountSum,0)
				/*---------------- Calculate tax -----------------*/
				IF(ISNULL(@pordITaxIndex,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@pordICalculateTax,0) = 1)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @pordITaxSum = ((ISNULL(@TmpIII,0)) * ISNULL(@pordITaxIndex,0) / 100)
					SET @pordITax = (ISNULL(@TmpII,0) * ISNULL(@pordITaxIndex,0) / 100)
				/**/
				END
				ELSE IF(ISNULL(@pordITax,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@pordICalculateTax,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(@TmpII,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @pordITaxSum = ISNULL(@pordITax,0) * ISNULL(@TmpI,0)
					SET @pordITaxIndex = (ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0) * 100) / (ISNULL(@TmpII,0))
				/**/
				END
				/*---------------- Calculate item ----------------*/			
				SET @pordIPriceSum = @TmpIII
				SET @pordITotalPrice = ISNULL(@pordIPriceSum,0) + ISNULL(@pordITaxSum,0)
				/*--------- Calculate item by currency unit ------*/
				IF(ISNULL(@pordIPrice,0) = 0 )
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @pordIPrice = 0
					SET @pordIDiscountSum = 0
					SET @pordIDiscount = 0
					SET @pordITaxSum = 0
					SET @pordITax = 0		
					SET @pordIPriceSum = 0
					SET @pordITotalPrice = 0
				/**/
				END
				/*------------------------------------------------*/
				IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
				BEGIN
					/*RZ14020626-Change Ceiling to Round*/
					SET @pordIPrice = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordIPrice))
					SET @pordIDiscountSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordIDiscountSum))
					SET @pordIDiscount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordIDiscount))
					SET @pordITaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordITaxSum))
					SET @pordITax = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordITax))			
					SET @pordIPriceSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordIPriceSum))
					SET @pordITotalPrice = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordITotalPrice))
					/*RZ14020626-End*/
				END
				/*-------------------------------------------------------*/
				SET @ItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] POI WHERE POI.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)
				SET @pordIOrderView = (ISNULL(@ItemCount,0) + 1) + (ISNULL(@ItemCount,0) * 4 ) - 1	
				/*-------------------------------------------------------*/
			
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems]
					([PreOrderId]
					,[pordIPrdId]
					,[pordIQuantity]
					,[pordIPrice]
					,[pordITotalPrice]
					,[pordIDescription]
					,[pordIDescriptionI]
					,[UserId]
					,[FPId]
					,[Month1]
					,[RegisterDate]
					,[RegisterDatePersian]
					,[pordIDiscount]
					,[pordIDiscountI]
					,[pordIDiscountPercent]
					,[pordIDiscountIPercent]
					,[pordIPrdUnitId]
					,[pordICurrencyUnitId]
					,[pordIOrderView]
					,[pordIFCR]
					,[pordITax]
					,[pordITaxIndex]
					,[pordICalculateTax]
					,[pordIFCRI]
					,[pordIWHId]
					,[pordIRound]
					,[AppType]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[FirstRegisterUserId]
					,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
					,[FirstRegisterDate]
					,[pordIRoundPlus]
					,[pordIPrdPriceGroupID]
					,[pordIPriceSum]
					,[pordIDiscountSum]
					,[pordIDiscountISum]
					,[pordITaxSum]								
					,[pordIPrdUnitIdI]
					,[pordIPrdUnitIRateResult]
					,[pordIPrdColorId]
					,[pordIPrdNickname]
					,[pordIValidityExpireDate]
					,[pordIValidityExpireDatePersian]
					,[pordIPrdAutoCalcRate]
					,[pordIPrdAutoCalcInflationRateInfo])/*RZ14020528- Change PrdAutoBill*/
				VALUES
					(@PreOrderId
					,@pordIPrdId
					,@pordIQuantity
					,@pordIPrice
					,@pordITotalPrice
					,@pordIDescription
					,@pordIDescriptionI
					,@UserId
					,@FPId
					,@Month1
					,@RegisterDate
					,@RegisterDatePersian
					,@pordIDiscount
					,@pordIDiscountI
					,@pordIDiscountPercent
					,@pordIDiscountIPercent				
					,@pordIPrdUnitId
					,@pordCurrencyUnitId
					,@pordIOrderView
					,@pordIFCR
					,@pordITax
					,@pordITaxIndex
					,@pordICalculateTax				
					,@pordIFCRI				
					,@pordIWHId
					,@pordIRound
					,@AppType
					,@DefaultLanguageId
					,@UserId
					,@RegisterDatePersian
					,@RegisterDate
					,@pordIRoundPlus
					,@pordIPrdPriceGroupID
					,@pordIPriceSum
					,@pordIDiscountSum
					,@pordIDiscountISum
					,@pordITaxSum																
					,@pordIPrdUnitIdI
					,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult
					,@pordIPrdColorId
					,@pordIPrdNickname
					,@pordIValidityExpireDate
					,@pordIValidityExpireDatePersian
					,@pordIPrdAutoCalcRate
					,@pordIPrdAutoCalcInflationRateInfo)
				SET @PreOrderItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				IF(ISNULL(@PreOrderItemId,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					/*Multi Language*/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems_Lang]
						([PreOrderItemID]
						,[LanguageID]						
						,[pordIPrdNickname]
						,[pordIDescriptionI]/*RZ14020529- Add fields and remove some parameters and change sp*/						
						)
					SELECT
						@PreOrderItemId
						,[LanguageID]						
						,[PrdNickname]
						/*RZ14020529- Add fields and remove some parameters and change sp*/
						,(CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) PLNI.PrdAutoCalcPordItemDesc 
											FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PLNI 
											WHERE PLNI.ProductID = @CrsrProductID
											AND PLNI.[LanguageID] = PLN.[LanguageID]),'') <> ''
							   THEN (
									(REPLACE((
												(REPLACE((REPLACE((SELECT TOP(1) PLNI.PrdAutoCalcPordItemDesc 
																	FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PLNI 
																	WHERE PLNI.ProductID = @CrsrProductID
																	/*AND PLNI.[LanguageID] = PLN.[LanguageID]),N'#FromDate#',ISNULL((FORMAT(@pordDateTime, 'yyyy/MM/dd', ISNULL((SELECT TOP (1) [LanguageCollation]   */
																	AND PLNI.[LanguageID] = PLN.[LanguageID]),N'#FromDate#',ISNULL((FORMAT(@FromDate, 'yyyy/MM/dd', ISNULL((SELECT TOP (1) [LanguageCollation]/*RZ14020720- Add field fromDate*/ 
																																	   FROM [dbo].[Languages] LL 
																																	   WHERE LL.[LanguageID] = PLN.[LanguageID]),'en-US'))),'')))
												,N'#ToDate#',ISNULL((FORMAT(@pordIValidityExpireDate, 'yyyy/MM/dd', 
																				ISNULL((SELECT TOP (1) [LanguageCollation]     
																				FROM [dbo].[Languages] LL 
																				WHERE LL.[LanguageID] = PLN.[LanguageID]),'en-US'))),'')))
									
									),'.','/'))
									)
							   ELSE NULL												
						 END)
						/*RZ14020529- End*/
					FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PLN
					WHERE ProductID = @pordIPrdId
					AND [LanguageID] <> @DefaultLanguageId										
				/**/
				END
				/*-------------------------------------------------------*/
				/*----------------------  Calculate ---------------------*/
				EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmounts] @PreOrderId, @Month1, @DefaultLanguageId, @DefaultLanguageId
				/*---------------------- Set PreOrders -------------------*/
				IF(ISNULL(@InsertedPords,'') <> '')
					SET @InsertedPords = ISNULL(@InsertedPords,'') + ','
				SEt @InsertedPords = ISNULL(@InsertedPords,'') + CAST(@PreOrderId AS NVARCHAR(200))
				/*-------------------------------------------------------*/
			/**/
			END			   		 
			/*---------------------------------------------------*/
		/**/
		END		
		/*---------------------------------------------------*/
		/*---------------- Issue PreOrder END ---------------*/
		/*---------------------------------------------------*/

		/*-----------------------------------------------------*/														    				 					
	/**/		
	FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPrdAutoBill INTO @CrsrProductID,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrdId,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPriceFromOrdItemRate
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPriceFromOrdItemPrdGroups,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcDynamicRate,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcInflationLastDurationRate
										,@CrsrPrdValidity,@CrsrPrdValidityDay,@CrsrPrdValidityTime
										/*RZ14020529- Add fields and remove some parameters and change sp*/
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordVerifyAfterIssue,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordReferUser
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordExpireDynamicRate,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordExpireDay
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordItemDesc,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordTaxDetectFromLastOrd
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordTaxDefSettingId,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordNoTaxDefSettingId	

										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjTitleGroupId,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjTitleId
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjPostFix,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjCnvsStatusGroupId
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjFOCmpCanSee,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjIsTicket
										,@CrsrPrdAutoCalcPordPrjUsedType
										/*RZ14020529- End*/
	END
	CLOSE CrsrPrdAutoBill
	DEALLOCATE CrsrPrdAutoBill
	/*---------------- Product Cursor End ---------------*/
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/		
	COMMIT TRANSACTION AutoIssueMain
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
/**/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION AutoIssueMain	
	SET @ErrorMessage = ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(ERROR_MESSAGE(),'Error')
/**/
END CATCh
/*---------------------------------------------------*/

END

		,(SELECT TOP (1) [IsDecimal] FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] CU WHERE CU.[CurrencyUnitID] = PO.[pordCurrencyUnitId])[pordCurrencyUnitIsDecimal]		
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [PrdAutoCalcPordCnvsReferUser] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P WHERE P.[ProductID] = 
			(SELECT TOP(1) [pordIPrdId] FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] POI 
			 WHERE POI.PreOrderId = PO.PreOrderID
			 AND [pordIPrdId] IN(SELECT PP.ProductID FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] PP WHERE ISNULL(PP.PrdAutoCalcIndexed,0) = 1))) [PrdAutoCalcPordCnvsReferUser]
		/*RZ14020621- End*/
	FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO
	WHERE PreOrderID IN(SELECT DISTINCT
							CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) 
						FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@InsertedPords,',')
						WHERE CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) <> 0)
	ORDER BY [pordDateTime],[pordNumber]
/**/
END

/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateBuyOrderAmounts]






/*RZ990902*/
/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
/*RZ14000812- Modify condition in check status*/

	exec WSspCalcAndUpdateBuyOrderAmounts 292,3,1065,1065	
*/

@Month1 SMALLINT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL

/**/
/*RZ14010530- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/

SET @cuUnitIsDecimal = (SELECT TOP 1 [IsDecimal]
						FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits]

												  FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrder] 
												  WHERE BuyOrderID = @BuyOrderId))

/*Calculate & Update the order*/	
/**/

/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
DECLARE @SumQuantity FLOAT = NULL,@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@TotalTaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL

SELECT  /*@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(/*ROUND(*/

		,@TotalTaxSum = SUM(bordITaxSum)
		/*RZ14020324- End*/
FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems]

	SET @bordSumAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) - ISNULL(@bordDiscount,0)

	IF(ISNULL(@bordCalculateTax,0) = 1)

	IF(ISNULL(@bordFacilityCostPercent,0) <> 0)

	/**/
	END
	/*------*/
	SET @bordFreightCost = ISNULL(@bordFreightCost,0)

	SET @bordFinalFreightCost = (ISNULL(@bordFreightCost,0) * ISNULL(@bordFreightCurrencyRate,1))
	/**/
	SET @bordCustomsFee = ISNULL(@bordCustomsFee,0)
	SET @bordCustomsCurrencyRate = ISNULL(@bordCustomsCurrencyRate,1)

		SET @bordSumAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@bordSumAmount))

	IF(@bordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)

		SET @TotalAmoutI = SUBSTRING(CAST(@bordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), 1, CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@bordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))-1)

		/**/
		IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1065)
		BEGIN
			SET @bordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )

			END
			SET @bordTotalAmountStr = @bordTotalAmountStr 
		END

			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )

	/*Update*/
	UPDATE [dbo].[WSBuyOrder]

		,[bordTransportation] = ISNULL(@bordTransportation,0)
		,[bordRound] = ISNULL(@bordRound,0)
		,[Month1] = @Month1
		/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
		,[bordItemsQty] = ISNULL(@SumQuantity,0)
		,[bordItemsDiscount] = ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)
		,[bordItemsTax] = ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)
		/*RZ14020324- End*/
		/*RZ14030308- Add fields*/
		,[bordFacilityCost] = @bordFacilityCost
		,[bordFacilityCostPercent] = @bordFacilityCostPercent
		,[bordFreightCost] = @bordFreightCost
		,[bordFreightCurrencyRate] = @bordFreightCurrencyRate 
		,[bordFinalFreightCost] = @bordFinalFreightCost 
		,[bordCustomsFee] = @bordCustomsFee
		,[bordCustomsCurrencyRate] = @bordCustomsCurrencyRate
		,[bordFinalCustomsFee] = @bordFinalCustomsFee
		,[bordCommission] = @bordCommission
		,[bordCommissionCurrencyRate] = @bordCommissionCurrencyRate 
		,[bordFinalCommission] = @bordFinalCommission
		,[bordTotalFinalCost] = @bordTotalFinalCost
		/*RZ14030308- End*/
	WHERE BuyOrderID = @BuyOrderId
	/**/
	IF(@bordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LangId INT
		/**/
		DECLARE Crsr CURSOR FOR
			SELECT LanguageID
			FROM [dbo].[Languages]		
			WHERE LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
			AND ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			While @@Fetch_Status = 0
			BEGIN	 
				DECLARE @ordTotalAmountStrLang NVARCHAR(1000)	
				/*-------------------------------------------*/				
				IF(@LangId = 1065)
				BEGIN
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang 
				END
				ELSE IF(@LangId = 1025)
				BEGIN
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
					END							
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = REPLACE(@ordTotalAmountStrLang,'-',' ')

					VALUES
						(@BuyOrderId
						,@LangId
						,@ordTotalAmountStrLang)
				END
				/*-------------------------------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			END
		CLOSE Crsr
		DEALLOCATE Crsr	
	END							
	/*==================================================*/
	/*================= Update status ==================*/	
	DECLARE @SumOrdPayAmount NUMERIC(18,2)
	SET @SumOrdPayAmount = ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL( SUM(bordpayAmount), 0) sumordpayAmount
									FROM dbo.WSBuyOrderPayments
									WHERE bordpayOrderId = @BuyOrderId
									AND ISNULL(bordpayDeActive,0) = 0/*RZ14020823- Add condition for update ordStatus*/),0)
	/*IF(@SumOrdPayAmount IS NOT NULL AND (@bordStatusId <> 4 AND @bordStatusId <> 5))*/
	IF(ISNULL(@SumOrdPayAmount,0) <> 0 AND (@bordStatusId <> 4 AND @bordStatusId <> 5))/*RZ14000812- Modify condition in check status*/
	BEGIN

		IF(@SumOrdPayAmount = 0 AND @bordStatusId <>1)
			SET @bordStatusId = 1
		/**/
		ELSE IF(@SumOrdPayAmount < @bordTotalAmount)/*RZ14020807- Change status - <>*/
			SET @bordStatusId = 2
		/**/
		ELSE IF(@SumOrdPayAmount >= @bordTotalAmount)/*RZ14020807- Change status - =*/
			SET @bordStatusId = 3
		/**/	 		
		/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[WSBuyOrder]
		SET [bordStatusId] = @bordStatusId

	/**/
	END
	/*==================================================*/
END

/*RZ980921*/
/*RZ990902- Remove rial in ordTotalAmountStr*/
/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
/*RZ14000812- Modify condition in check status*/
/*RZ14010530- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
/*RZ14020419- Add ordTspSettingId*/
/*RZ14020626-Change Ceiling to Round*/
/*RZ14020807- Change status*/
/*RZ14020823- Add condition for update ordStatus*/
/*RZ14021030- Re-Calculate items tax*/
/*RZ14030126- Add calculate OrderOtherAmounts*/
/*RZ14030301- Clac and update Amount in currencyI*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateOrderAmounts]
/* 	
	exec WSspCalcAndUpdateOrderAmounts 42983,3,1065,1065	
*/
(
@OrderId INT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
/*----------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14021030- Re-Calculate items tax*/
DECLARE @CalcItemTaxResult INT = 0
EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateOrderItemsTax]
@OrderId = @OrderId,
@Month1 = @Month1,
@Result = @CalcItemTaxResult OUTPUT	
/*RZ14021030- END*/
/*----------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14010530- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
DECLARE @cuUnitIsDecimal BIT
SET @cuUnitIsDecimal = (SELECT TOP 1 [IsDecimal]
						FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] 
						WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = (SELECT ordCurrencyUnitId 
												  FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] 
												  WHERE OrderID = @OrderId))
/*RZ14010530- End*/
/*RZ14020419- Add ordTspSettingId*/
DECLARE @ordTspSettingId INT 
SET @ordTspSettingId = (SELECT TOP(1) TspSettingId FROM [dbo].[TspSetting])
UPDATE  [dbo].[WSOrder]
SET  ordTspSettingId = @ordTspSettingId
WHERE [OrderID] = @OrderId
AND ISNULL(ordTspSettingId,0) = 0
/*RZ14020419- End*/
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*Calculate & Update the order*/	
/**/
DECLARE @SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2)
/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
DECLARE @SumQuantity FLOAT = NULL,@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@TotalTaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL
/*RZ14020324- End*/

SELECT  /*@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(/*Round(*/
								CAST(SUM(
									(ISNULL(ordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL( ordIFCR, 1)* ISNULL( ordIFCRI, 1)) *
									(ISNULL(ordIPrice, 0) - ( ISNULL(ordIDiscount, 0) + ISNULL(ordIDiscountI, 0) + ISNULL(ordIRound, 0)) 
									+ ISNULL(ordIRoundPlus, 0) )		
									+ ISNULL(ordITax, 0) * ISNULL(ordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL( ordIFCR, 1)* ISNULL( ordIFCRI, 1)		
								) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
								/*, 0)*/ ,0)*/
		/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
		@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(CAST(SUM( ISNULL([ordIPriceSum],0) + ISNULL([ordITaxSum],0)) AS NUMERIC(18,2)),0)
		/*RZ991008- End*/
		/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
		,@SumQuantity = SUM(ordIQuantity)
		,@TotalDiscountSum = SUM(ordIDiscountSum)
		,@TotalTaxSum = SUM(ordITaxSum)
		/*RZ14020324- End*/	
FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems]
WHERE OrderId = @OrderID
AND ISNULL(ordINotInSum, 0) = 0
IF(@SumPriceAmount IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
	/**/
	DECLARE @ordItemCount INT, @ordItemsAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
	@ordInstallAmount NUMERIC(18,2), @ordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),
	@ordSumAmount NUMERIC(18,2), @ordTax NUMERIC(18,2), @ordTaxIndex NUMERIC(18,2),
	@ordCalculateTax BIT,@ordTotalAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@ordTransportation NUMERIC(18,2),
	@ordDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),@ordRound NUMERIC(18,2),@ordStatusId INT,
	@ordTotalAmountStr NVARCHAR(1000)
	/**/
	SELECT 
       @ordInstallAmount =[ordInstallAmount],
       @ordDiscount = [ordDiscount],
       @ordTaxIndex = [ordTaxIndex],
       @ordCalculateTax = [ordCalculateTax],
       @ordDiscountPercent = [ordDiscountPercent],
       @ordTransportation = [ordTransportation],
       @ordRound = [ordRound],
	   @ordStatusId= [ordStatusId] 
	FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O
	WHERE O.[OrderID] = @OrderId
	/**/
	SET @ordItemsAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)
	IF(@ordDiscountPercent IS NOT NULL AND @ordDiscountPercent > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @ordDiscount = (ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) * ISNULL(@ordDiscountPercent,0)) / 100
	END
	/**/
	SET @ordSumAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) + ISNULL(@ordInstallAmount,0) - ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0)
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@ordCalculateTax,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @ordTax = ISNULL(@ordSumAmount,0) * ISNULL(@ordTaxIndex,0) / 100
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @ordTax = 0
	END
	/**/
	SET @ordTotalAmount = ISNULL(ISNULL(@ordSumAmount,0) + ISNULL(@ordTax,0) + ISNULL(@ordTransportation,0) - ISNULL(@ordRound,0),0)
	/**/
	SET @ordItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems] OI WHERE OI.OrderId = @OrderId)
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14010530- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
	IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
	BEGIN	
		/*RZ14020626-Change Ceiling to Round*/
		SET @ordItemsAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@ordItemsAmount))					
		SET @ordSumAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@ordSumAmount))		
		SET @ordTax = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@ordTax))		
		SET @ordTotalAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@ordTotalAmount))		
		SET @ordDiscount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@ordDiscount))
		/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/	
		SET @TotalDiscountSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)))	
		SET @TotalTaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)))	
		/*RZ14020324- End*/
		/*RZ14020626-End*/
	END
	/*RZ14010530- End*/
	/*************** TotalAmountStr *******************/
	DECLARE @TotalAmoutI NVARCHAR(MAX),@TotalAmoutII NVARCHAR(MAX)
	IF(@ordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN			
		SET @TotalAmoutI = SUBSTRING(CAST(@ordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), 1, CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@ordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))-1)                                    
		SET @TotalAmoutII = SUBSTRING(CAST(@ordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@ordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))+1, 2)
		/**/
		IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1065)
		BEGIN
			SET @ordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ordTotalAmountStr = @ordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			END
			SET @ordTotalAmountStr = @ordTotalAmountStr /*+ N' —Ì«·' *//*RZ990902- Remove rial in ordTotalAmountStr*/
		END
		ELSE IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1025)
		BEGIN
			SET @ordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ordTotalAmountStr = @ordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			END
			SET @ordTotalAmountStr = @ordTotalAmountStr
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @ordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ordTotalAmountStr = @ordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
			END
			SET @ordTotalAmountStr = REPLACE(@ordTotalAmountStr,'-',' ') 
		END
	END
	/**************************************************/
	/*Update*/
	UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrder]
	SET  [ordItemCount] = ISNULL(@ordItemCount,0)
		,[ordItemsAmount] = ISNULL(@ordItemsAmount,0)
		,[ordSumAmount] = ISNULL(@ordSumAmount,0)
		,[ordTax] = ISNULL(@ordTax,0)
		,[ordTotalAmount] = @ordTotalAmount
		,[ordTotalAmountStr] = @ordTotalAmountStr
		,[ordDiscount] = ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0)
		,[Month1] = @Month1
		/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
		,[ordItemsQty] = ISNULL(@SumQuantity,0)
		,[ordItemsDiscount] = ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)
		,[ordItemsTax] = ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)
		/*RZ14020324- End*/
	WHERE OrderID = @OrderId
	/**/
	IF(@ordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LangId INT
		/**/
		DECLARE Crsr CURSOR FOR
			SELECT LanguageID
			FROM [dbo].[Languages]		
			WHERE LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
			AND ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			While @@Fetch_Status = 0
			BEGIN	 
				DECLARE @ordTotalAmountStrLang NVARCHAR(1000)	
				/*-------------------------------------------*/

					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang /*+ N' —Ì«·'*//*RZ990902- Remove rial in ordTotalAmountStr*/

				ELSE IF(@LangId = 1025)

					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = @ordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
					END							
					SET @ordTotalAmountStrLang = REPLACE(@ordTotalAmountStrLang,'-',' ')
				END

					UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrder_Lang]

					WHERE [WSOrderLangID] = @OrdIdLang						
				END
				ELSE

					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSOrder_Lang]
						([OrderID]
						,[LanguageID]
						,[ordTotalAmountStr])
					VALUES

						,@LangId
						,@ordTotalAmountStrLang)
				END
				/*-------------------------------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @LangId
			END
		CLOSE Crsr
		DEALLOCATE Crsr	
	END							
	/*==================================================*/
	/*================= Update status ==================*/	
	DECLARE @SumOrdPayAmount NUMERIC(18,2)
	SET @SumOrdPayAmount = ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL( SUM(ordpayAmount), 0) sumordpayAmount
									FROM dbo.WSOrderPayments
									WHERE ordpayOrderId = @OrderId
									AND ISNULL(ordpayDeActive,0) = 0/*RZ14020823- Add condition for update ordStatus*/),0)
	/*IF(@SumOrdPayAmount IS NOT NULL AND (@ordStatusId <> 4 AND @ordStatusId <> 5))*/
	IF(ISNULL(@SumOrdPayAmount,0) <> 0 AND (@ordStatusId <> 4 AND @ordStatusId <> 5))/*RZ14000812- Modify condition in check status*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		IF(@SumOrdPayAmount = 0 AND @ordStatusId <>1)
			SET @ordStatusId = 1
		/**/
		ELSE IF(@SumOrdPayAmount < @ordTotalAmount)/*RZ14020807- Change status - <>*/
			SET @ordStatusId = 2
		/**/
		ELSE IF(@SumOrdPayAmount >= @ordTotalAmount)/*RZ14020807- Change status - =*/
			SET @ordStatusId = 3
		/**/	 		
		/**/
		UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrder]
		SET [ordStatusId] = @ordStatusId 
		WHERE [OrderID] = @OrderId
	/**/
	END
	/*==================================================*/
END

/*RZ14030126- Add calculate OrderOtherAmounts*/

/*RZ990901*/
/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/

	exec WSspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmounts 4841,3,1033,1065	
*/

@Month1 SMALLINT,

@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL

AS
BEGIN

EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderItemsTax]
@PreOrderId = @PreOrderId,
@Month1 = @Month1,
@Result = @CalcItemTaxResult OUTPUT	
/*RZ14021030- END*/
/*----------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14010530- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
DECLARE @cuUnitIsDecimal BIT
SET @cuUnitIsDecimal = (SELECT TOP 1 [IsDecimal]
						FROM [dbo].[WSCurrencyUnits] 
						WHERE [CurrencyUnitID] = (SELECT pordCurrencyUnitId 
												  FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] 
												  WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId))
/*RZ14010530- End*/
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*Calculate & Update the order*/	
/**/
/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
DECLARE @SumQuantity FLOAT = NULL,@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@TotalTaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL
/*RZ14020324- End*/
DECLARE @SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2)
SELECT 
	/*@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(/*ROUND(*/
							CAST(SUM(
							 (ISNULL(pordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL(pordIFCR, 1) * ISNULL(pordIFCRI, 1)) 
							 * 
							 (( ISNULL(pordIPrice, 0) - ( ISNULL(pordIDiscount, 0) + ISNULL(pordIDiscountI, 0) + ISNULL(pordIRound, 0))
							 /*ADBF960120*/
							 + ISNULL(pordIRoundPlus, 0)
							 ))	  
	 							+ (ISNULL( pordITax, 0) * ISNULL(pordIQuantity, 0) * ISNULL(pordIFCR, 1) * ISNULL(pordIFCRI, 1))
							) AS NUMERIC(18,2))
							/*, 0)*/,0)*/
	/*RZ991008- Modify SumPriceAmount*/
	@SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(CAST(SUM(ISNULL([pordIPriceSum],0) + ISNULL([pordITaxSum],0)) AS NUMERIC(18,2)),0)
	/*RZ991008- End*/	
	/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
	,@SumQuantity = SUM(pordIQuantity)
	,@TotalDiscountSum = SUM(pordIDiscountSum)
	,@TotalTaxSum = SUM(pordITaxSum)
	/*RZ14020324- End*/	
FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems
WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderId
AND ISNULL(pordINotInSum, 0) = 0
/**/
IF(@SumPriceAmount IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
	/**/
	DECLARE @pordItemCount  INT, @pordItemsAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordInstallAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@pordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordSumAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@pordTax NUMERIC(18,2),@pordTaxIndex NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordCalculateTax BIT,@pordTotalAmount NUMERIC(18,2),@pordTransportation NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),@pordRound NUMERIC(18,2),
	@pordTotalAmountStr NVARCHAR(1000)	
	/**/			
	SELECT 
       @pordInstallAmount =[pordInstallAmount],
       @pordDiscount = [pordDiscount],
       @pordTaxIndex = [pordTaxIndex],
       @pordCalculateTax = [pordCalculateTax],
       @pordDiscountPercent = [pordDiscountPercent],
       @pordTransportation = [pordTransportation],
       @pordRound = [pordRound]      
	FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO
	WHERE PO.[PreOrderID] = @PreOrderId
	/**/
	SET @pordItemsAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)
	IF(@pordDiscountPercent IS NOT NULL AND @pordDiscountPercent > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @pordDiscount = (ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordDiscountPercent,0)) / 100
	END
	/**/
	SET @pordSumAmount = ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) + ISNULL(@pordInstallAmount,0) - ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0)
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@pordCalculateTax,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTax = ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0) * ISNULL(@pordTaxIndex,0) / 100
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @pordTax = 0
	END
	/**/
	SET @pordTotalAmount = ISNULL(ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0) + ISNULL(@pordTax,0) + ISNULL(@pordTransportation,0) - ISNULL(@pordRound,0),0)
	/**/
	SET @pordItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] POI WHERE POI.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14010530- Add Check IsDecimal in CurrencyUnit*/
	IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
	BEGIN	
		/*RZ14020626-Change Ceiling to Round*/
		SET @pordItemsAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordItemsAmount))					
		SET @pordSumAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordSumAmount))		
		SET @pordTax = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTax))		
		SET @pordTotalAmount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordTotalAmount))		
		SET @pordDiscount = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@pordDiscount))	
		
		/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/	
		SET @TotalDiscountSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)))	
		SET @TotalTaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)))	
		/*RZ14020324- End*/
		/*RZ14020626- End*/
	END
	/*RZ14010530- End*/
	
	/*************** ToTalAmountStr *******************/
	DECLARE @TotalAmoutI NVARCHAR(MAX),@TotalAmoutII NVARCHAR(MAX)
	IF(@pordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN			
		SET @TotalAmoutI = SUBSTRING(CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), 1, CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))-1)                                    
		SET @TotalAmoutII = SUBSTRING(CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@pordTotalAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)))+1, 2)
		/**/
		IF(@DefaultLanguageID = 1065)
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			END
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr /*+ N' —Ì«·'*/
		END

			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
			END
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
			IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @pordTotalAmountStr = @pordTotalAmountStr + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
			END
			SET @pordTotalAmountStr = REPLACE(@pordTotalAmountStr,'-',' ') 
		END
	END
	/**************************************************/
	/*Update*/
	UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
	SET  [pordItemCount] = ISNULL(@pordItemCount,0)
		,[pordItemsAmount] = ISNULL(@pordItemsAmount,0)
		,[pordSumAmount] = ISNULL(@pordSumAmount,0)
		,[pordTax] = ISNULL(@pordTax,0)
		,[pordTotalAmount] = @pordTotalAmount
		,[pordTotalAmountStr] = @pordTotalAmountStr
		,[pordDiscount] = ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0)
		,[Month1] = @Month1 
		/*RZ14020324- Add ItemsQty and ItemsDiscount and ItemsTax*/
		,[pordItemsQty] = ISNULL(@SumQuantity,0)
		,[pordItemsDiscount] = ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0)
		,[pordItemsTax] = ISNULL(@TotalTaxSum,0)
		/*RZ14020324- End*/
	WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrderId
	/**/
	IF(@pordTotalAmount IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LangId INT
		/**/
		DECLARE Crsr CURSOR FOR
			SELECT LanguageID
			FROM [dbo].[Languages]		
			WHERE LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
			AND ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
		/**/

						SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToFaWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang /*+ N' —Ì«·'*/

				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToArWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS NUMERIC(38,0)))),'')
					END
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutI AS BIGINT))),'')
					IF(@TotalAmoutII IS NOT NULL AND CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS INT) > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = @pordTotalAmountStrLang + '.' + ISNULL((SELECT [dbo].[fnNumberToEnWords](CAST(@TotalAmoutII AS BIGINT))),'')
					END							
					SET @pordTotalAmountStrLang = REPLACE(@pordTotalAmountStrLang,'-',' ')

					WHERE [WSPreOrderLangID] = @PreOrdIdLang						
				END
				ELSE

					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrder_Lang]
						([PreOrderID]
						,[LanguageID]
						,[pordTotalAmountStr])
					VALUES
						(@PreOrderId
						,@LangId

	END							
	
END		
/*==================================================*/	
/*RZ14030301- Clac and update Amount in currencyI*/
EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmountsCurrency]	
@PreOrderId = @PreOrderId,

Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateStockSupplyFields]
/*

*/
(

@Month1 SMALLINT,

)
As
BEGIN
/**/
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*----------------------------------------------*/

	@stsupItemsQty = (SUM(ISNULL([stsupIQuantity],0))) 				
FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems] 
WHERE [StockSupplyId] = @StockSupplyId
/*----------------------------------------------*/
SET @stsupItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems]  WHERE [StockSupplyId] = @StockSupplyId)
/*----------------------------------------------*/
UPDATE [dbo].[WSStockSupply]
SET	[stsupItemsQty] = @stsupItemsQty
	,[stsupItemCount] = @stsupItemCount
	,[Month1] = @Month1
WHERE [StockSupplyId] = @StockSupplyId
/*----------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END
