		/*------------------ Variables --------------------*/
		DECLARE @bordpayImportDate NVARCHAR(8),
		@bordpayImportDateTime DATETIME,@bordpayTypeId INT,
		@bordpayAmount NUMERIC(18, 2),@OrdPay NVARCHAR(MAX)		
		/*-------------------------------------------------*/
		BEGIN TRAN
			DECLARE CrsrPay CURSOR LOCAL FOR 		
				SELECT 
				(STUFF((SELECT '|' + CAST(PJIN.[Name] AS NVARCHAR(max)) + '=' + CAST(PJIN.[StringValue] AS NVARCHAR(max))							
									FROM [dbo].[fnParseJSON](@BuyOrderPaymentJson) PJIN
									WHERE PJIN.[Parent_ID] =PJ.[SequenceNO]
									FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value(N'(./text())[1]', N'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '')) 
				FROM [dbo].[fnParseJSON](@BuyOrderPaymentJson) PJ
				WHERE PJ.[ValueType] = 'object'
			OPEN CrsrPay
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPay INTO @OrdPay
			/**/
			WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
			BEGIN		
			/**/
				DECLARE @InsertedBordPayId INT = NULL
				/**/				
				SET @bordpayImportDate = NULL
				SET @bordpayImportDateTime = NULL
				SET @bordpayTypeId = NULL
				SET @bordpayAmount = NULL
				/**/
				IF(ISNULL(@OrdPay,'') <> '')
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @OrdPay = @OrdPay + '|'/*for last field*/
					DECLARE @PayField NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
					WHILE LEN(@OrdPay) > 0
					BEGIN
						IF(PATINDEX('%|%',@OrdPay) > 0)
						BEGIN
							SET @PayField = SUBSTRING(@OrdPay, 0, PATINDEX('%|%', @OrdPay))						
							/**/
							DECLARE @PayFieldValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
							DECLARE @PayFieldName NVARCHAR(200)
							SET @PayFieldName = SUBSTRING(@PayField, 1, CHARINDEX('=',@PayField)-1)                                    
							SET @PayFieldValue = SUBSTRING(@PayField, CHARINDEX('=', @PayField)+1, Len(@PayField))
							/**/
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'bordpayTypeId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @bordpayTypeId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'bordpayImportDateTime'
							BEGIN						
								SELECT @bordpayImportDateTime = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS DATETIME) END
								/**/
								IF(@bordpayImportDateTime IS NULL)
									SET @bordpayImportDateTime = @RegisterDate							
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'bordpayImportDate'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @bordpayImportDate = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'')  = '' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE @PayFieldValue END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @PayFieldName = 'bordpayAmount'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @bordpayAmount = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PayFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@PayFieldValue AS NUMERIC(18,2)) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/																				
							/*--------------------------*/
							SET @OrdPay = SUBSTRING(@OrdPay,
									  LEN(@PayField + '|') + 1,
									  LEN(@OrdPay))
							/*--------------------------*/								
							/*--------------------------*/
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @PayField = @OrdPay
							SET @OrdPay = NULL						
						END
					END
					/**/	
					/**********************************************************/					
					IF(@bordpayImportDateTime IS NULL)
						SET @bordpayImportDateTime = @RegisterDate
					/**/
					IF(@bordpayImportDateTime IS NOT NULL AND @bordpayImportDate IS NULL)
					BEGIN
						SET @bordpayImportDate = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithOutSlash](CAST(@bordpayImportDateTime AS DATE)))						
					END
					/*========================================================*/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSBuyOrderPayments]
						([ImportDate]
						,[bordpayTypeId]
						,[bordpayOrderId]
						,[bordpayAmount]
						,[bordpayDocDate]
						,[bordpayFirstRegisterUserId]
						,[bordpayFirstRegisteDatePersian]
						,[bordpayFirstRegisteDate]
						,[UserId]
						,[FPId]
						,[Month1]
						,[RegisterDate]
						,[RegisterDatePersian]
						,[ImportDateTime]
						,[bordpayDocDateTime]
						,[AppType]
						,[bordpayDocAmount]
						,[LanguageID]
						,[FirstRegisterUserId]
						,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
						,[FirstRegisterDate])
					VALUES
						(@bordpayImportDate
						,@bordpayTypeId
						,@InsertedBordId
						,@bordpayAmount
						,@bordpayImportDate
						,@UserId
						,@RegisterDatePersian
						,@RegisterDate
						,@UserId
						,@FPId
						,@Month1
						,@RegisterDate
						,@RegisterDatePersian
						,@bordpayImportDateTime
						,@bordpayImportDateTime
						,@AppType
						,@bordpayAmount
						,@LanguageID
						,@UserId
						,@RegisterDatePersian
						,@RegisterDate)
					SET @InsertedBordPayId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()			
					/*Insert records in lang table*/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSBuyOrderPayments_Lang]
						([BuyOrderPaymentId]
						,[LanguageID])
					SELECT
						 @InsertedBordPayId
						,[LanguageID]				
					FROM [dbo].[Languages]
					WHERE ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
					AND [LanguageID] <> @LanguageID					
					/*========================================================*/		
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPay INTO @OrdPay
			END
			/**/
			CLOSE CrsrPay
			DEALLOCATE CrsrPay
			/**/
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN SET @ErrorMessage='Error In Insert BuyOrderPayments' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 
		/*------------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END
	/*=========================== Calculate BuyOrder ====================*/		
	EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateBuyOrderAmounts] @InsertedBordId, @Month1, @LanguageID, @LanguageID
	/*RZ991210- Change sp*/
	DECLARE @SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL, @bordTotalAmount NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL
	SELECT  @SumPriceAmount = ISNULL(CAST(SUM(ISNULL([bordICostSum],0)  + ISNULL([bordITaxSum],0)) AS NUMERIC(18,2)),0)		
	FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems]
	WHERE BuyOrderId = @InsertedBordId
	AND ISNULL(bordINotInSum, 0) = 0
	IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT TOP 1
			@bordTotalAmount = [bordTotalAmount]      
		FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrder]
		WHERE [BuyOrderID] = @InsertedBordId
		/**/
		IF(ISNULL(@bordTotalAmount,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@bordFacilityCostPercent,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @bordFacilityCost = (@SumPriceAmount * @bordFacilityCostPercent) / 100;
			/**/
			END

			SET @bordTotalFinalCost = ISNULL(@bordTotalAmount,0) + ISNULL(@bordFacilityCost,0) 
									+ ISNULL(@bordFinalFreightCost,0) + ISNULL(@bordFinalCustomsFee,0) 
									+ ISNULL(@bordFinalCommission,0)
									
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSBuyOrder]		
			SET bordTotalFinalCost = @bordTotalFinalCost,
				bordFacilityCost = @bordFacilityCost
			WHERE [BuyOrderID] = @InsertedBordId
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ991211- End*/				
	/*=========================================================================*/		
	IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') = '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SET @InsertedId = @InsertedBordId
		SET @InsertedNumber = @bordNumber
		SELECT 1					
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
		SET @InsertedId = 0
		SET @InsertedNumber = 0				 
		SELECT 0			
	/**/
	END	
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	/*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
    SET @InsertedId = 0
	SET @InsertedNumber = 0		
	SELECT 0	 
END CATCH  	

/**/
END








GO

		/*--------------------------------------------*/

		/*---------------------------------------------*/

												,@stsupIPrdColorId,@stsupIPrdNickname,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr

		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN

							FROM OPENJSON(ISNULL(@StsupItemList ,'[]'))

								[Id] INT '$.Id',
								[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
							) AS JS

			IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) <= 0)

				FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrStsupBordItem INTO	 @StockSupplyItemId,@stsupIPrdId,@stsupIQuantity
												,@stsupIDescription,@stsupIQuantityDesc,@stsupIPrdUnitId

												,@stsupITracing,@stsupIPrdUnitIdI,@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@stsupIPrdColorId,@stsupIPrdNickname,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr	
												,@stsupIBuyOrderIds,@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds
				CONTINUE
			/**/
			END
			ELSE /*IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) > 0)*/
			BEGIN
			/**/					
				SET @stsupIQuantity = @CurrQty
			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/								
			SET @PrdUnitIRate = NULL
			SET @PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = NULL
			SET @PrdQtyNoFCR = NULL

			FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]
			WHERE ProductId = @stsupIPrdId

			SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@stsupIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@stsupIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@stsupIFCRI,1)
			IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@stsupIQuantity,1) 					
			/**/

			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*-----------------------------------------------------*/														    				 					
		/**/	
		FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrStsupBordItem INTO	 @StockSupplyItemId,@stsupIPrdId,@stsupIQuantity

		/*--------------------------------------------*/

		BEGIN 
			SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSBuyOrderItems'

	/**/
	END		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*--------------------------------------------*/		 
	/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END		
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@FinalResult,0) = 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)

	END

		SET @FinalResult = 1	
	/**/
	END	
/**/
END
ELSE
BEGIN
/**/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueBordFromStsup	
/**/
END
/*--------------------------------------------*/
SELECT @FinalResult AS 'Result'
/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/

					,[bordSubject]
					,[bordNote]
					,[bordDeliveryTerm])
				SELECT
					@BuyOrderId
					,[LanguageID]
					,[Title]
					,[Subject]						
					,[Note]						
					,[DeliveryTerm]
				FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderDefaultSetting_Lang] BS
				WHERE [BuyOrderDefaultSettingId] = @bordDefaultSettingId
				AND LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID				
			/**/
			END
			ELSE IF(ISNULL(@bordDefaultSettingId,0) = 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSBuyOrder_Lang]
					([BuyOrderID]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[bordNote])
				SELECT
					@BuyOrderId
					,[LanguageID]
					,NULL
				FROM [dbo].[Languages] L
				WHERE ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
				AND LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID				
			/**/
			END
			/*-------------------------------------------------*/
		/**/
		END
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*------------------- tran1 ------------------------*/
	IF (@@ERROR > 0)
	BEGIN 
		SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSBuyOrder' 
		SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
	ROLLBACK TRAN 
	END		
	ELSE 
	COMMIT TRAN 
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	SET @InsertedBuyOrderId = @BuyOrderId
	/*------------------- tran2 --------------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL(@BuyOrderId,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		DECLARE @StockSupplyItemId INT = NULL,@stsupIPrdId INT = NULL,
		@stsupIQuantity FLOAT = NULL,@stsupIDescription NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
		@stsupIQuantityDesc NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL,@stsupIPrdUnitId INT = NULL,
		@stsupIFCR FLOAT = NULL,@stsupIFCRI FLOAT = NULL,@stsupIWHId INT = NULL,
		@stsupITracing NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,@stsupIPrdUnitIdI INT = NULL,
		@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult FLOAT = NULL,@stsupIPrdColorId INT = NULL,
		@stsupIPrdNickname NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
		@TmpI FLOAT = NULL, @PrdUnitIRate FLOAT = NULL,@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto BIT = NULL,@PrdQtyNoFCR BIT = NULL,@PrdUnitIRateResult FLOAT = NULL,
		@stsupIBuyOrderIds NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL,@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		/*------------------- tran2 --------------------------*/
		BEGIN TRAN
		/*---------------------------------------------*/
		DECLARE CrsrStsupBordItem CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		/**/
			SELECT 
				 [StockSupplyItemId]					
				,[stsupIPrdId]
				,[stsupIQuantity]
				,[stsupIDescription]
				,[stsupIQuantityDesc]
				,[stsupIPrdUnitId]
				,[stsupIFCR]
				,[stsupIFCRI]
				,[stsupIWHId]
				,[stsupITracing]
				,[stsupIPrdUnitIdI]
				,[stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult]
				,[stsupIPrdColorId]
				,[stsupIPrdNickname]					
				,[stsupILinkAccWHIdStr]	
				,[stsupIBuyOrderIds]
				,[stsupIBuyOrderItemIds]
			FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems] STI
			WHERE StockSupplyItemId IN(SELECT [Id]
									FROM OPENJSON(@StsupItemList )
									WITH (
									[Id] INT '$.Id',
									[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
									) AS JS	
								)					
			AND stsupIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
									FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
									WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )				
			ORDER BY (SELECT TOP(1) [stsupDateTime] FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] ST WHERE ST.StockSupplyId = STI.StockSupplyId) DESC, 
					(SELECT TOP(1) [stsupNumber] FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] ST WHERE ST.StockSupplyId = STI.StockSupplyId)  DESC,
					[stsupIPrdId]

		/**/
		OPEN CrsrStsupBordItem
		FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrStsupBordItem INTO	 @StockSupplyItemId,@stsupIPrdId,@stsupIQuantity
												,@stsupIDescription,@stsupIQuantityDesc,@stsupIPrdUnitId
												,@stsupIFCR,@stsupIFCRI,@stsupIWHId
												,@stsupITracing,@stsupIPrdUnitIdI,@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@stsupIPrdColorId,@stsupIPrdNickname,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr	
												,@stsupIBuyOrderIds,@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------- WSBuyOrderItems ------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/

			DECLARE @CurrQty FLOAT = NULL
			SET @CurrQty = (SELECT TOP(1) [Value]
							FROM OPENJSON(ISNULL(@StsupItemList ,'[]'))
							WITH (
								[Id] INT '$.Id',
								[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
							) AS JS	
							WHERE [Id] = @StockSupplyItemId)
			IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) <= 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/	
				FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrStsupBordItem INTO	 @StockSupplyItemId,@stsupIPrdId,@stsupIQuantity
												,@stsupIDescription,@stsupIQuantityDesc,@stsupIPrdUnitId
												,@stsupIFCR,@stsupIFCRI,@stsupIWHId
												,@stsupITracing,@stsupIPrdUnitIdI,@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@stsupIPrdColorId,@stsupIPrdNickname,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr	
												,@stsupIBuyOrderIds,@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds
				CONTINUE
			/**/
			END
			ELSE /*IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) > 0)*/
			BEGIN
			/**/					
				SET @stsupIQuantity = @CurrQty
			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/								
			SET @PrdUnitIRate = NULL
			SET @PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = NULL
			SET @PrdQtyNoFCR = NULL	
			SET @TmpI = NULL
			/*--------------*/			
			SELECT 				
				@PrdUnitIRate = [PrdUnitIRate],
				@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = [PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto],
				@PrdQtyNoFCR = [PrdQtyNoFCR]				
			FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]
			WHERE ProductId = @stsupIPrdId
			/*--------------*/
			SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@stsupIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@stsupIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@stsupIFCRI,1)
			IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@stsupIQuantity,1) 					
			/**/
			END
			/*----------------------------------------------------*/
			IF(/*ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto,0) = 1 AND*/ ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/				
				SET @stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@stsupIQuantity,1)

				IF(ISNULL(@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult = CAST((FORMAT(@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult, '000.000')) AS FLOAT) 
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			END	
			/*----------------------------------------------------*/
			/*RZ14021124- Add price*/
			DECLARE @bordICost NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@bordITotalCost NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,
			@bordITax NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@bordICostSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@bordITaxSum NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL,@bordIPrdCostGroupID INT = NULL
			/**/					
			SELECT TOP(1) 
				@bordICost = [Cost],
				@bordIPrdCostGroupID = [CostGroupId]
			FROM OPENJSON(ISNULL(@StsupItemList ,'[]'))
			WITH (
				[Id] INT '$.Id',
				[Cost] NUMERIC(18,2) '$.Cost',
				[CostGroupId] INT '$.CostGroupId'	
			) AS JS	
			WHERE [Id] = @StockSupplyItemId

			IF(ISNULL(@bordIPrdCostGroupID,0) = 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @bordIPrdCostGroupID = @PrdCostGroupID
			/**/
			END
			/*-------------*/
			SET @bordICostSum = ISNULL(@bordICost,0) * ISNULL(@TmpI,0)
			IF(ISNULL(@CalculateTaxItem,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				IF(ISNULL(@TaxIndexItem,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@bordICostSum,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@TmpI,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @bordITaxSum = (ISNULL(@bordICostSum,0) * ISNULL(@TaxIndexItem,0))/100
					SET @bordITax = ISNULL(@bordITaxSum,0) / ISNULL(@TmpI,0)
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			END	
			ELSE IF(ISNULL(@CalculateTaxItem,0) = 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @TaxIndexItem = NULL
			/**/
			END	
			SET @bordITotalCost = ISNULL(@bordICostSum,0) + ISNULL(@bordITaxSum,0)
			/*--------- Calculate item by currency unit ------*/
			IF(ISNULL(@cuUnitIsDecimal,0) = 0)
			BEGIN				
				SET @bordICost = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@bordICost))
				SET @bordITotalCost = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@bordITotalCost))			
				SET @bordITax = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@bordITax))
				SET @bordICostSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@bordICostSum))
				SET @bordITaxSum = (SELECT [dbo].[fnRoundNumberCalculation](@bordITaxSum))
			END
			/*RZ14021124- End*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
			DECLARE @BuyOrderItemId INT = 0,@bordIOrderView INT = 0,@ItemCount INT = NULL
			SET @ItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems] BOI WHERE BOI.BuyOrderId = @BuyOrderId)
			SET @bordIOrderView = (@ItemCount + 1) + (@ItemCount * 4 ) - 1
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems]
				([BuyOrderId]
				,[bordIPrdId]
				,[bordIQuantity]
				,[bordICost]
				,[bordITotalCost]
				,[bordIDescription]
				,[UserId]
				,[FPId]
				,[Month1]
				,[RegisterDate]
				,[RegisterDatePersian]
				,[bordIQuantityDesc]
				,[bordIPrdUnitId]
				,[bordICurrencyUnitId]
				,[bordIOrderView]
				,[bordIFCR]
				,[bordITax]
				,[bordITaxIndex]
				,[bordICalculateTax]
				,[bordIFCRI]
				,[bordIWHId]
				,[AppType]
				,[LanguageID]
				,[FirstRegisterUserId]
				,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
				,[FirstRegisterDate]
				,[bordIPrdCostGroupID]
				,[bordITracing]
				,[bordICostSum]
				,[bordITaxSum]					
				,[bordILinkAccWHIdStr]
				,[bordIPrdUnitIdI]
				,[bordIPrdUnitIRateResult]
				,[bordIPrdColorId]
				,[bordIPrdNickname])
			VALUES
				(@BuyOrderId
				,@stsupIPrdId
				,@stsupIQuantity
				,@bordICost/*RZ14021124- Add price*/
				,@bordITotalCost/*RZ14021124- Add price*/
				,@stsupIDescription
				,@UserId
				,@FPId
				,@Month1
				,@RegisterDate
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@stsupIQuantityDesc
				,@stsupIPrdUnitId
				,@bordCurrencyUnitId
				,@bordIOrderView
				,@stsupIFCR
				,@bordITax/*RZ14021124- Add price*/
				,@TaxIndexItem
				,@CalculateTaxItem 
				,@stsupIFCRI
				,@stsupIWHId
				,@AppType
				,@DefaultLanguageID
				,@UserId
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@RegisterDate
				,@bordIPrdCostGroupID
				,@stsupITracing
				,@bordICostSum/*RZ14021124- Add price*/
				,@bordITaxSum	/*RZ14021124- Add price*/				
				,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr
				,@stsupIPrdUnitIdI
				,@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult
				,@stsupIPrdColorId
				,@stsupIPrdNickname)
														   					 				  
			SELECT @BuyOrderItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			IF(ISNULL(@BuyOrderItemId,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems_Lang]
					([BuyOrderItemId]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[bordIDescription]
					,[bordIQuantityDesc]
					,[bordIPrdNickname])

					@BuyOrderItemId
					,STILN.LanguageID

				AND STILN.LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
				/**/
				/*---------------------- Update StocksupplyItem --------*/					
				DECLARE @AddBordId BIT = 1
				IF(ISNULL(@stsupIBuyOrderIds,'') <> '')
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) 
						        FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@stsupIBuyOrderIds,',') 
								WHERE CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) <> 0
								AND CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) = @BuyOrderId),0) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @AddBordId = 0
					END
				/**/
				END
				IF(ISNULL(@AddBordId,0) = 1)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL(@stsupIBuyOrderIds,'') <> '')
					BEGIN
						SET @stsupIBuyOrderIds = @stsupIBuyOrderIds + ','
					END
					SET @stsupIBuyOrderIds =  ISNULL(@stsupIBuyOrderIds,'') + CAST(@BuyOrderId AS NVARCHAR(50))
				/**/
				END
				/*--------*/
				DECLARE @AddBordIId BIT = 1
				IF(ISNULL(@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds,'') <> '')
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) 
						        FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds,',') 
								WHERE CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) <> 0
								AND CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) = @BuyOrderItemId),0) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @AddBordIId = 0
					END
				/**/
				END
				IF(ISNULL(@AddBordIId,0) = 1)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL(@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds,'') <> '')
					BEGIN
						SET @stsupIBuyOrderItemIds = @stsupIBuyOrderItemIds + ','
					END
					SET @stsupIBuyOrderItemIds = ISNULL(@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds,'') + CAST(@BuyOrderItemId AS NVARCHAR(50))
				/**/
				END
				/*--------*/
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems]
				SET [stsupIBuyOrderIds] = @stsupIBuyOrderIds
					,[stsupIBuyOrderItemIds] = @stsupIBuyOrderItemIds
				WHERE StockSupplyItemId = @StockSupplyItemId
				/*----------------------------------------------------------*/
			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*-----------------------------------------------------*/														    				 					
		/**/	
		FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrStsupBordItem INTO	 @StockSupplyItemId,@stsupIPrdId,@stsupIQuantity
												,@stsupIDescription,@stsupIQuantityDesc,@stsupIPrdUnitId
												,@stsupIFCR,@stsupIFCRI,@stsupIWHId
												,@stsupITracing,@stsupIPrdUnitIdI,@stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@stsupIPrdColorId,@stsupIPrdNickname,@stsupILinkAccWHIdStr	
												,@stsupIBuyOrderIds,@stsupIBuyOrderItemIds
		END
		CLOSE CrsrStsupBordItem
		DEALLOCATE CrsrStsupBordItem
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN 
			SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSBuyOrderItems' 
			SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
		ROLLBACK TRAN 
		END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateBuyOrderAmounts]
		@BuyOrderId = @BuyOrderId,
		@Month1 = @Month1,
		@LanguageID = @LanguageID,
		@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID			
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*--------------------------------------------*/		 
	/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END		
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@FinalResult,0) = 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueBordFromStsup	
		SET @InsertedBuyOrderId = 0
		SET @InsertedBordNumber = 0	
		SET @FinalResult = 0	
	/**/
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION MainIssueBordFromStsup
		SET @FinalResult = 1	
	/**/
	END	
/**/
END
ELSE
BEGIN
/**/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueBordFromStsup	
/**/
END
/*--------------------------------------------*/
SELECT @FinalResult AS 'Result'
/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END












GO

																NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)) 
			 OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM([prjDesc])),'') AS NVARCHAR(2000)), 
																NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))
			  = 
			  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(@prjDesc)),'') AS NVARCHAR(2000)), NCHAR(1740),
																NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)) 
			 )
		/**/
		END

		/**/

			SET @ErrorIds = ISNULL(@ErrorIds + ',','') + @ErrorId 				
			SET @CreateErrorMsg = REPLACE((REPLACE(@MsgErrorCheckDuplicatePrjDesc,'{0}',ISNULL(@DupCmpNumber,''))),'{1}',ISNULL(@DupCmpName,''))
			SET @ErrorJson = ISNULL(@ErrorJson + ',','') + REPLACE((REPLACE(@SampleJson,'{0}',@ErrorId)),'{1}',@CreateErrorMsg)			
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END		
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @CrsrBuyOrderItemId INT,@CrsrQuantity FLOAT,@Text NVARCHAR(MAX)
	/**/
	DECLARE CrsrI CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	/**/	
		SELECT SplitData  
		FROM fnSplitString(@BordItemList, '|')
	/**/
	OPEN CrsrI
	FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrI INTO @Text
	WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*================================================================================*/
		DECLARE @Field NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
		SET @CrsrBuyOrderItemId = NULL
		SET @CrsrQuantity = NULL			
		/**/
		/*****************************************************************/
		IF(ISNULL(@Text,'') <> '') 
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*===========================================================*/	
			SET @CrsrBuyOrderItemId = CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Text, 1, CHARINDEX(',',@Text)-1),'0') AS INT)                                    
			SET @CrsrQuantity = CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Text, CHARINDEX(',', @Text)+1, Len(@Text)),'0') AS FLOAT)

			INSERT INTO @TmpTable ([BuyOrderItemId],[Quantity])
			VALUES(@CrsrBuyOrderItemId,@CrsrQuantity)
								
			/*===========================================================*/				
		/**/
		END
		/*================================================================================*/					    				 					
	/**/	
	FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrI INTO @Text
	END
	CLOSE CrsrI
	DEALLOCATE CrsrI

		,@PrdUnitIRate FLOAT = NULL,@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto BIT,@PrdQtyNoFCR BIT  = NULL
		,@TmpI FLOAT = NULL
		/*RZ14010621- End*/
		,@bordIPrdNickname NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
		/*--*/
		DECLARE crsr CURSOR FOR /*For OrderItems*/
		SELECT 	BuyOrderItemID,
			bordIPrdId,
			bordIQuantity,
			bordIDescription
			,bordIFCR,bordIFCRI/*RZ980729- Add FCR,FCRI to docItem */
			,bordITracing/*RZ990318- Add Tracing*/
			,bordIPrdUnitId/*RZ14010425- Add PrdUnitId*/
			,bordIQuantityTotal /*RZ14010524- Add QuantityTotal*/
			/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
			,bordIPrdUnitIdI
			,bordIPrdUnitIRateResult
			/*RZ14010621- End*/
			,bordIPrdNickname /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
		FROM dbo.WSBuyOrderItems
		WHERE BuyOrderId = @BuyOrderId
		AND bordIWHId = @WareHouseId /*RZ14000631- Add the possibility of issuing multiple docs for different warehouses*/
		/*RZ14020606- Not Add Product by prdKind 2*/
		AND bordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
								FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
								WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )
		/*RZ14020606- End*/
		/*--*/
		OPEN crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM crsr INTO @BuyOrderItemID, @bordIPrdId, @bordIQuantity, 
									@bordIDescription,@bordIFCR,@bordIFCRI/*RZ980729- Add FCR,FCRI to docItem */
									,@bordITracing/*RZ990318- Add Tracing*/
									,@bordIPrdUnitId /*RZ14010425- Add PrdUnitId*/
									,@bordIQuantityTotal /*RZ14010524- Add QuantityTotal*/
									,@bordIPrdUnitIdI,@bordIPrdUnitIRateResult/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
									,@bordIPrdNickname /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
		/*--*/
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
		BEGIN
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*------------------------- WSDocItems --------------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*RZ14000631- Add manual quantity for every product in multi draft*/
			IF(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @TmpTable))
			BEGIN

				DECLARE @CurrQty FLOAT = NULL
				SET @CurrQty = (SELECT TOP 1 [Quantity] FROM @TmpTable WHERE BuyOrderItemId = @BuyOrderItemID)
				IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) <= 0)

				/**/	
					FETCH NEXT FROM crsr INTO @BuyOrderItemID, @bordIPrdId, @bordIQuantity,

					IF(ISNULL(@bordIQuantityTotal,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@bordIQuantity,0) <> ISNULL(@CurrQty,0))
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @bordIQuantityTotal = ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) * ISNULL(@bordIFCR,1)
					/**/
					END
					/*RZ14011005- End*/

					SET @bordIQuantity = @CurrQty
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			END
			/*RZ14000631- End*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/			
			/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
			SET @PrdUnitIRate = NULL
			SET @PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = NULL
			SET @PrdQtyNoFCR = NULL	
			SET @TmpI = NULL
			/*--------------*/			
			SELECT 				
				@PrdUnitIRate = [PrdUnitIRate],
				@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = [PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto],
				@PrdQtyNoFCR = [PrdQtyNoFCR]				
			FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]
			WHERE ProductId = @bordIPrdId
			/*--------------*/
			SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@bordIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@bordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@bordIFCRI,1)
			IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@bordIQuantity,1) 					
			/**/
			END
			/*----------------------------------------------------*/
			IF(/*ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto,0) = 1 AND*/ ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@bordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)/*RZ14020904- Calculate RateResult in fiexd PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto*/
			BEGIN
			/**/
				/*SET @bordIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@TmpI,1)*/
				SET @bordIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@bordIQuantity,1)/*RZ14010629- Neutralize PrdQtyNoFCR and FRCS in PrdUnitIRateResult*/

				IF(ISNULL(@bordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @bordIPrdUnitIRateResult = CAST((FORMAT(@bordIPrdUnitIRateResult, '000.000')) AS FLOAT) 
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			END
			/*RZ14010621- End*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
			INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItems (

				WHId,

				,@bordIPrdUnitId /*RZ14010425- Add PrdUnitId*/

				/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
				,@bordIPrdUnitIdI

			Declare @DocItemId INT = NULL
			Select @DocItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			/*RZ960225 for multi language*/
			/*Begin insert records in lang table*/
			INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItems_Lang (

			Declare Crsr_Add_Serial CURSOR LOCAL For
				/*RZ14000631- Insert docItemSerials to number  (@bordIQuantity)*/
				SELECT TOP (CAST(@bordIQuantity AS INT))/*RZ14000631- Add manual quantity for every product in multi doc*/
					BuyOrderItemSerialID,

					InfoVI	
				FROM dbo.WSBuyOrderItemSerials OSI
				WHERE BuyOrderItemID = @BuyOrderItemID	
				/*RZ14000631- Add manual quantity for every product in multi doc*/
				
				AND  (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((OSI.Serial),'') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
									NOT IN(SELECT (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(DIS.Serial AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
											FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS

																FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems]
																WHERE PrdId = @bordIPrdId
																AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																				FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																				WHERE D.BuyOrderId = @BuyOrderID
																				/*AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType = 1)*/)																
																)																
						)
						
				/*RZ14000628- End*/
					
				OPEN Crsr_Add_Serial
				FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO @BuyOrderItemSerialID, @Serial, @StatusId, @bordItemSerialDescription,
														@IsFix, @SerialId, @IsAutoBarcode, @tblTmpBarcodeId, @ExpDate, @ExpDatePersian,

				WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
				BEGIN

					/*RZ14000631- Add rootId and Serial*/

					SET @OprType = (SELECT TOP 1[OprType]
										FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr]  DO

																	(SELECT TOP 1 Opr.DocOprId 
																		FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderOpr] Opr WHERE Opr.BuyOrderOprID = O.BuyOrderOprId) 			 
																	FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrder] O

									)									
					/*check doc type*/
					IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 1)/*Doc*/
					BEGIN
					/**/						
						SET @RootId = 0
						SET @SerialId = NULL
					/**/
					END
					ELSE IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 2 OR  ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 3)/*Draft Or Movement*/
					BEGIN

						/*----------------*/
						SELECT TOP 1 
							 @SerialId = [DocItemSerialID]							
							,@RootId = [RootId]
						FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
						WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemId] 
											FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI
											WHERE DI.DocId IN(SELECT D.DocId
																FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D
																/*WHERE D.BuyOrderId = @BuyOrderID*/
																WHERE D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType IN(1,3))
																AND D.WHId = ISNULL(@WareHouseId,@WHId))
											)
						AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST([Serial] AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,
							NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) = 
							(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@Serial AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,
							NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))							
						SET @RootId = ISNULL(@RootId,0)
						IF(@RootId = 0)
						BEGIN
							SET @RootId = @SerialId
						END							
						/*----------------*/
					/**/
					END						 			
						
					/*RZ14000325- End*/

					INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItemSerials (
						ItemId,
						Serial,

					)

						@Serial,

						@UserId,

						@RootId/*RZ14000631- Add multi doc*/						
					)

					/*Insert records in lang table*/

					(

						,[LanguageID]

					FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO  @BuyOrderItemSerialID, @Serial, @StatusId, @bordItemSerialDescription,
															@IsFix, @SerialId, @IsAutoBarcode, @tblTmpBarcodeId, @ExpDate, @ExpDatePersian,
															@InfoI, @InfoII, @InfoIII, @InfoIV, @InfoV, @InfoVI
				/*---------------------------------------*/
				END
				CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
				DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
				/*----------------- End user cursor for insert serial in doc --------------------------------*/
				/*-------------------------------------- Old version ----------------------------------------*/
				/*

			SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItems'

		ROLLBACK TRAN

	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Wrhs
		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14000631- End*/

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
begin
	RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main

	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main
	Return @DocId

/*--891115921115930994119502*/
/*RZ960225 For multi language*/
/*RZ960829- add length nvarchar to max*/
/*RZ980703- Edit DocDateTime*/
/*RZ980710- Move OrdDescII to Doc*/
/*RZ980729- Add FCR,FCRI to docItem */
/*RZ990318- Add Tracing*/
/*RZ14000226- Add the possibility of issuing multiple docs for different warehouses*/
/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
/*RZ14000628- Add manual quantity for every product in multi draft*/
/*RZ14000908- Remove null in parameters*/
/*RZ14010425- Add PrdUnitId*/
/*RZ14010524- Add QuantityTotal*/
/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
/*RZ14010629- Neutralize PrdQtyNoFCR and FRCS in PrdUnitIRateResult*/
/*RZ14011005- Calculate QuantityTotal*/
/*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
/*RZ14020606- Not Add Product by prdKind 2*/
/*RZ14020904- Calculate RateResult in fiexd PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto*/
/*RZ14021202- Add OrderItemId to WSDocItems*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspIssueDraftFromOrder]	
(		
/*
	declare @InsertedDraftID INT = 0, @InsertedDraftNumber INT = 0
	exec WSspIssueDraftFromOrder  
	@OrderID = 17613,
	@DraftDate = '14000226',
	@UserId  = 3,
	@Month1 = 2,
	@FPId = 30,
	@WHId = 1,
	@RegisterDatePersian = '14000226',
	@AppType = 'dasti',
	@InsertedDraftID = @InsertedDraftID OUTPUT ,
	@InsertedDraftNumber = @InsertedDraftNumber OUTPUT,	
	@LanguageID = 1065,
	@OrdItemList = N'3113,5|3114,3|3115,2|3116,0|3117,4|3118,4|3120,0'
	select @InsertedDraftID,@InsertedDraftNumber
	 
*/
@OrderID INT,
@DraftDate VARCHAR(8),
@UserId INT,
@Month1 INT,
@FPId INT,
@WHId INT,
@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(50),
@InsertedDraftID INT OUTPUT ,
@InsertedDraftNumber INT OUTPUT,
/*ADBF951130*/
@LanguageID INT ,
@OrdItemList NVARCHAR(MAX) /*= NULL*//*RZ14000628- Add manual quantity for every product in multi draft*/ /*RZ14000908- Remove null in parameters*/
)
As
BEGIN
/**/
/*---------------------- Set TmpTabel -------------------------------------*/
/*RZ14000628- Add manual quantity for every product in multi draft*/
DECLARE @TmpTable TABLE (
	[OrderItemId] INT,
	[Quantity] FLOAT
)
IF(ISNULL(@OrdItemList,'') <> '')
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @CrsrOrderItemId INT,@CrsrQuantity FLOAT,@Text NVARCHAR(MAX)
	/**/
	DECLARE CrsrI CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	/**/	
		SELECT SplitData  
		FROM fnSplitString(@OrdItemList, '|')
	/**/
	OPEN CrsrI
	FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrI INTO @Text
	WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*================================================================================*/
		DECLARE @Field NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
		SET @CrsrOrderItemId = NULL
		SET @CrsrQuantity = NULL			
		/**/
		/*****************************************************************/
		IF(ISNULL(@Text,'') <> '') 
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*===========================================================*/	
			SET @CrsrOrderItemId = CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Text, 1, CHARINDEX(',',@Text)-1),'0') AS INT)                                    
			SET @CrsrQuantity = CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Text, CHARINDEX(',', @Text)+1, Len(@Text)),'0') AS FLOAT)

					/*---------------------------------------*/
						/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
						DECLARE @Serial NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,@RootId INT = NULL,@OprType INT = NULL
						/*Find doc type via orderOpr*/
						SET @OprType = (SELECT TOP 1[OprType]
											FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr]  DO
											WHERE DO.[DocOprID]  = ((SELECT  
																		(SELECT TOP 1 Opr.DocOprId 
																			FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr WHERE Opr.OrderOprID = O.OrderOprID) 			 
																		FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																		WHERE OrderId = @OrderId))						
										)
						/*check doc type*/
						IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 1)/*Doc*/
						BEGIN
						/**/
							SELECT TOP 1 
								 @Serial = [Serial]	
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
							WHERE [DocItemSerialID] = @SerialId
							SET @RootId = 0
							SET @SerialId = NULL
						/**/
						END
						ELSE IF(ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 2 OR  ISNULL(@OprType,0) = 3)/*Draft Or Movement*/
						BEGIN
						/**/
							/*----------------*/
							SELECT TOP 1 
								 @Serial = [Serial]							
								,@RootId = [RootId]
							FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials]
							WHERE [DocItemSerialID] = @SerialId
							SET @RootId = ISNULL(@RootId,0)
							IF(@RootId = 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @RootId = @SerialId
							END
							/*ELSE IF(@RootId <> 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @RootId = @RootId
							END*/
							/*----------------*/
						/**/
						END						 			
						
						/*RZ14000325- End*/
						
						INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItemSerials (
							ItemId,
							SerialId,
							[Description],
							WHId,
							UserId,	
							Month1,	
							FPId, 
							RegisterDate, 
							RegisterDatePersian, 
							AppType,
							/*ADBF951130*/
							LanguageID,
							FirstRegisterDatePersian,
							FirstRegisterUserId,
							FirstRegisterDate,
							/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
							[Serial],
							[RootId]
							/*RZ14000325*/)	
						VALUES( 
							@DocItemId,
							@SerialId,
							@ordItemSerialDescription,
							/*@WhID,*/
							ISNULL(@WareHouseId,@WhID),/*RZ14000226- Add the possibility of issuing multiple docs for different warehouses*/
							@UserId, 
							@Month1, 
							@FPId, 
							GETDATE(), 
							@RegisterDatePersian, 
							@AppType,
							/*ADBF951130*/
							@LanguageID,
							@RegisterDatePersian,
							@UserId,
							GETDATE(),
							/*RZ14000325- Add rootId and Serial*/
							@Serial,
							@RootId
							/*RZ14000325*/)
		
						SET @docItemSerialId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
						/*Insert records in lang table*/			
						INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials_Lang]
						(
							[DocItemSerialID]
						   ,[LanguageID]
						   ,[Description]
						)
						SELECT
							@docItemSerialId,
							OISLN.LanguageID,
							OISLN.[Description]
						FROM dbo.WSOrderItemSerials_Lang OISLN 
						WHERE  OISLN.OrderItemSerialID = @OrderItemSerialID
		
						FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add_Serial INTO  @SerialId, @ordItemSerialDescription, @OrderItemSerialID
					/*---------------------------------------*/
					END
					CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
					DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
					/*----------------- End user cursor for insert serial in doc --------------------------------*/				
					/*------------------- tran3 -----------------------*/
					IF (@@ERROR > 0)
					BEGIN 
						SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItemSerial' 
						SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
						/*RZ960225 for multi language*/
						CLOSE Crsr_Add_Serial
						DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add_Serial
					ROLLBACK TRAN 
					END		
					ELSE 
					COMMIT TRAN 
					/*------------------- tran3 -----------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM crsr INTO @OrderItemID, @ordIPrdId, @ordIQuantity, 
										  @ordIDescription,@ordIFCR, @ordIFCRI, /*RZ980729- Add FCR,FCRI to docItem */
										  @ordITracing/*RZ990318- Add Tracing*/
										  ,@ordIPrdUnitId /*RZ14010425- Add PrdUnitId*/
										  ,@ordIQuantityTotal /*RZ14010524- Add QuantityTotal*/
										  ,@ordIPrdUnitIdI,@ordIPrdUnitIRateResult/*RZ14010621- Add PrdUnitIdI*/
										  ,@ordIPrdNickname  /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			END
			/*--*/
			CLOSE crsr
			DEALLOCATE crsr
			/*--*/
			/*------------------- tran2 ----------------------*/
			IF (@@ERROR > 0)
			BEGIN 
				SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItems' 
				SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
			ROLLBACK TRAN 
			END		
			ELSE 
			COMMIT TRAN 
			/*------------------- tran2 ----------------------*/			
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Wrhs INTO @WareHouseId
	END
	CLOSE Crsr_Wrhs
	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Wrhs
		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14000226- End*/

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
begin
	RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
	Set @DraftId = 0
	Return @DraftId
end
ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main
	Return @DraftId
END	
/*--*/
END











GO

							ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)	
							FOR JSON PATH)

	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @PordItemList = (SELECT 
								PreOrderItemID [Id],			
								(ISNULL(pordIQuantity,0) - 
								ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Quantity) 
										FROM dbo.WSDocItems DI
										WHERE DocId IN(SELECT D.DocId 
														 FROM dbo.WSDoc D 
														 WHERE D.PreOrderId = POI.PreOrderId
														 )

										/*RZ14021202- Add PreOrderItemId to WSDocItems*/
										AND DI.PreOrderItemId = POI.PreOrderItemID
										/*RZ14021202- End*/
														 ),0)
	
								) [Value]				
							FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems POI
							WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID	
							/*RZ14020606- Not Add Product by prdKind 2*/
							AND pordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
											  FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
											  WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )
							/*RZ14020606- End*/
							ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)

/**/
END

/*»—«Ì «Ì‰òÂ »—«Ì Ìò ÅÌ‘ ›«ò Ê— »Ì‘ — «“  ⁄œ«œ „Ã«“ »—êÂ «‰»«— ’«œ— ‰‘Êœ  çò »—«”«” „Ã„Ê⁄Â  ⁄œ«œ «ﬁ·«„  «‰Ã«„ „Ì ‘Êœ.
 “Ì—« „Ì  Ê«‰ »—êÂ «‰»«— »«  ⁄œ«œ œ·ŒÊ«Â ò«·« «“ ÅÌ‘  ›«ò Ê— ’«œ— ò—œ.*/
IF(ISNULL((
	ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(pordIQuantity,0))

			),0)
	-
    ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(Quantity,0)) FROM dbo.WSDocItems DI WHERE DI.DocId IN(SELECT D.DocId FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D WHERE D.PreOrderId = @PreOrderId)),0)
	),0) = 0
)
BEGIN
	SELECT -1 AS 'Result'

DECLARE @InsertedOldDraftID INT,@DocId INT,@DocNumber INT,

AND FormActionId = (SELECT Id FROM dbo.CrmsysFormActions WHERE ActionName = N'actMovePordDescriptionIIToDoc'
						AND FormId = (SELECT ID FROM dbo.CrmsysForms WHERE FormName = N'frmIssueDraftFromPreOrder' ))
AND RollId = (SELECT TOP 1 RollId FROM dbo.UsersPermission WHERE UserId = @UserId AND PrjId = 11/*CRM*/))
	SET @actMovePordDescriptionIIToDoc = 1
ELSE
	SET @actMovePordDescriptionIIToDoc = 0
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
SELECT TOP(1)
	@CompanyId = pordCompanyId,
	@CompanyPersonId = pordCompanyPersonId,
	@ProjectId = pordProjectId,
	@Description = (CASE WHEN(@actMovePordDescriptionIIToDoc = 1)
						THEN [pordDescriptionII]
						ELSE NULL
					END),
	@SendAddress = (ISNULL((SELECT City FROM dbo.City WHERE CityID = (SELECT cmpCityId FROM dbo.CrmCompany WHERE CompanyId = pordCompanyId)),'')

					+ ' ' +
					(SELECT cmpAddress FROM dbo.CrmCompany WHERE CompanyId = pordCompanyId))	
FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO
WHERE PO.PreOrderID = @PreOrderId
/*---------------------------------------------------*/

BEGIN TRANSACTION Main
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

							  WITH(

							  ) JS

		/*RZ14020606- Not Add Product by prdKind 2*/

	OPEN Crsr_Wrhs

	WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
	BEGIN		
		SET @DocId = NULL

		/*--------------------------------------------*/

				AND pordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID

			ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)

			OPEN CrsrPordDocItem

												,@pordIPrdUnitId,@pordIFCR,@pordIFCRI,@pordITracing,@pordIQuantityTotal

			WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0

								WITH (
									[Id] INT '$.Id',
									[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
								) AS JS	
								WHERE [Id] = @PreOrderItemID)
				IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) <= 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/	
					FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPordDocItem INTO @PreOrderItemID,@pordIPrdId,@pordIQuantity,@pordIDescription
														,@pordIPrdUnitId,@pordIFCR,@pordIFCRI,@pordITracing,@pordIQuantityTotal
														,@pordIPrdUnitIdI,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult	
														,@pordIPrdNickname /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
					CONTINUE
				/**/
				END
				ELSE /*IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) > 0)*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					IF(ISNULL(@pordIQuantityTotal,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,0) <> ISNULL(@CurrQty,0))
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @pordIQuantityTotal = ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) * ISNULL(@pordIFCR,1)
					/**/
					END
					/**/
					SET @pordIQuantity = @CurrQty
				/**/
				END			
				/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
				SET @PrdUnitIRate = NULL
				SET @PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = NULL
				SET @PrdQtyNoFCR = NULL	
				SET @TmpI = NULL
				/*--------------*/			
				SELECT 				
					@PrdUnitIRate = [PrdUnitIRate],
					@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = [PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto],
					@PrdQtyNoFCR = [PrdQtyNoFCR]				
				FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]
				WHERE ProductId = @pordIPrdId
				/*--------------*/
				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCRI,1)
				IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1) 					
				/**/
				END
				/*----------------------------------------------------*/
				IF(/*ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto,0) = 1 AND*/ ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)/*RZ14020904- Calculate RateResult in fiexd PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto*/
				BEGIN
				/**/				
					SET @pordIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1)

					IF(ISNULL(@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @pordIPrdUnitIRateResult = CAST((FORMAT(@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult, '000.000')) AS FLOAT) 
					/**/
					END
				/**/
				END			
				/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSDocItems]
					([DocId]
					,[PrdId]
					,[Quantity]
					,[Description]
					,[WHId]
					,[UserId]
					,[Month1]
					,[FPId]
					,[RegisterDate]
					,[RegisterDatePersian]
					,[AppType]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[FirstRegisterUserId]
					,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
					,[FirstRegisterDate]
					,[FCR]
					,[FCRI]
					,[Tracing]
					,[PrdUnitId]
					,[QuantityTotal]
					,[PrdUnitIdI]
					,[PrdUnitIRateResult]
					,[PrdNickname] /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
					,[PreOrderItemId]/*RZ14021202- Add PreOrderItemId to WSDocItems*/

					)
				VALUES
					(@DocId
					,@pordIPrdId
					,@pordIQuantity
					,@pordIDescription
					,@WareHouseId
					,@UserId
					,@Month1
					,@FPId
					,@RegisterDate
					,@RegisterDatePersian
					,@AppType
					,@DefaultLanguageID
					,@UserId
					,@RegisterDatePersian
					,@RegisterDate
					,@pordIFCR
					,@pordIFCRI
					,@pordITracing
					,@pordIPrdUnitId
					,@pordIQuantityTotal
					,@pordIPrdUnitIdI
					,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult
					,@pordIPrdNickname /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
					,@PreOrderItemID /*RZ14021202- Add PreOrderItemId to WSDocItems*/
					)

				DECLARE @DocItemId INT = NULL
				SELECT @DocItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				IF(ISNULL(@DocItemId,0) > 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					INSERT INTO dbo.WSDocItems_Lang (
						 [DocItemID]
						,[LanguageID]
						,[Description]	
						,[PrdNickname] /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/
					) 
					SELECT
						@DocItemId,
						POILN.LanguageID,
						POILN.pordIDescription,
						POILN.pordIPrdNickname /*RZ14011021- Add PrdNickname*/

			END

			/*--------------------------------------------*/
			/*--------------------------------------------*/

			BEGIN 
				SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into DocItems' 
				SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR

			END		
			ELSE 
			COMMIT TRAN 
			/*--------------------------------------------*/
		/**/
		END
		
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Wrhs INTO @WareHouseId
	END
	CLOSE Crsr_Wrhs
	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Wrhs
		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main	
	SET @InsertedDocId = 0
	SET @InsertedDocNumber = 0	
	SELECT 0 AS 'Result'
/**/
END
ELSE
BEGIN
/**/
	COMMIT TRANSACTION Main
	SELECT 1 AS 'Result'
/**/
END	
/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END











GO

						   WHERE PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
						   AND DI.BuyOrderItemId = BIS.BuyOrderItemId
						   AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
										  FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
										  WHERE D.BuyOrderId = ' + CAST(@BuyOrderID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ')	
						   AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL(DIS.Serial,'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
							   = (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((BIS.Serial),'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
							)								
	
		) SerialId    
    
	FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItemSerials] BIS 
	WHERE BIS.[BuyOrderItemId] = ' + CAST(@bordItemId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '  
	AND ISNULL(Serial,'''') <> ''''
	AND  (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((BIS.Serial),'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
												IN(SELECT (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL(DIS.Serial,'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
														FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
														WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemID]    
																			FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI
																			WHERE PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
																			AND DI.BuyOrderItemId = BIS.BuyOrderItemId
																			AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																							FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																							WHERE D.BuyOrderId = ' + CAST(@BuyOrderID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
																							/*AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType = 1)*/)																
																			)																
													)
) AS TmpSerial '
						
						SET @Qry = @Qry + ' WHERE ISNULL([SerialId],0) > 0	
						AND ISNULL([SerialId],0) NOT IN(SELECT ISNULL(SerialId,0) 
															FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItemSerials] OIS
															WHERE OIS.OrderItemId IN (SELECT OI.OrderItemId 
																						FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems] OI
																						WHERE OI.OrderId IN (SELECT O.OrderID 
																											FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																											WHERE O.OrderOprID IN (SELECT Opr.OrderOprID     
																																	FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr
																																	WHERE [OprType] = ' + CAST(@OprType AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '))))
						AND ISNULL([SerialId],0) NOT IN(SELECT 
															DIS.[DocItemSerialID]
														FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS 
														INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI ON(DIS.ItemId = DI.DocItemID)
														INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDoc] D ON(DI.DocId = D.DocID)
														WHERE D.WHId = TmpSerial.WHId			
														AND DI.PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
														AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr] WHERE OprType IN(3))	/*IN(1,3)*/							
														AND DIS.DocItemSerialID NOT IN (SELECT ISNULL(SerialId,0) 
																						FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItemSerials] OIS
																						WHERE OIS.OrderItemId IN (SELECT OI.OrderItemId 
																												  FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems] OI
																												  WHERE OI.OrderId IN (SELECT O.OrderID 
																																	   FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																																	   WHERE O.OrderOprID IN (SELECT Opr.OrderOprID     
																																							  FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr
																																							  WHERE [OprType] = ' + CAST(@OprType AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ')))														 
																					)			
														AND DIS.DocItemSerialID NOT IN (SELECT Isnull(DIS_I.SerialId, 0)
																						FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS_I 
																						INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI_I ON(DIS_I.ItemId = DI_I.DocItemID)
																						INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDoc] D_I ON(DI_I.DocId = D_I.DocID)
																						WHERE D_I.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr] WHERE OprType = 3)
																						And DI_I.PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '	 															
																						And D_I.WHIdI = TmpSerial.WHId	 
																						UNION
																						SELECT Isnull(DIS_II.SerialId, 0)
																						FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS_II 
																						INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI_II ON(DIS_II.ItemId = DI_II.DocItemID)
																						INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDoc] D_II ON(DI_II.DocId = D_II.DocID)
																						WHERE D_II.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr] WHERE OprType = 2)
																						And DI_II.PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 																
																						And D_II.WHId = TmpSerial.WHId 
																						)
							)
												'						
					/**/
					END
					ELSE IF(@OprType = 2) /*Return from sale*/
					BEGIN
					/**/
						SET @Qry = N'
							SELECT 
							 [BuyOrderItemSerialID]
							,[Serial]
							,[Description]
							,[WHId]
							,[SerialId]
						FROM(
							SELECT  DISTINCT TOP((CAST(' + CAST(@ordIQuantity AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' AS INT)))
								 [BuyOrderItemSerialID]
								,[Serial]
								,[Description]
								,[WHId]
							   ,(SELECT TOP(1) [DocItemSerialID]
								FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
								WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemID]    
												   FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI
												   WHERE PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
												   AND DI.BuyOrderItemId = BIS.BuyOrderItemId
												   AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																  FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																  WHERE D.BuyOrderId = ' + CAST(@BuyOrderID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' )	
												   AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL(DIS.Serial,'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
													   = (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((BIS.Serial),'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
													)								
	
								) SerialId    
    
							FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItemSerials] BIS 
							WHERE BIS.[BuyOrderItemId] = ' + CAST(@bordItemId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '  
							AND ISNULL(Serial,'''') <> ''''
							AND  (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL((BIS.Serial),'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740))) 
																		IN(SELECT (REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(ISNULL(DIS.Serial,'''') AS NVARCHAR(2000)) ,NCHAR(1740), NCHAR(1610)),NCHAR(1603),NCHAR(1705)),NCHAR(1609),NCHAR(1740)))
																				FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS
																				WHERE [ItemId] IN (SELECT [DocItemID]    
																									FROM [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI
																									WHERE PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
																									AND DI.BuyOrderItemId = BIS.BuyOrderItemId
																									AND [DocId] IN(SELECT D.DocId 
																													FROM [dbo].[WSDoc] D 
																													WHERE D.BuyOrderId = ' + CAST(@BuyOrderID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 
																													/*AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM dbo.WSDocOpr WHERE OprType = 1)*/)																
																									)																
																			)
						) AS TmpSerial ' 
						SET @Qry = @Qry + ' WHERE ISNULL([SerialId],0) > 0	
						AND ISNULL([SerialId],0) NOT IN(SELECT ISNULL(SerialId,0) 
															FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItemSerials] OIS
															WHERE OIS.OrderItemId IN (SELECT OI.OrderItemId 
																						FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems] OI
																						WHERE OI.OrderId IN (SELECT O.OrderID 
																											FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																											WHERE O.OrderOprID IN (SELECT Opr.OrderOprID     
																																	FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr
																																	WHERE [OprType] = ' + CAST(@OprType AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '))))

														DIS.[DocItemSerialID]						
													FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS 
													INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI ON(DIS.ItemId = DI.DocItemID)
													INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDoc] D ON(DI.DocId = D.DocID)
													WHERE 
														D.WHId = TmpSerial.WHId			
														AND DI.PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 			
														AND D.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr] WHERE OprType IN(3))/*IN(1,3)*/
														AND DIS.DocItemSerialID NOT IN (SELECT SerialId
																						FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItemSerials] OIS
																						WHERE OIS.OrderItemId IN (SELECT OI.OrderItemId 
																												  FROM [dbo].[WSOrderItems] OI
																												  WHERE OI.OrderId IN (SELECT O.OrderID 
																																	   FROM [dbo].[WSOrder] O 
																																	   WHERE O.OrderOprID IN (SELECT Opr.OrderOprID     
																																								FROM [dbo].[WSOrderOpr] Opr
																																								WHERE [OprType] = ' + CAST(@OprType AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '))))
			
														AND DIS.DocItemSerialID IN (SELECT Isnull(DIS_I.SerialId, 0)
																					FROM [dbo].[WSDocItemSerials] DIS_I 
																					INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDocItems] DI_I ON(DIS.ItemId = DI.DocItemID)
																					INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSDoc] D_I ON(DI.DocId = D.DocID)
																					WHERE D_I.OprId IN (SELECT DocOprID FROM [dbo].[WSDocOpr] WHERE OprType = 2)
																					AND DI.PrdId = ' + CAST(@ordIPrdId AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' 				
																					AND D.WHId = TmpSerial.WHId	 
																					)
							)
						
						'						
					/**/
					END

					INSERT INTO @Tmp_BordItemSerial ([BuyOrderItemSerialID],[Serial],[Description],[WHId],[SerialId])
					EXECUTE(@Qry)
					/*-------------------------------------------*/

					DECLARE CrsrORDItemSerial CURSOR LOCAL FOR
					/**/	
						SELECT TOP (CAST(@ordIQuantity AS INT))
							 [BuyOrderItemSerialID]
							,[Description]
							,[WHId]
							,[SerialId]
						FROM @Tmp_BordItemSerial
					/**/
					OPEN CrsrORDItemSerial
					FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrORDItemSerial INTO @BuyOrderItemSerialID,@OrdItemSerialDesc,@OrdItemSerialWHId,@DocItemSerialID
					WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
					BEGIN
					/**/
						/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
						SET @OrderItemSerialID = NULL
						INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSOrderItemSerials]
							([OrderItemId]
							,[SerialId]
							,[Description]
							,[UserId]
							,[Month1]
							,[FPId]
							,[RegisterDate]
							,[RegisterDatePersian]							
							,[WHId]
							,[AppType]
							,[LanguageID]
							,[FirstRegisterUserId]
							,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
							,[FirstRegisterDate])
						VALUES
							(@OrderItemId
							,@DocItemSerialID
							,@OrdItemSerialDesc
							,@UserId
							,@Month1
							,@FPId
							,@RegisterDate
							,@RegisterDatePersian
							,@OrdItemSerialWHId
							,@AppType
							,@DefaultLanguageID
							,@UserId
							,@RegisterDatePersian
							,@RegisterDate)
						SET @OrderItemSerialID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
						/*-------------------------------------------*/
						IF(ISNULL(@OrderItemSerialID,0) > 0 )
						BEGIN
						/**/
							INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSOrderItemSerials_Lang]
								([OrderItemSerialID]
								,[LanguageID]
								,[Description])
							SELECT
								 @OrderItemSerialID
								,[LanguageID]
								,[Description]
							FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItemSerials_Lang]
							WHERE BuyOrderItemSerialID = @BuyOrderItemSerialID
							AND LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID							
						/**/
						END
						/*-----------------------------------------------------*/														    				 					
					/**/	
					FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrORDItemSerial INTO @BuyOrderItemSerialID,@OrdItemSerialDesc,@OrdItemSerialWHId,@DocItemSerialID
					END
					CLOSE CrsrORDItemSerial
					DEALLOCATE CrsrORDItemSerial
					/*-------------------------------------------*/
				/**/
				END
				/*-------------------------------------------*/							
				/*-----------------------------------------------------*/														    				 					
			/**/	
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrOrdItem INTO @BordItemId,@ordIQuantity,@ordIPrice,@ordIPrdPriceGroupID
			END
			CLOSE CrsrOrdItem
			DEALLOCATE CrsrOrdItem
		/*------------------- tran2 --------------------*/
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN 
			SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSOrdersItems' 
			SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 	
			SET @InsertedOrderID = 0
			SET @InsertedOrderNumber = 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN 			
		END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		IF(ISNULL(@InsertedOrderID,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateOrderAmounts]
			@OrderId = @InsertedOrderID,
			@Month1 = @Month1,
			@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID,
			@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID						
			/**/
			SELECT 1 AS 'Result'
		/**/
		END		
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END

	/*------------------- tran2 --------------------*/
	/*----------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@FinalResult,0) = 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueOrdFromBord	
		SET @InsertedOrderID = 0
		SET @InsertedOrderNumber = 0
		SET @FinalResult = 0	
	/**/
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION MainIssueOrdFromBord
		IF(ISNULL(@InsertedOrderID,0) = 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @InsertedOrderNumber = 0
		END
		SET @FinalResult = 1	
	/**/
	END	
/**/
END
ELSE
BEGIN
/**/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueOrdFromBord	
/**/
END
/*--------------------------------------------*/
SELECT @FinalResult AS 'Result'
/*--------------------------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @CommFieldName = 'pordCommAmountCurrUnId'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @CommAmountCurrUnId = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@CommFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@CommFieldValue AS INT) END
							END
							/*--------------------------*/
							IF @CommFieldName = 'pordCommAmountCurrencyRate'
							BEGIN
								SELECT @CommAmountCurrencyRate = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@CommFieldValue,'0')  = '0' 
										  THEN NULL 
										  ELSE CAST(@CommFieldValue AS FLOAT) END
							END														
							/*--------------------------*/																				
							/*--------------------------*/
							SET @OrdComm = SUBSTRING(@OrdComm,
									  LEN(@CommField + '|') + 1,
									  LEN(@OrdComm))
							/*--------------------------*/								
							/*--------------------------*/
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @CommField = @OrdComm
							SET @OrdComm = NULL						
						END
					END
					/**/	
					/**********************************************************/					
					IF(@CommDateTime IS NULL)
						SET @CommDateTime = @RegisterDate
					/**/
					IF(@CommDateTime IS NOT NULL AND @CommDatePersian IS NULL)
					BEGIN
						SET @CommDatePersian = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithOutSlash](CAST(@CommDateTime AS DATE)))						
					END
					/*========================================================*/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderCommissions]
						([CommDateTime]
						,[CommDatePersian]
						,[CommPreOrderId]
						,[CommCmpId]
						,[CommUserId]
						,[CommBaseAmount]
						,[CommAmount]
						,[CommAmountCurrUnId]
						,[CommAmountCurrencyRate]
						,[FirstRegisterUserId]
						,[FirstRegisterDate]
						,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
						,[UserId]
						,[Year1]
						,[Month1]
						,[RegisterDate]
						,[RegisterDatePersian]
						,[AppType]
						,[LanguageID])
					VALUES
						(@CommDateTime
						,@CommDatePersian
						,@InsertedPordId
						,@pordCompanyId
						,@CommUserId
						,@CommBaseAmount
						,@CommAmount
						,@CommAmountCurrUnId
						,@CommAmountCurrencyRate
						,@UserId
						,@RegisterDate
						,@RegisterDatePersian
						,@UserId
						,CAST(@FPId AS SMALLINT)
						,@Month1
						,@RegisterDate
						,@RegisterDatePersian
						,@AppType
						,@LanguageID)					
					SET @InsertedPordCommId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()			
					/*Insert records in lang table*/
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSPreOrderCommissions_Lang]
						([PreOrderCommissionId]
						,[LanguageID])
					SELECT
						 @InsertedPordCommId
						,[LanguageID]				
					FROM [dbo].[Languages]
					WHERE ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
					AND [LanguageID] <> @LanguageID					
					/*========================================================*/		
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrComm INTO @OrdComm
			END
			/**/
			CLOSE CrsrComm
			DEALLOCATE CrsrComm
			/**/
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN SET @ErrorMessage+='Error In Insert PreOrderCommissions' SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR ROLLBACK TRAN END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 
		/*------------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END
	/*=========================== Calculate PreOrder ====================*/		
	EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdatePreOrderAmounts] 	@InsertedPordId, @Month1, @LanguageID, @LanguageID
	/*====================== Update CostSheetProject ====================*/
	/*RZ991205- Remove WSCostSheetProjects*/
	/*UPDATE [dbo].[WSCostSheetProjects]
	SET  [ctshPrjCompanyId] = @pordCompanyId
		,[ctshPrjCmpPersonId] = @pordCompanyPersonId
		,[ctshPrjCmpProjectId] = @pordProjectId
	WHERE [CostSheetProjectId] = @CostSheetProjectId
	AND [ctshPrjCompanyId] IS NULL	*/	
	/*=========================================================================*/		
	IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') = '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main 
		SET @InsertedId = @InsertedPordId
		SET @InsertedNumber = @pordNumber
		SELECT 1					
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
		SET @InsertedId = 0
		SET @InsertedNumber = 0				 
		SELECT 0			
	/**/
	END	
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
	/*RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)*/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main
    SET @InsertedId = 0
	SET @InsertedNumber = 0		
	SELECT 0	 
END CATCH  	

/**/
END

/*RZ14020915*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspIssueStockSupplyFromPreOrder]	
(		
/*
	declare @InsertedStockSupplyId INT = 0, @InsertedStsupNumber INT = 0
	exec WSspIssueStockSupplyFromPreOrder  	
	@PreOrderId = 3356,
	@StsupDate = '14020915',
	@StsupDateTime = '2023-12-06',

	@UserId = 3,
	@Month1 = 9,
	@FPId = 30,
	@RegisterDate = '2023-12-06',

	@InsertedStockSupplyId = @InsertedStockSupplyId OUTPUT,

	select @InsertedStockSupplyId,@InsertedStsupNumber
*/
@PreOrderId INT,
@StsupDate NVARCHAR(8),
@StsupDateTime DATETIME,
@PordItemList NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
/**/
@UserId INT,

@FPId INT,
