@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(50),
@LanguageID INT,
@DefaultLanguageID INT,
@InsertedStockSupplyId INT OUTPUT,
@InsertedStsupNumber BIGINT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*---------------------------- Set PordItemList -------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@PordItemList,'') = '')
BEGIN
/**/		
	/*---------------------------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) [StockSupplyId] FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] WHERE [stsupPreOrderId] = @PreOrderID ),0) = 0) /*PreOrder not have any stockSupply*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @PordItemList = (SELECT 
								PreOrderItemID [Id],			
								pordIQuantity [Value]			
							FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems
							WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID								
							AND pordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
											      FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
											      WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )							
							ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)	
							FOR JSON PATH)
	/**/
	END
	ELSE /*IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1) [StockSupplyId] FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] WHERE [stsupPreOrderId] = @PreOrderID ),0) = 0)*/ /*PreOrder have stockSupply*/
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @PordItemList = (SELECT 
								PreOrderItemID [Id],			
								(ISNULL(pordIQuantity,0) - 
								 ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL([stsupIQuantity],0)) 
										FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems] SI
										WHERE SI.stsupIPreOrderId = POI.PreOrderId
										AND SI.stsupIPreOrderItemId = POI.PreOrderItemID										
										AND SI.stsupIPrdId = pordIPrdId
										AND ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(ST.stsupIsCanceled,0) FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] ST WHERE ST.StockSupplyId = SI.StockSupplyId),0) = 0),0)
	
								) [Value]				
							FROM dbo.WSPreOrderItems POI
							WHERE PreOrderId = @PreOrderID								
							AND pordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
											      FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
											      WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )							
							ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)	
							FOR JSON PATH)
	/**/
	END
	/*---------------------------------------*/
/**/
END
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
DECLARE @FinalResult INT = NULL
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/*Check preorder have stockSupply*/
DECLARE @TmpCheckPordHaveStockSupply TABLE(
		[Result] INT
)

INSERT INTO @TmpCheckPordHaveStockSupply ([Result])
EXEC [dbo].[WSspCheckPreOrderHaveStockSupply] @PreOrderId = @PreOrderId

IF(ISNULL((SELECT TOP(1)[Result] FROM @TmpCheckPordHaveStockSupply),0) = 1)
BEGIN
	SET @FinalResult = -1	
END
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
DECLARE @StockSupplyOprId INT,@StockSupplyId INT,@stsupNumber BIGINT,
@stsupVerificationWorkFlowId INT,@stsupVerifierRequestId INT,
@stsupCompanyId INT,@stsupCompanyPersonId INT,@stsupProjectId INT
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
SET @StockSupplyOprId = 1

SELECT TOP (1) 
     @stsupVerifierRequestId = [stsupDefVerifierRequestId]
    ,@stsupVerificationWorkFlowId = [stsupDefVerificationWorkFlowId]
FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting]
/*---------------------*/
SELECT TOP(1)
	@stsupCompanyId = pordCompanyId,
	@stsupCompanyPersonId = pordCompanyPersonId,
	@stsupProjectId = pordProjectId		
FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder] PO
WHERE PO.PreOrderID = @PreOrderId
/*---------------------------------------------------*/
/*--********************MAINTRAN*/
DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT, @ErrorFrom VARCHAR(50)
BEGIN TRANSACTION MainIssueStsupFromPord
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION START ------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
IF(ISNULL(@FinalResult,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@PordItemList,'') <>'')
BEGIN
/**/	
	/*--------------------------------------------*/		
	SET @StockSupplyId = NULL
	SET @InsertedStockSupplyId = NULL
	SET @stsupNumber = NULL
	SET @InsertedStsupNumber = NULL
	/*---------------- StockSupply Number ----------------*/
	SELECT @stsupNumber =  (SELECT [dbo].[WSfnReturnStockSupplyNumber](@StockSupplyOprId))
	SET @InsertedStsupNumber = @stsupNumber
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*--------------------- tran1 ----------------*/
	BEGIN TRAN
	/*--------------------------------------------*/	
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSStockSupply]
			([StockSupplyOprId]
			,[stsupReferUserId]
			,[stsupNumber]
			,[stsupDateTime]
			,[stsupDate]
			,[stsupCompanyId]
			,[stsupCompanyPersonId]
			,[stsupProjectId]
			,[stsupIsFixed]				
			,[stsupVerifierRequestId]				
			,[stsupVerificationWorkFlowId]				
			,[stsupPreOrderId]
			,[FirstRegisterUserId]
			,[FirstRegisterDate]
			,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
			,[UserId]
			,[FPId]
			,[Month1]
			,[RegisterDate]
			,[RegisterDatePersian]				
			,[AppType]
			,[LanguageID])
		VALUES
			(@StockSupplyOprId
			,@UserId
			,@stsupNumber
			,@stsupDateTime
			,@stsupDate
			,@stsupCompanyId
			,@stsupCompanyPersonId
			,@stsupProjectId
			,1 /*stsupIsFixed*/
			,@stsupVerifierRequestId				
			,@stsupVerificationWorkFlowId
			,@PreOrderId
			,@UserId
			,@RegisterDate
			,@RegisterDatePersian
			,@UserId
			,@FPId
			,@Month1
			,@RegisterDate
			,@RegisterDatePersian				
			,@AppType
			,@DefaultLanguageID)
				
		SELECT @StockSupplyId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		IF(ISNULL(@StockSupplyId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*-------------------------------------------------*/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSStockSupply_Lang]
				([StockSupplyId]
				,[LanguageID])
			SELECT
					@StockSupplyId
				,L.LanguageID
			FROM [dbo].[Languages] L
			WHERE ISNULL(IsActive,0) = 1
			AND LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
			/*-------------------------------------------------*/
		/**/
		END
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*------------------- tran1 ------------------------*/
	IF (@@ERROR > 0)
	BEGIN 
		SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSStockSupply' 
		SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
	ROLLBACK TRAN 
	END		
	ELSE 
	COMMIT TRAN 
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	SET @InsertedStockSupplyId = @StockSupplyId
	/*------------------- tran2 --------------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL(@StockSupplyId,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*--------------------------------------------*/			
		DECLARE @PreOrderItemID INT = NULL, @pordIPrdId INT = NULL, @pordIQuantity float = NULL 
		,@pordIDescription NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @pordIWHId INT = NULL
		,@pordIFCR FLOAT = NULL,@pordIFCRI FLOAT = NULL
		,@pordITracing NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@pordIPrdUnitId INT = NULL
		,@pordIQuantityTotal FLOAT = NULL
		,@pordIPrdUnitIdI INT = NULL,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult FLOAT = NULL
		,@PrdUnitIRate FLOAT = NULL,@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto BIT,@PrdQtyNoFCR BIT  = NULL
		, @TmpI FLOAT = NULL
		,@pordIPrdNickname NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL
		,@pordiQuantityDesc NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL
		,@pordIPrdColorId INT = NULL,@pordILinkAccWHIdStr  NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		/*------------------- tran2 --------------------------*/
		BEGIN TRAN
		/*---------------------------------------------*/
		DECLARE CrsrPordStsupItem CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		/**/
			SELECT 
					[PreOrderItemID]
				,[pordIPrdId]
				,[pordIQuantity]
				,[pordIDescription]
				,[pordIPrdUnitId]
				,[pordIFCR]
				,[pordIFCRI]
				,[pordITracing]
				,[pordIQuantityTotal]
				,[pordIPrdUnitIdI]
				,[pordIPrdUnitIRateResult]	
				,[pordIPrdNickname] 
				,[pordiQuantityDesc]
				,[pordIPrdColorId]
				,[pordILinkAccWHIdStr]
				,[pordIWHId]
			FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems]
			WHERE [PreOrderId] = @PreOrderId			
			AND PreOrderItemID IN(SELECT [Id]
									FROM OPENJSON(@PordItemList)
									WITH (
									[Id] INT '$.Id',
									[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
									) AS JS	
								)					
			AND pordIPrdId NOT IN(SELECT ProductID 
									FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] 
									WHERE ISNULL(PrdKind,1) = 2 )				
		ORDER BY ISNULL(pordIOrderView, PreOrderItemID)	
		/**/
		OPEN CrsrPordStsupItem
		FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPordStsupItem INTO	 @PreOrderItemID,@pordIPrdId,@pordIQuantity,@pordIDescription
												,@pordIPrdUnitId,@pordIFCR,@pordIFCRI,@pordITracing,@pordIQuantityTotal
												,@pordIPrdUnitIdI,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@pordIPrdNickname,@pordiQuantityDesc,@pordIPrdColorId,@pordILinkAccWHIdStr,@pordIWHId
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*------------------------- WSStocksupplyItems ------------------------*/
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/

			DECLARE @CurrQty FLOAT = NULL
			SET @CurrQty = (SELECT TOP(1) [Value]
							FROM OPENJSON(ISNULL(@PordItemList,'[]'))
							WITH (
								[Id] INT '$.Id',
								[Value] FLOAT '$.Value'	
							) AS JS	
							WHERE [Id] = @PreOrderItemID)
			IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) <= 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/	
				FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPordStsupItem INTO	 @PreOrderItemID,@pordIPrdId,@pordIQuantity,@pordIDescription
												,@pordIPrdUnitId,@pordIFCR,@pordIFCRI,@pordITracing,@pordIQuantityTotal
												,@pordIPrdUnitIdI,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@pordIPrdNickname,@pordiQuantityDesc,@pordIPrdColorId,@pordILinkAccWHIdStr,@pordIWHId
				CONTINUE
			/**/
			END
			ELSE /*IF(ISNULL(@CurrQty,0) > 0)*/
			BEGIN
			/**/					
				SET @pordIQuantity = @CurrQty
			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
			SET @PrdUnitIRate = NULL
			SET @PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = NULL
			SET @PrdQtyNoFCR = NULL	
			SET @TmpI = NULL
			/*--------------*/			
			SELECT 				
				@PrdUnitIRate = [PrdUnitIRate],
				@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto = [PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto],
				@PrdQtyNoFCR = [PrdQtyNoFCR]				
			FROM [dbo].[WSProducts]
			WHERE ProductId = @pordIPrdId
			/*--------------*/
			SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCR,1) * ISNULL(@pordIFCRI,1)
			IF(ISNULL(@PrdQtyNoFCR,0) = 1)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @TmpI = ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1) 					
			/**/
			END
			/*----------------------------------------------------*/
			IF(/*ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRateCalcAuto,0) = 1 AND*/ ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0) <> 0  AND ISNULL(@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/				
				SET @pordIPrdUnitIRateResult = (1 / ISNULL(@PrdUnitIRate,0)) * ISNULL(@pordIQuantity,1)

				IF(ISNULL(@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult,0) <> 0)
				BEGIN
				/**/
					SET @pordIPrdUnitIRateResult = CAST((FORMAT(@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult, '000.000')) AS FLOAT) 
				/**/
				END
			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
			DECLARE @StockSupplyItemId INT = 0,@stsupIOrderView INT = 0,@ItemCount INT = NULL
			SET @ItemCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems] STI WHERE STI.StockSupplyId = @StockSupplyId)
			SET @stsupIOrderView = (@ItemCount + 1) + (@ItemCount * 4 ) - 1
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------*/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems]
				([StockSupplyId]
				,[stsupIPrdId]
				,[stsupIQuantity]
				,[stsupIDescription]
				,[stsupIQuantityDesc]
				,[stsupIPrdUnitId]
				,[stsupIOrderView]
				,[stsupIFCR]
				,[stsupIFCRI]
				,[stsupIWHId]
				,[stsupITracing]
				,[stsupIPrdUnitIdI]
				,[stsupIPrdUnitIRateResult]
				,[stsupIPrdColorId]
				,[stsupIPrdNickname]
				,[stsupIPreOrderId]
				,[stsupIPreOrderItemId]
				,[stsupILinkAccWHIdStr]
				,[FirstRegisterUserId]
				,[FirstRegisterDate]
				,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
				,[UserId]
				,[FPId]
				,[Month1]
				,[RegisterDate]
				,[RegisterDatePersian]					
				,[AppType]
				,[LanguageID])
			VALUES
				(@StockSupplyId
				,@pordIPrdId
				,@pordIQuantity
				,@pordIDescription
				,@pordIQuantityDesc
				,@pordIPrdUnitId
				,@stsupIOrderView
				,@pordIFCR
				,@pordIFCRI
				,@pordIWHId
				,@pordITracing
				,@pordIPrdUnitIdI
				,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult
				,@pordIPrdColorId
				,@pordIPrdNickname
				,@PreOrderId
				,@PreOrderItemID
				,@pordILinkAccWHIdStr
				,@UserId
				,@RegisterDate
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@UserId
				,@FPId
				,@Month1
				,@RegisterDate
				,@RegisterDatePersian
				,@AppType
				,@DefaultLanguageID)

			SELECT @StockSupplyItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			IF(ISNULL(@StockSupplyItemId,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems_Lang]
					([StockSupplyItemId]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[stsupIDescription]
					,[stsupIQuantityDesc]
					,[stsupIPrdNickname])
				SELECT
					@StockSupplyItemId
					,POILN.LanguageID
					,pordIDescription
					,pordIQuantityDesc
					,pordIPrdNickname
				FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems_Lang] POILN 
				WHERE  POILN.PreOrderItemID = @PreOrderItemID
				AND POILN.LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID
			/**/
			END			
			/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
			/*-----------------------------------------------------*/														    				 					
		/**/	
		FETCH NEXT FROM CrsrPordStsupItem INTO	 @PreOrderItemID,@pordIPrdId,@pordIQuantity,@pordIDescription
												,@pordIPrdUnitId,@pordIFCR,@pordIFCRI,@pordITracing,@pordIQuantityTotal
												,@pordIPrdUnitIdI,@pordIPrdUnitIRateResult
												,@pordIPrdNickname,@pordiQuantityDesc,@pordIPrdColorId,@pordILinkAccWHIdStr,@pordIWHId
		END
		CLOSE CrsrPordStsupItem
		DEALLOCATE CrsrPordStsupItem
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		IF (@@ERROR > 0)
		BEGIN 
			SET @ErrorFrom='Insert Into WSStockSupplyItems' 
			SET @ErrorNumber=@@ERROR 
		ROLLBACK TRAN 
		END		
		ELSE 
		COMMIT TRAN 
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
		EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalcAndUpdateStockSupplyFields]
		@StockSupplyId = @StockSupplyId,
		@Month1 = @Month1,
		@LanguageID = @LanguageID,
		@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID			
		/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/**/
	END		
	/*--------------------------------------------*/
	/*--------------------------------------------*/		 
	/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END		
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*--------------------------- MAIN TRANSACTION END --------------------------*/
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@FinalResult,0) = 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	IF (@ErrorNumber > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		RAISERROR('Error From TransAction %S', 16, 1, @ErrorFrom)
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueStsupFromPord	
		SET @InsertedStockSupplyId = 0
		SET @InsertedStsupNumber = 0	
		SET @FinalResult = 0	
	/**/
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	/**/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION MainIssueStsupFromPord
		SET @FinalResult = 1	
	/**/
	END	
/**/
END
ELSE
BEGIN
/**/
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MainIssueStsupFromPord	
/**/
END
/*--------------------------------------------*/
SELECT @FinalResult AS 'Result'
/*--------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END

Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspOrderCommissionVerifyMulti]			
(
/*

*/	
@OrderCommissionIds NVARCHAR(MAX),
@VerifierUserId INT,
@VerifiedDate DATETIME,
@VerifiedDatePersian VARCHAR(8)
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrderCommissions]
	SET  [CommIsVerified] = 1
		,[CommVerifierUserId] = @VerifierUserId
		,[CommVerifiedDateTime] = @VerifiedDate
		,[CommVerifiedDatePersian] = @VerifiedDatePersian  
	WHERE [OrderCommissionId] IN(SELECT CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) 
								 FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@OrderCommissionIds,',')
								 WHERE CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) <> 0)
	AND ISNULL([CommIsVerified],0) = 0
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[WSspPayExitOrderCommissionManual]








/*RZ981120*/
/*RZ14020119- Add commission to payroll*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspPayExitOrderCommissionManual]			
(
/*
	exec WSspPayExitOrderCommissionManual  175,58,'dasti'
*/	
@OrderCommissionId INT,
@UserId	INT = NULL,
@AppType VARCHAR(20) = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
	/*
	UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrderCommissions]
	SET [CommIsPaid] = 0
       ,[CommIsPaidUserId] = NULL
       ,[CommIsPaidDateTime] = NULL
       ,[CommIsPaidDatePersian] = NULL
	WHERE [OrderCommissionId] = @OrderCommissionId
	*/
	/*RZ14020119- Add commission to payroll*/
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL(@UserId,0) = 0)
		SET @UserId = ( (SELECT TOP 1 [UserID] FROM dbo.Users WHERE @UserId > 0))
	IF(ISNULL(@AppType,'') = '')
		SET @AppType = 'win'
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	BEGIN TRANSACTION Main
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/
	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE @CommAmount NUMERIC(18,2) = 0,
		@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId INT = 0,
		@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleItemValueId  INT = 0
		/**/
		SELECT  TOP(1)
			 @CommAmount = [CommAmount]
			,@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId = [CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId]			
			,@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleItemValueId = [CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleItemValueId]
		FROM [dbo].[WSOrderCommissions]
		WHERE [OrderCommissionId] = @OrderCommissionId
		/**/
		/*Uodate commission*/
		UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrderCommissions]
		SET [CommIsPaid] = 0
		   ,[CommIsPaidUserId] = NULL
		   ,[CommIsPaidDateTime] = NULL
		   ,[CommIsPaidDatePersian] = NULL
		   ,[CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId] = NULL
		   ,[CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleItemValueId] = NULL
		WHERE [OrderCommissionId] = @OrderCommissionId
		/*Update Payrolls*/
		IF(ISNULL(@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleItemValueId,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'',@DefaultLanguageID INT ,
			@RegisterDate DATETIME,	@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(8),@Year1	SMALLINT,@Month1	SMALLINT

			SET @RegisterDate = GETDATE()
			SET @RegisterDatePersian = (SELECT dbo.[fnGregorianToPersianDateWithOutSlash](CAST(@RegisterDate AS DATE)))
			SET @Month1 = CAST(SUBSTRING(@RegisterDatePersian,5,2) AS INT)	
			SET @DefaultLanguageID = (SELECT TOP 1 [DefaultLanguageID] FROM [dbo].[CrmsysSetting])
			SET @Year1 = (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM dbo.WSFinancialPeriod ORDER BY ID DESC)



			UPDATE [dbo].[PayRollUserCycleItemValues]
			SET  [Value] = ISNULL([Value],0) - ISNULL(@CommAmount,0)	
				,[UserId] = @UserId
				,[Year1] = @Year1
				,[Month1] = @Month1
				,[RegisterDate] = @RegisterDate
				,[RegisterDatePersian] = @RegisterDatePersian				
				,[AppType] = @AppType				
			WHERE [PayRollUserCycleItemValueId] = @CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleItemValueId

			/*Calculate PayrollUserCycle*/
			EXEC [dbo].[PayRollspCalculateUserCycleItemValues]
			@CycleId = @CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId,
			@UserId = @UserId,
			@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
			@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
			@Year1 = @Year1,
			@Month1 = @Month1,
			@AppType = @AppType,
			@ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT,
			@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID,
			@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID
		/**/
		END
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/	
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/
		COMMIT TRANSACTION Main		
		/*--------------------------------------------------*/
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH 
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Main			
	END CATCH 
	/*---------------------------------------------------*/	
	/*RZ14020119- END*/
	/*---------------------------------------------*/
	
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[WSspReturnBuyOrderNumRef]





/*RZ991213*/
/*RZ14000115- Remove prjInquiryNumR and add prjNumR,prjNumRef*/
/*RZ14000616- Change cmpName based on cmpKind*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[WSspReturnBuyOrderNumRef]
(	
/* 
	exec WSspReturnBuyOrderNumRef 6156,6891,3,45888,1033,1065	
*/
@BordCompanyId INT,
@BordProjectId INT,
@BordReferUserId INT,
@BordNumber BIGINT,
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL 
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*------------------------ Define variabels -------------------*/
DECLARE 
@ValueForCmpName NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForCmpNameEng NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForCmpNumber NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForCmpCode NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForPrjInquiryNum NVARCHAR(1000),
/*@ValueForPrjInquiryNumR NVARCHAR(1000),*/
/*RZ14000115- Remove prjInquiryNumR and add prjNumR,prjNumRef*/
@ValueForPrjNumR NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForPrjNumRef NVARCHAR(1000),
/*RZ14000115- End*/
@ValueForSysNum NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForSysNumR NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForUserFName NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForUserLName NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForUserFullName NVARCHAR(1000),
@ValueForUserPersCode NVARCHAR(1000),
@bordNumRef NVARCHAR(150),
@bordNumRefFormula NVARCHAR(4000)
/*-----------------------------------------------------------*/
SELECT TOP 1 
    @bordNumRefFormula = [bordNumRefFormula]    
FROM [dbo].[CrmNumRefSetting]
/*------------------ Check prjNumRefFormula -----------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@bordNumRefFormula,'') <> '')
BEGIN
/**/
	/*------------------------ Set variabels -------------------*/
	/*SELECT 
		@ValueForCmpName = cmpName, 
		@ValueForCmpNameEng = cmpNameEng,
		@ValueForCmpNumber = CAST(cmpNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)),
		@ValueForCmpCode = cmpCode			
	FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany] 
	WHERE CompanyID = @BordCompanyId*/

	/*RZ14000616- Change cmpName based on cmpKind*/
	IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			@ValueForCmpName = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(C.[cmpKind],0) = 0
									   THEN ((ISNULL((SELECT CompanyTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyTitle] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTitleID] = C.[cmpTitleId]),'') + ' ' + 
											  ISNULL(C.[cmpName],'')))
									   ELSE	(SELECT ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle] PT WHERE PT.PersonTitleID = CCP.prsTitleId),'')  + ' ' +
													ISNULL(prsFName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(prsLName,'')
											FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
											WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = C.[cmpMainPersonId]		
											)				
								 END), 
			@ValueForCmpNameEng = cmpNameEng,
			@ValueForCmpNumber = CAST(cmpNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)),
			@ValueForCmpCode = cmpCode			
		FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany] C
		WHERE CompanyID = @BordCompanyId
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			@ValueForCmpName = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(C.[cmpKind],0) = 0
									THEN ((ISNULL((SELECT CompanyTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyTitle_Lang] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTitleID] = C.[cmpTitleId] AND CT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'') + ' ' + 
											ISNULL((SELECT CLN.[cmpName] FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany_Lang] CLN WHERE CLN.CompanyID = C.CompanyID AND CLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')))
									ELSE	(SELECT ISNULL((SELECT PersonTitle FROM [dbo].[CrmPersonTitle_Lang] PT WHERE PT.PersonTitleID = CCP.prsTitleId AND PT.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')  + ' ' +
												ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(CCPLN.prsFName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(CCPLN.prsLName,'') FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons_Lang] CCPLN WHERE CCPLN.CompanyPersonID = CCP.CompanyPersonID AND CCPLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')
										FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyPersons] CCP
										WHERE CCP.CompanyPersonID = C.[cmpMainPersonId]		
										)				
								END), 
			@ValueForCmpNameEng = cmpNameEng,
			@ValueForCmpNumber = CAST(cmpNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)),
			@ValueForCmpCode = cmpCode			
		FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany] C
		WHERE CompanyID = @BordCompanyId
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14000616- End*/

	SELECT 
		@ValueForPrjInquiryNum = prjInquiryNum, 
		/*@ValueForPrjInquiryNumR = CAST(prjInquiryNumR AS NVARCHAR(50))	*/
		/*RZ14000115- Remove prjInquiryNumR and add prjNumR,prjNumRef*/
		@ValueForPrjNumR = CAST(prjNumR AS NVARCHAR(50)),			
		@ValueForPrjNumRef = prjNumRef
		/*RZ14000115- End*/
	FROM [dbo].[CrmProjects] 
	WHERE ProjectID = @BordProjectId

	SET @ValueForSysNum = @BordNumber
		
	/*SELECT 
		@ValueForUserFName = [FName],
		@ValueForUserLName = [LName],
		@ValueForUserFullName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([FName],'') + ' ' +  ISNULL([LName],''))),
		@ValueForUserPersCode = [PersCode]    
	FROM [dbo].[Users] U
	WHERE U.[UserId] = @BordReferUserId*/

	/*RZ14000616- Add multiLang*/
	IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			@ValueForUserFName = [FName],
			@ValueForUserLName = [LName],
			@ValueForUserFullName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([FName],'') + ' ' +  ISNULL([LName],''))),
			@ValueForUserPersCode = [PersCode]    
		FROM [dbo].[Users] U
		WHERE U.[UserId] = @BordReferUserId
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			@ValueForUserFName = ISNULL((SELECT [FName] FROM [dbo].[Users_Lang] ULN WHERE ULN.UserId = U.UserId AND ULN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),''),
			@ValueForUserLName = ISNULL((SELECT [LName] FROM [dbo].[Users_Lang] ULN WHERE ULN.UserId = U.UserId AND ULN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),''),
			@ValueForUserFullName =  LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT [FName] FROM [dbo].[Users_Lang] ULN WHERE ULN.UserId = U.UserId AND ULN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'') 
								  + ' ' 
								  +  ISNULL((SELECT [LName] FROM [dbo].[Users_Lang] ULN WHERE ULN.UserId = U.UserId AND ULN.LanguageID = @LanguageID),''))),
			@ValueForUserPersCode = [PersCode]    
		FROM [dbo].[Users] U
		WHERE U.[UserId] = @BordReferUserId
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14000616- End*/	
	/*------------------------ Set NumRef ---------------------*/
	SET @bordNumRef = @bordNumRefFormula
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#CmpName#]', ISNULL(@ValueForCmpName, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#CmpNameEng#]', ISNULL(@ValueForCmpNameEng, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#CmpNumber#]', ISNULL(@ValueForCmpNumber, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#CmpCode#]', ISNULL(@ValueForCmpCode, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#SysNum#]', ISNULL(@ValueForSysNum, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#SysNumR#]', ISNULL(@ValueForSysNumR, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#PrjInquiryNum#]', ISNULL(@ValueForPrjInquiryNum, '') )
	/*SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#PrjInquiryNumR#]', ISNULL(@ValueForPrjInquiryNumR, '') )*/
	/*RZ14000115- Remove prjInquiryNumR and add prjNumR,prjNumRef*/
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#PrjNumR#]', ISNULL(@ValueForPrjNumR, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#PrjNumRef#]', ISNULL(@ValueForPrjNumRef, '') )
	/*RZ14000115- End*/	
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#UserFName#]', ISNULL(@ValueForUserFName, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#UserLName#]', ISNULL(@ValueForUserLName, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#UserFullName#]', ISNULL(@ValueForUserFullName, '') )
	SET @bordNumRef = REPLACE(@bordNumRef, N'[#UserPersCode#]', ISNULL(@ValueForUserPersCode, '') )	
/**/
END
/**/
SELECT @bordNumRef [bordNumRef]
/**/
END

	@UserId INT,

	@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL 
)

BEGIN
	/**/

	BEGIN

			/** */		
			 [OrderSettingID]
			,[Title]
			,[Subject]
			,[GuarantyId]
			,[TaxIndex]
			,[CalculateTax]
			,[SpecialWord]
			,[DescriptionI]
			,[DescriptionII]

			,[AccountShabaNumberII]

			,(SELECT P.OprType FROM WSOrderOpr P WHERE P.OrderOprID = ODS.OrderOprID) AS OprType
			,[AutoGenerateOrdSerial]
			,[AppType]

		,(SELECT TOP (1) [PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix] FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] PLN WHERE PLN.[ProductID] = P.[ProductID] AND PLN.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdOrdIssuePrjPostFix]
		,[PrdOrdIssuePrjCnvsStatusGroupId]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [ConversationStatusGroup] FROM [dbo].[CrmConversationStatusGroups_Lang] CSG WHERE CSG.[ConversationStatusGroupID] = [PrdOrdIssuePrjCnvsStatusGroupId] AND CSG.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [PrdOrdIssuePrjCnvsStatusGroup]
		,[PrdOrdIssuePrjRemindDay]

		,[PrdOrdIssueUpdateCmpTypeId]
		,(SELECT TOP (1) [CompanyTypeName] FROM [dbo].[CrmCompanyType_Lang] CT WHERE CT.[CompanyTypeID] = [PrdOrdIssueUpdateCmpTypeId] AND CT.LanguageID = @LanguageID)[PrdOrdIssueUpdateCmpType]

/*RZ14020921*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[WSspSelectStockSupplyCanceledByItemIds]
( 
/*
	exec WSspSelectStockSupplyCanceledByItemIds '34,35',1033,1065 
*/
@StockSupplyItemIds NVARCHAR(4000),
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL
)
AS 
BEGIN 
/**/
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
	IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			 ST.[StockSupplyId]
			,[StockSupplyOprId]
			,'' [StockSupplyOpr]
			,[stsupReferUserId]
			,(SELECT TOP(1) ISNULL(FName +' ', '') + ISNULL(LName,'') FROM [dbo].[Users] U WHERE U.UserId = ST.[stsupReferUserId]) [stsupReferUser]
			,[stsupNumber]
			,[stsupDateTime]
			,[stsupDate]					
			,(SELECT TOP(1) PrdName FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P WHERE ProductID = [stsupIPrdId]) [stsupIPrdName]
			,(SELECT TOP(1) PrdCode FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P WHERE ProductID = [stsupIPrdId]) [stsupIPrdCode]	
		FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] ST
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems] STI ON (ST.StockSupplyId = STI.StockSupplyId)
		WHERE [StockSupplyItemId] IN(SELECT CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@StockSupplyItemIds,','))	
		AND ISNULL([stsupIsCanceled],0) = 1
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(@LanguageID IS NOT NULL AND @LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SELECT 
			 ST.[StockSupplyId]
			,[StockSupplyOprId]
			,'' [StockSupplyOpr]
			,[stsupReferUserId]
			,(SELECT TOP(1) ISNULL(FName +' ', '') + ISNULL(LName,'') FROM [dbo].[Users_Lang] U WHERE U.UserId = ST.[stsupReferUserId] AND U.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [stsupReferUser]
			,[stsupNumber]
			,[stsupDateTime]
			,[stsupDate]					
			,(SELECT TOP(1) PrdName FROM [dbo].[WSProducts_Lang] P WHERE ProductID = [stsupIPrdId] AND P.LanguageID = @LanguageID) [stsupIPrdName]
			,(SELECT TOP(1) PrdCode FROM [dbo].[WSProducts] P WHERE ProductID = [stsupIPrdId]) [stsupIPrdCode]	
		FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply] ST
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[WSStockSupplyItems] STI ON (ST.StockSupplyId = STI.StockSupplyId)
		WHERE [StockSupplyItemId] IN(SELECT CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@StockSupplyItemIds,','))	
		AND ISNULL([stsupIsCanceled],0) = 1					
	/**/
	END		
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

-- [dbo].[WSspTransferCostSheetProduct]





/*RZ991205*/
/*RZ14000117- Issue multi preorder and not save info buyorder and preorder in costsheet*/
/*RZ14000531- Add ctshILength,ctshIWidth*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[WSspTransferCostSheetProduct]
(		
/*
	exec WSspTransferCostSheetProduct 38, 36,37, 3, 2,12,'2021-02-23','13991205','web',1065
*/
@CostSheetProductId INT, 
@FromCostSheetId INT,
@ToCostSheetId INT,
 /**/
@UserId INT,
@FPId INT,
@Month1 INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@AppType NVARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT 
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*-------------------------- Begin define variables ------------------------------*/
DECLARE @FromCostSheetItemId INT,@InsertedCostSheetItemId INT
/*-------------------------- End define variables --------------------------------*/
BEGIN TRY/*RZ960217 For multi language*/
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    /*-------------------------- Set variables -----------------------------------*/
	SET @FromCostSheetItemId = (SELECT TOP 1 [CostSheetItemId] 
								FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] 
								WHERE [CostSheetProductId] = @CostSheetProductId
								AND [CostSheetId] = @FromCostSheetId)	 	
	/*----------------------- Insert Product in toCostSheet ----------------------*/
	IF(ISNULL(@FromCostSheetItemId,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*----------------------- Insert Item in toCostSheet ------------------*/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems]
			([CostSheetId]
			,[CostSheetProductId]
			,[ctshIQuantity]
			,[ctshIWeight]
			,[ctshICost]
			,[ctshITotalCost]
			,[ctshIDesctCurrencyCost]
			,[ctshIDesctCurrencyTotalCost]
			,[ctshIPrice]
			,[ctshIPriceRounded]
			,[ctshITotalPrice]
			,[FirstRegisterUserId]
			,[FirstRegisterDate]
			,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
			,[UserId]
			,[FPId]
			,[Month1]
			,[RegisterDate]
			,[RegisterDatePersian]			
			,[AppType]
			,[LanguageID]
			,[ctshIRoundRate]
			/*,[ctshIBuyOrderId]
			,[ctshIBuyOrderItemId]*/
			,[ctshIPreOrderItemId]
			/*RZ14000531- Add ctshILength,ctshIWidth*/
			,[ctshILength]
			,[ctshIWidth]
			/*RZ14000531- End*/)
		SELECT
			 @ToCostSheetId
			,CostSheetProductId
			,ctshIQuantity
			,ctshIWeight
			,ctshICost
			,ctshITotalCost
			,ctshIDesctCurrencyCost
			,ctshIDesctCurrencyTotalCost
			,ctshIPrice
			,ctshIPriceRounded
			,ctshITotalPrice
			,@UserId
			,@RegisterDate
			,@RegisterDatePersian
			,@UserId
			,@FPId
			,@Month1
			,@RegisterDate
			,@RegisterDatePersian			
			,@AppType
			,@LanguageID
			,ctshIRoundRate
			/*,ctshIBuyOrderId
			,ctshIBuyOrderItemId*/
			,ctshIPreOrderItemId
			/*RZ14000531- Add ctshILength,ctshIWidth*/
			,ctshILength
			,ctshIWidth
			/*RZ14000531- End*/
		FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] 
		WHERE [CostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId	
		SET @InsertedCostSheetItemId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
		/*------------------------ Calculate toCostSheet ----------------------*/
		EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalculateCostSheet]
		@CostSheetId = @ToCostSheetId,
		@UserId = @UserId,
		@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
		@FPId = @FPId,
		@Month1 = @Month1,
		@AppType = @AppType		
		/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
		/*---------------  Update Items in preorde and buyOrder ---------------*/
		DECLARE @ctshIPreOrderItemId INT,@ctshIBuyOrderItemId INT
		/*---- WSPreOrderItems ---*/
		/*SET @ctshIPreOrderItemId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ctshIPreOrderItemId] 
								FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] 
								WHERE [CostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId)	 
		IF(ISNULL(@ctshIPreOrderItemId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/-**-/
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems]
			   SET [pordICostSheetItemId] = @InsertedCostSheetItemId
			WHERE [PreOrderItemId] = @ctshIPreOrderItemId
		/-**-/
		END
		/-*---- WSBuyOrderItems ---*-/
		SET @ctshIBuyOrderItemId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ctshIBuyOrderItemId] 
								FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] 
								WHERE [CostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId)	
		IF(ISNULL(@ctshIBuyOrderItemId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/-**-/
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems]
			   SET [bordICostSheetItemId] = NULL
			WHERE [BuyOrderItemId] = @ctshIBuyOrderItemId
		/-**-/
		END*/
		/*RZ14000117- Issue multi preorder and not save info buyorder and preorder in costsheet*/
		/*---- WSPreOrderItems ---*/		
		SET @ctshIPreOrderItemId = (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderItemId] 
								FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] 
								WHERE [pordICostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId)	 		
		IF(ISNULL(@ctshIPreOrderItemId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*Update PreOrder*/
			DECLARE @PreOrdeId INT,@pordCostSheetIds NVARCHAR(2000)
								
			/*--------------------------------------------*/
			DECLARE Crsr_Update_Pord CURSOR LOCAL FOR				
				SELECT 
					PreOrderID,
					pordCostSheetIds
				FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
				WHERE PreOrderID IN (SELECT TOP 1 [PreOrderId] 
							FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems] 
							WHERE [pordICostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId)
			OPEN Crsr_Update_Pord
			FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Update_Pord INTO @PreOrdeId,@pordCostSheetIds
			WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
			BEGIN
				/*--------------------------------------------*/				
					IF(ISNULL(@pordCostSheetIds,'') <> '')
					BEGIN
					/**/
						DECLARE @FindCtshId INT = 0
						SET @FindCtshId = (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) 
										   FROM [dbo].[fnSplitString](@pordCostSheetIds,',')
										   WHERE CAST(ISNULL(splitdata,0) AS INT) = @ToCostSheetId)
						
						IF(ISNULL(@FindCtshId,0) = 0 )
						BEGIN
							SET @pordCostSheetIds = @pordCostSheetIds + ',' + CAST(@ToCostSheetId AS NVARCHAR(20))							
						END

						UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
							SET [pordCostSheetIds] = @pordCostSheetIds
						WHERE PreOrderID = @PreOrdeId						
					/**/
					END	
			
				/*--------------------------------------------*/
				FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Update_Pord INTO @PreOrdeId,@pordCostSheetIds
			END
			CLOSE Crsr_Update_Pord
			DEALLOCATE Crsr_Update_Pord		
			/*--------------------------------------------*/						
			/**/
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrderItems]
			   SET [pordICostSheetItemId] = @InsertedCostSheetItemId
			WHERE [pordICostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId						
		/**/
		END
		/*---- WSBuyOrderItems ---*/
		SET @ctshIBuyOrderItemId = (SELECT TOP 1 [ctshIBuyOrderItemId] 
								FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] 
								WHERE [CostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId)	
		IF(ISNULL(@ctshIBuyOrderItemId,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			UPDATE [dbo].[WSBuyOrderItems]
			   SET [bordICostSheetItemId] = NULL
			WHERE [BuyOrderItemId] = @ctshIBuyOrderItemId
		/**/
		END		
		/*RZ14000117- End*/		
		/*--------------------- Delete Item from fromCostSheet ----------------*/
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] 
		WHERE [CostSheetItemId] = @FromCostSheetItemId				
		/*------------------------ Calculate fromCostSheet --------------------*/
		EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalculateCostSheet]
		@CostSheetId = @FromCostSheetId,
		@UserId = @UserId,
		@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
		@FPId = @FPId,
		@Month1 = @Month1,
		@AppType = @AppType		
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@FromCostSheetItemId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		DECLARE @ctshRoundRate FLOAT
		SET @ctshRoundRate = (SELECT TOP 1 [ctshRoundRate] FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheets] WHERE CostSheetId = @ToCostSheetId)
		/*----------------------- Insert Item in toCostSheet ------------------*/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems]
			([CostSheetId]
			,[CostSheetProductId]
			,[ctshIQuantity]           
			,[FirstRegisterUserId]
			,[FirstRegisterDate]
			,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
			,[UserId]
			,[FPId]
			,[Month1]
			,[RegisterDate]
			,[RegisterDatePersian]
			,[AppType]
			,[LanguageID]
			,[ctshIRoundRate])
		SELECT
			 @ToCostSheetId
			,[CostSheetProductId]
			,[ctshPrdQuantity]           
			,@UserId
			,@RegisterDate
			,@RegisterDatePersian
			,@UserId
			,@FPId
			,@Month1
			,@RegisterDate
			,@RegisterDatePersian           
			,@AppType
			,@LanguageID
			,@ctshRoundRate
		FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetProducts] CPRD
		WHERE [CostSheetProductId] = @CostSheetProductId
		AND [CostSheetProductId] NOT IN(SELECT CSHI.[CostSheetProductId] 
									    FROM [dbo].[WSCostSheetItems] CSHI
									    WHERE CSHI.CostSheetId = @ToCostSheetId)	 	
		/*------------------------ Calculate toCostSheet ----------------------*/
		EXEC [dbo].[WSspCalculateCostSheet]
		@CostSheetId = @ToCostSheetId,
		@UserId = @UserId,
		@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
		@FPId = @FPId,
		@Month1 = @Month1,
		@AppType = @AppType	
	/**/
	END	
	/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT 1 AS Result    
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
    /**/
	SELECT 0 AS Result 	
END CATCH
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END

		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add INTO @PreOrderCommissionId,@CommDateTime,@CommDatePersian,@CommOrderId
									 ,@CommCmpId,@CommUserId,@CommBaseAmountDec,@CommBaseAmountDecDesc
									 ,@CommBaseAmount,@CommRate,@CommRateDesc,@CommAmount
									 ,@CommAmountCurrUnId,@CommAmountCurrencyRate,@CommEffectiveDateTime
									 ,@CommEffectiveDatePersian,@CommPayTypeId,@CommStatusId
									 ,@CommDesc,@CommIsPaid,@CommIsPaidUserId,@CommIsPaidDateTime
									 ,@CommIsPaidDatePersian,@CommIsPaidPayRollUserCycleId,@LanguageID
	/**/
	END
	CLOSE Crsr_Add
	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add
    SELECT 1 as Result
    
    COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK
    CLOSE Crsr_Add
	DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add
	SELECT 0 as Result
END CATCH

/*NKR14000530*/
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[WSspTransferPreOrderFileToOrderAll]
(		
	/* exec [WSspTransferPreOrderFileToOrderAll] 66,3,2,4,'13960427','dasti' */
	@PreOrderId INT, 
	@OrderId INT,

	/* FileDirectoryId=OrderFileDirectoryTypeId| =======> '5=10|12=50|70=6|50=1|24=13|'*/
	@FileDirectoryTypeIdStr NVARCHAR(4000), 

	@UserId INT,	
	@FPId INT,
	@Year1 SMALLINT,
	@Month1 SMALLINT,
	@RegisterDate DATETIME,
	@RegisterDatePersian VARCHAR(8),
	@AppType NVARCHAR(50),
	@LanguageId INT
)
As
BEGIN
	/**/
	DECLARE
		@FileDirectoryID INT = NULL,
		@FileDirectoryTypeId INT = NULL,
		@MasterId INT = NULL,
		@DetailId INT = NULL,
		@SubDetailId INT = NULL,
		@Title NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
		@FolderName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
		@FileName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
		@FilePath NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
		@CopyFromPath NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
		@DocDate NVARCHAR(8) = NULL,
		@DocDay NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,
		@DocTime NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
		@DocDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
		@TypeOprObjectId INT = NULL,
		@OrderView INT = NULL

	DECLARE 
		@FileDirectoryTypeIdHelp INT = 0,
		@FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
		@FileDirectoryIdHelp INT = 0,
		@OrderFileDirectoryTypeId INT = 0

	DECLARE @TmpTypeTbl table(
		FileDirectoryId INT,
		OrderFileDirectoryTypeId INT
	)


	/**/
	/*================= Create Temp Table From @FileDirectoryTypeIdStr =================*/
	SET @FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp = @FileDirectoryTypeIdStr
	WHILE (LTRIM(RTRIM(@FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp)) <> '')
	BEGIN
		/**/	
		DECLARE @CoupleIdStr NVaRCHAR(200) = ''
		SET @CoupleIdStr = SUBSTRING(@FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp, 1, CHARINDEX('|', @FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp))
		SET @FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp = REPLACE(@FileDirectoryTypeIdStrHelp, @CoupleIdStr, '')
		SET @CoupleIdStr = SUBSTRING(@CoupleIdStr, 1, LEN(@CoupleIdStr)-1)
		IF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@CoupleIdStr)) <> '')
		BEGIN
			SET @FileDirectoryIdHelp = 0
			SET @OrderFileDirectoryTypeId = 0
			/**/
			SET @FileDirectoryIdHelp = CAST(SUBSTRING(@CoupleIdStr, 1, CHARINDEX('=', @CoupleIdStr)-1) AS INT)
			SET @OrderFileDirectoryTypeId = CAST(SUBSTRING(@CoupleIdStr, CHARINDEX('=', @CoupleIdStr)+1, LEN(@CoupleIdStr)) AS INT)
			/**/
			IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @TmpTypeTbl t where t.FileDirectoryId = @FileDirectoryIdHelp AND t.OrderFileDirectoryTypeId = @OrderFileDirectoryTypeId) <= 0)
			BEGIN
				/**/
				insert into @TmpTypeTbl(FileDirectoryId, OrderFileDirectoryTypeId)
				values(@FileDirectoryIdHelp, @OrderFileDirectoryTypeId)
				/**/
			END
		END
		/**/
	END

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
		Declare Crsr_Add CURSOR For
			SELECT 
				FD.FileDirectoryID,
				FD.FileDirectoryTypeId,
				FD.MasterId,
				FD.DetailId,
				FD.SubDetailId,
				FD.Title,
				FD.FolderName,
				FD.[FileName],
				FD.FilePath,
				FD.CopyFromPath,
				FD.DocDate,
				FD.DocDay,
				FD.DocTime,
				FD.DocDateTime,
				FD.TypeOprObjectId,
				FD.OrderView
				/*FD.FileDirectoryNumRef*/
			FROM CrmFilesDirectory FD
			WHERE FileDirectoryTypeId IN (
						SELECT FileDirectoryTypeID 
						FROM dbo.CrmFileDirectoryType 
						WHERE FileDirectoryTypeOprId = 10)
					AND TypeOprObjectId = @PreOrderId
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr_Add
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add INTO 
			@FileDirectoryID, 
			@FileDirectoryTypeId, 
			@MasterId,
			@DetailId,
			@SubDetailId,
			@Title,
			@FolderName,
			@FileName,
			@FilePath,
			@CopyFromPath,
			@DocDate,
			@DocDay,
			@DocTime,
			@DocDateTime,
			@TypeOprObjectId,
			@OrderView
		/**/
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
			/**/
			DECLARE @InsertedId INT = 0
			/**/
			SET @OrderFileDirectoryTypeId = 0
			SET @OrderFileDirectoryTypeId = (SELECT TOP 1 T.OrderFileDirectoryTypeId FROM @TmpTypeTbl T WHERE T.FileDirectoryId = @FileDirectoryTypeId)
			/**/
			INSERT INTO CrmFilesDirectory(
				FileDirectoryTypeId,
				MasterId,
				DetailId,
				SubDetailId,
				Title,
				FolderName,
				[FileName],
				FilePath,
				CopyFromPath,
				UserId,
				Year1,
				Month1,
				RegisterDate,
				RegisterDatePersian,
				DocDate,
				DocDay,
				DocTime,
				DocDateTime,
				TypeOprObjectId,
				AppType,
				LanguageID,
				FirstRegisterUserId,
				FirstRegisterDate,
				FirstRegisterDatePersian,
				OrderView
				/*FileDirectoryNumRef*/
			)
			VALUES( 
				@OrderFileDirectoryTypeId,
				@MasterId,
				@DetailId,
				@SubDetailId,
				@Title,
				@FolderName,
				@FileName,
				@FilePath,
				@CopyFromPath,
				@UserId,
				@Year1,
				@Month1,
				@RegisterDate,
				@RegisterDatePersian,
				@DocDate,
				@DocDay,
				@DocTime,
				@DocDateTime,
				@OrderId,
				@AppType,
				@LanguageId,
				@UserId,
				@RegisterDate,
				@RegisterDatePersian,
				@OrderView
				/*FD.FileDirectoryNumRef*/
			)

			SET @InsertedId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			IF (ISNULL(@InsertedId, 0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				/**/
				INSERT INTO CrmFilesDirectory_Lang(
					FileDirectoryID,
					LanguageID,
					Title
				)
				SELECT 
					@InsertedId,
					FDL.LanguageID,
					FDL.Title
				FROM CrmFilesDirectory_Lang FDL
				WHERE FileDirectoryID = @FileDirectoryId
				/**/
			END
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr_Add INTO 
				@FileDirectoryID, 
				@FileDirectoryTypeId, 
				@MasterId,
				@DetailId,
				@SubDetailId,
				@Title,
				@FolderName,
				@FileName,
				@FilePath,
				@CopyFromPath,
				@DocDate,
				@DocDay,
				@DocTime,
				@DocDateTime,
				@TypeOprObjectId,
				@OrderView
		END
		CLOSE Crsr_Add
		DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add
		SELECT 1 as Result
    
		COMMIT
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			ROLLBACK
		CLOSE Crsr_Add
		DEALLOCATE Crsr_Add
		SELECT 0 as Result
	END CATCH
	/**/
END

	@Month1 SMALLINT,

BEGIN
	/**/
	/*RZ14010603- Add ordProjectId*/

	SET @ordProjectId = (SELECT TOP(1) ordProjectId FROM WSOrder WHERE OrderID = @OrderId)

		FirstRegisterDatePersian,
		OrderView,
		FileFOCmpCanSee,/*NKR14000601*/
		FileDirectoryParentId/*NKR14000601*/
		/*FileDirectoryNumRef*/
	)
	SELECT 
		@FileDirectoryTypeId,
		FD.MasterId,
		FD.DetailId,
		/*FD.SubDetailId,*/
		@ordProjectId,/*RZ14010603- Add ordProjectId*/
		FD.Title,
		FD.FolderName,
		FD.[FileName],
		FD.FilePath,
		FD.CopyFromPath,
		@UserId,
		@Year1,
		@Month1,
		@RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian,
		FD.DocDate,
		FD.DocDay,
		FD.DocTime,
		FD.DocDateTime,
		@OrderId,
		@AppType,
		@LanguageId,
		@UserId,
		@RegisterDate,
		@RegisterDatePersian,
		FD.OrderView,
		FileFOCmpCanSee,/*NKR14000601*/
		FD.FileDirectoryID /*NKR14000601*/
		/*FD.FileDirectoryNumRef*/
	FROM CrmFilesDirectory FD
	WHERE  fd.FileDirectoryID = @FileDirectoryId and
			fd.FileDirectoryID not in (
				select d.FileDirectoryParentId from CrmFilesDirectory d 
				where TypeOprObjectId = @OrderId and 
					d.FileDirectoryTypeId IN (
						SELECT FileDirectoryTypeID 
						FROM dbo.CrmFileDirectoryType 
						WHERE FileDirectoryTypeOprId = 20)
			)

			
	/*
	FileDirectoryParentId <> @FileDirectoryId
	FileDirectoryTypeId IN (
			SELECT FileDirectoryTypeID 
			FROM dbo.CrmFileDirectoryType 
			WHERE FileDirectoryTypeOprId = 10)
	AND TypeOprObjectId = @PreOrderId
	*/

	SET @InsertedId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	IF (ISNULL(@InsertedId, 0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		/**/
		INSERT INTO CrmFilesDirectory_Lang(
			FileDirectoryID,
			LanguageID,
			Title
		)
		SELECT 
			@InsertedId,
			FDL.LanguageID,
			FDL.Title
		FROM CrmFilesDirectory_Lang FDL
		WHERE FileDirectoryID = @FileDirectoryId
		/**/
	END
	/**/
END

/*RZ14020912- Add WSStockSupply and buyOrder*/
/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
/*RZ14030116- Check discount strategy*/
/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[WSspVerificationRequestVerify]
(		
/* 
	EXEC WSspVerificationRequestVerify 		
*/
@VerificationWorkFlowId INT,
@ObjectId INT,
@VerificationRequestId INT,
@VerificationWorkFlowStepId INT,
@VerifyText NVARCHAR(MAX),
@VerifyTextLang NVARCHAR(MAX),
@MsgSubject NVARCHAR(200),
@VerifiedMsgSubject NVARCHAR(200),
@RollId INT,
@RegisterDate DATETIME,
@RegisterDatePersian NVARCHAR(8),
@UserId INT,
@FPId INT,
@Year1 SMALLINT,
@Month1 SMALLINT,
@AppType VARCHAR(20),
@LanguageID INT = NULL,
@DefaultLanguageID INT = NULL,
@MaxDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2) OUTPUT,
@Result NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT 
)
AS
BEGIN
/**/
/*===================================== Define variables ==================================*/
DECLARE @ObjectType INT, @SequenceObservation BIT,
@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive BIT,@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),
@LimitOrderDiscountActive BIT,@LimitOrderDiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),
@DiscountPercent NUMERIC(18,2),@SumPriceAmount NUMERIC(18,2),
@SumDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),
@MsgTypeId INT,@VerifyUserId INT, @RegisterTime NVARCHAR(8),@InternalMessageId INT
/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
,@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount NUMERIC(18,2),@TotalDiscountSum NUMERIC(18,2)
/*RZ14001018- End*/
,@SumStrategeyDisAmount NUMERIC(18,2) = NULL/*RZ14030116- Check discount strategy*/
SET @RegisterTime = CAST(@RegisterDate AS TIME)
/*============================= SET Object and @SequenceObservation =======================*/	
SELECT @ObjectType = [ObjectType], @SequenceObservation = [SequenceObservation]
FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlows]
WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId
/*================================= Check Discount Percent ================================*/
SELECT @LimitPreOrderDiscountActive = LimitPreOrderDiscountActive, 
@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent = LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent,
@LimitOrderDiscountActive = LimitOrderDiscountActive,
@LimitOrderDiscountPercent = LimitOrderDiscountPercent
FROM dbo.CrmsysRolls
WHERE ID = @RollId

IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 10)/*PreOrder*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @MaxDiscountPercent = ISNULL(@LimitPreOrderDiscountPercent,0)
	END
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @pordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2)
		SET @pordDiscount = (SELECT pordDiscount FROM dbo.WSPreOrder WHERE PreOrderID = @ObjectId)
		SELECT 
			@SumPriceAmount = SumPriceAmount,
			@SumDiscount = SumDiscount, 
			/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount ,
			@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
			/*RZ14001018- End*/
		FROM [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)				

		/**/		
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		/*IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0)		
			SET @Result = '-1' /-*DivisionByZero*-/
		ELSE*/	
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 )	
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)

			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/					
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')	/*RZ14000202- Modify for DivisionByZero*//*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@SumDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)*//*calculate product discount*/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/

			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)/*calculate preorder discount*/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
				SET @Result = '-3' /*The pre-order discount is too high*/	
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		ELSE IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@pordDiscount,0) <> 0)	
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-1' /*DivisionByZero*/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/		
	END
	/*----------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14030116- Check discount strategy*/
	SET @SumStrategeyDisAmount = NULL
	IF(ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM .[dbo].[WSPreOrderDiscounts]WHERE [pordDisPreOrderId] = @ObjectId),0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @SumStrategeyDisAmount = (SELECT SUM(ISNULL([pordDisAmount],0)) [SumPordDisAmount]
									  FROM .[dbo].[WSPreOrderDiscounts]
									  WHERE [pordDisPreOrderId] = @ObjectId)
		IF(ISNULL(@SumStrategeyDisAmount,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @TotalDiscountSum = NULL
			SELECT 
				@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum			
			FROM [dbo].[WSfnReturnPreOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)	
			IF(ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @Result = '-7' /*Not Add discount strategy to items*/
			END
			ELSE IF(ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) <> 0)
			BEGIN
				IF(ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) <> ISNULL(@SumStrategeyDisAmount,0))
				BEGIN
					SET @Result = '-8' /*different discount strategy with sum item discount*/
				END
			END
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14030116- End*/
	/*----------------------------------------------*/	
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 20)/*Order*/
BEGIN
/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountActive,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @MaxDiscountPercent = ISNULL(@LimitOrderDiscountPercent,0)
	END
	/**/
	IF(ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ordDiscount NUMERIC(18,2)
		SET @ordDiscount = (SELECT ordDiscount FROM dbo.WSOrder WHERE OrderID = @ObjectId)
		SELECT 
			@SumPriceAmount = SumPriceAmount,
			@SumDiscount = SumDiscount,
			/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount = TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount ,
			@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum
			/*RZ14001018- End*/
		FROM [dbo].[WSfnReturnOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)
		/**/		
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		/*IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0)		
			SET @Result = '-1' /-*DivisionByZero*-/
		ELSE*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 )	
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)
			/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
		/**/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/
		IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')	/*RZ14000202- Modify for DivisionByZero*//*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
		BEGIN
			/*SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@SumDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)*//*calculate product discount*/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@TotalPriceSumWithoutDiscount,0)/*RZ14001018- Modify Calculate discount in item*/
			/**/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
			SET @Result = '-2' /*The product discount is too high*/
			/**/
			SET @DiscountPercent = (ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0) * 100) / ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0)/*calculate order discount*/
			IF(ISNULL(@DiscountPercent,0) > ISNULL(@MaxDiscountPercent,0) AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
				SET @Result = '-3' /*The order discount is too high*/	
		END
		/*RZ14021108- Check for a preorder not items*/
		ELSE IF(ISNULL(@SumPriceAmount,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(@ordDiscount,0) <> 0)	
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-1' /*DivisionByZero*/
		END
		/*RZ14021108- End*/

	END
	/*----------------------------------------------*/
	/*RZ14030116- Check discount strategy*/
	SET @SumStrategeyDisAmount = NULL
	IF(ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM .[dbo].[WSOrderDiscounts]WHERE [ordDisOrderId] = @ObjectId),0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @SumStrategeyDisAmount = (SELECT SUM(ISNULL([ordDisAmount],0)) [SumOrdDisAmount]
									  FROM .[dbo].[WSOrderDiscounts]
									  WHERE [ordDisOrderId] = @ObjectId)
		IF(ISNULL(@SumStrategeyDisAmount,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @TotalDiscountSum = NULL
			SELECT 
				@TotalDiscountSum = TotalDiscountSum			
			FROM [dbo].[WSfnReturnOrderSumFooter](@ObjectId)
			IF(ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @Result = '-7' /*Not Add discount strategy to items*/
			END
			ELSE IF(ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) <> 0)
			BEGIN
				IF(ISNULL(@TotalDiscountSum,0) <> ISNULL(@SumStrategeyDisAmount,0))
				BEGIN
					SET @Result = '-8' /*different discount strategy with sum item discount*/
				END
			END
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14030116- End*/
	/*----------------------------------------------*/
/**/
END
/*RZ14001128- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to dyform*/
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 80)/*DyForm*/
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @DyWorkflowId INT = 0;
	SET @DyWorkflowId = (SELECT TOP (1) [WorkflowId]
						FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
						WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @ObjectId)

	IF(ISNULL(@DyWorkflowId,0) <> 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/	
		IF(EXISTS (SELECT [FormId] 
					FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValueDetails] VMD 
					WHERE VMD.[MasterValueId] = @ObjectId
					AND  ISNULL(VMD.[IsChecked],0) = 0
					AND VMD.FormId <> (SELECT MV.FormId FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues] MV WHERE MV.FormFieldMasterValueId = @ObjectId)))
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @Result = '-6' /*the mastervalue hav masterValueDetails in workflow not checked*/	
		/**/	
		END
	/**/
	END
/**/
END
/*RZ14001128- End*/



/*================================== Check steps before current step ======================*/
IF(ISNULL(@SequenceObservation,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(@Result,'') ='')
BEGIN
/**/
	DECLARE @StepBfCurrId INT
	SET @StepBfCurrId = (SELECT TOP 1 [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]       	   
							FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
							WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId
							AND ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId]) < (SELECT ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])  
																						FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWSI 
																						WHERE VWSI.[VerificationWorkFlowStepId] = @VerificationWorkFlowStepId)
							AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] NOT IN (SELECT  [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]      
																	 FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails] VRD 
																	 WHERE VRD.[VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId)	
							ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId]))
	IF(ISNULL(@StepBfCurrId,0) > 0 )
	BEGIN
		IF(@LanguageID IS NULL OR @LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID)
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-4|' + ISNULL((SELECT [VerificationWorkFlowStepTitle]  	   
											FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
											WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] = @StepBfCurrId),'')
		END
		ELSE IF(@LanguageID <> @DefaultLanguageID)
		BEGIN
			SET @Result = '-4|' + ISNULL((SELECT [VerificationWorkFlowStepTitle] 	   
											FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps_Lang] VWS
											WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] = @StepBfCurrId AND VWS.LanguageID = @LanguageID),'')	
		END

	END
/**/
END

/*=========================================================================================*/
/*-----------------------------------*/
/*RZ14020607- Add cmpReferUserId and cmpSuppUserId to verifyUser*/
DECLARE @CompanyId INT = NULL, @cmpReferUserId INT = NULL, @cmpSuppUserId INT = NULL

/*----------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 10) /*pord*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = pordCompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
	WHERE PreOrderID = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 20) /*ord*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = ordCompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[WSOrder]
	WHERE OrderID = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
/*RZ14020912- Add WSStockSupply and buyOrder*/
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 40) /*bord*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = bordCompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[WSBuyOrder]
	WHERE BuyOrderID = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 45) /*stsup*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = stsupCompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[WSStockSupply]
	WHERE StockSupplyId = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
/*RZ14020912- End*/
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 60) /*doc*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = CompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[WSDoc]
	WHERE DocID = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 80) /*dyForm*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = CompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
	WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 90 OR ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 100) /*Leave Or Mission*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = CompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[CrmLeave]
	WHERE [LeaveId] = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
ELSE IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) = 110) /*Letter*/
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1) 
		@CompanyId = LetterCompanyId
	FROM [dbo].[SecLetters]
	WHERE [LetterId] = @ObjectId	
/**/
END
/*RZ14030308- End*/
/*----------------------*/
IF(ISNULL(@CompanyId,0) <> 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP(1)
		 @cmpReferUserId = cmpReferUserId
		,@cmpSuppUserId = cmpSuppUserId
	FROM [dbo].[CrmCompany]
	WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyId
/**/
END
/*RZ14020607- End*/
/*-----------------------------------*/
/*RZ14011210- Add responsible user*/
DECLARE @ResponsibleUserId INT
DECLARE @VerificationReqUserIdI INT
SELECT @VerificationReqUserIdI = [VerificationReqUserId] FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequests] WHERE [VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId
IF(ISNULL(@SequenceObservation,0) = 1)
BEGIN
/**/	
	SELECT TOP 1
		 @VerifyUserId = [VerifyUserId]	
	FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
	WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowId] = @VerificationWorkFlowId
	AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] NOT IN (SELECT  [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]      
												FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails] VRD 
												WHERE VRD.[VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId)
	AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] <> @VerificationWorkFlowStepId
	ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])			
	IF(ISNULL(@VerifyUserId,0) = -101)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @ResponsibleUserId = (SELECT TOP(1) [ResponsibleUserId] FROM [dbo].[Users] U WHERE U.UserId = @VerificationReqUserIdI)
		IF(ISNULL(@ResponsibleUserId,0) = 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @Result = '-101' /*Not Set Responsible*/
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14020607- Add cmpReferUserId and cmpSuppUserId to verifyUser*/
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@VerifyUserId,0) = -102 AND ISNULL(@cmpReferUserId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @Result = '-102' /*Not Set cmpReferUserId*/
	/**/
	END
	ELSE IF(ISNULL(@VerifyUserId,0) = -103 AND ISNULL(@cmpSuppUserId,0) = 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @Result = '-103' /*Not Set cmpSuppUserId*/
	/**/
	END
	/*RZ14020607- End*/
/**/
END IF(ISNULL(@SequenceObservation,0) = 0)
BEGIN
/**/
	SELECT TOP 1
		 @VerifyUserId = [VerifyUserId]	
	FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
	WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowId] = @VerificationWorkFlowId
	AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] NOT IN (SELECT  [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]      
												FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails] VRD 
												WHERE VRD.[VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId)
	AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] <> @VerificationWorkFlowStepId
	AND [VerifyUserId] = -101
	ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])

	IF(ISNULL(@VerifyUserId,0) = -101)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @ResponsibleUserId = (SELECT TOP(1) [ResponsibleUserId] FROM [dbo].[Users] U WHERE U.UserId = @VerificationReqUserIdI)
		IF(ISNULL(@ResponsibleUserId,0) = 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @Result = '-101' /*Not Set Responsible*/
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END	
	
	/*RZ14020607- Add cmpReferUserId and cmpSuppUserId to verifyUser*/
	IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @VerifyUserId = NULL
		SELECT TOP(1)
			@VerifyUserId = [VerifyUserId]
		FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
		WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId	
		AND [VerifyUserId] = -102
		ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])

		IF(ISNULL(@VerifyUserId,0) = -102 AND ISNULL(@cmpReferUserId,0) = 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @Result = '-102' /*Not Set cmpReferUserId*/
		/**/
		END		
	/**/
	END
	
	/*--------*/
	IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
	BEGIN
	/**/
		SET @VerifyUserId = NULL
		SELECT TOP(1)
			@VerifyUserId = [VerifyUserId]
		FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
		WHERE VerificationWorkFlowId = @VerificationWorkFlowId	
		AND [VerifyUserId] = -103
		ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])
		IF(ISNULL(@VerifyUserId,0) = -103 AND ISNULL(@cmpSuppUserId,0) = 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			SET @Result = '-103' /*Not Set cmpSuppUserId*/
		/**/
		END
	/**/
	END	
	/*RZ14020607- End*/	
/**/
END
SET @VerifyUserId = NULL
	
/*RZ14011210- End*/
/*===================================== Verify Request =====================================*/
IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
BEGIN
/**/	
	/*======================== Create Tmp table for language ==========================*/
	/*Sample= @VerifyTextLang = N'[LangId=1033|,|Txt=TextI|,|Subj=subjectI|,|VerifiedSubj=vSubjI|,|]@[LangId=1025|,|Txt=TextII|,|Subj=subjectII|,|VerifiedSubj=vSubjII|,|]@',*/
	DECLARE @TmpTable TABLE (
		[LangId] INT,
		[Txt] NVARCHAR(MAX),
		[Subj] NVARCHAR(200),
		[VerifiedSubj] NVARCHAR(200)
	)
	DECLARE @LangId INT,@Txt NVARCHAR(MAX), @Subj NVARCHAR(200),@Text NVARCHAR(MAX),@VerifiedSubj NVARCHAR(200)
	IF(ISNULL(@VerifyTextLang,'') <> '')
	BEGIN
		/**/	
		DECLARE Crsr Cursor For
		/**/	
			SELECT SplitData  
			FROM fnSplitString(@VerifyTextLang, '@')
		/**/
		OPEN Crsr
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @Text
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*================================================================================*/
			DECLARE @Field NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
			SET @LangId = NULL
			SET @Txt = NULL
			SET @Subj = NULL
			SET @VerifiedSubj = NULL
			/**/
			/*****************************************************************/
			IF(ISNULL(@Text,'') <> '') 
			BEGIN
			/**/
				SET @Text = SUBSTRING(@Text, 2, LEN(@Text)-2)			
				/*===================== Get Fields ==========================*/
				WHILE LEN(@Text) > 0
				BEGIN
					IF PATINDEX('%|,|%', @Text) > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @Field = SUBSTRING(@Text, 0, PATINDEX('%|,|%', @Text))
						/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						/*Get parameter name and split value form parameter*/
						/*For example => LangId=1065 => LangId= => LangId => Compare => value*/
						DECLARE @FieldValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
						DECLARE @FieldName NVARCHAR(200)
						SET @FieldName = SUBSTRING(@Field, 1, CHARINDEX('=',@Field)-1)                                    
						SET @FieldValue = SUBSTRING(@Field, CHARINDEX('=', @Field)+1, Len(@Field))
						/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						/*---------------------------- BEGIN Fill variabele ------------------------------*/
						/*BEGIN*/
						IF @FieldName = 'LangId'
						BEGIN
							SET @LangId = CASE WHEN CAST(ISNULL(@FieldValue,'0') AS INT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(@FieldValue AS INT) END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'Txt'
						BEGIN
							SET @Txt = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'Subj'
						BEGIN
							SET @Subj = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/
						IF @FieldName = 'VerifiedSubj'
						BEGIN
							SET @VerifiedSubj = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldValue,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE @FieldValue END
						END
						/*--------------------------*/				
						/*END */
						/*---------------------------- END Fill variabele --------------------------------*/
						/*---------------------------- Remove current parameter from listparam ------------*/
						SET @Text = SUBSTRING(@Text,LEN(@Field + '|,|') + 1,LEN(@Text))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @Field = @Text
						SET @Text = NULL       
					END
				END
				/*===========================================================*/
				INSERT INTO @TmpTable ([LangId],Txt,Subj,VerifiedSubj)
				VALUES(@LangId,@Txt,@Subj,@VerifiedSubj)
			/**/
			END
			/*================================================================================*/					    				 					
		/**/	
		FETCH NEXT FROM Crsr INTO @Text
		END
		CLOSE Crsr
		DEALLOCATE Crsr
	/**/
	END		
	/*============================= Insert into WSVerificationRequestDetails ===================*/	
	DECLARE @VerificationRequestDetailId INT
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails]
           ([VerificationRequestId]
           ,[ObjectId]
           ,[ObjectType]
           ,[VerificationWorkFlowId]
           ,[VerificationWorkFlowStepId]
           ,[VerifyUserId]
           ,[VerifyDateTime]
           ,[VerifyText]
           ,[FirstRegisterUserId]
           ,[FirstRegisterDate]
           ,[FirstRegisterDatePersian]
           ,[UserId]
           ,[Year1]
           ,[Month1]
           ,[RegisterDate]
           ,[RegisterDatePersian]
           ,[AppType]
           ,[LanguageID])
    VALUES
           (@VerificationRequestId
           ,@ObjectId
           ,@ObjectType
           ,@VerificationWorkFlowId
           ,@VerificationWorkFlowStepId
           ,@UserId
           ,@RegisterDate
           ,@VerifyText
           ,@UserId
           ,@RegisterDate
           ,@RegisterDatePersian
           ,@UserId
           ,@FPId
           ,@Month1
           ,@RegisterDate
           ,@RegisterDatePersian
           ,@AppType
           ,@DefaultLanguageID)
	SET @VerificationRequestDetailId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	IF(ISNULL(@VerificationRequestDetailId,0) > 0)
	BEGIN
	/**/
		/*Insert into lang tabel*/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails_Lang]
           ([VerificationRequestDetailId]
           ,[LanguageID]
           ,[VerifyText])
		SELECT
            @VerificationRequestDetailId
           ,[LangId]
           ,[Txt]
		FROM @TmpTable
		WHERE [LangId] <> 0
		/**/
		/*============================= IsFixed Object =======================*/	
		IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) > 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*Add (@ObjectType = 30) ==> BuyOrder,(@ObjectType = 40) ==> Do */
			IF(@ObjectType = 10)/*PreOrder*/
			BEGIN
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSPreOrder]
					SET [pordIsFixed] = 1      
				WHERE PreOrderID = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 5
			END
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 20)/*Order*/
			BEGIN
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSOrder]
					SET [ordIsFixed] = 1      
				WHERE OrderID = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 8
			END
			/*RZ14020912- Add WSStockSupply and buyOrder*/
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 40)/*BuyOrder*/
			BEGIN
			/**/
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSBuyOrder]
					SET [bordIsFixed] = 1      
				WHERE BuyOrderID = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 9	
			/**/
			END
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 45)/*StockSupply*/
			BEGIN
			/**/
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSStockSupply]
					SET [stsupIsFixed] = 1      
				WHERE StockSupplyId = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 21	
			/**/
			END
			/*RZ14020912- End*/
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 80)/*DyForm*//*RZ14001128- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to dyform*/
			BEGIN
			/**/				
				SET @MsgTypeId = 16
			/**/
			END
			/*RZ14010929- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to doc*/
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 60)/*Doc*/
			BEGIN
			/**/
				UPDATE [dbo].[WSDoc]
					SET [IsFix] = 1      
				WHERE DocID = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 20	
			/**/
			END
			/*RZ14010929- End*/
			/*AI14011113*/
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 90)/*leave*/
			BEGIN
				UPDATE [dbo].[CrmLeave]
				   SET [VerificationWorkFlowId] = @VerificationWorkFlowId      
				WHERE [LeaveId] = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 6
			END
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 100)/*mission*/
			BEGIN
				UPDATE [dbo].[CrmLeave]
				   SET [VerificationWorkFlowId] = @VerificationWorkFlowId      
				WHERE [LeaveId] = @ObjectId
				SET @MsgTypeId = 7
			END
			/*AI14011113-End*/
			/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
			ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 110) /*Letter*/
			BEGIN
			/**/
				/*UPDATE [dbo].[SecLetters]
					SET [IsFix] = 1      
				WHERE LetterId = @ObjectId*/
				SET @MsgTypeId = 14	
			/**/
			END
			/*RZ14030308- End*/
		END
		/*============================= Find next step =======================*/	
		DECLARE @NextStepId INT,@NextStepVerifyUserId INT
		SELECT TOP 1
			 @NextStepId = [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]
			/*,@NextStepVerifyUserId = [VerifyUserId]	*/			
			/*RZ14011210- Add responsible user*/
			,@NextStepVerifyUserId = (CASE WHEN ISNULL([VerifyUserId],0) = -101
										THEN (SELECT TOP(1) [ResponsibleUserId] 
												FROM [dbo].[Users] U
												WHERE U.UserId = @VerificationReqUserIdI										   
											)
										/*RZ14020607- Add cmpReferUserId and cmpSuppUserId to verifyUser*/
										WHEN ISNULL([VerifyUserId],0) = -102
										THEN (@cmpReferUserId)
										WHEN ISNULL([VerifyUserId],0) = -103
										THEN (@cmpSuppUserId)
										/*RZ14020607- End*/
										ELSE [VerifyUserId]
									END)
			/*RZ14011210- End*/
		FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationWorkFlowSteps] VWS
		WHERE [VerificationWorkFlowId] = @VerificationWorkFlowId
		AND [VerificationWorkFlowStepId] NOT IN (SELECT  [VerificationWorkFlowStepId]      
												 FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequestDetails] VRD 
												 WHERE VRD.[VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId)
		ORDER BY ISNULL([OrderView],[VerificationWorkFlowStepId])			
		/*======================= GET VerificationReqUserId ==================*/
		DECLARE @VerificationReqUserId INT
		SELECT @VerificationReqUserId = [VerificationReqUserId] FROM [dbo].[WSVerificationRequests] WHERE [VerificationRequestId] = @VerificationRequestId
		/*============================= Send Message =======================*/	
		IF(ISNULL(@NextStepId,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@SequenceObservation,0) = 1)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*EXEC [dbo].[CRMspInternalMessageLoadReceiver] @crmUserId = @VerificationReqUserId
			EXEC [dbo].[CRMspIntMsgUpdateSelectReceiver]
						@crmUserId = @VerificationReqUserId,@UserId = @NextStepVerifyUserId,@Selected = 1, @Mode  = 1  */

			/*AI14011223 - instead of [CRMspInternalMessageSend]*/
			EXEC [dbo].[CRMspInternalMessageSendSingle]
						@msgMasterId = NULL,
						@msgSubject = @MsgSubject,
						@msgBody = @VerifyText,
						/*@msgActiveInCycle = NULL, AI14011223*/
						@msgdTypeId = @MsgTypeId,
						@msgdFromUserId = @VerificationReqUserId,
						@msgdToUserId = @NextStepVerifyUserId,
						@msgdSendDate=@RegisterDatePersian,
						@msgdSendTime = @RegisterTime,
						@msgdSendDateTime = @RegisterDate,
						@msgdPriorityId = NULL,
						@msgdAttachFile = NULL,
						@msgdAttachRecId = @ObjectId,
						@msgdAttachRecDesc = NULL,
						@msgdGroupId  = NULL,
						@UserId = @UserId,
						@Year1 = @Year1,
						@Month1 = @Month1,
						@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
						@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
						@AppType = @AppType, 
						@InsertedID = @InternalMessageId OUTPUT, /*AI14011223 - instead of @InternalMessageID*/
						@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID,
						@msgdAttachRecIdI = @NextStepId,
						@msgdAttachRecDescI = NULL

			/*Insert Lang table*/
			IF(ISNULL(@InternalMessageId,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmInternalMessage_Lang]
					([InternalMessageID]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[msgSubject]
					,[msgBody])
				SELECT
					@InternalMessageId
					,[LangId]
					,Subj
					,Txt
				FROM @TmpTable 
				WHERE [LangId] <> 0 
			END			
		/**/
		END
		ELSE IF(ISNULL(@NextStepId,0) = 0)
		BEGIN
		/**/
			/*============================= Verify Object =============================*/	
			IF(ISNULL(@ObjectType,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
			/**/
				/*Add (@ObjectType = 40) ==> BuyOrder,(@ObjectType = 60) ==> Do */
				IF(@ObjectType = 10)/*PreOrder*/
				BEGIN
					EXEC dbo.WSspPreOrderVerify @ObjectId,@UserId,@RegisterDatePersian
				END
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 20)/*Order*/
				BEGIN
					EXEC dbo.WSspOrderVerify @ObjectId,@UserId,@RegisterDatePersian
				END
				/*RZ14020912- Add WSStockSupply and buyOrder*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 40)/*BuyOrder*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.WSspBuyOrderVerify
					@BuyOrderId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 45)/*Stocksupply*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.WSspStockSupplyVerify
					@StockSupplyId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				/*RZ14020912- End*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 80)/*DyForm*//*RZ14001128- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to dyform*/
				BEGIN
				/**/

					DECLARE @DyFrmWorkflowId INT = 0;
					SET @DyFrmWorkflowId = (SELECT TOP (1) [WorkflowId]
										FROM [dbo].[CrmDyFormFieldMasterValues]
										WHERE [FormFieldMasterValueId] = @ObjectId)

					IF(ISNULL(@DyFrmWorkflowId,0) = 0)/*normal form*/
					BEGIN
					/**/	
						EXEC dbo.CRMspDyFormCheck 
						@MasterValueId = @ObjectId,
						@CheckerUserId = @UserId,
						@CheckedDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
						@Mode = 1
					/**/
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
					/**/	
						EXEC dbo.CRMspDyFormCheck 
						@MasterValueId = @ObjectId,
						@CheckerUserId = @UserId,
						@CheckedDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
						@Mode = 2
					/**/
					END					
				/**/
				END
				/*RZ14010929- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to doc*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 60)/*Doc*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.WSspDocVerify
					@DocId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@VerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@VerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				/*RZ14010929- End*/
				/*AI14011113*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 90)/*leave*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.CRMspLeaveVerify
					@LeaveId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@VerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@VerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 100)/*mission*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC dbo.CRMspLeaveVerify
					@LeaveId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,
					@VerifiedRegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
					@VerifiedRegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian
				/**/
				END
				/*AI14011113-End*/
				/*RZ14030308- Add VerificationWorkFlowId to letter*/
				ELSE IF(@ObjectType = 110) /*Letter*/
				BEGIN
				/**/
					EXEC [dbo].[SecspLetterVerify]
					@LetterId = @ObjectId,
					@VerifierUserId = @UserId,					
					@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
					@AppType = @AppType					
				/**/
				END
				/*RZ14030308- End*/
			END
			/*======================== Expired All Request but current request ========*/
			EXEC WSspUpdateVerificationRequestsExpired 
				@VerificationRequestId = @VerificationRequestId,
				@VerificationWorkFlowId = 0,
				@ObjectId = @ObjectId,
				@ObjectType = @ObjectType,
				@Expired = 1,
				@LanguageID = @LanguageID,
				@DefaultLanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID
			/*================== Send Message for the object is verified ==============*/
			/*EXEC [dbo].[CRMspInternalMessageLoadReceiver] @crmUserId = @UserId
			EXEC [dbo].[CRMspIntMsgUpdateSelectReceiver]
				@crmUserId = @UserId,@UserId = @VerificationReqUserId,@Selected = 1, @Mode  = 1 AI14011223 */

			/*AI14011223 - instead of [CRMspInternalMessageSend]*/
			EXEC [dbo].[CRMspInternalMessageSendSingle]
				@msgMasterId = NULL,
				@msgSubject = @VerifiedMsgSubject,
				@msgBody = @VerifyText,
				/*@msgActiveInCycle = NULL, AI14011223*/
				@msgdTypeId = @MsgTypeId,
				@msgdFromUserId = @UserId,
				@msgdToUserId = @VerificationReqUserId,
				@msgdSendDate=@RegisterDatePersian,
				@msgdSendTime = @RegisterTime,
				@msgdSendDateTime = @RegisterDate,
				@msgdPriorityId = NULL,
				@msgdAttachFile = NULL,
				@msgdAttachRecId = @ObjectId,
				@msgdAttachRecDesc = NULL,
				@msgdGroupId  = NULL,
				@UserId = @UserId,
				@Year1 = @Year1,
				@Month1 = @Month1,
				@RegisterDate = @RegisterDate,
				@RegisterDatePersian = @RegisterDatePersian,
				@AppType = @AppType, 
				@InsertedID = @InternalMessageId OUTPUT, /*AI14011223 - instead of @InternalMessageID*/
				@LanguageID = @DefaultLanguageID,
				@msgdAttachRecIdI = NULL,
				@msgdAttachRecDescI = NULL
			/*Insert Lang table*/
			IF(ISNULL(@InternalMessageId,0) > 0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[CrmInternalMessage_Lang]
					([InternalMessageID]
					,[LanguageID]
					,[msgSubject]
					,[msgBody])
				SELECT
					@InternalMessageId
					,[LangId]
					,[VerifiedSubj]
					,[Txt]
				FROM @TmpTable 
				WHERE [LangId] <> 0 
			END			
			/*=========================================================================*/
		/**/
		END		
	/**/
	END
	ELSE
		SET @Result = '-5'/*error in insert into WSVerificationRequestDetails*/
/**/
END
/*======================================================================*/
IF(ISNULL(@Result,'') = '')
	SET @Result = '1' /*OK*/
/**/
END
